We're a team of passionate innovators, leveraging the latest in AI and technology to transform the future of mobility. Our platform enhances road safety and traffic management by turning real-time data into actionable insights for cities and road operators. Our patented technology collects and analyzes data from connected sensors like cameras, radar, and traffic signal controllers to help predict and prevent road incidents. We deploy edge and cloud solutions that make intersections and highways safer and smarter.<br><br><strong>Role Overview<br><br></strong>We are looking for a Sales Solutions Engineer to provide pre-sales technical support and documentation to our Sales team, while helping customers and partners understand how Derq's AI-powered traffic analytics improves road safety and traffic operations.<br><br>In this role, you will translate customer requirements into clear solution designs, technical proposals, and compelling demos. You'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to position Derq's solutions effectively and support successful deployments. You will also build strong relationships with traffic consulting firms, infrastructure partners, and technology consultants to expand Derq's presence in the ITS ecosystem.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Provide pre-sales technical support to the Sales team, including solution design, technical documentation, and customer-facing materials. </li><li> Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand requirements, constraints, and success criteria (public sector and commercial). </li><li> Deliver product demos and technical presentations, clearly explaining Derq's value and differentiators to technical and non-technical stakeholders. </li><li> Own technical parts of proposals, including RFP/RFI responses, compliance questions, and clarifications. </li><li> Gather and document technical requirements, system interfaces, integration approach, and deployment assumptions for handover to Projects and Engineering. </li><li> Support pre-award planning by drafting initial scopes, timelines, and high-level budgets with the Project team, then ensure a clean transition post-award. </li><li> Act as the technical point of contact for consultants, infrastructure partners, and technology partners during the sales cycle to drive adoption and integration opportunities. </li><li> Maintain accurate, up-to-date notes, opportunities, and technical details in the CRM to keep pipeline execution clean. </li><li> Stay current on ITS and smart mobility trends (traffic management, road safety, AI analytics, funding programs) to inform solution positioning and proposals<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions consulting, or a related role within the traffic management or smart infrastructure industry</li><li>Deep understanding of traffic safety, ITS, and the ability to recognize opportunities where Derq's solutions can drive value</li><li>Strong relationships with traffic consultants, infrastructure firms, or transportation agencies</li><li>Proven ability to build relationships and influence decision-makers in complex organizations</li><li>Strong technical background with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business solutions</li><li>Excellent negotiation skills, with a focus on creating mutual value for partners</li><li>Highly organized with exceptional communication and project management skills</li><li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment</li></ul>

metadata.description: FutureSight is seeking an experienced and visionary Founding CEO to lead the launch of a new AI-native platform that transforms how government contractors win proposals.<br><br>Government contractors are drowning in complexity. Proposal teams juggle chasing SMEs, hunting through outdated content, and manually tracking compliance — coordinating across BD, legal, and finance. The result: slower proposals, lower win rates (&lt;45%), and high stress.<br><br>Our venture reimagines this workflow. We're building an AI-enabled orchestration platform that streamlines SME coordination, automates compliance tracking, and intelligently reuses knowledge — all while preserving the human + SME voice in proposals. Contractors move faster, reduce risk, and increase win rates.<br><br>Own the vision for a GovCon AI platform that streamlines people, content, and compliance across a $774B+ federal contracting market.<br><br><strong>As Founding CEO, you will<br><br></strong><ul><li>Win customers — Run pilots, shape pricing, and validate retention + expansion</li><li>Build the product — Work with FutureSight's product/engineering pod to launch V1</li><li>Raise capital — Lead the seed round with our initial investment</li><li>Build your team — Hire your founding team and set the cultural foundation<br><br></li></ul><strong>About FutureSight<br><br></strong>FutureSight is a venture studio that co-creates and invests in B2B SaaS and Vertical AI startups alongside exceptional entrepreneurs. We give founders an unfair advantage — pairing hands-on studio support with early capital, thereby reducing risk and increasing the odds of success by 10x.<br><br>We're led by a cross-functional team of builders and investors. Kevin Nguyen and Alan Smith lead venture design and product strategy. Prathna Ramesh applies her experience as a venture investor with capital strategy in every new business. Dennis Ensing mentors our ventures with operational and strategic expertise, Krista LaRiviere brings years of entrepreneurial and marketing experience as a multi-time exited founder, and Anupama Joshi drives founder excellence. John Carbrey (San Francisco), a successful software entrepreneur and people leader, adds deep insight into scaling startups from 0 to 1, having built and exited multiple prior SaaS ventures.<br><br><strong>What We Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li>Validated problem — You will enter a venture with a proven market need and strong momentum toward building and scaling</li><li>Studio bench strength — Designers, engineers, growth marketers, and fundraising pros are embedded from Day 1</li><li>Capital commitment — Initial pre-seed funding for early hires and building the MVP with potential for follow-on funding, and access to our investor and advisor network<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li>Founder-level drive — You're motivated to co-found a new venture as the CEO. With or without us, this is your calling</li><li>Startup scrappiness — You know what you're signing up for. You're familiar with the scrappiness of owning something from start to finish</li><li>Previous founding experience — You have co-founded a product company or B2B SaaS venture, or have been at a venture-backed company</li><li>Risk appetite and capacity — Read more on our post on the Entrepreneurial Risk Profile</li><li>GTM chops — Proven success in B2B SaaS sales, marketing, and customer engagement</li><li>Fundraising fluency — Able to craft investor narratives and close capital; well-networked in fintech and early-stage communities</li><li>People leadership — Magnet for top talent; coach and culture carrier</li><li>Industry experience — Background in government contracting, proposal management, or B2B SaaS for professional services<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Can Expect<br><br></strong><ul><li>Daily active engagement with our team to: launch initial product, achieve initial market traction and prepare for seed fundraise</li><li>Full P/L ownership of the new entity</li><li>A significant equity stake in the business</li><li>This is a full-time role; we are seeking someone to dedicate themselves full-time and exclusively to building and owning a new SaaS venture<br><br></li></ul>Ready to build?<br><br>If this is the perfect opportunity for you, we want to hear from you!<br><br>Submit your Resume and LinkedIn profile and tell us more about why you think we should chat!<br><br>FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

metadata.description: <strong>About Us<br><br></strong>We are a strategy and innovation consultancy that helps organizations thrive in the face of change. Support company growth by participating in the ongoing recruitment of talent<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Desired Skills And Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>2-4 years of experience; client services experience a huge plus</li><li>Demonstrated work and/or educational experience in synthesizing data, drawing meaningful insights, and providing actionable strategies</li><li>Exceptional attention to detail - quick to catch internal inconsistencies in documents and strong ability to recall key insights and decisions that impact project thinking</li><li>Stellar communication skills and a high EQ, with an ability to strike the right tone with clients in e-mails and verbal communications</li><li>Passionate about technology, and the opportunities it presents to our clients</li><li>Good technological literacy and ability to quickly learn and navigate the full functionality of tools like Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Dropbox, and Google Docs</li><li>Quick learner who is eager to absorb feedback</li><li>Enjoy solving complex problems using analytic and creative methods</li><li>Ability to structure thinking in an easy to follow manorHave a strong record as a high performer in academic, volunteer, or work activities, with noted leadership accomplishments</li><li>Strong numeracy; Excel skills a plus</li><li>Entrepreneurial mindset, but experience working with corporate clients</li><li>Are super-flexible, adaptable, realistic, practical, and agile</li><li>Thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Investing in our people is a high priority. metadata.description: <p>Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over one hundred nationalities. The acquisition of Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 has marked the Group’s entry into the food sector, applying the same high-quality criteria. Very proactive also in the art field, the Prada Group strengthens its presence through contemporary art projects in constant evolution.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong> </p><p><br></p><p>The CRM &amp; Client Development Director is responsible for leading the strategy, execution, and performance of CRM, clienteling, and client development across Miu Miu Americas. This role drives client loyalty, repurchase, and lifetime value by building a scalable, data-driven CRM and client development framework, while ensuring strong adoption of clienteling behaviors across the retail network and e-commerce.</p><p><br></p><p>Primary goals include growing the VIC and top-client portfolios, increasing customer retention and repurchase, improving CRM KPIs, and partnering closely with Retail to embed a client-centric mindset in stores. Store Enablement</strong></p><ul><li>Serve as the regional owner of clienteling strategy, tools, and best practices, ensuring consistent store adoption</li><li>Partner with Retail to reinforce high-quality outreach, appointment culture, follow-up standards, and data capture</li><li>Track store performance across CRM KPIs and client development activities, ensuring ongoing improvement</li><li>Work with Retail Training &amp; metadata.description: <strong>Position Details:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Title: Manager, Clinical Operations (Patient Recruitment)</li><li>Location: Hybrid, New York, NY<br><br></li></ul><strong>Company Overview<br><br></strong>Founded in 2021, Transcend Therapeutics is a late-clinical-stage neuroscience company developing rapid-acting treatments for neuropsychiatric diseases. Our lead asset TSND-201, a rapid-acting neuroplastogen, is the first and only product to demonstrate rapid, robust, and durable therapeutic effects in PTSD. TSND-201 was granted Breakthrough Therapy designation by the FDA based on Phase 2 results, and we have aligned on a Phase 3 program for TSND-201 in PTSD. Transcend is backed by leading life sciences investors and driven by a mission to create treatments for the millions of people for whom current psychiatric medicines have not worked.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>The Manager, Patient Recruitment is a member of the Clinical Operations team and is responsible for overseeing patient recruitment to support enrollment in clinical studies in collaboration with patient recruitment vendors and sites.<br><br>A successful Manager in Patient Recruitment takes initiative in recruitment strategies, identifies challenges and proactively makes adjustments or decisions to meet study enrollment goals. The position will report to the (Assoc/Sr) Director, Clinical Operations.<br><br><strong>Key responsibilities will include:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Set up study recruitment plans/operations during study start up including site recruitment and central recruitment strategies. </li><li>Evaluate patient recruitment vendors and provide oversight/coordination with vendors throughout the study. </li><li>Develop and review study and site recruitment materials (design elements and written content of flyers, posters, newsletters, ads, etc.). </li><li>Regularly interact with clinical study sites to support individualized site recruitment needs. </li><li>Track progress and success of various recruitment tactics with study enrollment goals in mind. </li><li>Identify new recruitment strategies as needed and lead efforts in recruitment challenges. </li><li>Communicate with various internal and external personnel (i.e., study staff, site personnel, CTM). </li><li>Participate in study team meetings and provide updates to senior personnel. </li><li>Participate in creation, review, and revision of clinical SOPs. </li><li>All other duties as required. <br><br></li></ul>This is a great opportunity to step into a high-impact, high-visibility role on the early team of Transcend Therapeutics. We offer competitive cash and equity compensation; medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401k; unlimited vacation and sick time; and more.<br><br>The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000, plus equity and benefits.<br><br><strong>Experience Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a life science</li><li>2+ years experience in patient recruitment in a pharmaceutical company, CRO, patient recruitment vendor or similar organization, 4+ overall years in clinical research</li><li>Experience in recruiting studies in psychiatry-related indications is preferred</li><li>Proficient knowledge of GCP/ICH, drug development process, clinical operations<br><br></li></ul><strong>Key Competency Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Excellent verbal, written, communication and interpersonal skills</li><li>Creative and flexible, able to pivot when needed</li><li>Able to align with company goals and focus on the big picture</li><li>Able to effectively communicate and collaborate across functions and job levels</li><li>Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work effectively in a fast-paced environment</li><li>Internally motivated, with a passion for mental health</li><li>Routinely takes initiative<br><br></li></ul><strong>Travel Required<br><br></strong><ul><li>Travel may be required (approximately 5%)<br><br></li></ul>We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and talented team, free from discrimination. If you're excited about our mission but don't meet 100% of the qualifications above, we encourage you to apply.

Duties</p><p>• Record customs duty files received from brokers and reconcile balances with Treasury payments across entities</p><p>Payments &amp; Reconciliations</p><p>• Review AP aging, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate timely payments</p><p>• Perform bi-weekly AP account reconciliations and prepare structured supporting analysis</p><p><br></p><p>Credit Card &amp; Travel Expenses</p><p>• Record corporate card and travel expense transactions and reconcile to external reports</p><p>• Reconcile Concur vs. SAP aging and resolve variances</p><p>Month-End Close, Accruals &amp; Analysis</p><p>• Prepare and post-month-end accruals across multiple cost categories</p><p>• Produce clear analysis and variance explanations for business partners and finance leadership</p><p>• Review aging reports, error queues, and pending approvals and ensure timely resolution</p><p><br></p><p>Audit &amp; Compliance</p><p>• Provide documentation for internal and external audits</p><p>• Ensure compliance with internal policies and accounting standards (IFRS / US GAAP exposure a plus)</p><p><br></p><p>Project Participation &amp; Attendance expectations may increase during critical close periods or as business needs require.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field</p><p>• Minimum 3 years of accounting or AP experience (retail experience preferred)</p><p>• Advanced Excel skills and ability to work with large data sets</p><p>• Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus</p><p>• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet defined deadlines</p><p>• Ability to work with incomplete inputs and still produce structured, accurate deliverables</p><p>• Professional communication skills and ability to translate financial reconciliations into clear business language</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>In addition to a competitive salary, you will also receive 25% discount to buy the latest trends in any of our brands and a variety benefit package where you can find a wide range of discounts.</p><p>Our internal talent is our greatest asset, and we are proud of offering internal promotion programs where you will find opportunities to grow, e-learning and training programs as well as social projects to get involved and contribute to a better society, and much more!</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Annual compensation range:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>$70,000 - $85,000 + discretionary bonus</p><p><br></p><p>* Zara, in good faith, believes that this posted rate of compensation is the accurate range for this role at this location at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. Actual compensation within that range will be dependent upon the individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable laws.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Zara USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</strong></p><p><br></p><p>All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, disability, age, citizenship status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.</p><p>EOE/DFW</p><p></p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone. </p><p><br></p><p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p><p><br></p><p>We’re looking for a Regional Recruiter to support our restaurant leadership. You should have a proven track record of interviewing and identifying leaders at all levels and teaching and coaching on recruiting best practices. As a Regional Recruiter, you’ll lead Restaurant Manager searches, and facilitate the internal interview process for regional leadership. In this position, you must be able to identify recruitment trends and challenges and implement solutions to solve business needs. Additionally, you must be able to interpret and apply an understanding of Chipotle policies and practices, employment law, and other regulations to serve as a recruiting expert in your region. A passion for fresh guac might also come in handy.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p><p>In addition to following Chipotle’s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:</p><ul><li>Creatively source, screen, and provide selection guidance for Restaurant Manager and field leadership positions</li><li>Facilitate the internal interview process for regional leadership positions</li><li>Develop regional recruitment strategies with senior field leadership by identify hiring trends through regular reporting while partnering with restaurant leadership to drive strategic priorities</li><li>Provide coaching to leaders and champion best practices in staffing, interviewing, and candidate experience</li><li>Be a brand and employee advocate who enables change and innovation to create best-in-class teams</li><li>Partner with HRBP, other support employees, and COEs to implement market-specific recruitment strategies to address current and future needs</li><li>Roll out and drive the execution of recruiting initiatives and processes in your region</li><li>Engage in critical activities to understand the business and enable talent succession planning effectively</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE</strong></p><ul><li>High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required, bachelor's degree from a 4-year college or university preferred</li><li>3+ years of experience in Recruiting or a related field, multi-unit restaurant or retail environment preferred</li><li>Proficient in MS Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook</li><li>Ability to build strong relationships and influence business leaders through effective communication</li><li>Results-driven approach; owns and executes short and long-term projects with sound judgment and decision-making skills</li><li>Expert problem-solving skills with an ability to work autonomously to identify gaps and apply creative solutions in ambiguous situations</li><li>Demonstrated ability to be a change agent, partnering with cross-functional and remote teams to support business leaders at all levels</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>PAY TRANSPARENCY</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $69,000.00–$93,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong></p><p><br></p><p>Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) is cultivating a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. For more information or to place an order online, visit WWW.CHIPOTLE.COM</p><p><br></p><p><em>Chipotle Mexican Grill is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. </em></p><p><br></p><p><em>Qualified applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or certain state or local laws. Please contact <u>ADAaccommodations@chipotle.com </u>if you need an accommodation due to a disability to complete an application, job interview, and/or to otherwise participate in the hiring process. This email does not respond to non-accommodations related requests.</em></p>

validation utilizing SQL.</li><li>Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.</li><li>Experience with backend database testing on SQL, PostgreSQL, or any other enterprise database systems.</li><li>Experience in performing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) related test automation, scenario testing, human-in-the-loop analysis, scripting, and testing.</li><li>Ability to use SQL to industry-standard Quality Assurance best practices for Agile and Iterative SDLCs, testing methodologies, version control systems, implementation, and deployment activities.</li></ul><p><strong>Scope/Background:</strong> Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR), Medicaid, and Client requires specialized testing and quality assurance services, with a focus on automated testing solutions</p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>The position advertised has been exempted from the federal civilian hiring freeze.</u></strong></p><p><br></p><p>Use your mathematics background to become an FBI special agent!</p><p><br></p><p>The transition from data to special agent is more than a career move—it’s an opportunity to upskill and become an expert in your field. At the FBI, you won’t just use your data analysis experience; you’ll also build on it by working on cases that challenge you to think critically, adapt quickly, and collaborate with elite professionals tackling national security threats. Your ability to uncover crucial information, problem-solve, and apply your technical knowledge will help protect our nation from cyberattacks, terrorism, fraud, and evolving threats.</p><p><br></p><p>With specialized training, real-world investigative experience, and access to cutting-edge technology, you’ll refine your predictive and statistical analysis skills, enhance your expertise, and develop the foundation to become a leader in your field. The Bureau matches your dedication with a commitment to professional growth, a supportive work environment, and a robust benefits package that prioritizes you.<strong> </strong>Set yourself apart. Apply today.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>HOW TO APPLY </strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 1</strong>: Click on the “Apply” button to be directed to the FBIJobs Careers website.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 2</strong>: Click the “Start” button to begin. You will be prompted to either sign in to continue or register with FBIJobs if you don’t already have an account.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 3</strong>: Follow the step-by-step process to submit your interest. You will be guided through each step. You must complete all sections of the form AND ALL REQUIRED DOCUMENTS MUST BE ATTACHED to successfully submit your interest.</p><p><br></p><ol><li>Your resume, specifically noting relevant work experience and associated start and end dates. Please note your resume MUST NOT exceed two (2) pages.</li><li>Other supporting documents:</li></ol><ul><li>College transcripts, if qualifying based on education or if there is a positive education requirement.</li><li>Veterans: DD 214; Disabled Veterans: DD 214, SF-15, and VA letter dated 1991 or later.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Please see instructions on the site for attaching documents.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>SALARY LEVEL</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Pay level for this position:</p><ul><li>$100,456.00–$129,609.00</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Salary is commensurate with base, locality, and availability pay.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>MAJOR DUTIES </strong></p><ul><li>Plan and conduct investigations of potential violations of federal laws, cybersecurity, and public safety.</li><li>Exercise judgment, resourcefulness, and versatility in meeting investigative demands.</li><li>Create and maintain effective liaison relationships with federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, and international law enforcement agencies.</li><li>Maintain a level of physical fitness to ensure the readiness required to perform law enforcement duties.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>KEY REQUIREMENTS </strong></p><ul><li>Must be a U.S. citizen.</li><li>Must be able to obtain a Top Secret Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) Clearance.</li><li>Must be willing to travel as required.</li><li>Must meet the FBI’s Employment Eligibility requirements.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>EDUCATION</strong></p><ul><li>Candidates must have a bachelor’s degree or higher (preferably in mathematics or a related field) from a U.S. accredited college or university.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>All degrees must be verified by submitting college transcripts.</strong></p><p><br></p><p>The FBI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for this vacancy. metadata.description: Ally Behavior is a full-time, center-based, early intervention Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy program, serving children with autism ranging from 18 months to 6 years of age. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality therapy to help our early learners reach their potential to communicate, improve social skills, and prepare for academic success. The children we serve are at the heart of everything we do and we are passionate about our commitment to having a meaningful impact in the lives of our children and their families.<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Maryland / Virginia / Washington, D.C. Metro Area (Frequent Travel Required)<br><br>Please include a cover letter so we can get to know you better and understand why you believe you will be a good fit for our team!<strong> Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be considered.<br><br></strong><strong>Job Summary:</strong> <br><br>We are seeking a <strong>New Center Launch Associate</strong> to help bring new autism therapy centers from the construction phase to opening day efficiently, thoughtfully, and on schedule. In this role, you'll ensure each new location is fully equipped with the furniture, supplies, and services needed to begin serving clients immediately. This is a highly hands-on, fast-paced role for someone who is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful. You'll work closely with our corporate team and travel regularly to new center locations to coordinate installations, manage deliveries, and oversee overall center readiness.<br><br>Ally Behavior is a dynamic, fun, and rewarding place to work that offers superior growth and leadership opportunities in a supportive, engaging environment. We have a unique and collaborative culture that is driven by our diverse team of professionals and our core values of <strong>Serving Others</strong>, <strong>Treatment Excellence</strong>, <strong>All One Ally</strong>, <strong>Resourceful in Finding Solutions</strong>, and <strong>Striving to Grow</strong>. Our comprehensive onboarding and training approach will support and prepare you to help us provide the best possible service to our clients!<br><br><strong>Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Manage launch timelines to ensure new centers open on schedule</li><li>Procure, track, and coordinate delivery of furniture, equipment, therapy materials, and supplies</li><li>Assist with installation and activation of operational services, including Wi-Fi, security systems, phones, printers, and other core infrastructure</li><li>Participate hands-on in furniture assembly and setup of therapy rooms, offices, and common areas</li><li>Track budgets, purchase orders, and invoices; provide regular updates on spend versus plan</li><li>Monitor multiple launches simultaneously and proactively identify risks related to timelines, deliveries, permitting, or compliance</li><li>Support compliance readiness by coordinating inspections, permits, fire metadata.description: <strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>Morton is seeking a Vice President of Technology for our client based in the DMV area, This is a senior executive responsible for leading the company’s technology transformation across product engineering, data platforms, and AI-enabled workflows. This role drives the modernization of systems and processes to improve quality, speed, consistency, and scalability across both client-facing products and internal operations.<br><br>As the leader of the end-to-end product and engineering function, the VP of Technology owns technology strategy, architecture, development, and delivery. Partnering closely with the Founder &amp; Managing Partner and the leadership team, this role replaces legacy and off-the-shelf tools with modern, scalable platforms and production-ready AI capabilities that deliver measurable business impact.<br><br>The ideal candidate is a decisive, execution-oriented leader with strong executive presence, a high sense of urgency, and consistent follow-through. They are a proactive communicator who aligns stakeholders, removes obstacles, and drives results through disciplined planning, effective team leadership, and operational rigor.<br><br>Key Responsibilities Technology Strategy &amp; Executive Leadership<br><br><ul><li>Define and own the company’s technology strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned to business goals and client needs. </li><li>Serve as the final decision maker on technology architecture, platforms, standards, and vendor selection, in partnership with executive leadership. </li><li>Lead the identification, prioritization, and retirement of legacy systems and technical debt to reduce risk and operational friction. </li><li>Act as a trusted advisor to the Founder &amp; Managing Partner, clearly articulating options, tradeoffs, and recommendations. </li><li>Establish clear priorities, ownership, and measurable outcomes across technology initiatives. </li><li>Implement operating rhythms that promote urgency, accountability, and predictable execution. <br><br></li></ul>AI &amp; Business Process Transformation<br><br><ul><li>Lead organizational change management to ensure adoption of new systems and workflows while maintaining operational stability. </li><li>Drive the practical integration of AI into business processes, focusing on measurable improvements in quality, speed, consistency, and cost efficiency. </li><li>Build a repeatable framework for identifying, piloting, prioritizing, and scaling AI use cases across the organization. </li><li>Ensure responsible AI practices, including governance, security, privacy, auditability, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. </li><li>Partner with functional leaders to redesign workflows and data practices so AI solutions succeed in production environments. <br><br></li></ul>Software Product Engineering &amp; Delivery<br><br><ul><li>Oversee the design, development, and delivery of high-quality enterprise software products for clients and internal users. </li><li>Establish and enforce engineering standards across architecture, code quality, testing, release management, and observability. </li><li>Drive predictable delivery through strong product and project management, clear requirements, and disciplined execution. </li><li>Maintain fast feedback loops with clients and internal stakeholders to continuously improve product value and usability. <br><br></li></ul>Data Platforms, Integrations &amp; Security<br><br><ul><li>Own the strategy for data architecture, integrations, and analytics platforms supporting internal reporting and client-facing capabilities. </li><li>Ensure reliable data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations that support scale, auditability, and high-quality AI outputs. </li><li>Establish product-focused security practices across the SDLC, including privacy-by-design, secure coding standards, and vulnerability management. <br><br></li></ul>Team Leadership &amp; Talent Development<br><br><ul><li>Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing teams across engineering, architecture, DevOps, and product and project management. </li><li>Set clear performance expectations, role clarity, and professional development plans for leaders and team members. </li><li>Foster a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, speed, and transparency. </li><li>Recruit, onboard, and retain top technical talent. <br><br></li></ul>Partner &amp; Vendor Management<br><br><ul><li>Oversee and hold external development partners accountable for quality, velocity, security, and adherence to standards. </li><li>Own technology budgets, resource allocation, and capacity planning across internal teams and external partners. <br><br></li></ul>Stakeholder Communication &amp; Transparency<br><br><ul><li>Communicate clearly and consistently with executives and stakeholders on priorities, risks, dependencies, timelines, and outcomes. </li><li>Provide concise, decision-oriented status reporting. </li><li>Translate complex technical topics into clear business language to drive alignment across the organization. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>10+ years of progressive technology experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership roles delivering complex systems at scale. </li><li>Proven success building and leading software engineering and product organizations with strong delivery, scalability, and security outcomes. </li><li>Strong understanding of modern AI capabilities and limitations, with experience integrating AI into real-world business workflows and software products. </li><li>Hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure, along with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools. </li><li>Experience modernizing legacy systems and replacing off-the-shelf tools with integrated, scalable platforms. </li><li>Demonstrated ability to execute with urgency, strong executive judgment, and consistent follow-through. </li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to executive and cross-functional audiences. </li><li>Experience managing technology budgets, vendors, and external development partners, including offshore teams. </li><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.</li></ul>

metadata.description: Ally Behavior is a full-time, center-based, early intervention Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy program, serving children with autism ranging from 18 months to 6 years of age. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality therapy to help our early learners reach their potential to communicate, improve social skills, and prepare for academic success. The children we serve are at the heart of everything we do and we are passionate about our commitment to having a meaningful impact in the lives of our children and their families.<br><br><strong>Location:</strong> Maryland / Virginia / Washington, D.C. Metro Area (Frequent Travel Required)<br><br>Please include a cover letter so we can get to know you better and understand why you believe you will be a good fit for our team!<strong> Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be considered.<br><br></strong><strong>Job Summary:</strong> <br><br>We are seeking a <strong>New Center Launch Associate</strong> to help bring new autism therapy centers from the construction phase to opening day efficiently, thoughtfully, and on schedule. In this role, you'll ensure each new location is fully equipped with the furniture, supplies, and services needed to begin serving clients immediately. This is a highly hands-on, fast-paced role for someone who is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful. You'll work closely with our corporate team and travel regularly to new center locations to coordinate installations, manage deliveries, and oversee overall center readiness.<br><br>Ally Behavior is a dynamic, fun, and rewarding place to work that offers superior growth and leadership opportunities in a supportive, engaging environment. We have a unique and collaborative culture that is driven by our diverse team of professionals and our core values of <strong>Serving Others</strong>, <strong>Treatment Excellence</strong>, <strong>All One Ally</strong>, <strong>Resourceful in Finding Solutions</strong>, and <strong>Striving to Grow</strong>. Our comprehensive onboarding and training approach will support and prepare you to help us provide the best possible service to our clients!<br><br><strong>Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Manage launch timelines to ensure new centers open on schedule</li><li>Procure, track, and coordinate delivery of furniture, equipment, therapy materials, and supplies</li><li>Assist with installation and activation of operational services, including Wi-Fi, security systems, phones, printers, and other core infrastructure</li><li>Participate hands-on in furniture assembly and setup of therapy rooms, offices, and common areas</li><li>Track budgets, purchase orders, and invoices; provide regular updates on spend versus plan</li><li>Monitor multiple launches simultaneously and proactively identify risks related to timelines, deliveries, permitting, or compliance</li><li>Support compliance readiness by coordinating inspections, permits, fire marshal approvals, and required sign-offs</li><li>Maintain and improve standardized launch checklists, templates, and playbooks</li><li>Ensure all centers meet Ally Behavior's brand, safety, and operational standards at opening</li><li>Support handoff from construction teams to property management and operations</li><li>Provide additional support as needed related to the successful launch of new centers<br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Qualifications:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience or familiarity with center-based ABA therapy is a plus, but not required</li><li>Demonstrated ability to manage timelines, vendors, and deliverables through completion</li><li>Comfortable working in a hands-on, field-based role with frequent travel and on-site problem-solving</li><li>Strong communication skills with contractors, vendors, and internal teams</li><li>Experience managing budgets, purchase tracking, and expense documentation</li><li>Proficiency with spreadsheets, project tracking tools, and shared documentation systems</li><li>Ability to adapt quickly to changing conditions such as delayed shipments, schedule shifts, or permitting challenges</li><li>Ability to travel frequently within Maryland, Virginia, and the Washington, D.C. metro area</li><li>Ability to pass MD/VA state, FBI, and sex offender background checks<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Will Bring:<br><br></strong><ul><li>You are an energetic, motivated and efficient person who can drive towards meeting deadlines and making sure a center is ready for clients </li><li>You are a self-starter who takes pride in seeing a project through and feels personally invested in opening centers on time</li><li>You have a problem-solving mindset, focusing on solutions, not roadblocks, when something goes awry</li><li>You are comfortable with daily accountability, deadlines, and progress reporting</li><li>You have a genuine desire to be part of Ally's growth and expansion, knowing that each successful opening directly impacts access to life-changing services for children and families</li><li>You like to work really hard and aren't just collecting a paycheck and letting the time pass. Excellent performance and building something special is what you find most fulfilling in life. If you have a project on your plate, you won't stop just because it's 5pm</li><li>You have varied interests and passions that you can dive deeply into. Maybe you love Russian Literature, minored in it in school, and are part of a local book club with some like-minded friends<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Offer When Joining Our Team:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Base salary of $50,000 - $60,000</li><li>Quarterly bonuses based on individual and company performance</li><li>Mileage Reimbursement</li><li>Guaranteed semi-monthly paycheck (24)</li><li>Company-sponsored DashPass</li><li>18 days of paid time off</li><li>9 paid holidays (5 set days + 4 "floating" holidays)</li><li>Professional development opportunities</li><li>Medical +HSA, Dental, and Vision coverage through Cigna</li><li>401(k) plan with company match.</li><li>Employee Assistance Program</li><li>Short-Term Disability, Term-Life/AD&amp;D Insurance, Critical Illness with Cancer Insurance, Accident Insurance, Hospital Confinement Insurance, and Pet Insurance</li><li>Tuition Assistance<br><br></li></ul><strong>Note:</strong> This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.<br><br>Ally Behavior is an equal opportunity employer. In compliance with Federal and State Equal Opportunity Laws, qualified applicants are considered for all positions applied for without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Your personal information will be used for recruitment purposes only and handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

metadata.description: <strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>Morton is seeking a Vice President of Technology for our client based in the DMV area, This is a senior executive responsible for leading the company’s technology transformation across product engineering, data platforms, and AI-enabled workflows. This role drives the modernization of systems and processes to improve quality, speed, consistency, and scalability across both client-facing products and internal operations.<br><br>As the leader of the end-to-end product and engineering function, the VP of Technology owns technology strategy, architecture, development, and delivery. Partnering closely with the Founder &amp; Managing Partner and the leadership team, this role replaces legacy and off-the-shelf tools with modern, scalable platforms and production-ready AI capabilities that deliver measurable business impact.<br><br>The ideal candidate is a decisive, execution-oriented leader with strong executive presence, a high sense of urgency, and consistent follow-through. They are a proactive communicator who aligns stakeholders, removes obstacles, and drives results through disciplined planning, effective team leadership, and operational rigor.<br><br>Key Responsibilities Technology Strategy &amp; Executive Leadership<br><br><ul><li>Define and own the company’s technology strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned to business goals and client needs. </li><li>Serve as the final decision maker on technology architecture, platforms, standards, and vendor selection, in partnership with executive leadership. </li><li>Lead the identification, prioritization, and retirement of legacy systems and technical debt to reduce risk and operational friction. </li><li>Act as a trusted advisor to the Founder &amp; Managing Partner, clearly articulating options, tradeoffs, and recommendations. </li><li>Establish clear priorities, ownership, and measurable outcomes across technology initiatives. </li><li>Implement operating rhythms that promote urgency, accountability, and predictable execution. <br><br></li></ul>AI &amp; Business Process Transformation<br><br><ul><li>Lead organizational change management to ensure adoption of new systems and workflows while maintaining operational stability. </li><li>Drive the practical integration of AI into business processes, focusing on measurable improvements in quality, speed, consistency, and cost efficiency. </li><li>Build a repeatable framework for identifying, piloting, prioritizing, and scaling AI use cases across the organization. </li><li>Ensure responsible AI practices, including governance, security, privacy, auditability, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. </li><li>Partner with functional leaders to redesign workflows and data practices so AI solutions succeed in production environments. <br><br></li></ul>Software Product Engineering &amp; Delivery<br><br><ul><li>Oversee the design, development, and delivery of high-quality enterprise software products for clients and internal users. </li><li>Establish and enforce engineering standards across architecture, code quality, testing, release management, and observability. </li><li>Drive predictable delivery through strong product and project management, clear requirements, and disciplined execution. </li><li>Maintain fast feedback loops with clients and internal stakeholders to continuously improve product value and usability. <br><br></li></ul>Data Platforms, Integrations &amp; Security<br><br><ul><li>Own the strategy for data architecture, integrations, and analytics platforms supporting internal reporting and client-facing capabilities. </li><li>Ensure reliable data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations that support scale, auditability, and high-quality AI outputs. </li><li>Establish product-focused security practices across the SDLC, including privacy-by-design, secure coding standards, and vulnerability management. <br><br></li></ul>Team Leadership &amp; Talent Development<br><br><ul><li>Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing teams across engineering, architecture, DevOps, and product and project management. </li><li>Set clear performance expectations, role clarity, and professional development plans for leaders and team members. </li><li>Foster a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, speed, and transparency. </li><li>Recruit, onboard, and retain top technical talent. <br><br></li></ul>Partner &amp; Vendor Management<br><br><ul><li>Oversee and hold external development partners accountable for quality, velocity, security, and adherence to standards. </li><li>Own technology budgets, resource allocation, and capacity planning across internal teams and external partners. <br><br></li></ul>Stakeholder Communication &amp; Transparency<br><br><ul><li>Communicate clearly and consistently with executives and stakeholders on priorities, risks, dependencies, timelines, and outcomes. </li><li>Provide concise, decision-oriented status reporting. </li><li>Translate complex technical topics into clear business language to drive alignment across the organization. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>10+ years of progressive technology experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership roles delivering complex systems at scale. </li><li>Proven success building and leading software engineering and product organizations with strong delivery, scalability, and security outcomes. </li><li>Strong understanding of modern AI capabilities and limitations, with experience integrating AI into real-world business workflows and software products. </li><li>Hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure, along with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools. </li><li>Experience modernizing legacy systems and replacing off-the-shelf tools with integrated, scalable platforms. </li><li>Demonstrated ability to execute with urgency, strong executive judgment, and consistent follow-through. </li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to executive and cross-functional audiences. </li><li>Experience managing technology budgets, vendors, and external development partners, including offshore teams. </li><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.</li></ul>

metadata.description: FutureSight is seeking an experienced and visionary Founding CEO to lead the launch of a new AI-native reverse logistics orchestration platform. metadata.description: Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.<br><br>The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) will serve as a key member of the Bank’s Executive Management Team and will be responsible for establishing and leading Bank’s information security and cybersecurity programs. As the Bank prepares to launch as a de novo Industrial Loan Company (ILC), the CISO will design and implement an enterprise-wide security framework that meets FDIC and state regulatory expectations, supports the Bank’s risk appetite, and protects customer and institutional data.<br><br>The CISO will lead the development of information security governance, technical controls, and third-party risk oversight, ensuring a strong and scalable security posture from inception through growth. This leader will collaborate closely with technology, risk, and operations teams to ensure security is integrated into every aspect of the Bank’s systems and operations.<br><br><strong><strong>What You’ll Do<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li> Information Security Program Development</li><li>Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive Information Security Program consistent with FDIC guidance (e.g., FIL-66-2019, FIL-13-2021) and the Interagency Guidelines Establishing Information Security Standards.</li><li>Develop and oversee policies, standards, and procedures governing cybersecurity, data protection, and incident response.</li><li>Ensure alignment with the Bank’s overall risk management and governance frameworks.</li><li>Provide regular reporting to executive management and the Board on the Bank’s security posture, emerging risks, and mitigation efforts.</li><li> Cybersecurity and Threat Management</li><li>Establish and manage a threat monitoring and detection capability to identify, assess, and respond to cybersecurity risks.</li><li>Oversee implementation of layered security controls (e.g., network segmentation, encryption, access controls, endpoint protection, vulnerability management).</li><li>Lead the Bank’s Incident Response Program, ensuring timely escalation and coordination with regulators when required.</li><li>Maintain relationships with information-sharing groups (e.g., FS-ISAC) and law enforcement to stay informed of emerging threats. </li><li> Third-Party and Affiliate Risk Oversight</li><li>Evaluate the information security posture of third-party and affiliate service providers in accordance with the Bank’s Vendor Management Program and FDIC third-party risk guidance.</li><li>Establish due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and contractual requirements for vendors handling sensitive data or performing critical services.</li><li>Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure third-party risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated. </li><li> Data Governance and Privacy Protection</li><li>Ensure compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements (e.g., GLBA, Regulation P, state privacy laws).</li><li>Implement processes to safeguard customer information and prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse.</li><li>Partner with business and technology teams to integrate privacy-by-design principles into new products and services. </li><li> Business Continuity and Resilience</li><li>Lead development and testing of the Bank’s Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) plans, ensuring they are integrated with information security objectives.</li><li>Coordinate regular testing and simulations to validate readiness for cyber incidents and system disruptions.</li><li>Support resilience planning for key systems, vendors, and communication protocols. </li><li> De Novo and Pre-Opening Readiness</li><li>Build and document the Bank’s information security program as part of the de novo application process.</li><li>Establish security architecture, monitoring tools, and vendor relationships prior to launch.</li><li>Prepare readiness materials for FDIC and state examinations related to cybersecurity and operational resilience.</li><li>Ensure security risk assessments and third-party reviews are completed and incorporated into pre-opening milestones. </li><li> Leadership and Culture</li><li>Serve as the Bank’s senior advocate for cybersecurity and data protection, promoting a culture of security awareness and accountability.</li><li>Provide training and guidance across the organization to enhance information security awareness.</li><li>Collaborate with peers in Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Technology to align security priorities with business strategy.</li><li>Build and lead a capable, mission-driven security team to support the Bank’s evolving needs. <br><br></li></ul><strong><strong>What We Look For<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>Minimum of 10 years of information security and technology risk management experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity at a regulated financial institution or Fintech.</li><li>Demonstrated experience designing and implementing information security programs compliant with FDIC and FFIEC standards.</li><li>Strong familiarity with third-party risk frameworks and financial services cybersecurity expectations.</li><li>Experience leading incident response, penetration testing, and security operations in cloud-based and hybrid environments.</li><li>Proven ability to communicate complex technical topics to executive leadership, the Board, and regulators.</li><li>Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a risk-based and pragmatic approach to decision-making. <br><br></li></ul><strong><strong>Core Competencies<br><br></strong></strong><ul><li>Expert knowledge of information security principles, frameworks, and regulatory requirements.</li><li>Strategic thinker with strong operational execution and control discipline.</li><li>Effective communicator capable of influencing across technical and business functions.</li><li>Collaborative leader who fosters a culture of accountability, awareness, and continuous improvement.<br><br></li></ul>Affirm Values<br><br>At Affirm, we live by our values: People Come First, No Fine Print, It’s On Us, Simplify, and Push the Envelope. As CCO, you will embody these principles while building the foundation of Affirm Bank as a trusted, transparent, and innovative financial institution.<br><br><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits<br><br></strong><strong>Base Pay Grade</strong> <strong>- T<br><br></strong><strong>Equity Grade</strong> <strong>- 14<br><br></strong>Employees new to Affirm <em>typically come in at the start of the pay range.</em> Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.<br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).<br><br><strong>USA Pacific base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year:</strong> $300,000 - $360,000<br><br><strong>USA Sapphire base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year:</strong> $267,000 - $327,000<br><br><strong>Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.<br><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong>We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:<br><br><ul><li>Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents </li><li>Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses</li><li>Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge</li><li>ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount<br><br></li></ul>We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.<br><br>[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<br><br>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.<br><br>

metadata.description: <strong>About Prisma International, Inc.</strong> - Prisma is a dynamic and growing language services provider committed to delivering exceptional translation solutions to clients worldwide. We pride ourselves on our dedication to linguistic excellence and client satisfaction.<br><br><strong>We are seeking experienced, professional Translators to join our exclusive ELECTIONS team.</strong> In this independent contractor role, you will provide high quality written translations between English and your native language. Successful applicants will have past Elections experience, exceptional time management skills and a commitment to linguistic excellence.<br><br><strong>TARGET LANGUAGES: <br><br></strong><strong>Arabic, Armenian, Chinese (Traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Hmong, Japanese, Khmer, Korean, Punjabi, Russian, Spanish-US, Tagalog, Thai, Ukrainian and Vietnamese<br><br></strong>If your native language is not listed above, you are welcome to apply. However, you must meet all minimum requirements to be considered.<br><br><strong>MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - You must meet ALL of the following requirements:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Reside in the United States</li><li>18+ years of age</li><li>Five (5) years of professional experience providing written translations to local, state or federal government offices as a contractor or sub-contractor. Two (2) of the five (5) years of experience must have been acquired within the last five years. Note: The resume you submit must clearly outline your five years of government-related translation experience and include dates. California elections experience is a plus, however, any U.S. election-related experience will be considered. </li><li>Availability to support Prisma after business hours (evenings) and on weekends and holidays during an Election cycle</li><li>Willing to abide by Prisma's Master Service Agreement (MSA) and related Addenda</li><li>High proficiency in English and a native speaker of the target language(s)</li><li>Reliable desktop PC or laptop with dedicated, secure, high-speed internet connection</li><li>Experience using modern CAT tools (e.g. XTM, Trados, etc.)</li><li>Adobe Acrobat on your device and the ability to use Adobe's markup tools on a PDF file</li><li>***At least ONE (1) of the following credentials*** You will be asked to provide proof</li><li>Current voting member in good standing of the American Translators Association (ATA)</li><li>Current member in good standing of the American Association of Language Specialists</li><li>Vietnamese translators - certified through the Society of Translators and Interpreters of British Columbia</li><li>Certified and registered on the California Judicial Council Master List</li><li>Categorized as "Certified" or "Professionally Qualified" by the Administrative Office of the United States Courts</li><li>Accreditation by a regional or national accrediting agency recognized by the United States Secretary of Education</li><li>Accreditation by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges<br><br></li></ul><strong>If you do not have at least one of the above-named certifications / accreditations, we may consider applicants with ALL of the following:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Native speaker of the target language</li><li>Educated in both English and the other language. Your resume must outline your educational background in a language-related field of study</li><li>5+ years of professional experience translating for local, state or federal government offices as a contractor or sub-contractor. Two (2) of the five (5) years of experience must have been acquired within the last five years. <br><br></li></ul><strong>TASKS &amp; RESPONSIBILITIES:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Provide written translations using a Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tool. We provide XTM to you</li><li>Adhere to all project work instructions, glossaries and reference materials</li><li>Ensure the source content's concept, style and register are culturally and linguistically appropriate for the target language</li><li>Perform language quality check steps (before delivery) to ensure the target translation is error-free and true to the meaning of the source document</li><li>Deliver completed translation jobs by the given deadlines and project budgets</li><li>Review formatted target language PDF files for accuracy; concisely mark any corrections needed. Using Adobe mark-up tools is required</li><li>Communicate in a timely and professional manner with Prisma team members</li><li>Participate in quality management processes, e.g. Corrective Action Reports (CARs), Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), process improvement and solution implementation</li><li>Take all measures necessary to protect and keep private sensitive information shared with you to carry out translation projects (e.g. PHI, PII, SBU)</li><li>Adhere to policies and processes defined in Prisma's Master Service Agreement (MSA) and the Prisma Vendor Guide<br><br></li></ul><strong>OTHER ATTRIBUTES:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Familiarity with voting materials: voter information guides, ballot measures, flyers, etc</li><li>Excellent communication skills and quick responses to Prisma requests</li><li>Ability to accommodate fast turnarounds for last-minute urgent corrections</li><li>High attention to detail - essential for proofreading and verifying names, numbers, dates, etc. and identifying font corruption in a non-English formatted document (PDF)</li><li>Integrity and impartiality for handling sensitive content</li><li>Awareness to understand cultural differences; ensure translated materials are appropriate and clear to specific communities</li><li>Advanced ability to translate complex or specialized jargon into clear, concise language</li><li>Ability to ask clarifying questions about technical or unclear content to ensure accuracy<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong>See full list of minimum requirements above.

metadata.description: WEBTOON Entertainment is a leading global entertainment company and home to some of the world's largest storytelling platforms. As the global leader and pioneer of the mobile webcomic format, WEBTOON Entertainment has transformed comics and visual storytelling for fans and creators.<br><br>With its CANVAS UGC platform empowering anyone to become a creator, and a growing roster of superstar WEBTOON Originals creators and series, WEBTOON Entertainment’s passionate fandoms are the new face of pop culture. WEBTOON Entertainment adaptations are available on Netflix, Prime Video, Crunchyroll, and other screens around the world, and the company’s content partners include Discord, HYBE, and DC Comics, among many others.<br><br>We are seeking a high-velocity, precision-focused Global Scheduler for a contract role supporting two of our most active teams. You will be the logistical engine behind complex meeting coordination for a specialized confidential task force working on a high-profile global initiative, as well as our Global Corporate Development group.<br><br>This is not a standard administrative role; it is a "Super Scheduler" position for someone who thrives on navigating the intricate organizational structures of major entertainment entities and global corporate partners across North America and Asia.<br><br>Location: Remote (Requires high-availability overlap for US and Asia-Pacific time zones)<br><br>Support Areas: High-Profile Specialized Project &amp; Global Corporate Development<br><br>Engagement: Independent Contractor (1099)<br><br>Project Duration: 6 months, with opportunity to extend<br><br><strong>Scope of Work<br><br></strong><ul><li>High-Volume Coordination: Execute and prioritize a massive volume of meeting requests daily, maintaining absolute accuracy in a fast-shifting environment. </li><li>Complex Stakeholder Management: Interface professionally with high-level executives at external partner organizations in NYC/LA and internal leadership in Korea. </li><li>Global Logistics &amp; Time Zone Mastery: Flawlessly coordinate across Seoul, Tokyo, Los Angeles, and NYC. You must be a master of the "time zone puzzle," ensuring critical stakeholders can connect across 13–16 hour differences. </li><li>Confidentiality &amp; Discretion: Support a specialized team on a high-profile project, requiring the utmost discretion and professional handling of sensitive information.</li><li>Agile Problem Solving: Pivot schedules instantly to accommodate urgent deal talks or sudden shifts in project strategy. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Minimum Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Expert English Communication: Ability to communicate with clarity, poise, and professional "edge" when dealing with high-level stakeholders.</li><li>Global Scheduling Experience: Proven track record of managing heavy calendars across multiple international time zones (specifically Asia and North America).</li><li>High Bandwidth: Ability to support "high-touch" teams during peak periods, including flexibility for long hours to bridge the gap between US and Asia business days.</li><li>Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Google Workspace, Outlook, and various global video conferencing platforms.</li><li>Professional working proficiency in Korean and/or Japanese is preferred, but not required.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Offer (For Full-Time Only)<br><br></strong><ul><li> Career development; we believe in mentorship and investing in your learning, supporting you to achieve your goals</li><li> Health benefits, including vision and dental!</li><li> Generous PTO and Parental Leave Top-up</li><li> 401K Contributions</li><li> Commuter Benefits</li><li> Global WEBTOON and LINE FRIENDS discount program</li><li> Winter break shutdown and a whole lot more!<br><br></li></ul>With approximately 155 million monthly active users, WEBTOON Entertainment’s IP &amp; Creator Ecosystem of aligned brands and platforms include WEBTOON, Wattpad--the world’s leading webnovel platform--WEBTOON Productions, Studio N, Studio LICO, WEBTOON Unscrolled, LINE MANGA, and eBookJapan, among others.<br><br>Join us and work with some of the biggest artists, IP, and fandoms in comics!<br><br>#WEBTOON<br><br>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

metadata.description: GoodRx is America’s healthcare marketplace. Each month, millions of people visit goodrx.com to find reliable health information and discounts for their healthcare — and we’ve helped people save $60 billion since 2011. We provide prescription discounts that are accepted at more than 70,000 pharmacies in the U.S., as well as telehealth services including doctor visits and lab tests. Our services have been positively reviewed by Good Morning America, The New York Times, NBC News, AARP, and many others.<br><br>Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.<br><br>As an intern you will be a part of the 12 week summer internship program that will provide an exceptional learning experience and an opportunity to be a part of a company who is helping Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We are currently looking for hard-working, curious and eager students to join our team.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong><strong>GoodRx is looking for an Intern to join the Internal Audit Team. <br><br></strong><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Support Sarbanes–Oxley (SOX) and Operational audits for both business process and IT functions.</li><li>Assist in evaluating internal controls over financial reporting (business process testing)</li><li>Assist in evaluating IT general controls (ITGCs) such as access management, change management, and system operations.</li><li>Observe process walkthroughs to identify key activities, risks, and controls.</li><li>Identify, discuss, and report control deficiencies and operational gaps.</li><li>Collaborate with management to ensure corrective actions are being implemented.</li><li>Prepare well-documented workpapers that are clear and organized.</li><li>Assist in drafting audit reports and summaries for management.</li><li>Expand audit, accounting, and technical knowledge through hands-on experience.</li><li>Seek clarification and ask questions to enhance understanding of assigned tasks.</li><li>Provide status updates on task progress and communicate any challenges to supervisors.</li><li>Listen and engage with peers, managers, and clients to foster collaboration.</li><li>Demonstrate dedication to help the Internal Audit department meet key milestones.</li><li>Help prepare documentation for ESG reporting (the disclosure of environmental, social and corporate governance data).</li><li>Perform other related duties as assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills And Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree candidate, preferably in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, or related field</li><li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills</li><li>Attention to detail and accuracy</li><li>A foundation in core business processes</li><li>Ability to work independently and in teams</li><li>Extremely curious and motivated to develop your skills throughout the internship!</li><li>Preferred location: Hybrid in Santa Monica, San Francisco, or New York</li><li>Graduating class of May/June 2027 - May/June 2028</li><li>Able to commit to a full-time internship program for 12 weeks during the summer of 2026.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits<br><br></strong><ul><li>The compensation rate for undergraduate students is $22.00 an hour.</li><li>GoodRx also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits to interns throughout the duration of the internship.</li><li>Application deadline: Tuesday, February 10th, 2026 (Noon PT)***<br><br></li></ul>We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has a seat at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel.<br><br>With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. GoodRx is committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage women, people of color, those in the LGBTQ+ communities, and Veterans to apply for positions even if they don’t necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Please still get in touch - we’d love to connect and see if you could be good for the role!<br><br>GoodRx is America's healthcare marketplace. The company offers the most comprehensive and accurate resource for affordable prescription medications in the U.S., gathering pricing information from thousands of pharmacies coast to coast, as well as a telehealth marketplace for online doctor visits and lab tests. Since 2011, Americans with and without health insurance have saved $60 billion using GoodRx and million consumers visit goodrx.com each month to find discounts and information related to their healthcare. GoodRx is the #1 most downloaded medical app on the iOS and Android app stores. For more information, visit www.goodrx.com.<br><br>We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from <strong>@</strong><strong>goodrx.com</strong> or <strong>goodrx@myworkday.com </strong>addresses.
