metadata.description: <strong>Department Summary<br><br></strong>The Academic Technology team designs, develops, configures, enhances, optimizes, and maintains core enterprise technologies ensuring functionality end, quality, business value, user-experience, and digital accessibility of the products and platforms meet the expectations of the campus community. Academic Technology fuels ITS’ cloud-first strategy by strategically reducing technical debt in partnership with other departments and teams leveraging cutting-edge techniques to accelerate releases using automation and application lifecycle management standards and tools.<br><br><strong>Position Summary<br><br></strong>The Academic Technology team designs, develops, configures, enhances, optimizes, and maintains core enterprise technologies ensuring functionality end, quality, business value, user-experience, and digital accessibility of the products and platforms meet the expectations of the campus community. Academic Technology fuels ITS’ cloud-first strategy by strategically reducing technical debt in partnership with other departments and teams leveraging cutting-edge techniques to accelerate releases using automation and application lifecycle management standards and tools.<br><br>The Product Manager, Student Records &amp; Engagement Products will play a critical role in defining the product strategy and execution of Student Records and Engagement products and services to enable secure, compliant record management for students and facilitate student engagement with their academics and the university (e.g., Registrar and MyUCLA). The Product Manager, Student Records and Engagement will conduct customer research and collaborate with key stakeholders across the university to develop and convey a distinct product vision. The Student Records and Engagement Product Manager will be responsible for driving innovation and excellence by working closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and users to define requirements, prioritize features, and deliver exceptional value. Product Strategy This role is responsible in defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a focus on long term success of Student Records and Engagement products. They will bring the voice of the customer during roadmap development and backlog prioritization stages, and collaborate with key product stakeholders incorporate their needs and convey a cohesive product vision. Product Planning The Product Manager will be responsible to define and establish clear and detailed product requirements, stories, security by design, and acceptability standards while working with stakeholders, business analysts, and UX/UI designers. Product Development The Product Manager is accountable for the successful delivery of the entire product lifecycle, working with development teams, product owners, team supervisors, and product development teams to ensure prioritized features are developed, secured, and compliant while maintaining a keen focus on human-centered design. Customer and Stakeholder Management The Student Records and Engagement Product Manager will be responsible for driving innovation and excellence by working closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, understanding their needs, gathering user insights, and acting as a liaison between functional stakeholders and product development teams. Human-Centered Design &amp; Product Insights Lastly, the Product Manager will maintain a keen focus building human-centered user experiences, ensuring accessibility and usability requirements are met. Additionally, they will define and track product metrics around adoption, customer satisfaction, and product performance in order to make data informed decisions to continually improve Student Records &amp; Engagement products. The Product Manager, Student Records &amp; Engagement will positively impact UCLA's operations and culture by enabling University stakeholders to effectively leverage human resources products and applications. This team member will advance the University's mission by delivering exceptional information technology services. comprehensively and consistently across faculty, staff, and students. This role will execute UCLA's vision while. modeling UCLA's culture and values.<br><br><strong>Salary &amp; Compensation<br><br></strong><ul><li>UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Five years experience working in one or more of the following fields: information technology, application services, product services, computer science, computer information systems, or related field. metadata.description: <p><strong>Title: Program Coordinator</strong></p><p><strong>Reports to: Program Director</strong></p><p><strong>Location: Must be based in the Chicago, IL or Los Angeles, CA metro areas. Remote work from home or co-working with weekly in-person events and meetings in Chicago. Occasional (approx. 6-8x/year) national travel.</strong></p><p><strong>Posted: January 29, 2026</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply - No Exceptions</strong></p><p>You must apply following these specific directions. Please read them carefully. Candidates who only apply on LinkedIn will not be considered. Please send the following in PDF format via email to careers@picklesgroup.org, with a subject line that reads (exactly as written): <em>Program Coordinator – Application</em>. We request your resume and a cover letter answering the following questions as an attachment to the email (cover letter in no more than one page, 11 point font):</p><ol><li><strong>&nbsp;What excites you about this role and Pickles Group’s mission? If you have a personal connection to the work that you’re comfortable sharing, we’d love to hear more.</strong></li><li><strong>How do you stay organized while managing multiple projects and high-priority responsibilities? Share a specific example to help us understand how you set yourself up for success.</strong></li><li><strong>How might you leverage your role to improve support for families who come from different backgrounds, communities, or are experiencing different challenges? Feel free to share an example of a time you’ve done this in the past that you’re proud of if you have one.</strong></li></ol><p><br></p><p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p><p>Pickles Group is a growing national 501(c)3 nonprofit organization founded in 2021. Our mission is to provide free peer-to-peer support and resources to kids facing a parent or caregiver’s cancer. We’ve doubled our impact every year since we launched, supporting 4,916 families and distributing 66,250 Family Cancer Support Kits across all 50 states and 13 countries to date.</p><p><br></p><p>Our team is caring, collaborative, and focused on making a big impact. We support each other and believe that the culture we’re building within our organization is as important as the work we do. We believe that every family navigating a parent or caregiver’s cancer deserves access to support and resources that help them heal and thrive.&nbsp;You can learn more about what that commitment means here.</p><p><br></p><p>We are hiring our first-ever Program Coordinator to ensure our programs run smoothly, consistently, and with care. This role exists so families, volunteers, and partners can focus on connection and support, while operations, logistics, and systems are handled effectively and reliably behind the scenes. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, creating systems others can rely on, and taking pride in strong operational execution. </p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><p><strong>Program Operations &amp; Logistics&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Coordinate logistics for virtual and in-person programs, webinars, and resources (calendars, scheduling, Zoom links, communications)</li><li>Coordinate with external vendors, partners, and facilities for programs and events</li><li>Manage program materials, inventory, and shipping</li><li>Build and maintain checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes</li><li>Anticipate needs and resolve issues proactively</li><li>Distribute and organize evaluations and feedback</li><li>Support planning and execution of signature programs and events</li><li>Coordinate registrations, materials, and run-of-show logistics for in-person and virtual programs</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Program Data &amp; Systems&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Maintain accurate enrollment, attendance, and participation data via Monday.com, Google forms, and other digital tools as we grow</li><li>Track workflows and deadlines using Monday.com and related tools</li><li>Flag data inconsistencies and system gaps</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Family &amp; Volunteer Coordination&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Serve as a welcoming point of contact for families</li><li>Support intake, enrollment, and ongoing participation logistics</li><li>Assist with volunteer scheduling, onboarding logistics, and training materials</li><li>Escalate sensitive situations when appropriate</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How Will You Know You’re Successful?</strong></p><ul><li>Programs run smoothly with minimal last-minute issues</li><li>Families and volunteers receive timely, supportive, welcoming communication</li><li>Program data is accurate and actionable</li><li>Systems and processes are refined and improved to help us scale and grow</li><li>Teammates can focus on strategy and relationships because operations are handled reliably</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How and When You’ll Do It</strong></p><p>Be a team player: We are a small team that is continually growing and evolving. We have an all-hands-on-deck approach in a remote working environment (working both from home and in the field) using Google Workplace and Zoom. To succeed in this role, you must be responsive to emails, texts, and calls. You will need to work frequent evenings and weekends, the times that often work best for our families and supporters for events and programs, with opportunities to take other weekdays off. (Our programs take place on half of the Sundays of the year; you would work with us to identify another day of the week to take off accordingly.)</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p><ul><li>Highly organized, efficient, and detail-oriented</li><li>Reliable, proactive, and at your best owning operational work</li><li>Clear, warm communicator</li><li>Excited about learning new digital systems and working with data</li><li>Curious and open to experimenting with new tools, including AI</li><li>Thoughtful about creating supportive, welcoming experiences for all families &nbsp;</li></ul><p><strong></strong></p><p><strong>What Would Be Great to Bring</strong></p><ul><li>1–2 years of related experience (including internships or volunteer roles) with logistics, programs, or events</li><li>Experience working with families, volunteers, and external partners</li><li>Familiarity with tools like Monday.com, Airtable, Asana, or Salesforce, and Google Workspace</li><li>Comfort working remotely or in hybrid environments</li><li>A sense of humor</li><li>Experience working with diverse communities&nbsp;</li><li>A personal connection to our mission</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Salary and Benefits</strong></p><p>The starting annual salary offered for this role is $55,000: your salary will be commensurate with your experience and competitive for the role. As a full-time staff member, you’ll receive a generous annual healthcare and retirement savings stipend, three weeks of paid time off, three months of paid family leave, and a home/co-working office stipend. The location for this position is either the Greater Chicago, IL metro area or Los Angeles, CA metro area.</p><p><br></p><p>Pickles Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse and inclusive workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals across race, ethnicity, color, spirituality, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, ability, veteran status, health, socioeconomic status, healthcare access, and other personal identities.</p>

metadata.description: <strong>Who We Are:<br><br></strong><strong>Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.<br><br></strong>Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of <strong>Fast Company’s Brands That Matter</strong> and winning a <strong>Best Carbon Footprint</strong> award, we have big goals like being <strong>Climate Positive by 2025</strong>, <strong>Circular by 2030</strong>, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in <strong>Drapers</strong> and <strong>Sourcing Journal</strong>, and <strong>TIME</strong> wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.<br><br>We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own <strong>sustainable factory in LA</strong>. We innovate across categories like <strong>accessories</strong>, <strong>swimwear</strong>, and <strong>sleepwear</strong>, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like <strong>this</strong>, <strong>this</strong> and <strong>this</strong>.<br><br>None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.<br><br>And starting right now, we want to do all that<strong> with you.<br><br></strong><strong>Work Location/ Schedule: </strong>Hybrid from Vernon HQ<br><br><strong>The Role: </strong>Quality Assurance Manager<br><br>The Manager of Quality Assurance is responsible for driving product compliance and quality consistency through the effective management and execution of core Quality Assurance processes. These processes include, but are not limited to, care label approvals, International garment and fabric inspections, fabric and garment testing, and high-return investigations. This role is essential for operational efficiency and acts as the key communication link between vendors, third-party inspection partners, internal Quality Control (QC), and the internal Production, Fabric, and Merchandising teams.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do:<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Overseas Inspection &amp; Audit Management (~65%):</strong> Review 3rd-party reports (QIMA, Intertek, Baak, etc.). You will release passing shipments, troubleshoot workmanship/measurement issues for failures, and hold shipments missing approved TOP samples. metadata.description: <p><strong>Title: Program Coordinator</strong></p><p><strong>Reports to: Program Director</strong></p><p><strong>Location: Must be based in the Chicago, IL or Los Angeles, CA metro areas. Remote work from home or co-working with weekly in-person events and meetings in Chicago. Occasional (approx. 6-8x/year) national travel.</strong></p><p><strong>Posted: January 29, 2026</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply - No Exceptions</strong></p><p>You must apply following these specific directions. Please read them carefully. Candidates who only apply on LinkedIn will not be considered. Please send the following in PDF format via email to careers@picklesgroup.org, with a subject line that reads (exactly as written): <em>Program Coordinator – Application</em>. We request your resume and a cover letter answering the following questions as an attachment to the email (cover letter in no more than one page, 11 point font):</p><ol><li><strong>&nbsp;What excites you about this role and Pickles Group’s mission? If you have a personal connection to the work that you’re comfortable sharing, we’d love to hear more.</strong></li><li><strong>How do you stay organized while managing multiple projects and high-priority responsibilities? Share a specific example to help us understand how you set yourself up for success.</strong></li><li><strong>How might you leverage your role to improve support for families who come from different backgrounds, communities, or are experiencing different challenges? Feel free to share an example of a time you’ve done this in the past that you’re proud of if you have one.</strong></li></ol><p><br></p><p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p><p>Pickles Group is a growing national 501(c)3 nonprofit organization founded in 2021. Our mission is to provide free peer-to-peer support and resources to kids facing a parent or caregiver’s cancer. We’ve doubled our impact every year since we launched, supporting 4,916 families and distributing 66,250 Family Cancer Support Kits across all 50 states and 13 countries to date.</p><p><br></p><p>Our team is caring, collaborative, and focused on making a big impact. We support each other and believe that the culture we’re building within our organization is as important as the work we do. We believe that every family navigating a parent or caregiver’s cancer deserves access to support and resources that help them heal and thrive.&nbsp;You can learn more about what that commitment means here.</p><p><br></p><p>We are hiring our first-ever Program Coordinator to ensure our programs run smoothly, consistently, and with care. This role exists so families, volunteers, and partners can focus on connection and support, while operations, logistics, and systems are handled effectively and reliably behind the scenes. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, creating systems others can rely on, and taking pride in strong operational execution. </p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><p><strong>Program Operations &amp; Logistics&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Coordinate logistics for virtual and in-person programs, webinars, and resources (calendars, scheduling, Zoom links, communications)</li><li>Coordinate with external vendors, partners, and facilities for programs and events</li><li>Manage program materials, inventory, and shipping</li><li>Build and maintain checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes</li><li>Anticipate needs and resolve issues proactively</li><li>Distribute and organize evaluations and feedback</li><li>Support planning and execution of signature programs and events</li><li>Coordinate registrations, materials, and run-of-show logistics for in-person and virtual programs</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Program Data &amp; Systems&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Maintain accurate enrollment, attendance, and participation data via Monday.com, Google forms, and other digital tools as we grow</li><li>Track workflows and deadlines using Monday.com and related tools</li><li>Flag data inconsistencies and system gaps</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Family &amp; Volunteer Coordination&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Serve as a welcoming point of contact for families</li><li>Support intake, enrollment, and ongoing participation logistics</li><li>Assist with volunteer scheduling, onboarding logistics, and training materials</li><li>Escalate sensitive situations when appropriate</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How Will You Know You’re Successful?</strong></p><ul><li>Programs run smoothly with minimal last-minute issues</li><li>Families and volunteers receive timely, supportive, welcoming communication</li><li>Program data is accurate and actionable</li><li>Systems and processes are refined and improved to help us scale and grow</li><li>Teammates can focus on strategy and relationships because operations are handled reliably</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How and When You’ll Do It</strong></p><p>Be a team player: We are a small team that is continually growing and evolving. We have an all-hands-on-deck approach in a remote working environment (working both from home and in the field) using Google Workplace and Zoom. To succeed in this role, you must be responsive to emails, texts, and calls. You will need to work frequent evenings and weekends, the times that often work best for our families and supporters for events and programs, with opportunities to take other weekdays off. (Our programs take place on half of the Sundays of the year; you would work with us to identify another day of the week to take off accordingly.)</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p><ul><li>Highly organized, efficient, and detail-oriented</li><li>Reliable, proactive, and at your best owning operational work</li><li>Clear, warm communicator</li><li>Excited about learning new digital systems and working with data</li><li>Curious and open to experimenting with new tools, including AI</li><li>Thoughtful about creating supportive, welcoming experiences for all families &nbsp;</li></ul><p><strong></strong></p><p><strong>What Would Be Great to Bring</strong></p><ul><li>1–2 years of related experience (including internships or volunteer roles) with logistics, programs, or events</li><li>Experience working with families, volunteers, and external partners</li><li>Familiarity with tools like Monday.com, Airtable, Asana, or Salesforce, and Google Workspace</li><li>Comfort working remotely or in hybrid environments</li><li>A sense of humor</li><li>Experience working with diverse communities&nbsp;</li><li>A personal connection to our mission</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Salary and Benefits</strong></p><p>The starting annual salary offered for this role is $55,000: your salary will be commensurate with your experience and competitive for the role. As a full-time staff member, you’ll receive a generous annual healthcare and retirement savings stipend, three weeks of paid time off, three months of paid family leave, and a home/co-working office stipend. The location for this position is either the Greater Chicago, IL metro area or Los Angeles, CA metro area.</p><p><br></p><p>Pickles Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse and inclusive workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals across race, ethnicity, color, spirituality, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, ability, veteran status, health, socioeconomic status, healthcare access, and other personal identities.</p>

metadata.description: <strong>About Goodr<br><br></strong>We create and sell active eyewear for anyone. No Slip. No Bounce. All Polarized. All Fun. Interested in joining our team? Keep reading.<br><br><strong>OUR VALUES:</strong> We have two core values: Fun &amp; Authenticity.<br><br><ul><li>FUN = Being sh*tty isn’t fun. Agreed? Taking pride in your work, finding joy in being GREAT, and celebrating wins… and losses. Now, that’s fun!</li><li>AUTHENTICITY = Focusing on being authentic over being liked. (Next-level guru stuff. Count it.) <br><br></li></ul><strong>LEADERSHIP:</strong> We expect our leaders to be guiding lights for their teams. To support that, we provide leadership courses to sharpen their leadership abilities, including an in-house leadership coach.<br><br><strong>Fun Fact:</strong> We do not allow email to be sent internally. Carrier pigeons only. JK, we use Slack.<br><br><strong>AUTONOMY:</strong> We practice autonomy, empowerment, and accountability so that every team member can be in control of their own life.<br><br><ul><li>HYBRID WORKING: This role is required to be in our Inglewood office every Tuesday and Thursday with the occasional third day thrown in.</li><li>PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: We have an all-company learning program so that we’re constantly leveling up our skills.<br><br></li></ul><strong>SUSTAINABILITY:</strong> We think Earth’s pretty rad. That’s why we take action wherever possible to limit our impact on the planet.<br><br><ul><li>1% FOR THE PLANET MEMBER: 1% of goodr’s annual sales go directly to environmental organizations.</li><li>CARBON NEUTRAL: In 2019, goodr became a 100% carbon neutral company.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Fun Fact:</strong> goodr celebrates every Earth Day by releasing limited-edition sunglasses with frames made from 100% recycled materials—and the packaging is 100% sustainable, too!<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>Do you look at a mess of legacy technical debt and see a beautiful puzzle instead of a reason to pull your hair out? We’re looking for a digital wizard to architect scalable, cloud-first platforms while ensuring our systems don’t pull a "blue screen of death" during a big launch. You’ll be the one holding the keys to the kingdom, negotiating vendor contracts like a shark and keeping our data more secure than a squirrel’s favorite nut stash.<br><br>If you can translate a "strategic roadmap" into plain English without making our eyes glaze over, you’re already halfway there. We need a leader who can kill off useless tech dependencies so we don’t accidentally end up using floppy disks in 2026. If you’re ready to lead our tech empire with high-level genius and a healthy dose of sarcasm, plug yourself in and apply!<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>LEADERSHIP<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead by example by consistently living into goodr’s values of Fun and Authenticity </li><li>Be a culture carrier by leaning into our three fundamentals of communication, professionalism, and vision</li><li>Hold monthly one-on-ones with each team member to build upon their role duties and hold everyone accountable</li><li>Ask clear questions, increase everyone’s knowledge, and empower the team so that we can get the best out of every person in your department</li><li>Give consistent, continuous feedback and challenge your flock to perpetually grow so they become the best version of themselves</li><li>Own your team’s budget and ensure its accuracy</li><li>Use imagination and wisdom to set team goals and communicate them clearly</li><li>Challenge the status quo ALWAYS; the phrase “this is how we’ve always done it” is banned here at goodr, so don’t be afraid to push out of your comfort zone and encourage your team to do the same<br><br></li></ul><strong>ROLE SPECIFIC<br><br></strong><ul><li>Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and administration of the organization’s technology systems, platforms, and equipment</li><li>Define and execute the enterprise technology strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring alignment with company objectives and growth plans</li><li>Architect and evolve scalable, cloud-first platforms and infrastructure to support rapid growth and operational reliability</li><li>Oversee enterprise systems, platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure performance, availability, and resiliency</li><li>Own technology financials, including annual budgeting, vendor strategy, contract negotiation, and cost optimization</li><li>Establish and maintain standards for data security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management</li><li>Drive reduction of technical debt, improve system resilience, and decrease dependency on external vendors to strengthen platform stability and operational agility</li><li>Lead delivery of large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives with clear business outcomes and measurable impact</li><li>Partner with executive leadership and business stakeholders to prioritize technology investments and initiatives</li><li>Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends to inform strategic decisions and maintain competitive advantage</li><li>This role is in the Money Department and will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer</li><li>Perform other related duties as assigned<br><br></li></ul><strong>About The Ideal Candidate<br><br></strong><ul><li>May or may not have a degree…we don’t care (bonus points for Basset Hound Science or Dinosaur Law)</li><li>12+ years in technology leadership, with at least 5+ in senior leadership roles</li><li>Experience managing ERP, CRM, and enterprise platforms, including NetSuite, Salesforce, and Shopify</li><li>Skilled in systems integration and iPaaS platforms (e.g., Boomi) and cloud-based infrastructure</li><li>Strong track record in data governance, security, compliance, and fraud prevention</li><li>Proven ability to translate business strategy into scalable technology solutions</li><li>Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, and ROI-driven investments</li><li>Visionary excited to grow and scale the systems function</li><li>Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives</li><li>Excellent executive communication and stakeholder collaboration skills</li><li>Lives for systems!</li><li>Loves the work more than a paycheck</li><li>Is happy to give away credit to their team </li><li>Loves getting and giving feedback </li><li>Is into personal growth</li><li>Thinks Fun is doing great work (not just partying) </li><li>Is proactive and an independent problem solver! (Can you google a question?)<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Get<br><br></strong><ul><li>A role at a company that is going to the moon</li><li>The opportunity to show up every day and have fun</li><li>The ability to learn and grow as a person</li><li>Paid vacation (we encourage you to take time off!)</li><li>Flexible work environment (want to go for a run at 11am on Wednesday, go for it!)</li><li>Paycheck... obviously. Salary range: $250k - $270k; final offer will be made within this range based on experience</li><li>Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits</li><li>401(K) with company matching</li><li>Financial Wellness Counseling</li><li>Sunglasses. Duh.</li><li>No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.<br><br></li></ul><strong>NEXT STEPS<br><br></strong>Here's what we expect the hiring process for this role to be, should all go well with your candidacy. This entire process is expected to take 10 weeks to complete and you'd be expected to start on a specific date.<br><br><ul><li> Application</li><li> Fill out a form with basic questions</li><li> 30 minute virtual interview with HR team member</li><li> 30 minute virtual interview with hiring manager</li><li> 25 minute virtual interviews with various leaders and peers</li><li> 45 minute in-person assignment and presentation with group panel</li><li> Final interview with hiring manager</li><li> Offer!<br><br></li></ul><strong>TO GET THE PROCESS STARTED, REVIEW &amp; SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Review goodr's Applicant Privacy Policy. metadata.description: <strong>Who We Are:<br><br></strong><strong>Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.<br><br></strong>Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of <strong>Fast Company’s Brands That Matter</strong> and winning a <strong>Best Carbon Footprint</strong> award, we have big goals like being <strong>Climate Positive by 2025</strong>, <strong>Circular by 2030</strong>, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in <strong>Drapers</strong> and <strong>Sourcing Journal</strong>, and <strong>TIME</strong> wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.<br><br>We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own <strong>sustainable factory in LA</strong>. We innovate across categories like <strong>accessories</strong>, <strong>swimwear</strong>, and <strong>sleepwear</strong>, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like <strong>this</strong>, <strong>this</strong> and <strong>this</strong>.<br><br>None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.<br><br>And starting right now, we want to do all that<strong> with you.<br><br></strong><strong>Work Location/ Schedule: </strong>Hybrid from Vernon HQ<br><br><strong>The Role: </strong>Quality Assurance Manager<br><br>The Manager of Quality Assurance is responsible for driving product compliance and quality consistency through the effective management and execution of core Quality Assurance processes. These processes include, but are not limited to, care label approvals, International garment and fabric inspections, fabric and garment testing, and high-return investigations. This role is essential for operational efficiency and acts as the key communication link between vendors, third-party inspection partners, internal Quality Control (QC), and the internal Production, Fabric, and Merchandising teams.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do:<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Overseas Inspection &amp; Audit Management (~65%):</strong> Review 3rd-party reports (QIMA, Intertek, Baak, etc.). You will release passing shipments, troubleshoot workmanship/measurement issues for failures, and hold shipments missing approved TOP samples. You’ll also manage the 3-week audit plan and follow up on unscheduled vendor audits.</li><li><strong>Care Label Compliance (~12%):</strong> Verify vendor-submitted labels against BOM, PIM, and Tech Packs. You’ll identify discrepancies, request vendor corrections, and update PIM layouts to ensure total accuracy.</li><li><strong>Fabric &amp; Garment Testing (~11%):</strong> Manage the end-to-end testing process. This includes reviewing overseas fabric reports, processing internal test requests (preparing yardage/forms), managing retests, and communicating rejection or replacement instructions to suppliers.</li><li><strong>Planning &amp; QC Capacity (~2%):</strong> Track TOP/Tech sample arrivals and build weekly QC capacity vs. demand charts to ensure the team stays ahead of incoming volume.</li><li><strong>Returns &amp; Escalation Analysis (~4%):</strong> Partner with Merch/Production to investigate high-return items. You’ll coordinate inventory pulls, conduct measurement checks against original inspection results, and prepare samples/findings for executive review.</li><li><strong>Special Call-Outs (~2%):</strong> Investigate escalated issues from Import Production, coordinate re-audits, and ensure vendors implement corrective actions to close out quality gaps.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You’ll Need:<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Experience:</strong> 4–6 years in Apparel Quality Control, QA, or Production.</li><li><strong>Technical Mastery:</strong> Strong knowledge of garment construction, fabric behavior, and inspection standards (AQL, inline vs. final audits).</li><li><strong>Documentation Savvy:</strong> Ability to cross-reference complex data across BOMs, PIMs, Tech Packs, and lab reports.</li><li><strong>System Skills:</strong> Intermediate Excel proficiency (vlookups, pivot tables). Experience with NetSuite or PIM systems is a major plus.</li><li><strong>Testing Knowledge:</strong> Familiarity with fabric performance standards (colorfastness, shrinkage, seam strength) and lab testing methods.</li><li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree (Textiles, Apparel Manufacturing, or Supply Chain) or equivalent professional experience.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Who You Are:<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Detail-Obsessed:</strong> You notice the small discrepancies in a care label or a lab report that others might miss.</li><li><strong>A Clear Communicator:</strong> You can provide concise, actionable feedback to overseas vendors and internal cross-functional partners.</li><li><strong>Data-Driven Decision Maker:</strong> You use standards and evidence to decide when to approve a marginal improvement or reject a lot.</li><li><strong>High-Volume Pro:</strong> You thrive in fast-paced environments and can manage multiple deadlines and hundreds of reports without breaking a sweat.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Compensation:<br><br></strong>At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is <strong>$70,000 to $77,000 annually + 10% bonus</strong> eligibility, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.<br><br>This role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a range of factors, including company performance, department goals, and individual contributions. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and are determined at the company’s discretion.<br><br>Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.<br><br><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.</li><li>We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees. </li><li>We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds. </li><li>We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.</li><li>You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.</li><li>We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis. </li><li>We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!<br><br></li></ul><strong><em>Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. </em></strong><em>We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.<br><br></em><em>If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.<br><br></em><strong><em>Still don’t know if you should apply? </em></strong><em>We get it—</em><strong><em>studies</em></strong><em> show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our </em><strong><em>general application.<br><br></em></strong><strong>Want some more?! -</strong> <strong>Sustainability</strong>, <strong>Forbes</strong><strong>,</strong> <strong>Fast Company<br><br></strong><strong>California Applicant Privacy Notice </strong><strong>found here</strong>

metadata.description: <strong>Job Description And Duties<br><br></strong>We are seeking a motivated person who values a positive and empowering work environment. As a Senior Legal Analyst in the Government Law Section, you will work under the direction of the Senior Assistant Attorney General in performing administrative, technical, and analytical work to support the Government Law Section's mission (which is to provide legal advice and representation to the State's constitutional officers and agencies on a wide range of issues). metadata.description: <p><strong>JOB TITLE</strong></p><p><span>Senior Applied Machine Learning Engineer (audio / music generation)</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p><p><span>We’re building an AI-powered music system focused on commercial-ready audio generation. Our initial priority is getting the music generation quality right - structure, musicality, consistency, and production readiness.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>We are looking for a Senior Applied ML Engineer to own the end-to-end audio generation pipeline for our MVP. This role is hands-on and pragmatic: you’ll fine-tune open-source music models, integrate inference pipelines, and work closely with audio and backend engineers to deliver usable results quickly and efficiently. This role starts as a contract engagement (details below), with a path to full-time position for the right fit.</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>ROLE DETAIL</strong></p><ul><li><span>Terms: Fixed-term (5 months) | Potential full-time conversion</span></li><li><span>Compensation:&nbsp; $30,000 (Full 5 Month Term)</span></li><li><span>Location: Hybrid/On-site (Monrovia, CA)</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON</strong></p><ul><li><span>Fine-tuning open-source music generation models.</span></li><li><span>Implement conditioning controls (beats per minute, key, mood, section, density).</span></li><li><span>Training and deploying parameter-efficient fine-tunes (LoRA / adapters).</span></li><li><span>Building reference-conditioned generation.</span></li><li><span>Support long-form generation via chunking and continuation.</span></li><li><span>Integrating with Backend inference pipelines and APIs.</span></li><li><span>Collaborating with audio DSP engineers to ensure outputs are production ready.</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p><ul><li><span>Strong experience with Python and PyTorch.</span></li><li><span>Hands-on experience with audio or speech generation models.</span></li><li><span>Familiarity with diffusion or autoregressive generative models.</span></li><li><span>Experience using or fine-tuning open-source ML models, familiar with HF Interfaces.</span></li><li><span>Understanding of audio representations.</span></li><li><span>Experience deploying ML models to production or API environments.</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS</strong></p><ul><li><span>Familiarity with CLAP / audio embeddings or retrieval-assisted generation.</span></li><li><span>Experience working with LoRA / PEFT methods.</span></li><li><span>Basic understanding of audio production workflows (tempo, key, stems, loudness).</span></li><li><span>Experience Optimizing inference cost and latency.</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>ROLE GOALS &amp; OBJECTIVES</strong></p><ul><li><span>Reliably generate musically coherent, commercial-friendly cues (30 ~ 120 seconds)</span></li><li><span>The model responds correctly to conditioning inputs like tempo, key and mood</span></li><li><span>Outputs are stable, repeatable and usable downstream by post-production tools</span></li><li><span>The system is modular and ready to be integrated with downstream models.</span></li></ul><p><br></p>

metadata.description: GoodRx is America’s healthcare marketplace. Each month, millions of people visit goodrx.com to find reliable health information and discounts for their healthcare — and we’ve helped people save $60 billion since 2011. We provide prescription discounts that are accepted at more than 70,000 pharmacies in the U.S., as well as telehealth services including doctor visits and lab tests. Our services have been positively reviewed by Good Morning America, The New York Times, NBC News, AARP, and many others.<br><br>Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.<br><br>As an intern you will be a part of the 12 week summer internship program that will provide an exceptional learning experience and an opportunity to be a part of a company who is helping Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We are currently looking for hard-working, curious and eager students to join our team.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong><strong>GoodRx is looking for an Intern to join the Internal Audit Team. <br><br></strong><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Support Sarbanes–Oxley (SOX) and Operational audits for both business process and IT functions.</li><li>Assist in evaluating internal controls over financial reporting (business process testing)</li><li>Assist in evaluating IT general controls (ITGCs) such as access management, change management, and system operations.</li><li>Observe process walkthroughs to identify key activities, risks, and controls.</li><li>Identify, discuss, and report control deficiencies and operational gaps.</li><li>Collaborate with management to ensure corrective actions are being implemented.</li><li>Prepare well-documented workpapers that are clear and organized.</li><li>Assist in drafting audit reports and summaries for management.</li><li>Expand audit, accounting, and technical knowledge through hands-on experience.</li><li>Seek clarification and ask questions to enhance understanding of assigned tasks.</li><li>Provide status updates on task progress and communicate any challenges to supervisors.</li><li>Listen and engage with peers, managers, and clients to foster collaboration.</li><li>Demonstrate dedication to help the Internal Audit department meet key milestones.</li><li>Help prepare documentation for ESG reporting (the disclosure of environmental, social and corporate governance data).</li><li>Perform other related duties as assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills And Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree candidate, preferably in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, or related field</li><li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills</li><li>Attention to detail and accuracy</li><li>A foundation in core business processes</li><li>Ability to work independently and in teams</li><li>Extremely curious and motivated to develop your skills throughout the internship!</li><li>Preferred location: Hybrid in Santa Monica, San Francisco, or New York</li><li>Graduating class of May/June 2027 - May/June 2028</li><li>Able to commit to a full-time internship program for 12 weeks during the summer of 2026.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits<br><br></strong><ul><li>The compensation rate for undergraduate students is $22.00 an hour.</li><li>GoodRx also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits to interns throughout the duration of the internship.</li><li>Application deadline: Tuesday, February 10th, 2026 (Noon PT)***<br><br></li></ul>We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has a seat at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel.<br><br>With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. GoodRx is committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage women, people of color, those in the LGBTQ+ communities, and Veterans to apply for positions even if they don’t necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Please still get in touch - we’d love to connect and see if you could be good for the role!<br><br>GoodRx is America's healthcare marketplace. The company offers the most comprehensive and accurate resource for affordable prescription medications in the U.S., gathering pricing information from thousands of pharmacies coast to coast, as well as a telehealth marketplace for online doctor visits and lab tests. Since 2011, Americans with and without health insurance have saved $60 billion using GoodRx and million consumers visit goodrx.com each month to find discounts and information related to their healthcare. GoodRx is the #1 most downloaded medical app on the iOS and Android app stores. For more information, visit www.goodrx.com.<br><br>We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from <strong>@</strong><strong>goodrx.com</strong> or <strong>goodrx@myworkday.com </strong>addresses.

metadata.description: <strong>Department Summary<br><br></strong>The UCLA Police Department is a leader in providing progressive law enforcement services to a culturally diverse urban campus and its surrounding community. We are dedicated to providing a safe and secure environment for teaching, research and public service. We do this through patrol, rapid response to calls for service, investigations, education and implementation of preventative strategies. Our work, grounded in a community policing philosophy, utilizes campus partnerships as the most effective approach for insuring a safe campus.<br><br><strong>Position Summary<br><br></strong>The Public Safety Dispatcher provides dispatching services during emergency and routine assignments. The Communications Center is staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with scheduled shift rotations every 6 months.<br><br>Daily duties include but are not limited to the following:<br><br><ul><li>Receive and relay emergency and nonemergency calls for assistance via telephone, radio and computer terminals</li><li>Answer and/or redirect calls for information</li><li>Prioritize and dispatch emergency calls for police, fire, medical aid, hazardous materials and allied agencies</li><li>Monitor, acknowledge and input computerized alarm data for intrusion, robbery, fire, unknown trouble and facilities alarm systems</li><li>Operate, update, and maintain computer terminals, including computer-aided dispatch and National Law Enforcement Telecommunications System, based on officer requests</li><li>Dispatch units, such as police, fire, medial aid, security, parking enforcement and facilities, utilizing two-way radio systems<br><br></li></ul>For lateral candidates with one year or more of recent experience in a 9-1-1 emergency dispatching center for fire or police, the department may consider waiving the online job-related skills assessment test portion of the examination process. All other interested candidates will be invited to participate in the complete process. The selection process consists of an online job-related skills assessment test that includes a typing test, oral interview, medical and psychological examinations, and a thorough background investigation.<br><br><strong>Salary &amp; Compensation<br><br></strong><ul><li>UCLA provides a full pay range. This role is hands-on and pragmatic: you’ll fine-tune open-source music models, integrate inference pipelines, and work closely with audio and backend engineers to deliver usable results quickly and efficiently. This role starts as a contract engagement (details below), with a path to full-time position for the right fit.</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>ROLE DETAIL</strong></p><ul><li><span>Terms: Fixed-term (5 months) | Potential full-time conversion</span></li><li><span>Compensation:&nbsp; metadata.description: <p><strong>Why Work For Us</strong></p><p>Grubhub, part of <u>Wonder Group Inc</u>, is all about connecting hungry diners with our network of over 375,000 merchants nationwide. Innovative technology, user-friendly platforms and streamlined delivery capabilities set us apart and make us an industry leader in the world of online food ordering. When you join our team, you become part of a community that works together to innovate, solve problems, grow, work hard and have a ton of fun in the process!</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About The Role</strong></p><p>Grubhub is looking for a bright, curious and energetic Product Analyst to join the Product Analytics team at GrubHub. The team surfaces insights that drive strategy and optimal decision making for the Executive team and leaders across the organization. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding the ‘who, what, and whys’ of our business - working cross-functionally to dig into trends and surface value-creating opportunities</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Impact You’ll Make:</strong></p><ul><li>Collaborate with product management stakeholders to design and deliver analysis that informs our product roadmap</li><li>Build business cases that evaluate opportunities prior to changes being built/tested and validate impact post-launch</li><li>Provide ad-hoc analysis to isolate consumer pain points and identify potential solutions</li><li>Monitor KPIs and business drivers, highlighting trends and investigating underlying causes of discrepancies</li><li>Prepare KPI reports for the senior leadership teams</li><li>Be curious! Proactively surface insights and trends that improve our customer experience and help us grow faster!</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What You Bring to the Table:</strong></p><ul><li>3+ years of experience in data analytics or a closely related field</li><li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of leveraging data insights to influence business decisions</li><li>Ability to communicate insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership</li><li>Skills to work with large datasets and perform custom aggregations and data cleaning to meet</li><li>analysis needs; SQL proficiency required</li><li>Understanding of data visualization best practices and tools (Excel skills required and Tableau experience preferred)</li><li>Understanding of basic statistical concepts (statistical significance, confidence intervals, etc) preferred</li><li>Functional experience with one or more of the following: product analytics, loyalty/subscription program analytics, e-commerce ads, website/app UI/UX optimization, and/or A/B testing is a plus</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>NYC Base Salary: </strong>$128,00- $135,500 per year.</p><p><br></p><p>Wonder Group uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.</p><p><br></p><p>Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.</p><p><br></p><p>Grubhub is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity and encourage a workplace that is just as diverse as the customers we serve. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. If you’re applying for a job in the U.S. and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an email to TalentAcquisition@grubhub.com and let us know the nature of your request and contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.</p><p><br></p><p>If you are a resident of the State of California and would like a copy of our CA privacy notice, please email privacy@grubhub.com.</p>

metadata.description: <strong>Be part of an amazing story.<br><br></strong>Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.<br><br><strong>Job Overview<br><br></strong>The Assistant Product Manager brings a high-energy approach to developing customer-centric e-commerce experiences and features that grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve the overall site and app experience. The role executes the product roadmap for the assigned product area and partners with other product managers to deliver domain objectives and key results. The Assistant Product Manager works in an agile environment focused on continuous improvement, where ideas and feedback are actively encouraged.<br><br><strong>What You Will Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Execute a pre-defined product roadmap by owning product milestones and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs).</li><li>Understand and synthesize customer and business needs through market analysis, customer research, hands-on experience, and business data.</li><li>Partner with business teams, UX, engineering, and analytics to define, build, and launch product and platform features.</li><li>Write discovery briefs and detailed product requirements.</li><li>Contribute to the development and documentation of Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).</li><li>Collaborate with product analysts to design, launch, and interpret A/B tests.</li><li>Manage communication and set clear expectations with internal stakeholders.</li><li>Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. </li><li>In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills You Will Need<br><br></strong><strong>Product Management Fundamentals</strong> – Foundational knowledge of product management principles, including roadmaps, requirements, and product lifecycles, with the ability to execute against a pre-defined roadmap and own product milestones.<br><br><strong>Customer-Centric Mindset</strong> – Deep passion for understanding customer needs and behaviors, translating insights into customer-centric e-commerce experiences that improve engagement across site and app journeys.<br><br><strong>Analytical Thinking &amp; Data-Driven Decisions</strong> – Ability to use data, analytics, KPIs, and A/B testing to inform product decisions, evaluate performance, and continuously optimize features and experiences.<br><br><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong> – Proven ability to partner effectively with engineering, UX, analytics, and business teams to define, build, and launch product and platform capabilities.<br><br><strong>Execution &amp; Delivery Excellence</strong> – Strong execution skills with the ability to manage priorities, milestones, and dependencies in an agile environment while delivering measurable outcomes.<br><br><strong>Problem Solving &amp; Curiosity</strong> – Naturally curious and solutions-oriented, with a structured approach to root-cause analysis and comfort navigating ambiguity to solve complex problems.<br><br><strong>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong> – Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and align teams around shared objectives.<br><br><strong>Continuous Learning &amp; Adaptability</strong> – Eagerness to learn industry trends, emerging technologies, and new methodologies, with a growth mindset focused on continuous improvement.<br><br><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong><ul><li>Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. </li><li>Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.</li><li>Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Can Offer You<br><br></strong>Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.<br><br><strong>Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include<br><br></strong><ul><li>Merchandise discounts</li><li>Performance-based incentives</li><li>Annual merit review</li><li>Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice</li><li>Tuition reimbursement<br><br></li></ul>Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.<br><br><strong>About Us<br><br></strong>This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.<br><br><strong>Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today! <br><br></strong><em>This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. <br><br></em>DIGITAL00<br><br>This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

metadata.description: Candid Health is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our team and build the products and features that will power the next generation of healthcare companies. As we grow our customers are becoming increasingly complex; our mission is to abstract that complexity into elegant solutions that make their work more efficient and our automations more robust. As a PM on Candid Health’s team you’ll have direct influence over how we plan, prioritize, and execute our roadmap; in close conjunction with stakeholders across the business.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Be Doing<br><br></strong><ul><li>You’ll be improving our existing product management practices building out new systems that will enable Candid to deliver great products and services</li><li>You’ll be building and executing the product vision in close collaboration with Engineering and Design </li><li>You’ll be thinking about the macro-structure of the business and the product to identify gaps and generate new ideas</li><li>You’ll be held accountable for business goals, and ensuring your partner teams are as well</li><li>You’ll be creating rigorous reporting dashboards for visibility and accountability</li><li>You’ll be capturing signal from the field and our customers to understand and prioritize user needs</li><li>You’ll be responsible for communication about new feature customer rollouts to customers and internal stakeholders including company leadership and operations teams<br><br></li></ul><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong><ul><li>You have 7+ years of experience as a product manager</li><li>You have experience building data-intensive products and applications </li><li>You ground your thinking in unit economics of the business</li><li>You are data driven and can leverage it to provide insights and influence critical decisions</li><li>You are outcome oriented, are an effective collaborator, and you bias towards action</li><li>You can get into technical details and know how to code or can read code, if you weren’t an engineer you can talk the talk</li><li>You have led and scaled a successful product function and had broad scope in a fast moving startup or late stage SaaS or Fintech company</li><li>You may have experience working with healthcare or medical billing, or on the technical side of other highly regulated industries</li><li>You may have experience building ML or AI products that solve real world problems<br><br></li></ul><strong>Pay Transparency<br><br></strong>The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $170,000 to $225,000 USD; commensurate with experience. The listed range is a guideline from Pave data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.<br><br><strong>Please note:</strong> we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, New York, or San Francisco). Our weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely.

metadata.description: <p><strong>Product Manager (New York, NY) </strong></p><p>Optomi, in partnership with a leading entertainment company, is seeking a Product Manager for a hybrid position in the NYC office! In this role, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-driven products, focusing on IT support services such as chatbots, voice chat, knowledge management, and workflow automation. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented individual who will be able to translate technical concepts into business outcomes.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What the right candidate will enjoy:</strong></p><ul><li>Being a part of a leading entertainment company in the U.S.! </li><li>Be a part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and delivery of impactful solutions! </li><li>A team centered environment! </li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Experience of the right candidate: </strong></p><ul><li>Experience in AI-driven product management.</li><li>Working knowledge of LLMs, copilots, agents, and automation.</li><li>Understanding of supervised, generative, and deterministic automation.</li><li>Ability to translate AI capabilities into practical use cases.</li><li>Experience with chatbots, copilots, decision support, and workflow automation.</li><li>Ability to build business cases and quantify cost reduction, productivity, and experience uplift.</li><li>Familiarity with unit economics (e.g., cost per interaction, cost per user, scale effects).</li><li>Strong executive-level communication skills.</li><li>Ability to influence without authority.</li></ul><p>Nice to haves:</p><ul><li>Experience with legacy ITSM tools like ServiceNow.</li><li>Knowledge of AI-related challenges such as hallucination, bias, data quality, and cost-to-serve.</li><li>Familiarity with risk, legal, and security considerations in AI implementation.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What the responsibilities are of the right candidate:</strong></p><ul><li>Managing proof-of-concept projects for voice AI and chat, with a goal of delivering measurable business outcomes.</li><li>Level zero and level one self-service rollouts</li><li>Integration of voice and web chat with the contact center</li><li>Exploration of Teams integration for chat capabilities.</li></ul><p></p>

While beauty experience is a plus, the client is prioritizing candidates with strong <strong>project management and merchandising backgrounds</strong>, particularly from <strong>CPG, mass retail, or large consumer brands</strong>.</p><p>This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced retail environments, enjoys coordinating complex projects, and has hands-on experience executing merchandising programs at scale.</p><p>You will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned retailer programs, overseeing timelines, visual merchandising initiatives, fixture rollouts, and point-of-sale activations from kickoff through performance tracking.</p><p>What You’ll Do</p><p>Retail Program &amp; Project Management</p><ul><li>Manage end-to-end execution of retailer programs, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery.</li><li>Develop and maintain detailed project timelines across multiple workstreams.</li><li>Lead status meetings and provide regular updates to internal and external stakeholders.</li><li>Coordinate cross-functional teams including marketing, supply chain, creative, and vendors.</li></ul><p>Visual Merchandising &amp; In-Store Activations</p><ul><li>Oversee the development and execution of in-store displays, fixtures, and point-of-sale materials.</li><li>Manage ordering and logistics for display components and custom fixtures.</li><li>Support visual weeks, planogram updates, and retailer-specific activations.</li><li>Handle retailer requests such as product linear updates and custom staging needs.</li></ul><p>Operational &amp; Analytical Support</p><ul><li>Create and manage pre-pack codes and merchandising order forms.</li><li>Track performance of merchandising and POS activations, providing insights for optimization.</li><li>Coordinate in-store video updates, including agency briefs, purchase orders, and installation.</li><li>Ensure accuracy of copy and assets in artwork or merchandising management platforms.</li></ul><p>Special Projects</p><ul><li>Support ad hoc retail initiatives and special projects as assigned by the trade marketing team.</li></ul><p>Required Skills &amp; Experience</p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Merchandising, or a related field.</li><li><strong>2–3+ years of experience in merchandising, trade marketing, or retail project management.</strong></li><li>Experience with <strong>CPG, mass retail, or large consumer brands</strong> strongly preferred.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.</li><li>Strong understanding of retail operations, fixtures, planograms, and in-store execution.</li><li>Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.</li><li>Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.</li><li>Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.</li></ul><p>Nice to Have</p><ul><li>Experience in beauty or cosmetics.</li><li>Background working with major retail partners.</li><li>Experience with artwork management or merchandising systems.</li></ul><p>Ideal Candidate Profile</p><ul><li>Comes from <strong>CPG, mass retail, or consumer brands</strong> with hands-on merchandising experience.</li><li>Strong project manager who can coordinate multiple timelines and stakeholders.</li><li>Operationally minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning execution.</li></ul><p></p>

metadata.description: <strong>Be part of an amazing story.<br><br></strong>Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.<br><br><strong>Job Overview<br><br></strong>The Product Manager brings a high-energy approach to developing customer-centric e-commerce user experiences and features that grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve the overall site experience. The role develops and owns execution of the product roadmap for the assigned product area and collaborates with cross-functional partners across design, engineering, analytics, and business throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through execution. The Product Manager works in an agile environment focused on continuous improvement, where ideas and feedback are encouraged, and is empowered to make decisions that create memorable, loyalty-building experiences for every Macy’s customer.<br><br><strong>What You Will Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Develop and maintain a product roadmap aligned to business goals and product strategy by delivering key milestones and achieving defined KPIs.</li><li>Communicate product vision, roadmap, and progress to partners across Macy’s.</li><li>Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve customer experiences through cross-functional collaboration, data analysis, and deep understanding of customer needs.</li><li>Define product and customer experiences through clear, detailed, and timely artifacts, including product requirements and user stories.</li><li>Collaborate with design, engineering, analytics, and other product managers to design, build, and launch product features that drive growth and engagement.</li><li>Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog of well-groomed, insight-driven user stories.</li><li>Partner with engineering scrum teams and technical leads to refine requirements that support simple, intuitive user experiences.</li><li>Define success metrics, ramp plans, and measurement criteria.</li><li>Design and run experiments to test hypotheses and identify solutions that improve conversion, engagement, and customer loyalty.</li><li>Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. </li><li>In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills You Will Need<br><br></strong><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Roadmap Ownership</strong> – Proven ability to define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps that align with business goals, product strategy, and KPIs while delivering measurable customer and commercial impact.<br><br><strong>Customer-Centric Product Thinking</strong> – Deep commitment to understanding customer needs and behaviors, translating insights into intuitive, loyalty-building e-commerce experiences that improve engagement and satisfaction.<br><br><strong>Analytical Thinking &amp; Data-Driven Decisions</strong> – Strong analytical rigor and first-principles problem-solving skills, with the ability to define success metrics, run experiments, interpret data, and apply insights to optimize conversion, engagement, and retention.<br><br><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Collaboration</strong> – Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively with design, engineering, analytics, and business partners across the full product lifecycle.<br><br><strong>Execution Excellence in Agile Environments</strong> – Strong execution skills with experience managing backlogs, grooming user stories, partnering with scrum teams, and delivering high-quality outcomes in an agile, fast-paced environment.<br><br><strong>Business Acumen &amp; E-commerce Expertise</strong> – Solid understanding of retail and e-commerce economics and business strategy frameworks, with the ability to balance customer value and commercial outcomes.<br><br><strong>Technical &amp; Product Development Fluency</strong> – Working knowledge of technical concepts, agile methodologies, and modern product development practices to effectively partner with engineering teams and make informed trade-offs.<br><br><strong>Innovation &amp; Emerging Technology Awareness</strong> – Ability to stay ahead of emerging technologies and leverage them to build differentiated, scalable digital experiences.<br><br><strong>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Influence</strong> – Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product vision, progress, and trade-offs to cross-functional partners and senior leaders.<br><br><strong>Continuous Learning &amp; Growth Mindset</strong> – Curiosity-driven, adaptable learner who actively seeks new methodologies, industry trends, and feedback to continuously improve products and ways of working.<br><br><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong><ul><li>Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. Previous work experience related to product strategy, product management, design, engineering, site merchandising, or management consulting preferably in a retail or ecommerce company required.</li><li>Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.</li><li>Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Can Offer You<br><br></strong>Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.<br><br><strong>Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include<br><br></strong><ul><li>Merchandise discounts</li><li>Performance-based incentives</li><li>Annual merit review</li><li>Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice</li><li>Tuition reimbursement<br><br></li></ul>Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.<br><br><strong>About Us<br><br></strong>This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.<br><br><strong>Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today! <br><br></strong><em>This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. <br><br></em>DIGITAL00<br><br>This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.
