One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.<br><br><strong>Job Overview<br><br></strong>The Assistant Product Manager brings a high-energy approach to developing customer-centric e-commerce experiences and features that grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve the overall site and app experience. The role executes the product roadmap for the assigned product area and partners with other product managers to deliver domain objectives and key results. The Assistant Product Manager works in an agile environment focused on continuous improvement, where ideas and feedback are actively encouraged.<br><br><strong>What You Will Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Execute a pre-defined product roadmap by owning product milestones and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs).</li><li>Understand and synthesize customer and business needs through market analysis, customer research, hands-on experience, and business data.</li><li>Partner with business teams, UX, engineering, and analytics to define, build, and launch product and platform features.</li><li>Write discovery briefs and detailed product requirements.</li><li>Contribute to the development and documentation of Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).</li><li>Collaborate with product analysts to design, launch, and interpret A/B tests.</li><li>Manage communication and set clear expectations with internal stakeholders.</li><li>Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. </li><li>In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Skills You Will Need<br><br></strong><strong>Product Management Fundamentals</strong> – Foundational knowledge of product management principles, including roadmaps, requirements, and product lifecycles, with the ability to execute against a pre-defined roadmap and own product milestones.<br><br><strong>Customer-Centric Mindset</strong> – Deep passion for understanding customer needs and behaviors, translating insights into customer-centric e-commerce experiences that improve engagement across site and app journeys.<br><br><strong>Analytical Thinking &amp; Data-Driven Decisions</strong> – Ability to use data, analytics, KPIs, and A/B testing to inform product decisions, evaluate performance, and continuously optimize features and experiences.<br><br><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong> – Proven ability to partner effectively with engineering, UX, analytics, and business teams to define, build, and launch product and platform capabilities.<br><br><strong>Execution &amp; Delivery Excellence</strong> – Strong execution skills with the ability to manage priorities, milestones, and dependencies in an agile environment while delivering measurable outcomes.<br><br><strong>Problem Solving &amp; Curiosity</strong> – Naturally curious and solutions-oriented, with a structured approach to root-cause analysis and comfort navigating ambiguity to solve complex problems.<br><br><strong>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong> – Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and align teams around shared objectives.<br><br><strong>Continuous Learning &amp; Adaptability</strong> – Eagerness to learn industry trends, emerging technologies, and new methodologies, with a growth mindset focused on continuous improvement.<br><br><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong><ul><li>Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. </li><li>Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.</li><li>Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Can Offer You<br><br></strong>Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.<br><br><strong>Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include<br><br></strong><ul><li>Merchandise discounts</li><li>Performance-based incentives</li><li>Annual merit review</li><li>Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice</li><li>Tuition reimbursement<br><br></li></ul>Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.<br><br><strong>About Us<br><br></strong>This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.<br><br><strong>Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today! <br><br></strong><em>This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. <br><br></em>DIGITAL00<br><br>This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

metadata.description: <strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>We are seeking a Manager, Premium Product Experience to lead the end-to-end journey for Uber's most premium offering. This isn't just about moving people from A to B; it's about redefining luxury mobility. Our ultra-luxury tier product is designed for users who expect a chauffeur-driven experience that rivals the best in the world.<br><br>As the Experience Manager, you will be the primary architect of the guest and chauffeur journey. You will own the service standards that solidify this product as ultra-luxury-from the moment a ride is reserved to the dropoff at the guest's destination. This role requires a blend of high-level strategic design and meticulous operational execution. You will ensure that every touchpoint-booking experience, vehicle ambiance, chauffeur professionalism, and personalized preferences-exceeds the expectations of our most discerning riders.<br><br>For our chauffeurs you'll ensure that their experience with Uber is one that makes their lives easier and empowers them to do what they do best. From onboarding with Uber, to completing rides and delivering first-class<br><br><strong>What You'll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li> Design the End-to-End Journey: Build and refine the Service Standards, moving beyond app mechanics to define the physical experience (e.g., chauffeur attire, meet-and-greet protocols, in-car amenities). </li><li> Optimize the Booking to Completion" Flow: Identify friction points in the reservation &amp; ride app experience and partner with cross-functional teams to improve the experience. </li><li> Drive Service Excellence: Develop specialized quality metrics that go beyond standard Uber ratings. </li><li> Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the voice of the customer &amp; chauffeur to Product, Tech, and Marketing to ensure the digital experience reflects the physical luxury of the ride. </li><li> Incident &amp; Recovery Strategy: Partner with our support org to define the support processes needed for premium products. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Basic Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li> Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Economics, or a related field. </li><li> 5+ years of experience in luxury hospitality, premium mobility, or high-end retail operations. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li> Luxury Mindset: Deep understanding of the "chauffeur" vs. "driver" distinction and what makes a 5-star hospitality experience. </li><li> Analytical Rigor: Ability to use data (SQL preferred) to track experience health and identify systemic issues in the service chain. </li><li> 0-to-1 Experience: Proven track record of launching or scaling premium products where attention to detail is the primary competitive advantage. </li><li> Stakeholder Influence: Experience navigating complex organizations and influencing Product/Tech roadmaps to support operational excellence. </li><li> Empathy &amp; Insight: Exceptional ability to anticipate guest needs and translate them into operational workflows. <br><br></li></ul>For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$146,000 per year - USD$162,000 per year. For New York, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$162,000 per year - USD$180,000 per year. For Washington, DC-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$162,000 per year - USD$180,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award &amp; other types of comp. metadata.description: Candid Health is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our team and build the products and features that will power the next generation of healthcare companies. As we grow our customers are becoming increasingly complex; our mission is to abstract that complexity into elegant solutions that make their work more efficient and our automations more robust. As a PM on Candid Health’s team you’ll have direct influence over how we plan, prioritize, and execute our roadmap; in close conjunction with stakeholders across the business.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Be Doing<br><br></strong><ul><li>You’ll be improving our existing product management practices building out new systems that will enable Candid to deliver great products and services</li><li>You’ll be building and executing the product vision in close collaboration with Engineering and Design </li><li>You’ll be thinking about the macro-structure of the business and the product to identify gaps and generate new ideas</li><li>You’ll be held accountable for business goals, and ensuring your partner teams are as well</li><li>You’ll be creating rigorous reporting dashboards for visibility and accountability</li><li>You’ll be capturing signal from the field and our customers to understand and prioritize user needs</li><li>You’ll be responsible for communication about new feature customer rollouts to customers and internal stakeholders including company leadership and operations teams<br><br></li></ul><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong><ul><li>You have 7+ years of experience as a product manager</li><li>You have experience building data-intensive products and applications </li><li>You ground your thinking in unit economics of the business</li><li>You are data driven and can leverage it to provide insights and influence critical decisions</li><li>You are outcome oriented, are an effective collaborator, and you bias towards action</li><li>You can get into technical details and know how to code or can read code, if you weren’t an engineer you can talk the talk</li><li>You have led and scaled a successful product function and had broad scope in a fast moving startup or late stage SaaS or Fintech company</li><li>You may have experience working with healthcare or medical billing, or on the technical side of other highly regulated industries</li><li>You may have experience building ML or AI products that solve real world problems<br><br></li></ul><strong>Pay Transparency<br><br></strong>The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $170,000 to $225,000 USD; commensurate with experience. The listed range is a guideline from Pave data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.<br><br><strong>Please note:</strong> we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, New York, or San Francisco). Our weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely.

metadata.description: <p><strong>Overview of the Role</strong></p><p>Our global technology-leading client is seeking a <strong>Product Marketing Specialist</strong> to support their TV Product Marketing team with day-to-day operations, reporting, project management, and cross-functional coordination. This role helps drive business performance by managing key workflows across product marketing, sales, supply chain, integrated marketing, and PR. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, exceptional communication abilities, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment.</p><p><strong>The Basics</strong></p><ul><li>Duration: 9 months, could extend</li><li>Hours: 40 hours per week</li><li>Schedule: 5 days per week, fully onsite</li><li>Location: Englewood Cliffs, NJ (7Northern NJ)</li></ul><p><strong>Top 3 Required Qualifications</strong></p><ol><li>Strong skills in relationship-building and working cross-functionally/collaborating/communicating with Sales, Supply Chain, Marketing, and related teams.</li><li>Proficiency in Excel (i.e. for Pivot Tables, managing Data Sets), PowerPoint (building presentations for senior leaders), and other Microsoft Office tools, with the ability to build and update complex presentations and reports.</li><li>Strong analytical skills, capable of processing multiple data inputs, identifying trends, and generating actionable insights.</li></ol><p><strong>Other Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent training.</li><li>3-5 years of relevant experience in product marketing, operations, business analysis, or project coordination.</li><li>Experience managing project plans, organizational forums, or cross-functional workflows.</li><li>Ability to independently manage time, prioritize tasks, and maintain meticulous attention to detail.</li><li>Understanding of marketing principles, go-to-market processes, and product promotion.</li><li>Familiarity with media, creative asset review, and communication workflows.</li><li>Ability to navigate internal and external stakeholders and influence outcomes in a matrixed organization.</li><li>Interest in or awareness of consumer electronics products and industry trends.</li></ul><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Support weekly, monthly, and annual reporting deliverables, including SCM updates, quarterly business review materials, and consolidated planning documents.</li><li>Partner with cross-functional groups, including integrated marketing, PR, sales, and supply chain, to coordinate marketing activities, asset development, and product promotion workflows.</li><li>Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform product positioning, messaging, and business strategy.</li><li>Use sales forecasting and strategic planning inputs to support product and revenue objectives.</li><li>Manage operational and workflow-related tasks such as contract execution, approval submissions, scheduling, and vendor coordination.</li><li>Organize day-to-day priorities for product managers and maintain visibility across project timelines and deliverables.</li><li>Serve as a backup Product Manager for ATS (available-to-sell) and aging inventory processes to ensure product availability and business continuity.</li></ul><p>In this position, you may have access to client or customer systems, confidential and/or proprietary information or data. This position is onsite and requires you to work closely with other individuals in a collaborative team environment.</p><p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>Creative Circle's Freelance Employee benefits package includes eligibility for Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC) medical plan, dental/vision/term life package, discount prescription program, critical illness, accident, tele-behavioral health, and 401(k) plan. Sick leave is provided to Candidates whose assignment work location is in a state or city subject to sick leave laws. A Minimum Value (MV) PPO medical plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and paid holiday eligibility are based on length and dates of service. <br><br><strong>Email Your Resume In Word To<br></strong>ldangelo@creativecircle.com<br>Looking forward to receiving your resume through our website and going over the position with you. Clicking apply is the best way to apply.<br>Please do NOT change the email subject line in any way. You must keep the JobID: linkedin : LD9-1976826 -- in the email subject line for your application to be considered.<br>Lucy D'Angelo - Senior Recruiter, Enterprise<br><br>For Creative Circle to represent you for this opportunity, you must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need of employer sponsorship for a non-immigrant visa such as a H-1B, TN, or O visa. We do not support or provide training for STEM/OPT programs. Additionally, you must be physically located in and perform the work for our client in the United States.This is a new role.<br><br>This job was first posted by Creative Circle on 02/04/2026 and applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled or closed.<br><br><strong>Creative Circle is an Equal Opportunity Employer<br><br></strong> All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring process includes AI screening for keywords and minimum qualifications. Recruiters review all results.  Creative Circle will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local law, including but not limited to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. If you need a reasonable accommodation in the application process, please contact your Recruiter (the person you'll be interviewing with) or a member of our Human Resources team to make arrangements. metadata.description: Job Type<br><br>Contract<br><br><strong>Description<br><br></strong><strong>Freelance Production Coordinator (PC)<br><br></strong><strong>Locations:</strong> NY, LA, Remote<br><br>MKG is a creative agency specializing in experiential marketing, brand storytelling, and immersive activations. We partner with some of the world’s most exciting brands to bring bold ideas to life across events, campaigns, and cultural moments.<br><br>We’re currently looking to expand our freelance roster. metadata.description: <p><strong>About Patch</strong></p><p><span>Patch is the leading hyperlocal news platform, serving communities across the United States with trusted journalism and essential local information. We are building the most effective way for local businesses and organizations to connect with their communities—through our network of newsletters, websites, and platform products. We also serve local small business customers with a portfolio of self-serve marketing tools to help them grow their businesses.</span></p><p><span>We are seeking a Product Manager who can accelerate our product execution and ensure fast, consistent delivery across a lean, high-velocity team.</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Role</strong></p><p><span>We’re looking for a decisive, action-oriented Product Manager who thrives on building, shipping, and improving products in rapid cycles. You will work directly with Patch’s Head of Product and operate as a force multiplier — owning the operational, execution-heavy parts of the product function so strategic initiatives can move forward.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>This role is designed for someone who loves the work itself: writing clear JIRA tickets, refining requirements, defining acceptance criteria, coordinating with engineering, QAing releases, managing product operations, and ensuring features move from idea → spec → build → launch → iteration without friction.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>You should be energized by business outcomes, not just output. You’ll use data to validate assumptions, spot patterns, and refine features quickly after launch. Familiarity with Jobs To Be Done is a plus; a genuine customer-obsessed mindset is essential.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>This is not a senior strategy role. It is a builder role for someone who wants ownership, momentum, constant throughput, and the satisfaction of seeing features ship weekly inside a scrappy, fast-moving environment.</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Product Execution</strong></p><ul><li><span>Translate concepts, problems, and rough direction into structured product specs and developer-ready JIRA tickets.</span></li><li><span>Define clear acceptance criteria, user flows, and edge cases for every feature.</span></li><li><span>Run point on end-to-end feature delivery—shepherding work across design, engineering, QA, and launch.</span></li><li><span>Validate work in staging, perform QA test plans, and ensure production releases are clean and complete.</span></li><li><span>Break large initiatives into small, shippable increments that maintain velocity.</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Product Operations &amp; Delivery</strong></p><ul><li><span>Own the day-to-day operations of the product development cycle.</span></li><li><span>Maintain JIRA hygiene, sprint readiness, backlog organization, ticket prioritization, and documentation.</span></li><li><span>Track progress, resolve blockers, and proactively ensure features keep moving.</span></li><li><span>Facilitate handoff and communication between engineering and cross-functional partners.</span></li><li><span>Monitor post-launch behavior and initiate immediate refinements when needed.</span></li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Quality, Analysis &amp; metadata.description: <strong>WHO WE ARE: <br><br></strong>Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.<br><br><strong>HOW WE WORK: <br><br></strong>At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that's thrown at us.<br><br>Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You'll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.<br><br>When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?<br><br><strong>JOB TITLE: </strong>Senior Product Manager, Growth<br><br><br><br><strong>LOCATION: </strong><em>REMOTE<br><br></em><strong>THE ROLE:</strong><strong> <br><br></strong>As a Senior Product Manager, Growth at Splice, you will craft high-impact experiences that fuel user and revenue growth across Splice's multi-product ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, experimentation, and execution; partnering closely with other product managers, designers, researchers, engineers, data scientists, marketing, finance, legal, and customer experience teams to bring ideas from concept to launch.<br><br>Your scope will span the full customer journey, from acquisition and onboarding through activation, monetization, engagement, and retention. You'll lead both iterative optimization and mission-critical, strategic initiatives, including greenfield work that requires navigating ambiguity, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and building new growth levers from the ground up.<br><br>This role requires strong systems thinking, crisp communication, and a hands-on approach to experimentation. You'll use data, research, and rapid prototyping to test hypotheses, learn quickly, and continuously improve business outcomes while delivering thoughtful, creator-centric experiences.<br><br><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead company-wide strategic growth initiatives that thread the needle between platform investments and customer experiences across the full funnel.</li><li>Define growth problems, form clear hypotheses, design and run experiments, and combine quantitative &amp; qualitative insight to drive measurable impact.</li><li>Identify Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and design end-to-end customer journeys tailored to those ICPs across Splice's multi-product ecosystem.</li><li>Drive subscription conversion, ARPS, and engagement by creating effective habit loops, onboarding flows, pricing experiments, and lifecycle touchpoints.</li><li>Collaborate with Marketing, Data, Finance, and CX to align product-led growth initiatives with go-to-market strategy, experimentation velocity, and business goals</li><li>Translate ambiguous business objectives into clear product bets, success metrics, and execution plans, and communicate progress and learnings to leadership.<br><br></li></ul><strong>JOB REQUIREMENTS: <br><br></strong><ul><li>5–8 years of product management experience, ideally in B2C SaaS, freemium, or subscription-based products.</li><li>Proven experience owning growth, lifecycle, or funnel optimization initiatives with a strong track record of impact.</li><li>Deep understanding of experimentation frameworks, analytics, and metrics-driven decision making (e.g., conversion, retention, LTV, ARPS, cohort analysis).</li><li>Strong product sense with the ability to balance customer experience, platform constraints, and business outcomes.</li><li>Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience influencing without authority.</li><li>Solid understanding of subscription economics and hybrid pricing models.<br><br></li></ul><strong>NICE TO HAVES: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience in music tech or creator platforms</li><li>Experience working with or adjacent to commerce platforms, including billing, payments, pricing infrastructure, or checkout flows.</li><li>Exposure to AI-powered products, personalization systems, or data-driven content discovery.</li><li>Familiarity with lifecycle marketing and value-prop messaging.<br><br></li></ul>The national pay range for this role is $148,320 - $185,400. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.<br><br><strong>Splice is an Equal Opportunity Employer<br><br></strong>Splice provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

</li><li>Contribute to Splunk’s international expansion strategy, collaborating with regional sales leaders to assess and prioritize new market opportunities </li><li>Leverage critical thinking and program management </li><li>Proven ability to communicate effectively with customers, sales leaders, and technical teams. </li><li>Experience working on B2B SaaS products or platforms, ideally serving MBA is a plus </li><li>FedRAMP High / IL5 eligible employees must be US citizens <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Prior experience working with US Public Sector customers or high compliance/regulatory products (e.g., FedRAMP, IL5) is a plus. </li><li>Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers, especially in sophisticated or highly regulated environments. </li><li>Familiarity with cloud technologies and SaaS business models. </li><li>Knowledge of international compliance and market expansion strategies is beneficial but not required. <br><br></li></ul>Why Cisco?<br><br>At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.<br><br>We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.<br><br>Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:<br><br>The starting salary range posted for this position is $122,000.00 to $172,100.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.<br><br>Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.<br><br>As a Manager at an Apple Store, you lead, coach, and develop a team who delivers exceptional customer experiences. You prioritize actively participating in customer interactions with team members throughout the store to achieve performance goals and business priorities.<br><br>A Manager is responsible for driving the performance of key goals within assigned areas of the store, in addition to company priorities. You work alongside and collaborate with others to execute strategy and deliver on Apple’s goals.<br><br><strong>Description<br><br></strong>Lead a team, developing and empowering each team member to learn, grow, and achieve performance and developmental goals.<br><br>Assist with recruiting, training, developing, and retaining a diverse, high-performing team.<br><br>Actively participate in Floor Leadership by interacting with team members and customers throughout the store, modeling what good looks like, and making sure that business priorities are met and exceptional customer service is delivered.<br><br>Address customer and team member concerns and escalations, and partner with leadership and key business or People partners when appropriate.<br><br>Drive business priorities and achieve store performance goals by planning and executing operational strategies within assigned functional areas.<br><br>Maintain and uphold company policies and procedures, and protect all company assets, including confidential business, customer, team member, and financial information.<br><br>Perform other tasks as needed.<br><br>Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.<br><br>Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.<br><br>Be a role model for inclusive leadership behaviors and build, develop, and retain diverse teams.<br><br>Take action to create a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all team members.<br><br><strong>Minimum Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You should:</li><li>Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.</li><li>Be proficient in written and spoken English (sign language supported).</li><li>Have experience leading others in retail, sales, or a related field.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You can: </li><li>Exceed goals successfully, and persist in Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits.<br><br>Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.<br><br>Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br></strong> <p>Finwise is developing an AI-powered platform to provide personalized financial guidance based on user financial data such as income, expenses, and debts. Key features include an AI-driven advice system via the Gemini API, an intuitive financial health dashboard, and tools for setting and tracking financial goals. The platform simplifies personal finance management by delivering actionable insights and clear data visualization. Finwise's goal is to empower users to make informed financial decisions and achieve their financial objectives effectively.<br></p> <strong>Role Description<br></strong> <p>This is a full-time on-site role for a Product Manager located in the Washington, DC-Baltimore area. Responsibilities include creating and prioritizing product roadmaps, defining and implementing product strategies, conducting market research, gathering user insights, and ensuring smooth product execution. The role also involves identifying areas for improvements and proposing innovative solutions to meet customer and business needs.<br></p> <strong>Qualifications<br></strong> <ul><li>Experience in product development, product lifecycle management, and creating product roadmaps</li><li>Strong skills in market research, user needs analysis, and data-driven decision making</li><li>Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as developers, designers, and marketers</li><li>Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and leadership skills</li><li>Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Trello, or product management software</li><li>Knowledge of AI and financial technology is highly desirable</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, computer science, or a related field</li><li>Previous experience in product management or a similar role is a plus</li></ul>

metadata.description: We improve lives<br><br>The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.<br><br><strong>About This Position<br><br></strong>We are looking for an organized, experienced, and dynamic Front Office (FO) Support Consultant. As FO Support Consultant, you will provide administrative, operational, budgetary, communications, and corporate support to the Front Office of FMP, ensuring smooth day‑to‑day operations and effective execution of core business activities.<br><br>You will work in the Financial Management and Procurement (FMP) team, which is part of the Vice Presidency for Countries (VPC). This team is responsible for ensuring the effective and efficient use of the institution’s development funds and for designing and overseeing the fiduciary management aspects of the Bank’s operations.<br><br>What you’ll do<br><br><strong>Administrative and Operational Support:</strong> Manage FMP’s and the Division Chief’s agenda with delegated authority. Plan, coordinate, and monitor internal and external meetings. Prepare travel authorizations and expense statements. Provide general administrative support to FMP’s Front Office. Support Letters of Agreement and related arrangements.<br><br><strong>Contracts and Procurement Support:</strong> Support preparation of contracts for consultants, firms, and other arrangements. Assist in uploading, monitoring, and maintaining contract documentation. Process and monitor payments to firms and contracts financed with administrative funds.<br><br><strong>Budget Support:</strong> Support preparation, execution, monitoring, and follow‑up of FMP’s regular budget. Assist with expenditure tracking and consolidation of financial data. Prepare summaries and periodic budget updates.<br><br><strong>Events and Corporate Coordination:</strong> Prepare and estimate event budgets. Support inter‑departmental meetings, conferences, and corporate events.<br><br><strong>Communications and Staff Meeting Support: </strong>Support the communications team with internal materials. Assist in preparing staff meetings, agendas, and slide decks. Draft and finalize internal communications. Support ad‑hoc communications requests. Manage dissemination of communication materials. Graphic Design Support.<br><br>What you'll need<br><br><ul><li>Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Accounting, Financial Management, or related field.</li><li>Experience: At least 2 years of relevant experience performing administrative tasks, managing calendars and providing executive support. </li><li>Languages: Proficiency in Spanish and English, spoken and written, is required. Additional knowledge of French and Portuguese is preferable.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. </li><li>Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.<br><br></li></ul>Type of contract and duration<br><br>International consultant Full-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to elegibility).<br><br>What we offer<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong>The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee’s life. These benefits include:<br><br><ul><li>A competitive compensation packages.</li><li>Leaves and vacations: 2 days per month of contract + gender- neutral parental leave.</li><li>Health Insurance: the IDB Group provides a monthly allowance for the purchase of health insurance.</li><li>Savings plan: The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance.</li><li>We offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your family when it applies.</li><li>On-site position with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.</li><li>Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more.</li><li>Health and wellbeing: Access to our Health Services Center which provides preventive care and health education for all employees.</li><li>Other perks: Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, and others.<br><br></li></ul>Our culture<br><br>At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.<br><br>In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.<br><br>We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org.

metadata.description: <strong>The Application Window Is Expected To Close On<br><br></strong><strong>Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received</strong>.<br><br><strong>Engineering Product Manager - Splunk Cloud for US Public Sector<br><br></strong>Join us as we pursue our disruptive new vision to make machine data accessible, usable, and valuable to everyone. We are a company filled with people who are passionate about our product and seek to deliver the best experience for our customers. At Splunk, we’re committed to our work, customers, having fun, and most importantly to each other’s success. Learn more about Splunk careers and how you can become a part of our journey!<br><br>As a Product Manager at Splunk, you will drive the roadmap for Splunk Cloud for the US Public Sector, including high compliance offerings such as FedRAMP and IL5, while shaping our international expansion strategy. You will engage with senior sales leaders and directly with customers to deeply understand their needs, enabling you to make data-driven decisions and trade-offs that improve product impact and growth.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Build, refine, and communicate the vision and roadmap for Splunk Cloud’s high compliance offerings in the US Public Sector, including FedRAMP and IL5. </li><li>Act as the primary point of contact for public sector product offerings, collaborating closely with US Federal and state agency customers as well as senior sales leaders, and cross-functional teams to deliver best-in-class solutions </li><li>Engage directly with customers to gather feedback, understand struggles, and translate insights into product priorities </li><li>Contribute to Splunk’s international expansion strategy, collaborating with regional sales leaders to assess and prioritize new market opportunities </li><li>Leverage critical thinking and data analysis to prioritize new features and enhancements, balancing customer needs with business impact and operational feasibility. </li><li>Partner with multiple engineering teams across Splunk to complete roadmap priorities, driving initiatives from concept to launch. </li><li>Maintain a customer-centric approach while balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. <br><br></li></ul><strong> </strong><strong>Requirements: What you'll need to succeed.<br><br></strong><ul><li>3+ years of proven experience in product management, product strategy or technical program management </li><li>Proven ability to communicate effectively with customers, sales leaders, and technical teams. </li><li>Experience working on B2B SaaS products or platforms, ideally serving enterprise or regulated industries. </li><li>Strong critical thinking skills, with a consistent record of making data-driven decisions and trade-offs. </li><li>Ability to synthesize customer feedback, market trends, and business priorities into a cohesive product vision and actionable roadmap. </li><li>Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. </li><li>Operate with a sense of urgency, balancing thoughtful planning with a bias towards shipping impactful features. </li><li>Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced, and evolving environment. </li><li>BA/BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. MBA is a plus </li><li>FedRAMP High / IL5 eligible employees must be US citizens <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Prior experience working with US Public Sector customers or high compliance/regulatory products (e.g., FedRAMP, IL5) is a plus. </li><li>Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers, especially in sophisticated or highly regulated environments. </li><li>Familiarity with cloud technologies and SaaS business models. </li><li>Knowledge of international compliance and market expansion strategies is beneficial but not required. <br><br></li></ul>Why Cisco?<br><br>At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.<br><br>Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.<br><br>We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.<br><br>Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:<br><br>The starting salary range posted for this position is $122,000.00 to $172,100.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.<br><br>Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.<br><br>U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.<br><br>U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:<br><br><ul><li>10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees</li><li>1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco</li><li>Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees</li><li>Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)</li><li>80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next</li><li>Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members</li><li>Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer<br><br></li></ul>For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.<br><br>Employees On Sales Plans Earn Performance-based Incentive Pay On Top Of Their Base Salary, Which Is Split Between Quota And Non-quota Components, Subject To The Applicable Cisco Plan. For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows<br><br><ul><li>.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;</li><li>1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;</li><li>1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and</li><li>Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.<br><br></li></ul>For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.<br><br>The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:<br><br><strong>New York City Metro Area<br><br></strong>$135,800.00 - $222,400.00<br><br><strong>Non-Metro New York State &amp; Washington State<br><br></strong>$122,000.00 - $197,900.00<br><br><ul><li> For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.</li><li> Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.</li></ul>

metadata.description: <strong>Steer Health | Remote (US-based) | Full-time<br><br></strong><strong>About Steer Health<br><br></strong>Steer Health is the Native AI Operating System for Access and Growth in healthcare. We're building the digital workforce that healthcare desperately needs—autonomous AI agents that handle patient engagement, operational automation, and revenue capture so clinical teams can focus on what matters most: patient care.<br><br>Our platform serves 19+ million patients across 360+ healthcare organizations, including one of the nation's largest health systems. With products spanning voice AI, clinical documentation, and intelligent patient access, we're addressing healthcare's most pressing challenge: doing more with less in the face of critical staffing shortages.<br><br>Backed by strategic healthcare investors and on a strong growth trajectory, we're entering our next phase of expansion and looking for a VP of Product to shape the future of our platform.<br><br><strong>The Role<br><br></strong>As VP of Product, you'll own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Steer Health's AI-powered platform. Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll lead a cross-functional product organization and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI capabilities and complex healthcare workflows. This is a high-impact role where you'll define how autonomous AI agents transform healthcare operations.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do<br><br></strong><strong>Strategic Leadership<br><br></strong><ul><li> Define and articulate the product vision and multi-year roadmap aligned with company strategy and market opportunity</li><li> Identify new product opportunities across our three core segments: Regional Health Systems, ASCs, and Medical Groups</li><li> Drive product-led growth strategies that accelerate adoption and expand our footprint within existing accounts<br><br></li></ul><strong>Product Execution<br><br></strong><ul><li> Lead the product management team across our suite of solutions including Luna AI (voice assistant), Steer Notes (clinical documentation), and Fast Track Care (patient access)</li><li> Partner closely with Engineering leadership to balance innovation with delivery velocity</li><li> Establish and refine product development processes that work across US and India time zones<br><br></li></ul><strong>Market &amp; Customer Insight<br><br></strong><ul><li> Serve as the voice of the customer internally, synthesizing feedback from enterprise health system buyers, end users, and operational stakeholders</li><li> Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform positioning and feature prioritization</li><li> Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to translate customer needs into scalable product capabilities<br><br></li></ul><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration<br><br></strong><ul><li> Partner with Marketing on product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy</li><li> Work with Customer Success to build feedback loops and drive product adoption</li><li> Support fundraising and board-level conversations with product vision and roadmap clarity<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><strong>What You Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li> 10+ years of product management experience, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles</li><li> Deep experience in healthcare technology, particularly in patient engagement, revenue cycle, or clinical operations</li><li> Proven track record shipping AI/ML-powered products at scale</li><li> Experience building and leading product teams in high-growth, Series A–C stage companies</li><li> Strong understanding of enterprise healthcare sales cycles and buyer personas(CIOs, CMOs, COOs, VP of Operations)</li><li> Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence at the executive level</li><li> Comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment with global teams</li><li> Bias toward action, intellectual curiosity, and a builder mentality<br><br></li></ul><strong>Bonus Points<br><br></strong><ul><li> Experience with conversational AI, voice interfaces, or automation platforms</li><li> Background working with large health systems or IDNs</li><li> Familiarity with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, interoperability standards)</li><li> Previous founder or early employee experience<br><br></li></ul><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong><strong>Why Steer Health<br><br></strong><ul><li> Mission that matters: Help solve healthcare's workforce crisis with technology that actually works</li><li> Growth stage momentum: Join at an inflection point as we scale from strong product-market fit to market leadership</li><li> Ownership &amp; impact: Shape product strategy with a direct line to the CEO and board</li><li> Remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US with a collaborative, distributed team</li><li> Competitive compensation: Base + equity + benefits designed for senior leaders<br><br></li></ul>Steer Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For Quota-based Incentive Pay, Cisco Typically Pays As Follows<br><br><ul><li>.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;</li><li>1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;</li><li>1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and</li><li>Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.<br><br></li></ul>For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.<br><br>The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:<br><br><strong>New York City Metro Area<br><br></strong>$135,800.00 - $222,400.00<br><br><strong>Non-Metro New York State &amp; Washington State<br><br></strong>$122,000.00 - $197,900.00<br><br><ul><li> For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.</li><li> Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.</li></ul>

metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br></strong> <p>Finwise is developing an AI-powered platform to provide personalized financial guidance based on user financial data such as income, expenses, and debts. Key features include an AI-driven advice system via the Gemini API, an intuitive financial health dashboard, and tools for setting and tracking financial goals. The platform simplifies personal finance management by delivering actionable insights and clear data visualization. Finwise's goal is to empower users to make informed financial decisions and achieve their financial objectives effectively.<br></p> <strong>Role Description<br></strong> <p>This is a full-time on-site role for a Product Manager located in the Washington, DC-Baltimore area. The Product Manager will be responsible for leading the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, while collaborating with cross-functional teams such as development, design, and marketing. Responsibilities include creating and prioritizing product roadmaps, defining and implementing product strategies, conducting market research, gathering user insights, and ensuring smooth product execution. The role also involves identifying areas for improvements and proposing innovative solutions to meet customer and business needs.<br></p> <strong>Qualifications<br></strong> <ul><li>Experience in product development, product lifecycle management, and creating product roadmaps</li><li>Strong skills in market research, user needs analysis, and data-driven decision making</li><li>Ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as developers, designers, and marketers</li><li>Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and leadership skills</li><li>Proficiency in tools like JIRA, Trello, or product management software</li><li>Knowledge of AI and financial technology is highly desirable</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, computer science, or a related field</li><li>Previous experience in product management or a similar role is a plus</li></ul>

metadata.description: Here at Appian, our values of <strong>Intensity </strong>and <strong>Excellence </strong>define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.<br><br>Here at Appian, we’re passionate about technology. We love making it, and we love using it. Joining Appian Engineering will provide you with the opportunity to learn in an environment that values cross-functional collaboration and is committed to personal and professional growth. We want to revolutionize the way people work, and in doing so, we develop the Appian platform to be simple so our customers can thrive.<br><br>As a Product Manager, you’ll be embedded as a product owner on a small team of engineers, interacting with key stakeholders, and owning the prioritized product development backlog to ensure your team delivers high-quality software with each and every iteration. Day to day you’ll share ideas and receive feedback on features through design sessions, mockups, UX reviews, and usability testing to ensure user success before a new release.<br><br><em>This role is based at our Headquarters in McLean, Virginia. Appian was built on a culture of in-person collaboration, which we believe is a key driver of our mission to be the best. Employees hired for this position are expected to be in the office 5 days a week to foster that culture and ensure we continue to thrive through shared ideas and teamwork. We believe being in the office provides more opportunities to come together and celebrate working with the exceptional people across Appian.<br><br></em><strong>To Be Successful In This Role, You Need<br><br></strong><ul><li>An understanding of what a roadmap for an enterprise software product looks like and ability to work with a team to guide the delivery </li><li>The ability to prioritize what we should build and when by collaborating with stakeholders on product vision and strategy </li><li>The ability to empathize with both stakeholders and end users to make the right compromises that can deliver value </li><li>Sharp negotiation skills, impressive organization, and superb writing abilities </li><li>Most importantly, a passion for software! <br><br></li></ul><strong>Basic Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Pursuing Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent </li><li>Team oriented, collaborative approach to problem solving </li><li>Strong commitment to delivering quality work </li><li>Prior experience in a product management role, technical program management, or product-oriented technology role </li><li>Command over written and spoken English with excellent communication skills <br><br></li></ul><strong>Tools and Resources <br><br></strong><ul><li>Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. </li><li>Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.</li><li>Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong>Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.<br><br><strong>About Appian<br><br></strong>Appian is a software company that automates business processes. The Appian AI-Powered Process Platform includes everything you need to design, automate, and optimize even the most complex processes, from start to finish. The world's most innovative organizations trust Appian to improve their workflows, unify data, and optimize operations—resulting in better growth and superior customer experiences. For more information, visit appian.com. [Nasdaq: APPN]<br><br><strong>Follow Appian:</strong> LinkedIn.<br><br><em>Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. <br><br></em><em>Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at ReasonableAccommodations@appian.com. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.<br><br></em><em>Appian's Applicant &amp; Candidate Privacy Notice</em>

metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>Acumatica is a company on a mission. We are a leading innovator in cloud ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions with growing businesses worldwide. But don’t take our word for it—read what analysts like G2, IDC, Nucleus Research, and Info-Tech have to say about us. Acumatica is different by design and purposely built to help small and midsized companies thrive in today’s digital economy. Our industry-specific business management solution is engineered to address real-world needs—featuring intelligent workflows and market-leading usability that enable companies to manage risk, anticipate disruption, and seize new opportunities. Our principled business practices, growth-friendly licensing, and flexible deployment options put organizations in control of their own future. Acumatica is more than just a product—we are a community of partners, customers, and creators committed to elevating business performance. Our ecosystem is driven by collaboration, merging leading technology and real-world insights to put organizations control of their future. In May of 2025, Acumatica was acquired by Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm focused on enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses.<br><br>Acumatica’s culture is collaborative and high-energy. We are passionate about our product and our mission, and we are loyal to each other and our company. We value work/life balance, efficiency, simplicity, freakishly friendly customer service, and making a difference in the world. Acumatica offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about Acumatica’s mission, please visit: http://www.acumatica.com.<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>Acumatica is looking for a <strong>Senior Technical Product Manager</strong> with a background in Manufacturing and Distribution with proven experience in product management, delivering B2B SaaS solutions to market. This exciting leadership position will play a key role in delivering Acumatica by fully understanding the market and customer needs and translating them into market requirements that our development teams and partners can create solutions for.<br><br>Working closely with engineering, this role will understand how technologies are applied to build complex, world-class business solutions that help customers automate core workflows such as advanced production scheduling, materials resource planning, warehouse management, and supply chain across broad business processes.<br><br>The Senior Technical Product Manager will partner with product management and development leaders and be responsible for creating, managing, and delivering the product roadmap that aligns with the overall product strategy and vision for the business. The role will also engage with Acumatica customers, support, sales, developers, and external ISVs. After speaking with stakeholders, the Senior Technical Product Manager will prepare the market requirements documents to inform developers of changes.<br><br><strong>What The Job Entails<br><br></strong><strong>Product Planning<br><br></strong><ul><li>Collaborate closely with product leadership to align roadmap to business goals, product vision, and strategy.</li><li>Speak with customers and partners as well as internal teams to understand how our tools are used to meet real-world scenarios.  </li><li>Create, maintain, and present external product roadmaps.  </li><li>Document the benefits of planned features and ensure senior management is presented with the information necessary to make informed decisions. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Product Launch Readiness<br><br></strong><ul><li>Execute new product release activities and coordination across the entire organization. </li><li>Review functional design documents and work with the development team more. </li><li>Identify early adopters and manage the beta release process.  </li><li>Review documentation and training materials and provide feedback and guidance to Education teams. </li><li>Review output of the Quality Assurance group to ensure the needs of customers, prospects, partners, and markets are built and delivered to a high level of satisfaction. </li><li>Train internal support and services teams on new product capabilities. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Program Management<br><br></strong><ul><li>Prepare and monitor quality metrics and drive improvements as needed. </li><li>Document and present conceptual ideas and design rationale.  </li><li>Ensure sales and partners are conducting proper discovery and analysis of customer projects to mitigate risk and achieve successful deployments. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Customer Success and Support<br><br></strong><ul><li>Become the subject matter expert on reporting, document management, data visualization, search, and other tools. </li><li>Resolve escalations from the support, customer success, and implementation teams. </li><li>Work with support to identify knowledgebase topics and assist with writing articles. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You have 8+ years of product management experience in business applications, in the ERP space.</li><li>You have domain experience in the distribution and manufacturing vertical markets and product experience with warehouse management systems (WMS), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, Materials Requirements Planning and supply chain management. </li><li>You enjoy spending time in the market to understand how customers use Acumatica and apply that knowledge to build and evangelize innovative solutions</li><li>You possess a blend </li><li>You have exceptional organizational and communication skills. <br><br></li></ul>Additional Information<br><br>Acumatica is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.<br><br>If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail [email protected]. This email is created exclusively to assist disabled job seekers whose disability prevents them from being able to apply online. Only emails sent for this purpose will be returned. Emails sent for other purposes, such as following up on an application or technical issues not related to a disability, will not receive a response.<br><br>For this role, the salary range is $129,000-$150,000 annually. This range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job and may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant elements.<br><br>At Acumatica, certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee’s role.<br><br>Benefits/perks listed here may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Acumatica and the country where you work. US-based employees gain access to healthcare benefits (medical, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents), employer paid Short-Term/Long-Term Disability and Basic life coverage, 401(k) plan with company match, Flexible time off, sick and safe leave, among others.

metadata.description: <strong>Summary<br><br></strong>Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.<br><br>As a Manager at an Apple Store, you lead, coach, and develop a team who delivers exceptional customer experiences. You prioritize actively participating in customer interactions with team members throughout the store to achieve performance goals and business priorities.<br><br>A Manager is responsible for driving the performance of key goals within assigned areas of the store, in addition to company priorities. You work alongside and collaborate with others to execute strategy and deliver on Apple’s goals.<br><br><strong>Description<br><br></strong>Lead a team, developing and empowering each team member to learn, grow, and achieve performance and developmental goals.<br><br>Assist with recruiting, training, developing, and retaining a diverse, high-performing team.<br><br>Actively participate in Floor Leadership by interacting with team members and customers throughout the store, modeling what good looks like, and making sure that business priorities are met and exceptional customer service is delivered.<br><br>Address customer and team member concerns and escalations, and partner with leadership and key business or People partners when appropriate.<br><br>Drive business priorities and achieve store performance goals by planning and executing operational strategies within assigned functional areas.<br><br>Maintain and uphold company policies and procedures, and protect all company assets, including confidential business, customer, team member, and financial information.<br><br>Perform other tasks as needed.<br><br>Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.<br><br>Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.<br><br>Be a role model for inclusive leadership behaviors and build, develop, and retain diverse teams.<br><br>Take action to create a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all team members.<br><br><strong>Minimum Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You should:</li><li>Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.</li><li>Be proficient in written and spoken English (sign language supported).</li><li>Have experience leading others in retail, sales, or a related field.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You can: </li><li>Exceed goals successfully, and persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks.</li><li>Follow through on commitments and establish mechanisms to encourage others to do the same.</li><li>Instill trust within the team and operate with a high level of integrity.</li><li>Make timely and sound decisions by asking questions and using analytics, experience, and judgment.</li><li>Communicate with excellence, and tailor your communication style to different audiences.</li><li>Develop others through mentorship, coaching, and effective feedback.</li><li>Provide support and guide others through challenges while remaining calm in a fast-paced and constantly changing retail environment.</li><li>Resolve conflict and settle differences in productive ways.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Pay &amp; Benefits<br><br></strong>At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $35.24 and $52.79/hr, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.<br><br>Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits.<br><br>Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.<br><br>Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant.<br><br>Apple accepts applications to this posting on an ongoing basis.<br><br>
