metadata.description: <strong>Overview of Watson Institute:<br><br></strong>Watson Institute powers transformative Fellowships in partnership with leading corporations and foundations to support highly promising entrepreneurs and leaders from underserved backgrounds. The Fellowships provide proven entrepreneurship and leadership skills training, committed mentorship, community development stipends, long-term Alumni support, and access to a global community of peers, mentors, and opportunities.<br><br>In partnership with Google, JPMorganChase Foundation, Walmart.org, Wells Fargo, Ford Philanthropy, SAP, Truist Foundation, BMO, Comcast, Western Union, and several private foundations, Watson Institute's programs will reach over 2,400 rising leaders this year.<br><br>Alumni of Watson Institute's Fellowships have raised over $190 million, created over 2,300 paid jobs, and impacted over 11 million people around the world through initiatives they have helped lead. 93% of Watson Institute alums are employed, continuing their education, or building a venture. 85% of Watson Institute Alumni use a skill they learned while in a Watson Institute-powered program up to 12 years later. Watson Institute's Alumni have been selected to Y Combinator, the Echoing Green Fellowship, and 11 have been named to Forbes' 30 under 30 lists. Alums continue their education at Harvard University, New York University, and Princeton University, among others.<br><br><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><strong>Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships - Mission Statement:<br><br></strong>The primary mission of the Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships is to identify, build, and grow new corporate and foundation partnerships.<br><br><strong>Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships - Role:<br><br></strong><strong>Partner Identification/Prospecting - 25%:<br><br></strong>Collaborate closely with Watson Institute's CEO and VP of Strategic Partnerships to grow Watson Institute's Fellowship model and impact through research, outreach, and relationship building with new prospective corporate partners.<br><br><ul><li>Participate in weekly prospecting meetings with the CEO and VP of Strategic Partnerships</li><li>Conduct research and lead outreach to aligned corporate and private foundation partners to create Fellowships powered by Watson Institute</li><li>Draft speaking and engagement applications for conferences that are aligned with Watson Institute's strategy. </li><li>Build strong relationships with conference organizers as a way to secure and strengthen Watson Institute's presence at relevant conferences and events</li><li>Help design systems and processes that strengthen how Watson Institute tracks and grows prospective partnerships. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Partnership Building - 50%: <br><br></strong>Play a critical role in building and growing new partnerships with corporate and foundation partners to create Fellowships powered by Watson Institute.<br><br><ul><li>Write and design compelling, persuasive, tailored, and well-designed/visual impact updates for Watson Institute's top prospects and partners. These impact updates may include decks, emails, Alumni and Fellow highlights, and more. </li><li>Participate and lead prospect and partner meetings including associated preparation, talking points during the meeting, diligent notes, and coordinating with appropriate team members on timely and comprehensive follow-ups. </li><li>Develop compelling concept notes, decks, and grant applications for prospects and partners. Examples include conducting landscape analyses for partners who are looking to bring their Fellowship to new markets and developing thought pieces/reports on current trends in entrepreneurship, corporate impact, and community impact.<br><br><ul><li>New responsibilities may develop as the position evolves<br><br></li></ul><strong>Culture Add:<br><br></strong>In order to thrive as the Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships at Watson Institute, a candidate must:<br><br><ul><li>Eager to join a team with extremely high standards for quality and excellence, recognizing that demonstrating excellence in partnership building is a direct path to scaling impact and achieving outsized results</li><li>An exceptional eye for detail. You have a knack for project management and a love for work plans and checklists. You cringe at missed steps and you are the first to identify a typo or formatting error</li><li>Intentional: Your working style is about creating order and planning ahead. You have a go-getter attitude and a drive to solve all sorts of problems, no matter the size or shape. When something is your responsibility, you find a way to see it through to the end</li><li>High Integrity: You will be asked to make sensitive and critical judgment calls, and as such, you are known for your integrity and you take that reputation seriously. You are comfortable escalating issues and holding your ground when you think it's the right thing to do for the organization and mission</li><li>Systems-minded: Demonstrated experience in building and implementing systems. This could be any system that involves inputs from or serves multiple people and requires consistent and accurate functioning</li><li>Communication Style: Based on a story from Watson Institute's early days, ‘Come to the Window' represents the principles of our communication including:</li><li>Obligation to Dissent: If you disagree with a decision or direction as an organization, you are expected to bring attention to this challenge because true leaders believe dissent is an obligation</li><li>Disagree and Commit: To complement Obligation to Dissent, there are times when we need to Disagree and Commit. metadata.description: <p><strong>Temporary Career Project Manager</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Status:</strong> Temporary Contract, FTE 40 hr./week, Fully Remote</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Contract Duration:</strong> ~4 months</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation: $30–$35 per hour, DOE</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p><p>A national healthcare association is seeking a Temporary Career Product Manager to support member‑focused programs and resources over a ~4‑month contract. metadata.description: <p>Acumatica is a company on a mission. We are a leading innovator in cloud ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) solutions with growing businesses worldwide. Acumatica offers exceptional professional and financial growth potential. To learn more about Acumatica’s mission, please visit: http://www.acumatica.com.<br><br><br><br></p><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong><p>Acumatica is hiring a <strong>Product Manager </strong>for our payments team. You'll be joining a collaborative team focused on tackling some of the most complex product challenges in the embedded payments space. As our new Product Manager, you'll be responsible for accelerating growth, with a particular focus on Integrated receivables.<br><br></p><p>This role involves a high degree of cross-collaboration, so you'll regularly engage with teams like Compliance, Risk, Accounting, Finance, Operations, Engineering, and DevOps.<br><br></p><p>This role reports to the VP, product management payments and we're open to hire <strong>remotely, in the United States.<br><br></strong></p><p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong> <br><br></p><ul><li>Deliver best in class experiences and enabling capabilities that delight customers and win in the market. </li><li>Deeply understand the external market and customer needs to define the priorities and inspire the broader team.  </li><li>Build the product roadmap, define users and drive tradeoff decisions.  </li><li>Invent new products and features on the customer’s behalf. </li><li>Lead 1-2 scrum teams to align on mission and deliver great results iteratively. </li><li>Leverages qualitative and quantitative data to measure results, inform roadmap and achieve benefit, adoption and financial results. </li><li>Cross collaborates with Sr PMs / Analytics / UX on product research to come up with better and disruptive solutions. </li><li>Engage in technical discussions with senior engineers to define product strategy, create value, and impact the direction of products and the business.  </li><li>Be a trusted partner that can present effectively to high-level stakeholders, set clear priorities and direction, and begin to build bridges across groups. </li><li>Own the product end-to end by developing business models, defining and analyzing success metrics, and managing strategic projects. </li></ul><p><strong>How you’ll engage: <br><br></strong></p><ul><li>Strategic Mindset: Seek to understand Acumatica’s corporate strategy, the competitive environment and market trends and how our products can create value. </li><li>Customer Obsessed: Deeply understand our customers’ needs through customer empathy, data and prioritize work. </li><li>Results Focused: Leverage data to understand how the product is performing and prioritize work.  </li><li>Insights Driven: Use qualitative and quantitative insights to drive decisions, define experiments and prioritize roadmap. </li><li>Trusted Partner:   Appreciate and comprehend different points of view and share information clearly and transparently with strong collaboration while knowing when to escalate.  </li><li>Relevant Expertise: Brings a deep understanding of the market, applied technologies and domain expertise, with a curiosity and learning mindset. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience within Product in a modern, data driven environment with a strong understanding of embedded payments.  </li><li>Minimum BA/BS degree required.  </li><li>Understanding how features (micro) interface with overall product vision (macro). </li><li>Growth mindset to start developing hypotheses that are tested and iterated.  </li><li>Deep understanding of B2B or B2B2C payment trends and flows. </li><li>Deep understanding of customer pain points and needs in the B2B, B2B2C, or B2C payment arenas. </li><li>Deep understanding of payment processes and financial operations including supplier management, invoice capture, matching, and approval processing. </li><li>Expertise in payment execution systems and workflows (e.g., ACH, check, card, wire).  </li><li>Strong ability to think through unifying elements and common denominators; dream up user workflows and interfaces. </li><li>Data driven approach for everything you do, understanding your customers, roadmap prioritization and measuring success.  </li><li>Ability to work in an agile fashion with your teams; go broad to go narrow; build, test, iterate. </li><li>Ability to nurture various projects in parallel, in different stages of maturity and velocity. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><p>Acumatica is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. metadata.description: <strong>About The Job<br><br></strong>We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our rapidly scaling Fintech team. This is a rare opportunity to help scale our incredibly successful fintech products across new sales channels, and innovate by creating new products that solve other customer problems.<br><br>You'll be on the design team working alongside product, engineering, and business stakeholders to create elegant, user-centric solutions that solve real problems. This role requires someone who can thrive in ambiguity, move quickly without sacrificing quality, and balance multiple priorities while keeping the customer experience at the center of every decision.<br><br><strong>What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like<br><br></strong><ul><li>Design end-to-end web experiences, owning the full process from concept through launch</li><li>Conduct customer interviews and usability tests, then leverage both qualitative feedback and quantitative data—tracking customer behavior, analyzing metrics, and running experiments—to validate and iterate on designs</li><li>Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to define problems, explore solutions, and ship features</li><li>Create simple, logical experiences that make complex workflows feel effortless</li><li>Balance customer needs with business goals and technical constraints</li><li>Make smart tradeoffs between speed, learning, and competing priorities</li><li>Lead design reviews with external partners and build strong cases for design decisions<br><br></li></ul><strong>An ideal candidate has<br><br></strong><ul><li>3+ years designing modern digital products with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end web design work and process</li><li>Proven track record designing 0-to-1 experiences from concept through launch</li><li>Collaborates effectively with product and engineering teams in agile settings, clearly articulating design rationale and assessing technical feasibility to simplify where needed</li><li>Shows strong judgment making data-driven decisions grounded in research, testing, and metrics—comfortable prioritizing and making tradeoffs without waiting for absolute certainty</li><li>Thrives as part of a founding team—scrappy, resourceful, passionate about solving real customer problems, and has no ego when it comes to being wrong or changing direction</li><li>Bonus: Experience with AI tooling such as Figma Make, Lovable and Cursor for rapid prototyping<br><br></li></ul><strong>Perks and benefits of working with us:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.</li><li>Unlimited PTO.</li><li>Carrot Cash travel stipend.</li><li>Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.</li><li>Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.</li><li>Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.</li><li>Open communication with management and company leadership.</li><li>Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.</li><li>100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees.</li><li>Access to Disability &amp; Life insurance.</li><li>Health Reimbursement Account (HRA).</li><li>DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan.<br><br></li></ul><strong>More about Hopper<br><br></strong>At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.<br><br>The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.<br><br>While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.<br><br>Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.<br><br><strong>Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:<br><br></strong>Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.<br><br>Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.<br><br>Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.<br><br>Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.<br><br>Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.<br><br>Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.<br><br>Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.<br><br>Come take off with us!<br><br>Compensation Range: $200K - $275K<br><br>

metadata.description: <p><strong>Product Manager, Automations</strong></p><p><strong>Location: Hybrid – Northern Virginia preferred</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>About careviso</strong></p><p><br></p><p>careviso is a healthcare technology company. By automating the impossible, we’re solving some of the most complex problems in the healthcare industry in real time—like prior authorizations and financial transparency. Our powerful, comprehensive platform increases patient access to care by delivering cost estimates, administrative requirements, and approvals instantly.</p><p>We began with a lab-focused approach, and our mission continues to be supporting patients, providers, and payors with total access to healthcare.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p><p><br></p><p>As the Product Manager, Automations, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution of careviso’s automation products—including RPA- and AI-driven workflows that power our prior authorization processes. This is a hands-on product role focused on delivering measurable impact by expanding automation coverage, improving operational efficiency, and unlocking faster, more consistent care decisions.</p><p><br></p><p>You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, Clinical Ops, and Data Science to identify high-value automation opportunities, define requirements, and build scalable solutions that meaningfully reduce manual workload across our platform. metadata.description: <strong>About Atticus<br><br></strong>At any given time, 16 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it.<br><br>Atticus makes it easy for any sick or injured person in crisis to get the life-changing aid they deserve. In the last six years, we’ve become the leading platform connecting people with disabilities to government benefits. We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence get compensation from insurance.<br><br>So far, we’ve helped hundreds of thousands of people access over $10B in life-changing aid —and earned over 17,000+ five-star reviews. And we’re just getting started.<br><br>We've raised more than $100 million from top VC firms like Fika, Forerunner, GV (Google Ventures), and True Ventures, with ambitions to create a category defining business assisting needy Americans. (We closed our Series C round in April 2025, so we're well-funded for the foreseeable future.) In 2025, our team grew from 151 to 210, and we will grow again in 2026.<br><br><strong>The Job<br><br></strong>At every step of our funnel, we aim to make choosing Atticus a no-brainer. Our platform covers a lot: evaluating a client’s case, giving advice, matching them with the right lawyer, formalizing the arrangement, and helping both parties work together as the case progresses. We hold ourselves to an incredibly high bar, because we know it results in life-changing aid for those in need. A few examples of what we’re currently working on:<br><br><ul><li>Improve an existing framework to match clients to the best law firm in our network available (for their case, geography, client and firm preferences, etc.) and work with the Data Science team to turn it into a reality. </li><li>Interview partner law firms to prioritize the next set of features we’ll build, then partner with Design and Engineering to craft a formal roadmap and mock up wireframes for our next product launch. </li><li>Leverage data from our call center and case details to optimize how and when we reach clients across mediums and throughout their case lifecycle. </li><li>Build a core data platform to support multiple verticals at varying scales with model-driven decision making and personalization throughout the funnel. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Get to know our users - both clients and lawyers - and understand their needs. </li><li>Craft a product vision for our next phase of growth. Go deep on strategy: become an expert in our business model, current offering, and key milestones to inform your work. </li><li>Develop a comprehensive product roadmap and build alignment for it with stakeholders and senior leadership. </li><li>Work with engineering and design to build and ship new products and features. Play the role of conductor, coordinating and empowering others. </li><li>Own key targets and metrics. Collect and analyze data, and use it to drive decision-making at a company level. Propose hypotheses, run experiments, and iterate quickly. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>3+ years of product management experience, building and shipping products at scale</li><li>Demonstrated success in setting a product vision and strategy, and the ability to speak thoughtfully about the key decisions and tradeoffs you made</li><li>Knowledge of best practices (from past work in a high-performing organization) and the ability to instill a great product culture as we grow</li><li>Great communication and people skills — shown by great reviews from PMs, engineers and designers you’ve worked with</li><li>Mastery of data platforms and ability to do your own analysis</li><li>A demonstrated commitment to doing good and helping people</li><li>Bonus: Early-stage startup experience - complex consumer business, two-sided marketplace, and/or B2B product<br><br></li></ul><strong>Salary And Benefits<br><br></strong>This is a rare opportunity to join a startup that has strong traction (substantial funding, well-respected backers, tremendous growth, and many happy customers) but is still small enough that you can have a huge impact and play a role in shaping our culture.We’re a certified B Corporation tackling a critical social problem. Our mission to help people in need drives everything we do, and your work here will touch many lives.<br><br>We offer competitive pay — including equity — and generous benefits:<br><br><ul><li>Medical and dental insurance with 100% of employee premiums covered</li><li>15 vacation days &amp; ~20 paid holidays each year (including two weeks at end-of-year)</li><li>Free membership to OneMedical</li><li>$600/year reimbursable stipend for internet service</li><li>$1,000 reimbursable stipend for education and training outside of work</li><li>Up to $1,200/year student loan repayment assistance</li><li>401(k) and optional HSA/FSA</li><li>Humble, thoughtful, smart, fun colleagues<br><br></li></ul><strong>Location<br><br></strong>This job is fully remote and we’re committed to empowering everyone with flexibility. Work remotely, and travel to LA (on the company dime) as needed to be with your colleagues – usually quarterly, plus offsites. We care a lot about building a great culture and we think some interactions need to happen in person, so we put a lot of thought into retreats, offsites, and other ways to gather.<br><br>

metadata.description: <strong>WHY WORK FOR VALENTINO <br><br></strong>Founded in Rome 1960, Valentino is an Italian Maison de Couture that aims to provide uniqueness to our customers through mastery, creativity, intimacy and care. As of today, Valentino counts about 4.000 colleagues in 30 different Countries all over the world. Every branch of the Valentino universe is nourished through passion, heritage and values that are constantly re-worked and steadily conveyed in an always contemporary way. Under the Creative Direction of Pierpaolo Piccioli, Valentino designs, manufactures and distributes dreamlike creations including Haute Couture, Women and Men RTW, Valentino Garavani Accessories, Eyewear and Beauty. Our network fully embodies the essence of the Maison, by practicing the Italian hospitality culture with our distinguishing quality, uniqueness and care for details.<br><br><strong>What We Believe In<br><br></strong>Here at Valentino, we act as a Unique Community &amp; Company. We strongly believe that HUMANISM is the core of our values and that only teamwork and mutual support will lead to achieve bigger and challenging goals. We act with integrity and respect towards both our Planet and our People. Our aim is to create costumer EMOTION and DESIRE because our future depends on our imagination and on being passionate about work as well as about life: every action you make brings you closer to your dreams.<br><br><strong> Valentino offers a hybrid working schedule with three days in office, and two days remote. This role is a full-time permanent position based in our Beverly Hills Office. <br><br></strong><strong>Overview<br><br></strong><strong> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR <br><br></strong>The Client Engagement Manager will lead planning and implementation of retail client development strategies across the West Coast directly operated store (DOS) that drive retention, elevation, and acquisition through exceptional relationship management and local market events to support key client moments and achieve overall targets. This role is responsible for translating Valentino America’s client engagement strategy, in alignment with retail business objectives, to create store-embedded client plans that directly impact sales. The Client Engagement Manager will coordinate the partnerships with Store Managers, retail leadership and corporate client engagement teams ensuring synergy and collaboration.<br><br>The Client Engagement Manager establishes and builds relationships with Very Important Clients. They offer exceptional customer experience, by understanding client needs and exceeding their expectations in order to increase sales and store profitability. The Client Engagement Manager maintains strong knowledge of the luxury fashion industry and has in depth understanding of the brand heritage and collections.<br><br>This role is based out of our Los Angeles office and reports to the Director of Client Engagement.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong> Client Development and Relations – 50% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Partner with Director of Client Engagement and Store teams to build expert knowledge of VICs in each location/store, and constantly develop and follow-up on action plans to grow existing VICs and develop future VICs by identifying innovative new concepts and personalized VIC experiences, proposing client targeting segmentation, and ensuring proper execution and follow-up </li><li> Partner with CRM, Retail Operations and Events on the execution of local retail activities and experiences to drive strong ROI </li><li> Support the Director of Client Engagement in planning and execution on major/institutional events (i.e., Fashion Shows, Forever Valentino Doha Exhibition, etc.) </li><li> Attend events and act as a Valentino Ambassador for VICs involved, ensuring excellence in event execution and sales maximization </li><li> Assist in managing the personal shoppers and stylists’ program for each store </li><li> Oversee the Runway VIC Pre-Orders end-to-end process <br><br></li></ul><strong> Clienteling Strategy and Performance – 30% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Manage the client gifting and experiences’ budget for retail network to develop and maximize client relationships, including invoicing, budget planning and tracking </li><li> Develop and oversee partnerships with third parties (e.g., AMEX Offer, hotels, concierges, membership clubs, etc.) to drive acquisition and cultivation of VICs </li><li> Work closely with cross-functional corporate teams (regional and HQ) and store teams to align VICs goals and annual calendar to achieve annual client development plan in cohesion with global and regional strategy </li><li> Lead regular performance reviews and impact of client initiatives, analyze prior, during and post strategy to ensure each touchpoint opportunity is maximized for client engagement KPIs </li><li> Constantly analyze client outreach to identify opportunities to close gaps and deriving bottom up action plans to meet sales and client segment goals </li><li> Produce benchmarking analysis along with research of new market landscapes and competitors’ events </li><li> Assist with the coordination, when needed, of event logistics including but not limited to car service, hair and makeup, florals, catering and gifting </li><li> Prepare post event recaps and ad-hoc analysis to monitor sales, client’s feedback and identify follow-up actions <br><br></li></ul><strong> Training and Team Development – 20% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Consistent training of store teams (in-person when necessary) around clienteling culture and activities, as well as onboarding new store members to ensure consistency across store teams </li><li> Identify store-specific opportunities to develop stronger training programs aimed to improve client development impact </li><li> Support the Store Managers in the management of all sensitive issues related to top clients and escalate when appropriate <br><br></li></ul><strong> Requirements : <br><br></strong><ul><li> 5+ Years of direct or related experience (personal shopping, sales, PR, etc); </li><li> In store, retail experience is a requirement </li><li> Established relationships with VIC clients </li><li> Elevated verbal and written communication skills </li><li> Ability to travel up to 25% <br><br></li></ul><strong> Budgeted salary - $125-150K + bonus (based on experience) <br><br></strong><strong>How We Are<br><br></strong>The Valentino Ecosystem is complex and interconnected. It is populated by many talents from different areas and with different attributes. We work hard to grow everyday both as a Maison and as individuals. Requirements : <br><br></strong><ul><li> 5+ Years of direct or related experience (personal shopping, sales, PR, etc); </li><li> In store, retail experience is a requirement </li><li> Established metadata.description: <p><strong>Our Mission</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™"</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Our Values</strong></p><p><br></p><p> <strong>One Team, One Dream</strong></p><p>We work hand-in-hand, building Tinder for our members. We succeed together when we work collaboratively across functions, teams, and time zones, and think outside the box to achieve our company vision and mission.</p><p><br></p><p> <strong>Own It</strong></p><p>We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.</p><p><br></p><p> <strong>Never Stop Learning</strong></p><p>We cultivate a culture where it’s safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.</p><p><br></p><p> <strong>Spark Solutions</strong></p><p>We’re problem solvers, focusing on how to best move forward when faced with obstacles. We don’t dwell on the past or on the issues at hand, but instead look at how to stay agile and overcome hurdles to achieve our goals.</p><p><br></p><p> <strong>Embrace Our Differences</strong></p><p>We are intentional about building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members. By leveraging different perspectives and other ways of thinking, we build better experiences for our members and our team.</p><p><br></p><p><span>Chemistry is Tinder’s AI matchmaking feature. We leverage a user’s activity on Tinder, answers to questions, and insights from scanning their Camera Roll to suggest their most compatible matches. Our goal is to get people good dates using state-of-the-art recommendation systems and LLMs. As the Product Team Lead (PTL) for Chemistry, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of one of Tinder’s most important AI-driven surfaces and help define the future of dating online. You will work at the intersection of product, design, ML, trust &amp; safety, and growth to deliver meaningful improvements to match quality and real-world outcomes.</span></p><p><p><br></p><strong>You will:</strong><li>Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Chemistry, from ideation to launch to iteration</li><li>Translate product vision into clear narratives, wireframes, and prototypes to gather feedback and drive alignment</li><li>Partner closely with design to deliver production-ready mocks and assets</li><li>Collaborate with ML and engineering teams to ship AI-powered features at scale</li><li>Work with user research to deeply understand target demographics, user needs, and pain points</li><li>Synthesize qualitative insights and product analytics to make data-informed decisions</li><li>Partner cross-functionally with revenue, trust &amp; safety, legal, marketing, and research teams to balance competing priorities</li><li>Ideate and support marketing campaigns</li><li>Ensure responsible use of AI, with strong attention to user trust, privacy, and consent</li><p><br></p><strong>You have:</strong><li>An excellent product sense that lets you solve user problems effectively</li><li>At least 5+ years of product management experience, with a preference for those working in consumer social</li><li>Experience shipping mobile products from inception to launch – if you’re a founder or early employee who has gone from 0 to 1 that’s a big plus</li><li>A strong command of data and analytics</li><li>An interest and understanding of broader cultural trends, including AI usage</li><li>Curiosity and empathy for our youngest users who may be just getting started on their dating journeys</li><li>A demonstrated ability to execute cross-functionally</li><li>Excellent communication skills not reliant on LLMs</li><p><br></p><strong>As a full-time employee, you’ll enjoy:</strong><li>Unlimited PTO (with no waiting period), 10 annual Wellness Days</li><li>Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually</li><li>Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage</li><li>100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li><li>100% paid parental leave (including for non-birthing parents), family forming benefits, and Milk Stork, which provides access to breast milk shipping for business travel, surrogacy, and employee relocation</li><li>Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual stipend for your professional development</li><li>Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, and Insight Timer; paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy</li><li>Free subscription to Tinder Platinum</li></p><p><br></p><br><p><strong>Commitment to Inclusion</strong></p><p><br></p><p><span>At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. Learn more here:&nbsp;</span><span>https://www.lifeattinder.com/dei</span></p><p><br></p><p><em>If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition Partner directly.</em></p><p><br></p><p><em>#Tinder</em></p><br><br><span>The salary range for this position is $235,000 - $240,000. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in San Francisco, CA. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.</span>

metadata.description: <strong>Department: </strong>Data<br><br><strong>Location: </strong>Remote<br><br><strong>Description<br><br></strong>Grasshopper Bank is a <strong>client-first</strong>, <strong>digital bank</strong> built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.<br><br>We are a highly experienced team who pride ourselves on <strong>diversity of thought and perspective</strong>. Nationally chartered, our portfolio of products and services range from VC, PE &amp; Portfolio Companies to SBA Lending, as well as direct SMB and Embedded Banking.<br><br>Our entrepreneurial drive allows us to support the growth and success of a wide range of clients at every stage of their business through <strong>inclusive partnership</strong>. We seek out team members who will enable both our organization and our people to grow and thrive through collaboration and acting with <strong>integrity and respect.<br><br></strong>Our focus on <strong>cross-functional teamwork </strong>provides a culture where ideas are valued, <strong>accountability is encouraged</strong>, and <strong>successes are celebrated</strong>. We welcome all those searching for the opportunity to contribute to banking innovation that influences and supports the emerging digital world of Financial Services.<br><br>Our digital first approach enables our teams the flexibility to work remotely. We have offices in NYC and Boston.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do<br><br></strong>Reporting to our Director of BI &amp; Analytics, you will join our data team as a key internal consultant and technical expert. Whether you are a seasoned architect or a rising talent in the analytics space, your primary mission is the same: to move beyond simple reporting and transform complex data into compelling data stories.<br><br>This is a high-impact role where technical rigor meets design strategy. You will serve as the bridge between our data infrastructure and our stakeholders, owning the end-to-end data lifecycle. This includes architecting scalable data models and ELT pipelines, as well as partnering directly with business lines to build polished, intuitive Tableau dashboards.<br><br>If you are a versatile professional who enjoys both writing complex Python/SQL transformation logic and crafting data stories that answer the "so what?" for leadership, we encourage you to apply.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities Include<br><br></strong><strong>Visualization &amp; Storytelling<br><br></strong><ul><li>Tableau Design: Design and build highly interactive dashboards that guide users through a clear narrative flow. Translate vague business questions into strict technical requirements and analytical stories that get to the root of the problem.</li><li>Mentorship: Foster a culture of data literacy by mentoring business users on dashboard interpretation and training junior analysts on SQL best practices.</li><li>Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation for data lineages, metric definitions, and pipeline logic.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Need<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a hybrid data role (Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or BI Developer).</li><li>Advanced SQL &amp; Modeling: Expert-level proficiency in SQL. You must be comfortable writing complex CTEs / window functions and have a strong grasp of Dimensional Modeling (Kimball methodology).</li><li>Tableau Proficiency: Deep proficiency with Tableau Desktop. You must have experience with advanced calculations (LODs, Parameters, Set Actions) and a strong understanding of layout strategies to guide user attention.</li><li>Python &amp; Scripting: Strong experience using Python for data manipulation, API calls, and automation scripting.</li><li>Data Storytelling: Proven ability to demonstrate how you have taken a raw dataset and turned it into a clear business recommendation or narrative.</li><li>Modern Data Stack: Experience working within a modern cloud ecosystem (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure) and cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).</li><li>Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills; you can present a dashboard to a stakeholder and clearly articulate the business value.</li><li>Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, Design, or a related field.</li></ul>

metadata.description: <p><span><span>Analytica is seeking a <strong>Data Governance Lead</strong> to support one or more dynamic, long-term federal government enterprise data programs. The ideal candidate will serve as the technical lead the architecture and implementation of cloud and hybrid big data solutions for large federal enterprises looking to modernize their data operations.  </span></span></p><p><span><span>Analytica has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing 250 businesses in the US for 3 years. We work with U.S. government clients in health, civilian, and national security missions to build better technology products that impact our day-to-day lives. The company offers competitive compensation with opportunities for bonuses, employer-paid health care, training and development funds, and 401k match.   <br><br></span>This is a hybrid role with a requirement of one on-site day per week.</span></p><p><strong><span><span> <br>Responsibilities include (but not limited to): </span></span></strong></p><p></p><ul><li><span><span>Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of <strong><span>enterprise data governance programs</span></strong><strong>,</strong> ensuring data is discoverable, trusted, secure, and compliant with federal standards</span></span></li><li><span><span>Define and enforce <strong><span>data governance policies</span></strong><strong>,</strong> including data ownership, stewardship, classification, retention, and lifecycle management</span></span></li><li><span><span>Establish and maintain <strong><span>data standards</span></strong> for metadata, data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical), naming conventions, lineage, and data quality metrics</span></span></li><li><span><span>Oversee the development and adoption of <strong><span>enterprise metadata management</span></strong><strong>,</strong> data catalogs, and business glossaries to support transparency and reuse</span></span></li><li><span><span>Partner with business, analytics, and engineering stakeholders to translate regulatory and mission requirements into <strong><span>governed data architectures </span></strong></span></span></li><li><span><span>Assess source system data quality, define remediation strategies, and implement data quality monitoring and controls</span></span></li><li><span><span>Design and govern <strong><span>master and reference data management (MDM/RDM)</span></strong> strategies aligned to enterprise and mission needs</span></span></li><li><span><span>Ensure alignment with<strong> </strong><strong><span>data security, privacy, and access control requirements</span></strong><strong>, </strong>including role-based access and attribute-based controls</span></span></li><li><span><span>Review and approve data architecture deliverables to ensure compliance with governance standards and federal best practices</span></span></li><li><span><span>Produce and maintain high-quality governance artifacts, including data dictionaries, lineage diagrams,  glossaries, governance playbooks, and compliance documentation</span></span></li><li><span><span>Serve as a subject matter expert on <strong><span>data governance and architecture</span></strong> in support of federal proposals and solution design efforts</span></span></li></ul><p><strong><span><span> Basic Qualifications: </span></span></strong></p><ul><li><span><span>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field</span></span></li><li><span><span>10+ years of experience designing and governing <strong><span>enterprise data platforms</span></strong><strong> </strong>in complex environments</span></span></li><li><span><span>5+ years of experience implementing <strong><span>data governance, metadata management, or data quality frameworks</span></strong></span></span></li><li><span><span>Strong knowledge of the end-to-end <strong><span>data and analytics lifecycle</span></strong><strong>,</strong> including governance, engineering, security, and consumption</span></span></li><li><span><span>Hands-on experience building cloud production data solutions leveraging AWS and Azure</span></span></li><li><span><span>Hands-on experience governing cloud-based data platforms using technologies such as <strong><span>Databricks, Spark, Redshift, Oracle, or Cloudera</span></strong></span></span></li><li><span><span>Experience implementing governance tooling such as Alation, <strong><span>Microsoft Purview, Databricks Unity Catalog, Collibra</span></strong>, or similar platforms</span></span></li><li><span><span>Deep understanding of <strong><span>federal data governance, security, and compliance requirements</span></strong></span></span></li><li><span><span>Experience leading or supporting <strong><span>on-premises to cloud data migrations</span></strong> with governance embedded by design</span></span></li><li><span><span>AWS, Azure, and/or Databricks certifications preferred</span></span></li><li><span><span>Ability to obtain<strong> Public Trust </strong><strong><span>Clearance</span></strong></span></span></li></ul><p><br><span><span>About ANALYTICA: Analytica is a leading consulting and information technology solutions provider to public sector organizations supporting health, civilian, and national security missions. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Bethesda, MD, the company is an established SBA small business that has been recognized by Inc. Magazine each of the past three years as one of the 250 fastest-growing companies in the U.S.  Analytica specializes in providing software and systems engineering, information management, analytics &amp; visualization, agile project management, and management consulting services. The company is appraised by the Software Engineering Institute (SEI) at CMMI® Maturity Level 3 and is an ISO 9001:2008 certified provider. </span></span></p>

metadata.description: Corner Alliance is a dynamic, growing consulting firm that devotes itself to providing an enriching employee experience while working in meaningful ways to create results for the government. We are currently seeking an <strong>Economic Data Analyst</strong> with <strong>3–6 years of experience</strong> to join our team and fully embrace our commitment to deliver, grow and thrive.<br><br><strong>About the Role: <br><br></strong>As an Economic Data Analyst supporting our Federal government client, you will be trusted to provide rigorous, data-driven economic and policy analysis in support of broadband, spectrum, telecommunications, and infrastructure-related initiatives. You will work closely with senior economists and project teams to analyze large datasets, support economic and financial modeling, and translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for federal stakeholders.<br><br>This role is ideal for someone with federal government consulting experience who is comfortable working with data, understands government decision-making environments, and enjoys applying quantitative analysis to real-world policy questions.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities include<em> (but are not limited to): <br><br></em></strong><ul><li>Conduct quantitative and qualitative economic analyses related to broadband deployment, spectrum use, telecommunications markets, and infrastructure investment </li><li>Clean, manage, and analyze large datasets from federal, public, and commercial sources </li><li>Support the development and execution of economic, financial, and scenario-based models (e.g., forecasting, impact analysis, cost-benefit analysis) </li><li>Assist with program evaluation and performance measurement efforts, including identification and analysis of KPIs </li><li>Contribute to technical memoranda, white papers, and analytic deliverables for federal audiences </li><li>Develop slides, charts, and data visualizations to communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders </li><li>Support senior staff in preparing briefings and materials for internal and external meetings </li><li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet project timelines and client expectations </li><li>Participate in client meetings, working sessions, and strategy discussions as appropriate </li><li>Carry out our Commitments to Deliver, Grow, and Thrive <br><br></li></ul><strong>Location: <br><br></strong>You will work as part of a dynamic team remotely, with proximity to Washington, DC; Reston, VA; Arlington, VA; or Boulder, CO preferred. You may work at the client site dependent on contract requirements.<br><br><strong>Required Experience/Skills: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Public Policy, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field </li><li>3–6 years of professional experience, including experience in federal consulting or government contracting </li><li>Demonstrated experience conducting data-driven analysis in a policy, regulatory, or government context </li><li>Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Excel, Python, R, SQL, or similar </li><li>Experience supporting economic, financial, or policy-related analyses </li><li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences </li><li>Experience working with federal clients and producing client-ready deliverables </li><li>U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and the ability to pass a public trust clearance or suitability determination <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Experience/Skills: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Master’s degree </li><li>Experience with broadband, telecommunications, spectrum policy, infrastructure, or public finance </li><li>Familiarity with economic modeling, forecasting, or program evaluation frameworks </li><li>Experience working with large or complex datasets in a federal environment </li><li>Experience developing briefing materials or slide decks for senior government stakeholders </li><li>Comfort working in a fast-paced consulting environment with evolving priorities <br><br></li></ul><em>Don’t think you have everything for this role but are still very interested? Please don’t hold back from applying because you may not have it all. You can learn and grow with us. We're looking for someone who is coachable, unflappable in navigating challenges, resourceful in learning new skills, innovative in challenging the status quo, excellent in writing, analytical in thinking, skilled in prioritization, and a rapport builder with clients and colleagues. <br><br></em><strong><em>About Us: <br><br></em></strong><em>Corner Alliance offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for full-time employees including 401k matching (4%), PTO (3 weeks to start, 4 weeks (2-5 years) and 5 weeks (5 years+)), health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, FSA accounts, 4 weeks of paid parental leave, 11 paid holidays (including your birthday off), fitness &amp; cell phone reimbursements, monthly all hands update meetings, annual in-person all hands team building day and evening out, regular check-ins for professional growth goals, semi-monthly one on one performance manager meetings, a social team that coordinates monthly events, use of technology like Slack to keep us connected and collaborative, and overall, a company culture dedicated to a highly engaged team. <br><br></em><em>Corner Alliance is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable law. We are dedicated to building a talented workforce that reflects the strength of our society and our shared commitment to excellence. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with Corner Alliance please call (202) 754-8120 or email recruiting@corneralliance.com. Corner Alliance participates in the E-verify program and will provide the Federal Government with Form I-9 information to confirm work authorization in the U.S. <br><br></em><em>Visit us at www.corneralliance.com to learn more. <br><br></em><strong><em>Securing Your Data: <br><br></em></strong><em>Beware of fake employment opportunities using Corner Alliance’s name. Corner Alliance will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Corner Alliance ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Corner Alliance will only communicate with you through our ATS system JazzHR and/or emails that are generated by the corneralliance.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Corner Alliance that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at recruiting@corneralliance.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. <br><br></em><strong><em>Salary: <br><br></em></strong><em>Approximate Salary Estimate: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 annually <br><br></em><em>The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range of candidates hired. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have, and comparison to other employees already in this role. <br><br></em>Powered by JazzHR<br><br>0ejjtdc0lT

metadata.description: <br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br><br></strong>BAE Systems is seeking a <br><br><strong>Data Analyst<br></strong> to join our team and provide support to facilitate operations on a critical infrastructure and services program. As a data analyst, you may be added to project teams in order to determine what data sets are needed for customers to meet their project requirements. Understanding of data attributes, integrations, ETL tools, APIs, MS Azure, and using tools such as JIRA will be part of the day to day.&nbsp;</p> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> practices.</li> <br> <li>Familiarity with backup and recovery tools, performance tuning, and monitoring utilities</li> <br> <li>Understanding of data privacy and protection regulations</li> <br> <li>Ability to lead and motivate a remote team&nbsp;</li> <br> <li>Excellent time management and organizational skills&nbsp;</li> <br> <li>Adaptability and openness to new ideas&nbsp;</li> <br></ul> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> <br><p><strong>WORKING CONDITIONS</strong></p> <br><p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <br><p>Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Must have reliable internet service that allows for effective telecommuting. </p> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> <br><p><strong>BENEFITS</strong></p> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> <br><p>Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:</p> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> <br><ul> <br> <li>Medical, Dental, and Vision</li> <br> <li>Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution&nbsp;</li> <br> <li>Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term &amp; Long-term Disability</li> <br> <li>Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, &amp; Critical Care Insurance</li> <br> <li>Voluntary Medical &amp; Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <br> <li>Accrued Paid Time Off &amp; Company Paid Holidays</li> <br> <li>401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match<br>&nbsp;</li> <br></ul> <br><p><strong>WORK AUTHORIZATION</strong></p> <br><p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <br><p>Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.</p> <br><p>&nbsp;</p> <br><p><strong>Sprezzatura&nbsp;</strong>is a mission-driven, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that thrives at the intersection of technology, innovation, and impact. We specialize in secure, scalable, and human-centered digital solutions that accelerate government transformation. Our work spans DevSecOps, health IT modernization, intelligent automation, benefits delivery, and digital communications. Any information collected there is subject to their terms and privacy notice.<br><br><strong>Purpose And Impact<br><br></strong>At Amentum, we don’t just analyze data — we use it to empower missions, shape strategy, and improve the way government works. We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented <strong>Junior Data Analyst</strong> to support one of our key defense initiatives through a unique blend of training development, data management, and strategic communications.<br><br>In this role, you’ll be more than a numbers person — you’ll help design, implement, and deliver flexible and innovative training programs that ensure the effective use of vital systems, tools, and services across the Department of Defense. You'll work closely with stakeholders to develop training materials, standard operating procedures, marketing collateral, and executive briefings, all while gaining exposure to high-level operations and decision-making processes.<br><br>Whether it’s creating collaborative training sessions, producing executive-level presentations, or supporting content and performance metrics management, your work will directly contribute to mission success. You’ll gain hands-on experience, receive mentorship from industry experts, and develop real-world skills in data analysis, systems training, communication, and stakeholder engagement.<br><br>If you’re ready to start your career with purpose — using your skills to support the people and technologies that protect our nation — <strong>Amentum is where your impact begins.<br><br></strong><strong>Work Schedule:</strong> M-F 8hrs a day core hours 9am-3pm<br><br><strong>Essential Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>Day-to-Day Responsibilities: What You’ll Be Doing<br><br></strong><strong>Role<br><br></strong>As a <strong>Junior Data Analyst</strong> , you’ll play an essential role in supporting training development, strategic communications, and operational efficiency within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. Your daily tasks may include:<br><br><ul><li>Design and deliver training programs for inventory systems, applications, and services, using diverse formats such as instructor-led sessions, online modules, desk-side training, and collaborative group workshops. </li><li>Develop and maintain the Falcon familiarization training plan , including creation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for consistent and effective instruction. </li><li>Determine the most effective training delivery methods based on audience, content, and mission needs — ensuring flexibility and accessibility. </li><li>Create and manage training and outreach materials , including brochures, pamphlets, slide decks, and job aids. </li><li>Support office operations , including performance metrics management, scheduling, task tracking, and content updates. </li><li>Attend meetings with stakeholders to gather requirements, provide input, and stay informed on evolving training and communication needs. </li><li>Assist in the development of executive briefings, strategy papers, and communication products tailored for DOD leadership. </li><li>Track and respond to executive-level taskers , ensuring timely and accurate delivery of requested materials and updates. </li><li>Support the implementation of new applications and services , developing tailored training content to ensure smooth adoption across user groups. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong>Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills (both written and verbal).<br><br><ul><li>Ability to multi-task and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment. </li><li>Experience or coursework in data analysis, training development, or instructional design . </li><li>Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint, Word, Excel). </li><li>Demonstrated ability to learn new systems and tools quickly. </li><li>Comfortable presenting in front of small groups or collaborating in team settings. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Other Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>Safety</strong> - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.<br><br><strong>Quality</strong> - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities.<br><br><strong>Procedure Compliance</strong> - Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job.<br><br>Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.<br><br><em>As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and compliant work environment, Amentum is a drug-free workplace and requires all personnel to comply with company drug and alcohol policies as a condition of employment. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the drug screening process. Please note that this may include pre-hire screening for marijuana, as well as other federally controlled substances due to Amentum’s role as a federal contractor and trusted partner to the US Government.<br><br></em><strong>Pay Transparency Verbiage<br><br></strong>Amentum’s health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Eligible employees and their dependents may elect medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, and, if eligible, a deferred compensation plan and Executive Deferral Plan. Employees will also receive 17 days of vacation per year, seven paid holidays, plus floating holidays and caregiver leave. Hired applicants will be able to purchase company stock and have the opportunity to receive a performance discretionary bonus.<br><br>The base salary range for this position is <strong>$140K to $145k</strong> . This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.<br><br><strong>Clearance Required<br><br></strong><strong>Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):<br><br></strong><ul><li>TS SCI Poly<br><br></li></ul><strong>Minimum Education<br><br></strong><ul><li>Associate degree<br><br></li></ul><strong>Minimum Years Of Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>Related discipline with five (5) years<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Familiarity with government or DOD operations . </li><li>Experience creating or supporting training programs , especially in a technical or systems environment. </li><li>Basic understanding of performance metrics , content management systems, or executive-level reporting. </li><li>Familiarity with tools like SharePoint, Power BI, or Learning Management Systems (LMS) is a plus. </li><li>Knowledge of marketing or internal communications practices. <br><br></li></ul>#javelin<br><br><strong>Compensation Details<br><br></strong>145000<br><br>The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. You will be trusted to work on analyses and tools to detect and prevent fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) in the Medicare programs. In this role you will:<br><br><ul><li>Contribute to completion of technical tasks independently and as part of a team. </li><li>Analyze claims data and conduct statistical analysis. </li><li>Assist with the development of data-driven solutions to business challenges of advanced scope/complexity. </li><li>Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize efficiencies, process improvements, and other business outcomes. </li><li>Assist with identifying opportunities for leveraging Medicare and Medicaid data to drive insightful FWA solutions. </li><li>Collaborate with teammates including subject matter experts to deliver quality, actionable findings. </li><li>Help prepare findings for presentation to a range of audiences (technical/non-technical) and to various levels of leadership. </li><li>Perform additional duties as assigned. </li><li>Effectively communicate with team members while working remotely. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelors degree with an analytical or technical focus (i.e., Statistics, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics) or related area </li><li>Minimum 2 years of related experience, preferably with background utilizing healthcare claims data </li><li>Proficient in SQL and familiarity with R or Python </li><li>Familiarity with Databricks and/or Snowflake <br><br></li></ul><strong>Desired Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Possess a desire to learn about and stay up to date on healthcare FWA </li><li>Be a self-starter with a natural curiosity to understand, simplify and explain data <br><br></li></ul>The likely salary range for this position is $85,000 - $115,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.<br><br>Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee's date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.<br><br>We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers consulting, technology and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 30,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. Together with our clients, we strive to create a safer, smarter world by harnessing the power of deep expertise and advanced technology.<br><br>Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at https://gdit.com/tc.<br><br>Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans<br><br>If you have questions about this posting, please contact support@lensa.com

metadata.description: <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Data Management Specialist/Analyst</strong> to help steward franchise data across the organization. You’ll support <strong>data uploads, data querying, processing, QA, and automation</strong> to ensure our data is accurate, complete, and ready for decision-making. This role reports to the <strong>Director of Information Management</strong> and partners with cross-functional teams.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Upload, update, and validate data across internal systems</li><li>Monitor data integrity and resolve issues or inefficiencies</li><li>Clean, merge, transform, and analyze datasets using <strong>SQL + Python and MS Excel</strong></li><li>Maintain and improve data pipelines and upload tools</li><li>Build workflow improvements, automation, and QA solutions (Python preferred)</li><li>Document processes, data definitions, and workflows</li><li>Support internal data requests with timely, accurate updates</li><li>Uphold data privacy and security standards</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Information Management, Data Science, Business, etc.)</li><li>Strong <strong>MySQL</strong> skills (schema design, indexing, query optimization, migrations)</li><li>Proficiency in <strong>Python (pandas)</strong> and advanced <strong>Excel</strong></li><li>Solid <strong>GitHub workflow</strong> experience (PRs, branching, code reviews)</li><li>Experience with AWS: <strong>RDS (MySQL), Lambda, API Gateway, S3</strong></li><li>Strong attention to detail and ability to work with technical + non-technical teams</li></ul><p><br></p>

metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>We are seeking a Financial Analyst for Residuals to be a key member of our Contingent Compensation and Residuals team. Residuals are additional compensation paid to talent for the reuse of content beyond the use covered by their initial compensation, based on collective bargaining agreements with various guilds/unions, e.g., SAG-AFTRA, DGA, and WGA.<br><br>In this role, your key responsibilities will be to interpret and analyze the residual impact of various guilds, unions, and production service agreements, and to execute accordingly. This includes calculating, preparing, and processing residual payments, preparing and managing financial forecasts of residual obligations, and working closely with cross-functional teams such as Labor, Production Finance, and Business Affairs to determine the residual impact across various titles.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Analyze and interpret production, distribution, and legal contracts/deal terms for residual liability and financial impact.</li><li>Forecast, set up, pay, and report residual liabilities in accordance with contractual terms. </li><li>Forecast and assist in accruing obligations. </li><li>Liaise with Production Accountants and Producers to gather required information for residual setups.</li><li>Contribute to financial analyses to evaluate the impact of residuals on the business, including scenario planning and assessing new deal terms. </li><li>Work closely with third-party payment processors to provide detailed setup data, ensuring complete and accurate residual payment setups. </li><li>Participate in initiatives to innovate and enhance processes, including testing and implementing new residual systems for improved automation, workflow efficiency, and standardization. </li><li>Collect necessary documentation and interface with auditors to provide support for guild and internal audits.</li><li>Lead and assist in complex projects, ensuring thorough analysis and execution. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>BA/BS in accounting, finance, business administration, or similar degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.</li><li>2+ years of related experience required, preferably in residuals. Experience with new media residuals is a plus.</li><li>Entertainment industry experience preferred.</li><li>Strong financial analysis and modeling skills, with the ability to problem-solve effectively.</li><li>Excellent Excel &amp; Google web-based program skills.</li><li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written</li><li>Must be able to comprehend and interpret collective bargaining agreements.</li><li>Highly motivated, analytical, proactive, organized, and self-sufficient.</li><li>Capable of planning and managing multiple projects simultaneously.</li><li>Must be able to work independently and cross-functionally with business partners.</li><li>Flexible and adaptable to evolving processes in a fast-paced environment.<br><br></li></ul>Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $105,000.00 - $175,000.00.<br><br>Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.<br><br>Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.<br><br>Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.<br><br>We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
