metadata.description: <strong>We Realize Potential in <em>Your</em> Story<br><br></strong>We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find a <strong>Data Analyst</strong> to join our Social Video Services team - Is this your next opportunity?<br><br>The Data Analyst will assist with the creation of weekly, monthly and quarterly client reports, using data to tell a story and inform strategy. This role will also support on ad-hoc data requests and general assistance to the Data and Product and Social Video Services teams.<br><br><strong>PERKS OF THE JOB<br><br></strong>🍏 <strong>Stay healthy</strong> with a monthly health &amp; wellness stipend and free access to counseling sessions<br><br>🍻 <strong>Enjoy regular Happy Hours</strong>, treats and events with your team<br><br>⏱ <strong>Plan ahead</strong> with a 401K retirement fund<br><br>🌳 <strong>Support your family</strong> with medical, dental &amp; vision insurance<br><br>📚 <strong>Invest in your growth </strong>both personally &amp; professionally with our Learning &amp; Development Program<br><br>🏡 <strong>Work flexibly </strong>with our hybrid working environment, with access to co-working locations and monthly reimbursement for home tech expenses<br><br>✈️ <strong>Take flex time off</strong> for vacations, family time, or mental health days<br><br>🌞 <strong>Enjoy long summer weekends </strong>by working half days on Friday<br><br><strong>How You Will Spend Your Time<br><br></strong><ul><li>Produce weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews &amp; analysis for major Little Dot Studios’ clients which include some of the biggest media companies in the world</li><li>Regularly analyze channel activity and provide actionable, data backed insights to the LDS SVS team</li><li>Help coordinate and design A/B testing experiments</li><li>Contribute to the insight teams general research &amp; technology roadmap</li><li>Field internal ad hoc insight requests from across the business</li><li>Proactively develop insights for the Social Video Services team<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Need To Succeed<br><br></strong>Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.<br><br><ul><li>Bachelor's Degree</li><li>Proficiency in YouTube analytics. Any experience in Looker and Tableau is a bonus</li><li>Knowledge of YouTube and other social platform APIs</li><li>Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills, or the ability to demonstrate aptitude in these areas</li><li>Excellent numerical reasoning skills</li><li>Ability to think on your feet clearly, logically, and creatively</li><li>Effective and clear written and oral communication with people at all levels</li><li>Ability to ask relevant questions, seek understanding, and quickly assimilate information in unfamiliar fields of knowledge</li><li>Passion and motivation to learn new skills and technologies on the job</li><li>Strong drive to get things done in an accurate manner within deadlines, with the ability to multi-task</li><li>Ability to work under own initiative, without constant supervision</li><li>Effective prioritization of workload to accommodate peaks and troughs in demand</li><li>Proactive in ensuring the team and/or manager are aware of problems and informed of potential issues</li><li>Ability to assimilate views (both internal and external), review feedback regularly to improve performance, and demonstrate a commitment to meeting agreed-upon standards<br><br></li></ul>Candidates must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.<br><br><strong>LITTLE DOT, BIG IMPACT<br><br></strong>We’re probably the biggest studio you didn’t know was fueling your favorite content. We’ve been one of the top dogs in the digital content space since 2013 (some would say, before its potential was even fully realized). We're proud to work with some of the hottest TV and movie studios, distributors, rights holders, sports federations and brands in the business.<br><br><strong>WE ARE COMMITTED<br><br></strong><strong><em>Little Dot Studios </em></strong><em>is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and does not unlawfully discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, pregnancy, age over 40, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, registered domestic partner status or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation. Please inform LDS if you need assistance to complete any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process. LDS will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.<br><br></em>Not accepting submissions from search firms or recruiters.<br><br>Learn more about us, our values and our commitments please visit our website www.littledotstudios.com for more information.<br><br>Little Dot Studios is a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network.<br><br>It distinguishes itself through its comprehensive offering as a social media agency and the world’s leading YouTube specialists for some of the biggest entertainment, sports, and consumer brands. Capabilities include strategy, audience development, content production, monetization, and digital copyright management.<br><br>Disruptive by nature and adaptive by design, it also operates a multi-platform, multi-format production company, specializing in creating everything from original long-form broadcast-quality film and TV and award-winning podcast series to short-form reactive social content and live streams that perfectly tap into cultural moments. All are designed to build communities, engage superfans, or drive performance.<br><br>Additionally, Little Dot Studios owns and operates a digital media network, Little Dot Channels, incorporating a global network of over 135+ channels across social platforms and six FAST channels on streaming services, licensing over 21,000 hours of long-form premium content to reach over 125 million unique viewers monthly. It also offers access to one of the largest global premium advertising inventories across YouTube and CTV, delivering brand-safe, targeted media campaigns.<br><br>Little Dot Studios also incorporates specialist sport and branded content production agency WING and owns broadcaster Dan Snow’s History Hit podcast network and SVOD service. The company is verified carbon neutral since its inception and is on track to be net-zero by 2030.<br><br>Little Dot Studios was founded in 2013, has offices in the UK, US, Germany and ANZ, and is an All3Media company.

metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company committed to providing high-quality, healthy brands and helping improve the lives of the people who live and work in the places where we operate. Ranked No. 1 on the 2025 PEOPLE® Companies That Care list and one of Fortune® magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” in the U.S., The Wonderful Company is continually recognized for its dedication to the well-being of its workforce, their communities, and the planet.<br><br>We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented <strong>Marketing Data Analyst </strong>to join our in-house agency team supporting a portfolio of premium and luxury brands. This position plays a pivotal role in transforming complex marketing data into strategic insights that drive growth, retention, and long-term brand value.<br><br>The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of digital marketing performance with the technical skills to work directly in BigQuery, SQL, ETL pipelines and BI visualization tools. You’ll partner with channel leads across email/SMS, paid search, paid social, CRO, and web analytics to enhance measurement frameworks and optimize media effectiveness.<br><br>This role requires strong platform knowledge and hands-on experience to develop strategic, creative recommendations. You’ll execute initiatives to achieve brand objectives and confidently pressure-test insights and recommendations across the paid media team and with key stakeholder groups. You’ll collaborate across departments and business units, using a test-and-learn mindset to drive continued growth across the company.<br><br>This position will be based at our <strong>West Los Angeles, CA </strong>office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday-Wednesday and the option to work remotely on Thursday and Friday.<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong><ul><li>Analyze and interpret marketing performance across multiple channels, including email, SMS, paid search, paid social, and web analytics, providing actionable insights to internal stakeholders and brand teams. </li><li>Develop and maintain multiple dashboards and reporting frameworks that monitor KPIs such as acquisition, conversion, retention, and subscription health. </li><li>Collaborate with marketing and creative leads to inform audience segmentation, creative testing, and campaign optimization strategies. </li><li>Use SQL and BigQuery to extract, clean, and model datasets across various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency. </li><li>Build automated reporting workflows using ETL tools (e.g., Funnel.io) to streamline data ingestion and reduce manual processes. </li><li>Support A/B and multivariate testing, providing statistical insights and recommendations for ongoing optimization. </li><li>Present findings through clear visualizations and executive-level, actionable, forward-looking summaries that influence marketing and business decisions. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>4-6 years of experience in marketing analytics, performance marketing, or digital strategy within an agency or in-house marketing environment. </li><li>Solid understanding of marketing KPIs, including CAC, ROAS, LTV, CTR, and CVR. </li><li>Strong understanding of marketing channels, for example, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (video and search), Commission Junction Affiliate, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, CRO. </li><li>Experience with ETL and data integration tools (Funnel.io, Supermetrics, Stitch, N8N, Airbyte, etc.). </li><li>Working knowledge of GA4, Looker Studio, or similar data visualization platforms. </li><li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to synthesize data into meaningful business insights. </li><li>Interest in or prior exposure to subscription-based and luxury brand marketing environments. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Klaviyo, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud. </li><li>Hands-on proficiency with SQL and Google BigQuery for querying and manipulating large data sets. </li><li>Experience with social and creative reporting platforms such as Hootsuite or Motion. </li><li>Familiarity with data modeling, attribution, or predictive analytics. </li><li>Experience working within subscription or DTC business models. </li><li>Understanding of data governance, quality assurance, and marketing data architecture. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Pay Range:</strong> $80,000 - $100,000 and may include a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills &amp; experience.<br><br><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><ul><li>Thriving Wellness Community: Access to top-notch medical coverage comprehensive vision and dental plans, and a 401k with match eligibility to secure your financial future and including:</li><ul><li>24/7 online physician consultations </li><li>virtual mental health resources </li><li>life coaching </li><li>engaging employee community groups </li><li>cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements </li><li>library of on-demand fitness videos </li></ul><li>Career Advancement Opportunities: Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units. </li><li>Focused Learning and Development: Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses. </li><li>Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward. </li><li>Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace. </li><li>Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. To learn more about our corporate social responsibility efforts, visit csr.wonderful.com. </li><li>Giving Back to the Community: Make a difference with Wonderful Giving, allowing you to allocate company-provided funds to up to three charities of your choice, and join Wonderful Neighbor to contribute to group service projects within our local communities. <br><br></li></ul>Wonderful Agency is the full-service in-house advertising and marketing agency at The Wonderful Company. Dedicated to creative excellence across all media (television, web, print, outdoor, POS, mobile and social media), Wonderful Agency builds consumer awareness and relevance across The Wonderful Company’s brands. This is accomplished by creating effective and innovative campaigns that match the quality of the highest echelon of global firms, while offering an environment that is far more entrepreneurial and fast-paced than a traditional agency. Wonderful Agency is highly integrated in direct brand and product development decisions with company owners, business unit leadership, legal, strategy and other key stakeholders.<br><br>The Wonderful Company, a successful, fast-growing privately held $6 billion company with 10,000 employees worldwide. The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back in its DNA. The company has a long-standing commitment to corporate social responsibility, including more than $1 billion invested in environmental sustainability; $65 million in charitable giving, education initiatives, and innovative health and wellness programs each year; and $143 million toward the construction of two charter school campuses in California’s Central Valley. To view the current Corporate Social Responsibility report, visit www.wonderful.com/csr.<br><br>To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products, and its core values, please visit wonderful.com, or follow The Wonderful Company on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. To learn more about The Wonderful Company’s corporate social responsibility impact, visit csr.wonderful.com.<br><br>The Wonderful Company is an Equality Opportunity Employer that provides opportunities for advancement. We are committed to creating a diverse workforce that embodies a deep culture of acceptance, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected categories.<br><br>EEO is the law - click here for more information<br><br>

A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>Responsible for complex reporting projects that gather and integrate large volumes of data, performs in depth analysis, interprets results and develops actionable insights and recommendations for use across the company for customer and employee populations. metadata.description: <p><strong>Role Overview</strong>&nbsp;</p><p>We are seeking a&nbsp;<strong>Data Engineer</strong>&nbsp;who brings deep experience in&nbsp;health plans and healthcare startups, and who thrives in transforming fragmented, archaic data workflows into reliable, scalable systems. This role sits at the intersection of&nbsp;operations, finance,&nbsp;utilization&nbsp;management, and technology, enabling the organization to measure impact, manage performance, and scale with confidence.&nbsp;</p><p>You will not only build data infrastructure, but you will also help define&nbsp;how data works&nbsp;at Blue Zones Health.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Why This Role Matters&nbsp;</strong></p><p>Blue Zones Health&nbsp;operates&nbsp;at the intersection of&nbsp;human care and hard data. This role ensures that the insights behind our mission are as strong as the care we deliver—unlocking data trapped in outdated systems and turning it into a strategic asset for scale and impact.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $180,000 annually.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What&nbsp;You’ll&nbsp;Do&nbsp;</strong></p><p><strong>Modern Data Infrastructure for Healthcare Reality&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Design, build, and&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;scalable data pipelines that integrate:&nbsp;</li></ul><p>       o Health plan eligibility and attribution files&nbsp;</p><p>       o Claims and&nbsp;utilization&nbsp;data&nbsp;</p><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Enrollment, engagement, and coaching activity data&nbsp;</p><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Vendor and partner datasets&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Write and&nbsp;optimize&nbsp;SQL to create analytics-ready data models used across the company.&nbsp;</li><li>Normalize and reconcile healthcare data from multiple sources into&nbsp;a single source&nbsp;of truth.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Operational &amp; Financial Enablement&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Partner closely with&nbsp;Operations and Finance&nbsp;to support:&nbsp;</li></ul><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Provider&nbsp;reporting and contract performance&nbsp;across different contract types&nbsp;</p><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Unit economics and margin analysis&nbsp;</p><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Capacity,&nbsp;utilization, and workforce planning&nbsp;</p><p>       o&nbsp;&nbsp;Revenue recognition and reconciliation&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Translate ambiguous business questions into structured, trustworthy data outputs.&nbsp;</li><li>Replace manual spreadsheets and one-off analyses with automated, auditable pipelines.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Driving Innovation in Legacy Systems</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Identify&nbsp;bottlenecks and inefficiencies in healthcare data workflows and redesign them for speed and accuracy.&nbsp;</li><li>Introduce modern data engineering practices into environments shaped by:&nbsp;</li></ul><p>      o&nbsp;&nbsp;Flat files&nbsp;</p><p>      o&nbsp;&nbsp;Manual handoffs&nbsp;</p><p>      o&nbsp;&nbsp;Inconsistent schemas&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Balance pragmatism and innovation—shipping value quickly while building for scale.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Work across&nbsp;<strong>Operations,&nbsp;Technology, Finance, and Clinical</strong>&nbsp;teams as a trusted data partner.&nbsp;</li><li>Help non-technical stakeholders understand data constraints, tradeoffs, and opportunities.&nbsp;</li><li>Shape data definitions and metrics that align with how care is actually delivered.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>People Leadership &amp; Team Growth</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Mentor and manage junior data engineers or analytics professionals as the team scales.&nbsp;</li><li>Establish best practices for documentation, testing, version control, and data quality.&nbsp;</li><li>Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and team culture within the data function.&nbsp;</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What&nbsp;We’re&nbsp;Looking For&nbsp;</strong></p><p><strong>Required&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>7+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering roles.&nbsp;</li><li>Strong SQL&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;and experience building production-grade data models.&nbsp;</li><li>Hands-on experience working with health plan or payer data (claims, eligibility, attribution,&nbsp;utilization).&nbsp;</li><li>Experience in startup or high-growth healthcare environments.&nbsp;</li><li>Demonstrated&nbsp;success&nbsp;modernizing or replacing legacy data workflows.&nbsp;</li><li>Experience leading, mentoring, or managing others.&nbsp;</li><li>Strong communication&nbsp;skills and ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Preferred</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Experience supporting value-based care or population health programs.&nbsp;</li><li>Familiarity with healthcare financial models (PMPM, shared savings, unit economics).&nbsp;</li><li>Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern ELT tools.&nbsp;</li><li>Exposure to&nbsp;compliance or audit-driven data environments.&nbsp;</li><li>A link to a GitHub repository or portfolio showcasing data engineering projects (e.g., pipelines, data models, analytics engineering, or infrastructure work).</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>What Success Looks Like at Blue Zones Health</strong>&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Data is trusted, accessible, and actively used across the organization.&nbsp;</li><li>Ops and Finance no longer rely on fragile spreadsheets or manual reconciliations.&nbsp;</li><li>Performance, cost, and outcomes can be measured clearly and confidently.&nbsp;</li><li>Legacy healthcare data workflows are replaced with scalable, automated systems.&nbsp;</li><li>The data function grows with strong foundations and thoughtful leadership.&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>For more information about <strong>Blue Zones Health</strong>, check us out at www.bluezoneshealth.com.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Blue Zones Health</strong> does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.</p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>What is the project about?</strong></p><p><br></p><p>The purpose of this project is to build a diverse, high-quality dataset of images that will be used to develop and improve machine learning, artificial intelligence, and computer vision technologies, including image processing, recognition, and feature detection.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Task Description:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>You will be asked to submit different types of images in RAW and other formats using smartphones or digital cameras across a wide range of scenes, lighting conditions, and photographic styles. Images can be submitted for a wide variety of categories, e.g., nature, events, animate and inanimate objects, etc., using our mobile app or browser-based data collection tool.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>We will be collecting the following types of images:</strong></p><ol><li><strong>RAW Images</strong>: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device, saved in RAW format. These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken. For this category, the images should be native RAW and DNG where applicable, including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF.</li><li><strong>Image Pairs:</strong> pairs of identical images, with specific objects present in one and removed in the other image. metadata.description: <p><strong>Technology, Americas | Change Management | Finacle Business Analyst - CONTRACTOR | NYC</strong></p><p><strong><u>About ING</u>: </strong></p><p><br></p><p>In Americas, ING’s Wholesale Banking division offers a broad range of innovative financial products and services to domestic and international corporate and institutional clients. </p><p> </p><p> When you come to work at ING, you’re joining a team where individuality isn’t just accepted, it’s encouraged. ING Americas follows a hybrid work model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility. Hybrid work arrangements vary based on business area.</p><p><br></p><p> Sound like the kind of place you’d feel at home? You align between squads –from the same or different Tribe(s) – and other parts of the organization and manage dependencies.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>About the department:</u></strong></p><p>You will be part of the Global Account Management System area within Wholesale Banking Tech, Network and Core Banking. We follow a Scrum Agile development process and strongly believe in the DevOps approach to deliver better software faster. We work with the latest technologies, tools, and frameworks, which means that you work in a dynamic environment in which you are continuously learning. If you have bright ideas, they will be valued and supported by both your peers and your management. </p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Responsibilities :</u></strong></p><ul><li>Interprets business rules and both functional and non-functional requirements to define technical specifications, based on the provided architectural design. Justifies decisions through logical and systematic reasoning.</li></ul><p><strong><em><u> </u></em></strong></p><p><strong><u>Qualifications and Competencies</u></strong></p><ul><li>4+ years of experience in software development projects preferably in Agile methodology.</li><li>Experience in designing backend solutions and developing applications with Java on/with J2EE platform, Spring, Spring Boot, Oracle PL/SQL.Experience in designing frontend solutions using TypeScript and JavaScript.</li><li>Experience in the same role in a complex environment with 24/7 service availability. </li><li>Excellent knowledge of the existing IT architecture (for the relevant domain) and technical flows.</li><li>Experience in implementing any core banking application.</li><li>Nice to have: Finacle implementation experience</li></ul><p><strong> Minimum Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li>At least 5 years of relevant working experience bridging the gap between business and IT.</li><li>Problem solving skills to find creative ways of driving progress and removing impediments</li><li>Analytic skills for creating end-to-end solutions.</li><li>A team player mindset, with a 'make it happen' mentality, eager to learn and the ability to coach others.</li><li>Good communication skills in English, strong communication and presentation skills (telling – selling) across different skill and seniority levels.</li><li>Main areas of knowledge: Microservices architecture and domain design model.</li><li>Advanced experience in the development of REST &amp; SOAP application services.</li><li>Technology landscape (application level) of the relevant domain.</li><li>Experienced in SWIFT Messaging format i.e. ISO 20022.</li><li> DBMS and SQL (e.g., Oracle, PL/ SQL) JUnit testing, test driven development and spring integration testing.</li><li>Agile paradigm and Scrum.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><em>Hourly Range $63-$105/hr </em></p><p><br></p><p><em>ING is a committed equal opportunity employer. metadata.description: <p>Clean Creatives is hiring <strong>three research assistants</strong> to conduct open source research between April 1 and June 15, 2026 for the 2026 edition of our annual report, The F-List.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>We are hiring one researcher in each of these 3 regions: (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe and (3) MENAT and brand studios. </strong>These are fully remote positions.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Details</strong></p><p>Clean Creatives is seeking researchers to contribute to the 2026 edition of our premier research report, the F-List. This report documents relationships between fossil fuel companies and advertising and PR firms worldwide, with the goals of providing transparency for communications professionals and brands and better understanding the communications strategies of major polluters.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>In its sixth year, the 2026 F-List will seek to present the most current picture of these relationships possible, with an added goal of filling in specific geographic gaps in our past research.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Past editions of this report have attracted wide coverage in communication industry press, extensive online conversation, and significantly impacted agencies’ practices. We are interested in uncovering data that helps make news and shapes the advertising and PR industry’s business goals.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><p>We are seeking either an individual researcher, or a team, to identify which agencies are responsible for promoting fossil fuel companies and lobbying groups in (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe, and (3) MENAT and brand studios.</p><p><br></p><p>The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized and intuitive, and have previous experience analyzing data or conducting research. We would like to work with researchers who are curious and self-motivated and who can consistently dedicate at least 15-20 hours of time every week during the 8-10 week research period. If you are the type of person who likes to search through databases and go through pages of Google search results, this is for you!</p><p><br></p><p>This researcher or team will analyze public sources to find proof of advertising and PR agencies working on fossil fuel campaigns. These sources include:</p><ul><li>Agency websites</li><li>Creative portfolio sites</li><li>Government disclosures</li><li>Lobbying databases</li><li>Award show directories</li><li>News coverage</li><li>LinkedIn and Meta ad libraries</li><li>Social media posts</li></ul><p><br></p><p>We will train researchers on how to find and record contracts and provide a list of countries and companies to guide their research. The researcher(s) should be comfortable working with multi-lingual sources, or in translation, to accurately and comprehensively identify key data in relevant languages.</p><p><br></p><p>We are especially interested in candidates who have experience researching the region and candidates who are familiar with company names and structures in the oil and gas industry and/or the advertising and PR industry. However, this experience is not required.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p><p>This is a paid contract position which will start on April 1, 2026 and end on June 15, 2026. Compensation will be $5000 for all deliverables.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply</strong></p><p>Applicants from any country are welcome to apply. <strong>To apply, send resumes and 2-3 research work samples to Clean Creatives Head of Research Nayantara Dutta (nayantara@fossilfree.media)</strong> with one of the following subject lines:</p><ul><li>“F-List Research Assistant - North America and LATAM”</li><li>"F-List Research Assistant - UK and Europe”</li><li>“F-List Research Assistant - MENAT and brand studios”</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Applicants are encouraged to apply by Feb 21.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><em>Further details in this Google Doc: </em>https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qr8bpE9Ofs7SEBVTDeK0IHOhJ88AX3r3yxstn9qh-Xo/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.8a9ub4h8xyvv</p>
metadata.title: F-List Research Assistant (remote)

metadata.description: <p><strong>Senior Active Directory Engineer</strong></p><p><br></p><p>The Active Directory Engineer is responsible for the design, security, hygiene, and operational integrity of enterprise Active Directory environments. This role provides hands-on technical leadership for identity and access governance, directory security, and large-scale remediation initiatives across complex, multi-domain and multi-forest environments. The engineer acts as a senior escalation point, partners with application and system owners, and drives proactive improvements to reduce risk and strengthen authentication and authorization controls.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Focus Area</strong></p><p>This role will play a critical part in improving Active Directory security posture through large-scale cleanup, remediation, and modernization efforts, with a strong emphasis on identity hygiene, access governance, and attack surface reduction.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Primary Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Lead and execute <strong>enterprise Active Directory cleanup initiatives</strong>, including identification and remediation of stale users, groups, computers, service accounts, and orphaned permissions.</li><li>Drive <strong>identity hygiene and access governance</strong> efforts, ensuring least-privilege access and compliance with security standards across large AD environments.</li><li>Perform <strong>risk analysis and security assessments</strong> using PowerShell-based discovery and AD assessment tools to identify misconfigurations, excessive privileges, and security gaps.</li><li>Analyze, correlate, and report on directory data to support remediation efforts, including lifecycle tracking, validation of cleanup outcomes, and audit-ready documentation.</li><li>Build and maintain remediation dashboards and reports using <strong>Excel, SQL, directory exports, and logging platforms</strong> to measure progress and effectiveness.</li><li>Serve as a technical advisor to application and system owners, guiding remediation efforts related to authentication, authorization, and directory dependencies.</li><li>Provide architecture, implementation, and escalation support for Microsoft Active Directory and Windows-based systems across the enterprise.</li><li>Support enterprise security initiatives, policy enforcement, and directory hardening efforts.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li><strong>5–7 years of Information Security experience</strong>, with <strong>5+ years supporting and remediating large-scale Active Directory environments</strong>.</li><li>Proven hands-on experience with <strong>enterprise AD cleanups</strong> across multi-domain and multi-forest environments.</li><li>Strong expertise in <strong>identity hygiene, access governance, and directory security</strong>.</li><li>Advanced proficiency with <strong>PowerShell</strong> for discovery, analysis, and large-scale remote management.</li><li>Strong working knowledge of <strong>AD security assessment tools and frameworks</strong> used to reduce attack surface and enforce least privilege.</li><li>Advanced skills in <strong>data analysis, correlation, and reporting</strong>, including Excel, SQL, and directory exports.</li><li>Deep understanding of <strong>Active Directory administration and architecture</strong>, including authentication (on-prem and Azure), ACLs, and Group Policy security and hardening.</li><li>Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li></ul>

metadata.description: <p><strong>About us</strong></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p>Zara offers the latest fashion trends for all. An international brand with stores in the main cities of the world and online. Our business model is centered in our customers, constantly adapting to their needs. We love what we do. Teamwork, passion, curiosity, diversity, sustainability, creativity and humility are our daily motivation. Does it sound like you? Maybe you are a Zara person.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Purpose </strong></p><p><br></p><p>We are seeking a Senior Accounts Payable Specialist to support the Finance organization across the United States, Puerto Rico, and Canada. This role manages high-volume AP activity and plays a key role in month-end closing, including preparing and booking accruals across multiple spend categories. The ideal candidate has strong Excel abilities, is experienced working with large and incomplete data sets, and can produce clear reconciliations and analysis for both finance and non-finance stakeholders. This position requires high attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to operate within defined deadlines in a multinational environment.</p><p>This position is also considered a structured entry point into the U.S. Finance team, with the opportunity to develop and grow into other areas of Finance depending on performance, business needs, and career aspirations.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Invoice &amp; Data Management</p><p>• Maintain AP mailboxes and ensure invoices and inquiries are processed timely</p><p>• Review and supervise outsourced AP entries to ensure accuracy and adherence to booking standards</p><p>• Support process improvements to enhance control and data integrity</p><p><br></p><p>Customs &amp; Duties</p><p>• Record customs duty files received from brokers and reconcile balances with Treasury payments across entities</p><p>Payments &amp; Reconciliations</p><p>• Review AP aging, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate timely payments</p><p>• Perform bi-weekly AP account reconciliations and prepare structured supporting analysis</p><p><br></p><p>Credit Card &amp; Travel Expenses</p><p>• Record corporate card and travel expense transactions and reconcile to external reports</p><p>• Reconcile Concur vs. SAP aging and resolve variances</p><p>Month-End Close, Accruals &amp; Analysis</p><p>• Prepare and post-month-end accruals across multiple cost categories</p><p>• Produce clear analysis and variance explanations for business partners and finance leadership</p><p>• Review aging reports, error queues, and pending approvals and ensure timely resolution</p><p><br></p><p>Audit &amp; Compliance</p><p>• Provide documentation for internal and external audits</p><p>• Ensure compliance with internal policies and accounting standards (IFRS / US GAAP exposure a plus)</p><p><br></p><p>Project Participation &amp; Collaboration</p><p>• Participate in accounting and cross-functional finance projects</p><p>• Recommend and support implementation of process improvements for control, visibility, or efficiency</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Hybrid Requirement:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>This is a hybrid NYC-based role. The role provides up to 30 work-from-home flex days per-6-month period, with the remaining days performed onsite in the office. Attendance expectations may increase during critical close periods or as business needs require.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field</p><p>• Minimum 3 years of accounting or AP experience (retail experience preferred)</p><p>• Advanced Excel skills and ability to work with large data sets</p><p>• Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus</p><p>• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet defined deadlines</p><p>• Ability to work with incomplete inputs and still produce structured, accurate deliverables</p><p>• Professional communication skills and ability to translate financial reconciliations into clear business language</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>In addition to a competitive salary, you will also receive 25% discount to buy the latest trends in any of our brands and a variety benefit package where you can find a wide range of discounts.</p><p>Our internal talent is our greatest asset, and we are proud of offering internal promotion programs where you will find opportunities to grow, e-learning and training programs as well as social projects to get involved and contribute to a better society, and much more!</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Annual compensation range:</strong></p><p><br></p><p>$70,000 - $85,000 + discretionary bonus</p><p><br></p><p>* Zara, in good faith, believes that this posted rate of compensation is the accurate range for this role at this location at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. Actual compensation within that range will be dependent upon the individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable laws.</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Zara USA, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</strong></p><p><br></p><p>All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, disability, age, citizenship status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.</p><p>EOE/DFW</p><p></p>

metadata.description: <strong>Who We Are<br><br></strong>Spot &amp; Tango is an innovative pet health &amp; wellness brand that delivers personalized meal plans on a subscription basis. Our recipes are developed by leading animal nutritionists and are made with only real, human-grade ingredients... and nothing artificial! We have lofty goals (to make every dog in the country healthier, and every pet parent happier!) and we are looking for the right people to help us get there. This is an exciting opportunity to join a VC-backed, high-growth e-commerce startup and have an outsized impact in an extremely fast-paced environment. Plus, you get to think about dogs all day!<br><br><strong>Who You Are<br><br></strong>You are a detail-oriented and analytical professional with a passion for ensuring the highest standards of quality in software products. You thrive in a dynamic environment where innovation and collaboration are valued, and you understand the crucial role that QA plays in delivering an exceptional customer experience. You are excited to learn new skills and embrace new tools to streamline and scale the QA process. You are familiar working with software engineering teams and business stakeholders and are adept at communicating QA findings to both groups.<br><br>As a QA Analyst at Spot &amp; Tango, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our digital platform — including our e-commerce websites, spotandtango.com and pupgum.com, as well as a suite of internal digital tools. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and resolve issues, ensuring a seamless and delightful experience for our customers. This is an opportunity to contribute to the success of a cutting-edge and growing ecommerce platform while working in an exciting, fast-paced environment.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Develop comprehensive test plans based on project requirements</li><li>Execute test cases, both manual and automated, to validate system functionality</li><li>Identify, document, and track bugs</li><li>Work with the Product team to inform the prioritization of bug tickets</li><li>Collaborate with developers and business stakeholders to solve bugs</li><li>Contribute to the deployment process — QAing code before it is launched to customers and ensuring new code is deployed seamlessly</li><li>Conduct regression testing to ensure that new features do not negatively impact existing functionality</li><li>Work closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to deeply understand our digital products</li><li>Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated integration test scripts to improve efficiency and coverage</li><li>Create and maintain detailed test documentation, including test cases, test scenarios, and test data<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor's degree</li><li>Proven experience in QA for software products in a startup or similar environment</li><li>Extremely strong attention to detail</li><li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills</li><li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills</li><li>Familiarity with agile development methodologies</li><li>A desire to learn more about technology, product management, and engineering</li><li>A passion for digital products and software development</li><li>Dog lover!<br><br></li></ul><strong>Nice to have:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field</li><li>Experience in Customer Service, Product Management, or Engineering, especially in a startup environment</li><li>Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.</li><li>Experience with test automation tools and frameworks<br><br></li></ul><em>This is a hybrid position based in our Midtown Manhattan office. In office presence is required on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.<br><br></em>Spot &amp; Tango is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

metadata.description: <strong>Position Details:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Title: Manager, Clinical Operations (Patient Recruitment)</li><li>Location: Hybrid, New York, NY<br><br></li></ul><strong>Company Overview<br><br></strong>Founded in 2021, Transcend Therapeutics is a late-clinical-stage neuroscience company developing rapid-acting treatments for neuropsychiatric diseases. Our lead asset TSND-201, a rapid-acting neuroplastogen, is the first and only product to demonstrate rapid, robust, and durable therapeutic effects in PTSD. TSND-201 was granted Breakthrough Therapy designation by the FDA based on Phase 2 results, and we have aligned on a Phase 3 program for TSND-201 in PTSD. Transcend is backed by leading life sciences investors and driven by a mission to create treatments for the millions of people for whom current psychiatric medicines have not worked.<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>The Manager, Patient Recruitment is a member of the Clinical Operations team and is responsible for overseeing patient recruitment to support enrollment in clinical studies in collaboration with patient recruitment vendors and sites.<br><br>A successful Manager in Patient Recruitment takes initiative in recruitment strategies, identifies challenges and proactively makes adjustments or decisions to meet study enrollment goals. The position will report to the (Assoc/Sr) Director, Clinical Operations.<br><br><strong>Key responsibilities will include:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Set up study recruitment plans/operations during study start up including site recruitment and central recruitment strategies. </li><li>Evaluate patient recruitment vendors and provide oversight/coordination with vendors throughout the study. </li><li>Develop and review study and site recruitment materials (design elements and written content of flyers, posters, newsletters, ads, etc.). </li><li>Regularly interact with clinical study sites to support individualized site recruitment needs. </li><li>Track progress and success of various recruitment tactics with study enrollment goals in mind. </li><li>Identify new recruitment strategies as needed and lead efforts in recruitment challenges. </li><li>Communicate with various internal and external personnel (i.e., study staff, site personnel, CTM). </li><li>Participate in study team meetings and provide updates to senior personnel. </li><li>Participate in creation, review, and revision of clinical SOPs. </li><li>All other duties as required. <br><br></li></ul>This is a great opportunity to step into a high-impact, high-visibility role on the early team of Transcend Therapeutics. We offer competitive cash and equity compensation; medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401k; unlimited vacation and sick time; and more.<br><br>The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000, plus equity and benefits.<br><br><strong>Experience Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a life science</li><li>2+ years experience in patient recruitment in a pharmaceutical company, CRO, patient recruitment vendor or similar organization, 4+ overall years in clinical research</li><li>Experience in recruiting studies in psychiatry-related indications is preferred</li><li>Proficient knowledge of GCP/ICH, drug development process, clinical operations<br><br></li></ul><strong>Key Competency Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>Excellent verbal, written, communication and interpersonal skills</li><li>Creative and flexible, able to pivot when needed</li><li>Able to align with company goals and focus on the big picture</li><li>Able to effectively communicate and collaborate across functions and job levels</li><li>Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work effectively in a fast-paced environment</li><li>Internally motivated, with a passion for mental health</li><li>Routinely takes initiative<br><br></li></ul><strong>Travel Required<br><br></strong><ul><li>Travel may be required (approximately 5%)<br><br></li></ul>We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and talented team, free from discrimination. If you're excited about our mission but don't meet 100% of the qualifications above, we encourage you to apply.

metadata.description: Verve For Advertisers is a technology company that empowers brands and agencies to connect moments of discovery and drive measurable outcomes across screens.<br><br>As part of Verve, we've unified the company's demand-side offering, bringing together the largest on-site search intent dataset outside of walled gardens, direct SDK integrations with top apps, alongside data partnerships with 3M+ websites and LLMs. Our technology captures both what consumers do and why they do it, delivering high-fidelity audiences, insights, and activation across premium omnichannel inventory.<br><br>We are looking for a Technical Support Analyst to provide technical support for our internal advertising application systems with a primary focus on supporting the operations of our revenue-generating applications. This mid-level contract role will work closely with internal customers including Operations (Production and Client Service), Product, Quality Assurance, and Application Development teams on systems support, application monitoring, and cloud infrastructure management across AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes environments. <strong>This position is a contract role and can work remotely anywhere in the US or outside of the US. They should be willing and open to collaborate with our US based engineering team during their business hours.<br><br></strong><strong>Responsibilities Include<br><br></strong><ul><li>Provide operational support for primary revenue-generating applications, participating proactively in incident resolution</li><li>Respond to support tickets and user inquiries with timely, effective solutions</li><li>Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues with applications and infrastructure</li><li>Document technical procedures, troubleshooting steps, and knowledge base articles</li><li>Create and maintain end user documentation for internal applications</li><li>Collaborate with platform engineering team on incident response and system improvements</li><li>Assist with user onboarding and training on systems and cloud platform access<br><br></li></ul><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>3-5 years of experience in technical support role</li><li>Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills</li><li>Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users</li><li>Strong technical writing skills with experience creating user documentation</li><li>Familiarity with ticketing systems and ITSM processes</li><li>Familiarity with monitoring and reporting tools<br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferred Skills And Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>Experience with advertising technology platforms</li><li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP)</li><li>Understanding of identity and access management (IAM) concepts</li><li>Experience creating and managing user accounts and permissions</li><li>Experience with container technologies (Kubernetes, Docker)<br><br></li></ul>Hourly Rate: $35/hour<br><br>We’re open to allowing the right person to learn our industry on the job. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into all of our roles. We believe in hiring the right person as opposed to the right combination of keywords.<br><br><strong>Communications regarding your application will only come from @jungroup.com or @hyprmx.com email addresses.</strong>

metadata.description: <p><strong>Technology, Americas | Change Management | Finacle Business Analyst - CONTRACTOR | NYC</strong></p><p><strong><u>About ING</u>: </strong></p><p><br></p><p>In Americas, ING’s Wholesale Banking division offers a broad range of innovative financial products and services to domestic and international corporate and institutional clients. </p><p> </p><p> When you come to work at ING, you’re joining a team where individuality isn’t just accepted, it’s encouraged. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, friendly and supportive – it’s the kind of place where you can be yourself and make the most of whatever you have to offer.</p><p><br></p><p> We give people the freedom to take risks, think differently, take ownership of their work, and make great things happen. We’re here to help you get ahead. And with our global network, there’s plenty of scope to take your career in new directions, perhaps even ones you’ve never considered. ING Americas follows a hybrid work model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility. Hybrid work arrangements vary based on business area.</p><p><br></p><p> Sound like the kind of place you’d feel at home? We’d love to hear from you.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>About the position: </u></strong></p><p>As an IT Business Analyst, you will be a key player in the cooperation between IT and Business stakeholders. You drive to make complex changes happen within and across Tribes.</p><p>Your holistic view as well as your knowledge of both Business and IT are crucial in translating business requirements into business value. You align between squads –from the same or different Tribe(s) – and other parts of the organization and manage dependencies.</p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>About the department:</u></strong></p><p>You will be part of the Global Account Management System area within Wholesale Banking Tech, Network and Core Banking. You will collaborate with multiple teams spread across domains in Philippines, India, Belgium, The Netherlands, and more. We follow a Scrum Agile development process and strongly believe in the DevOps approach to deliver better software faster. We work with the latest technologies, tools, and frameworks, which means that you work in a dynamic environment in which you are continuously learning. If you have bright ideas, they will be valued and supported by both your peers and your management. </p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>Responsibilities :</u></strong></p><ul><li>Interprets business rules and both functional and non-functional requirements to define technical specifications, based on the provided architectural design. metadata.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.<p> </p><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong><p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p><p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p><p> </p> <strong>About the team</strong><p>At Roku, we like to say that there are no bystanders, and that is as true in the advertising team as it is in any other facet of the company. We work together to ensure our clients understand this new world of advertising, that they are making the best possible decisions to support their own goals, and drive advertiser interest and engagement across the board. The Client Services team is responsible for managing and growing Roku’s partnerships with Advertisers and ultimately enabling our clients to reach their business objectives.</p><p> </p><strong>About the role</strong><p>The Account Manager role is a strategic partner to Roku’s Clients and the Roku Ad Sales team. This position plays a key role in ensuring end-to-end success for advertising partners from pre-sale to post-sale via ownership over campaign success and execution within the Political, Advocacy &amp; Government Ads vertical. This individual is integral in maintaining and growing key partnerships while upselling and maximizing revenue for Roku’s advertising business. This individual will have a passion for data, building strong customer relationships, and collaborating closely with internal Ad Support departments. This position requires strong communication skills and a high-level of attention to detail while working in a fast-paced sales environment. </p><p>The expectations placed on the Account Manger role within the Political Ad Sales team are largely similar to the broader Client Services team but will have a few key differences. During peak season when political campaigns are in full swing and advertising heavily, there may be times when an adjusted schedule is required in order to meet the unique needs of political advertisers. Timeliness, with respect to both response time and communication of core campaign needs such as inventory availability and campaign adjustments, is an area of greater importance for this role, and candidates should be prepared to adopt an accommodating approach to client needs. Roku, and particularly the Political Ad Sales Team, is non-partisan, works with the full spectrum of political advertisers, and promises the same end-to-end client experience to all political advertisers; the Account Manager should prepare to be apolitical and show no evidence of personal bias or political affinity. The account manager may also work with an array of different clients in the advocacy and government spheres as they are included in the larger P.A.G. team’s account portfolio.</p><p>As an Account Manager you will work to support the Ad Sales team and adopt a consultative approach to supporting Roku’s Ad Sales clients. Account Managers at Roku are involved in each step of the campaign lifecycle from pitch, pre-sale, launch, execution, optimization, post-sale campaign readouts, billing, and client engagement. The role is directly responsible for campaign execution, performance, and Roku ROI.  </p><p> </p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong><ul><li>Serve as the lead day-to-day point of contact for Roku’s clients in the Political, Advertising and Government spaces</li><li>Manage high volume accounts with very quick timelines while still forging strong client relationships, understanding their objectives, and proactively driving renewals and upsell opportunities</li><li>Maintain exceptional attention to detail while multitasking across clients, often shifting priorities in real time based on breaking news or campaign needs</li><li>Collaborate with Account Executives and Sales Planners to review and respond to RFPs (Request for Proposals) for your assigned accounts with comprehensive media plans and inventory forecasts</li><li>Support Account Executives on client meetings, including presenting insights, data, and campaign metrics during meetings and/or QBRs</li><li>Be an expert on Roku’s unique ad products with support from Measurement, Analytics, and Product teams to provide the best value to our clients to achieve their advertising goals</li><li>Serve as the liaison between the client, Roku’s Sponsorships and Design team, and ad operation teams – support Roku Best Practices &amp; Ad Guidelines on design and approach for assets</li><li>Responsible for ensuring campaigns launches are seamless and on time. Regular and constant communication with clients and internal teams to confirm creative asset collection, campaign setup and activation</li><li>Frequent monitoring and reporting of campaigns to ensure they are performing and pacing toward client KPIs. Provide status updates and reporting to key stakeholders (AEs and clients)</li><li>Exceptional troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, along with a strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Ad Operations and other business operations teams on campaign activations and optimizations</li><li>Own the creation and presentation of campaign report deliverables including pacing reports, custom performance insights, and end of flight wrap decks. Craft persuasive narratives with data driven storytelling to engage and upsell clients to drive incremental revenue</li><li>Support the Finance team to ensure campaigns are properly invoiced each month and work with clients to receive timely payments</li><li>Well organized and detailed-oriented individual with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines</li><li>Execute across a variety of media types including Direct IO, PG, and PMP campaigns</li></ul><p> </p><strong>We’re excited if you have</strong><ul><li>3-5 years of experience in account management/client services at an ad tech company or media planning at an agency</li><li>Experience working with major political campaigns and/or political advertisers for at least 1 election cycle</li><li>Experience in media planning and crafting or responding to RFPs preferred</li><li>Experience in display, video and CTV advertising with a premium publisher, agency, ad network, or data vendor</li><li>Hands on experience in Programmatic video executions, workflows, and troubleshooting--particularly within a DSP, Ad Exchange or SSP (ex: TTD, Yahoo DSP, DV360, Stackadapt, Magnite)</li><li>Understanding of PMP and PG deals and how to troubleshoot &amp; optimize them</li><li>Proficiency in ad serving platforms and understanding of how tags function (ex: DCM/GCM, ExtremeReach, Innovid, etc.)</li><li>Reporting intelligence with Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint &amp; Tableau</li><li>Comfortability in working within campaign data sets, finding actionable insights through analysis and data visualization techniques, and presenting them to a client in a clear compelling narrative</li><li>Analytical, project management, deadline-driven, and process-oriented personality</li><li>Strong desire for collaboration, creative brainstorms and proactive client engagement</li><li>Strong &amp; persuasive communication skills, both verbal and written</li><li>Self-starter, comfortable working in fast-paced, growing environment<br></li></ul> <p> </p><strong>Our Hybrid Work Approach</strong><p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.</p><p> </p><strong>Benefits</strong><p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p><p> </p><strong>Accommodations</strong><p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.</p><p> </p><strong>The Roku Culture</strong><p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p><p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. data sets<br><br></li></ul><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong>At TheIncLab we recognize that innovation thrives when employees are provided with the support and resources, they need to be successful in As part of our team, you will enjoy:<br><br><ul><li> Hybrid and Flexible Work Environment that supports working remote and in-office</li><li> Professional Development Programs to support training and certification reimbursement, skill development, continued learning, and career advancement. </li><li> Paid Time Off for personal time off, volunteering, holidays, and more. </li><li> Health and Wellness Benefits include options for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance along with access to Wellness, Mental Health, and Employee Assistance Programs</li><li> 100% Company Paid Benefits that include STD, LTD, and Basic Life insurance. </li><li> 401(k) Plan Options that include up to a 4% match and immediate vesting</li><li> Incentive Bonuses for eligible clearance, performance, retention, and referrals. </li><li>A company culture that values your individual strengths, career goals, and contributions to the team<br><br></li></ul><strong>About TheIncLab<br><br></strong>Founded in 2015, TheIncLab ("TIL") is the first human-centered artificial intelligence (AI+X) lab. metadata.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.<p> </p><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong><p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p><p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p><p> </p> <strong>About the team</strong><p>At Roku, we like to say that there are no bystanders, and that is as true in the advertising team as it is in any other facet of the company. We work together to ensure our clients understand this new world of advertising, that they are making the best possible decisions to support their own goals, and drive advertiser interest and engagement across the board. The Client Services team is responsible for managing and growing Roku’s partnerships with Advertisers and ultimately enabling our clients to reach their business objectives.</p><p> </p><strong>About the role</strong><p>The Account Manager role is a strategic partner to Roku’s Clients and the Roku Ad Sales team. This position plays a key role in ensuring end-to-end success for advertising partners from pre-sale to post-sale via ownership over campaign success and execution within the Political, Advocacy &amp; Government Ads vertical. This individual is integral in maintaining and growing key partnerships while upselling and maximizing revenue for Roku’s advertising business. This individual will have a passion for data, building strong customer relationships, and collaborating closely with internal Ad Support departments. This position requires strong communication skills and a high-level of attention to detail while working in a fast-paced sales environment. </p><p>The expectations placed on the Account Manger role within the Political Ad Sales team are largely similar to the broader Client Services team but will have a few key differences. During peak season when political campaigns are in full swing and advertising heavily, there may be times when an adjusted schedule is required in order to meet the unique needs of political advertisers. Timeliness, with respect to both response time and communication of core campaign needs such as inventory availability and campaign adjustments, is an area of greater importance for this role, and candidates should be prepared to adopt an accommodating approach to client needs. Roku, and particularly the Political Ad Sales Team, is non-partisan, works with the full spectrum of political advertisers, and promises the same end-to-end client experience to all political advertisers; the Account Manager should prepare to be apolitical and show no evidence of personal bias or political affinity. The account manager may also work with an array of different clients in the advocacy and government spheres as they are included in the larger P.A.G. team’s account portfolio.</p><p>As an Account Manager you will work to support the Ad Sales team and adopt a consultative approach to supporting Roku’s Ad Sales clients. Account Managers at Roku are involved in each step of the campaign lifecycle from pitch, pre-sale, launch, execution, optimization, post-sale campaign readouts, billing, and client engagement. The role is directly responsible for campaign execution, performance, and Roku ROI.  </p><p> </p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong><ul><li>Serve as the lead day-to-day point of contact for Roku’s clients in the Political, Advertising and Government spaces</li><li>Manage high volume accounts with very quick timelines while still forging strong client relationships, understanding their objectives, and proactively driving renewals and upsell opportunities</li><li>Maintain exceptional attention to detail while multitasking across clients, often shifting priorities in real time based on breaking news or campaign needs</li><li>Collaborate with Account Executives and Sales Planners to review and respond to RFPs (Request for Proposals) for your assigned accounts with comprehensive media plans and inventory forecasts</li><li>Support Account Executives on client meetings, including presenting insights, data, and campaign metrics during meetings and/or QBRs</li><li>Be an expert on Roku’s unique ad products with support from Measurement, Analytics, and Product teams to provide the best value to our clients to achieve their advertising goals</li><li>Serve as the liaison between the client, Roku’s Sponsorships and Design team, and ad operation teams – support Roku Best Practices &amp; Ad Guidelines on design and approach for assets</li><li>Responsible for ensuring campaigns launches are seamless and on time. Regular and constant communication with clients and internal teams to confirm creative asset collection, campaign setup and activation</li><li>Frequent monitoring and reporting of campaigns to ensure they are performing and pacing toward client KPIs. Provide status updates and reporting to key stakeholders (AEs and clients)</li><li>Exceptional troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, along with a strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Ad Operations and other business operations teams on campaign activations and optimizations</li><li>Own the creation and presentation of campaign report deliverables including pacing reports, custom performance insights, and end of flight wrap decks. Craft persuasive narratives with data driven storytelling to engage and upsell clients to drive incremental revenue</li><li>Support the Finance team to ensure campaigns are properly invoiced each month and work with clients to receive timely payments</li><li>Well organized and detailed-oriented individual with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines</li><li>Execute across a variety of media types including Direct IO, PG, and PMP campaigns</li></ul><p> </p><strong>We’re excited if you have</strong><ul><li>3-5 years of experience in account management/client services at an ad tech company or media planning at an agency</li><li>Experience working with major political campaigns and/or political advertisers for at least 1 election cycle</li><li>Experience in media planning and crafting or responding to RFPs preferred</li><li>Experience in display, video and CTV advertising with a premium publisher, agency, ad network, or data vendor</li><li>Hands on experience in Programmatic video executions, workflows, and troubleshooting--particularly within a DSP, Ad Exchange or SSP (ex: TTD, Yahoo DSP, DV360, Stackadapt, Magnite)</li><li>Understanding of PMP and PG deals and how to troubleshoot &amp; optimize them</li><li>Proficiency in ad serving platforms and understanding of how tags function (ex: DCM/GCM, ExtremeReach, Innovid, etc.)</li><li>Reporting intelligence with Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint &amp; posture of third-party and affiliate service providers in accordance with the Bank’s Vendor Management Program and FDIC third-party risk guidance.</li><li>Establish due diligence, ongoing monitoring,
