metadata.description: <p><strong>Title: Program Coordinator</strong></p><p><strong>Reports to: Program Director</strong></p><p><strong>Location: Must be based in the Chicago, IL or Los Angeles, CA metro areas. Remote work from home or co-working with weekly in-person events and meetings in Chicago. Occasional (approx. 6-8x/year) national travel.</strong></p><p><strong>Posted: January 29, 2026</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply - No Exceptions</strong></p><p>You must apply following these specific directions. Please read them carefully. Candidates who only apply on LinkedIn will not be considered. Please send the following in PDF format via email to careers@picklesgroup.org, with a subject line that reads (exactly as written): <em>Program Coordinator – Application</em>. We request your resume and a cover letter answering the following questions as an attachment to the email (cover letter in no more than one page, 11 point font):</p><ol><li><strong>&nbsp;What excites you about this role and Pickles Group’s mission? If you have a personal connection to the work that you’re comfortable sharing, we’d love to hear more.</strong></li><li><strong>How do you stay organized while managing multiple projects and high-priority responsibilities? Share a specific example to help us understand how you set yourself up for success.</strong></li><li><strong>How might you leverage your role to improve support for families who come from different backgrounds, communities, or are experiencing different challenges? Feel free to share an example of a time you’ve done this in the past that you’re proud of if you have one.</strong></li></ol><p><br></p><p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p><p>Pickles Group is a growing national 501(c)3 nonprofit organization founded in 2021. Our mission is to provide free peer-to-peer support and resources to kids facing a parent or caregiver’s cancer. We’ve doubled our impact every year since we launched, supporting 4,916 families and distributing 66,250 Family Cancer Support Kits across all 50 states and 13 countries to date.</p><p><br></p><p>Our team is caring, collaborative, and focused on making a big impact. We support each other and believe that the culture we’re building within our organization is as important as the work we do. We believe that every family navigating a parent or caregiver’s cancer deserves access to support and resources that help them heal and thrive.&nbsp;You can learn more about what that commitment means here.</p><p><br></p><p>We are hiring our first-ever Program Coordinator to ensure our programs run smoothly, consistently, and with care. This role exists so families, volunteers, and partners can focus on connection and support, while operations, logistics, and systems are handled effectively and reliably behind the scenes. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, creating systems others can rely on, and taking pride in strong operational execution. </p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><p><strong>Program Operations &amp; Logistics&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Coordinate logistics for virtual and in-person programs, webinars, and resources (calendars, scheduling, Zoom links, communications)</li><li>Coordinate with external vendors, partners, and facilities for programs and events</li><li>Manage program materials, inventory, and shipping</li><li>Build and maintain checklists, timelines, and repeatable processes</li><li>Anticipate needs and resolve issues proactively</li><li>Distribute and organize evaluations and feedback</li><li>Support planning and execution of signature programs and events</li><li>Coordinate registrations, materials, and run-of-show logistics for in-person and virtual programs</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Program Data &amp; Systems&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Maintain accurate enrollment, attendance, and participation data via Monday.com, Google forms, and other digital tools as we grow</li><li>Track workflows and deadlines using Monday.com and related tools</li><li>Flag data inconsistencies and system gaps</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Family &amp; Volunteer Coordination&nbsp;</strong></p><ul><li>Serve as a welcoming point of contact for families</li><li>Support intake, enrollment, and ongoing participation logistics</li><li>Assist with volunteer scheduling, onboarding logistics, and training materials</li><li>Escalate sensitive situations when appropriate</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How Will You Know You’re Successful?</strong></p><ul><li>Programs run smoothly with minimal last-minute issues</li><li>Families and volunteers receive timely, supportive, welcoming communication</li><li>Program data is accurate and actionable</li><li>Systems and processes are refined and improved to help us scale and grow</li><li>Teammates can focus on strategy and relationships because operations are handled reliably</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>How and When You’ll Do It</strong></p><p>Be a team player: We are a small team that is continually growing and evolving. We have an all-hands-on-deck approach in a remote working environment (working both from home and in the field) using Google Workplace and Zoom. To succeed in this role, you must be responsive to emails, texts, and calls. You will need to work frequent evenings and weekends, the times that often work best for our families and supporters for events and programs, with opportunities to take other weekdays off. (Our programs take place on half of the Sundays of the year; you would work with us to identify another day of the week to take off accordingly.)</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p><ul><li>Highly organized, efficient, and detail-oriented</li><li>Reliable, proactive, and at your best owning operational work</li><li>Clear, warm communicator</li><li>Excited about learning new digital systems and working with data</li><li>Curious and open to experimenting with new tools, including AI</li><li>Thoughtful about creating supportive, welcoming experiences for all families &nbsp;</li></ul><p><strong></strong></p><p><strong>What Would Be Great to Bring</strong></p><ul><li>1–2 years of related experience (including internships or volunteer roles) with logistics, programs, or events</li><li>Experience working with families, volunteers, and external partners</li><li>Familiarity with tools like Monday.com, Airtable, Asana, or Salesforce, and Google Workspace</li><li>Comfort working remotely or in hybrid environments</li><li>A sense of humor</li><li>Experience working with diverse communities&nbsp;</li><li>A personal connection to our mission</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Salary and Benefits</strong></p><p>The starting annual salary offered for this role is $55,000: your salary will be commensurate with your experience and competitive for the role. As a full-time staff member, you’ll receive a generous annual healthcare and retirement savings stipend, three weeks of paid time off, three months of paid family leave, and a home/co-working office stipend. The location for this position is either the Greater Chicago, IL metro area or Los Angeles, CA metro area.</p><p><br></p><p>Pickles Group is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse and inclusive workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals across race, ethnicity, color, spirituality, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, ability, veteran status, health, socioeconomic status, healthcare access, and other personal identities.</p>

metadata.description: FutureSight is seeking an experienced and visionary Founding CEO to lead the launch of a new AI-native reverse logistics orchestration platform. Reverse logistics — everything that happens after a sale — has become one of the largest and least controlled cost centers in modern commerce. Returns, warranties, exchanges, and recoveries are unavoidable, high-volume workflows, yet they are still managed through fragmented tools, spreadsheets, and manual judgment.<br><br>Operations, finance, and customer teams spend enormous effort enforcing policy, chasing evidence, routing returns, and reconciling outcomes — often with little visibility into where value is lost or when cash will actually be recovered. The result is margin leakage, long cycle times, and growing operational drag in a workflow that continues to scale.<br><br>We are building an AI-first orchestration layer that sits between customers, fulfillment networks, and finance systems. The platform enforces policy at intake, captures evidence at the source, determines the optimal path for each return, and tracks outcomes through to financial closure — without replacing existing ERPs, WMSs, or commerce platforms.<br><br>This is an opportunity to build c infrastructure in a $700B+ global market, shaping how modern organizations control cost, risk, and recovered value after the sale.<br><br><strong>As Founding CEO, you will<br><br></strong><ul><li>Win customers — Run pilots, shape pricing, and validate retention + expansion</li><li>Build the product — Work with FutureSight's product/engineering pod to launch V1</li><li>Raise capital — Lead the seed round with our initial investment</li><li>Build your team — Hire your founding team and set the cultural foundation<br><br></li></ul><strong>About FutureSight<br><br></strong>FutureSight is a venture studio that co-creates and invests in B2B SaaS and Vertical AI startups alongside exceptional entrepreneurs. We give founders an unfair advantage — pairing hands-on studio support with early capital, thereby reducing risk and increasing the odds of success by 10x.<br><br>We're led by a cross-functional team of builders and investors. Kevin Nguyen and Alan Smith lead venture design and product strategy. Prathna Ramesh applies her experience as a venture investor with capital strategy in every new business. Dennis Ensing mentors our ventures with operational and strategic expertise, Krista LaRiviere brings years of entrepreneurial and marketing experience as a multi-time exited founder, and Anupama Joshi drives founder excellence. John Carbrey (San Francisco), a successful software entrepreneur and people leader, adds deep insight into scaling startups from 0 to 1, having built and exited multiple prior SaaS ventures.<br><br><strong>What We Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li>Validated problem — You will enter a venture with a proven market need and strong momentum toward building and scaling</li><li>Studio bench strength — Designers, engineers, growth marketers, and fundraising pros are embedded from Day 1</li><li>Capital commitment — Initial pre-seed funding for early hires and building the MVP with potential for follow-on funding, and access to our investor and advisor network<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Bring<br><br></strong><ul><li>Founder-level drive — You're motivated to co-found a new venture as the CEO. You're familiar with the scrappiness of owning something from start to finish</li><li>Previous founding experience — You have co-founded a product company or B2B SaaS venture, or have been at a venture-backed company</li><li>Risk appetite and capacity — Read more on our post on the Entrepreneurial Risk Profile</li><li>GTM chops — Proven success in B2B SaaS sales, marketing, and customer engagement</li><li>Fundraising fluency — Able to craft investor narratives and close capital; well-networked in fintech and early-stage communities</li><li>People leadership — Magnet for top talent; coach and culture carrier</li><li>Industry experience — Experience in operations-heavy commerce, supply chain, or logistics environments, with hands-on exposure to returns, warranty, fulfillment, or post-sale workflows<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Can Expect<br><br></strong><ul><li>Daily active engagement with our team to: launch initial product, achieve initial market traction and prepare for seed fundraise</li><li>Full P/L ownership of the new entity</li><li>A significant equity stake in the business</li><li>This is a full-time role; we are seeking someone to dedicate themselves full-time and exclusively to building and owning a new SaaS venture<br><br></li></ul>Ready to build?<br><br>If this is the perfect opportunity for you, we want to hear from you!<br><br>Submit your Resume and LinkedIn profile and tell us more about why you think we should chat!<br><br>FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. metadata.description: <strong>What We Do<br><br></strong>At GoGuardian, we're helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world's greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.<br><br><strong>What It's Like to Work at GoGuardian<br><br></strong>We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.<br><br><strong>The Role<br><br></strong>The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for retaining and growing a portfolio of active customer accounts, providing best-in-class support and customer success management. Reporting to the Manager, Customer Success, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring that our customers are achieving maximum value from our solutions, ultimately driving renewals, expansions, and cross-sells. Working closely with New Business Managers, you'll collaborate on Strategic Growth Plans, guide new customers through onboarding, and proactively monitor customer health to mitigate churn risks. Your primary objective will be to support customers in achieving their goals through GoGuardian's platform, acting as their trusted advisor and main point of contact throughout the customer journey to retain and grow GoGuardian products and services.<br><br>This role requires a proactive, customer-focused individual who is comfortable managing multiple accounts, identifying growth opportunities, and acting as a bridge between the customer and internal teams. The ideal candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time.You will be measured against ARR targets and responsible for ensuring timely renewals, cross-selling additional products, and expanding accounts to align with evolving customer needs. In every customer interaction, you'll strive to provide a delightful experience, supported by strategic guidance and best practices to drive strong customer engagement and long-term success.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Drive Renewals and Account Retention:</strong> Ensure a high rate of renewals by managing and nurturing customer relationships, proactively identifying and addressing any challenges, and securing contract renewals before expiration.</li><li><strong>Identify and Execute Expansion Opportunities: </strong>Recognize opportunities for account growth by upselling and cross-selling GoGuardian's products to meet evolving customer needs, contributing to both customer success and revenue targets.</li><li><strong>Guide Customers Through Onboarding and Product Adoption: </strong>Lead new customers through implementation and onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition to GoGuardian's platform and supporting product adoption through monitoring, guidance, and ongoing best practices.</li><li><strong>Monitor and Improve Customer Health: </strong>Track customer usage and engagement, leveraging product usage and analytics tools to forecast risks of churn and opportunities for growth. Take proactive steps to maintain and improve customer health, providing personalized support as needed.</li><li><strong>Act as a Strategic Customer Advocate: </strong>Build trusted advisor relationships by understanding customer goals and acting as their advocate within GoGuardian. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver on customer needs, providing feedback to Product and other departments to continuously improve the customer experience.</li><li><strong>Maintain a High-Accuracy Sales Pipeline: </strong>Manage your pipeline within Salesforce, maintaining high accuracy in opportunity forecasting and reporting. You will be responsible for meeting or exceeding a renewal, expansion, and cross-sell quota on a quarterly, and annual basis.</li><li><strong>Deliver Exceptional Customer Experience: </strong>Aim to provide a delightful experience in every interaction by being responsive, knowledgeable, and proactive, continuously working to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.</li><li><strong>Support Strategic Initiatives and Internal Collaboration: </strong>Work closely with New Business Managers to develop and execute Strategic Growth Plans for your designated region. Facilitate seamless transitions from Sales to Customer Success, ensuring alignment on customer needs and objectives.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Who You Are <br><br></strong><ul><li>3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing sales role</li><li>Deep understanding of GoGuardian's full product suite and ability to align solutions to district needs</li><li>Proficient in Salesforce, including managing forecasts and building reports to inform account strategy</li><li>Skilled in navigating customer objections and negotiating toward value-based outcomes</li><li>Owns renewal and expansion motions, consistently delivering against ARR targets</li><li>Able to work cross functionally with channel and sales</li><li>Practice detailed sales data hygiene in salesforce and other sales tools</li><li>Eager to take initiative in a fast-paced, ever-changing, dynamic environment.</li><li>Fueled by the opportunity to truly impact the education landscape.</li><li>Something else? Tell us! We want to learn more about you…<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Expect<br><br></strong><ul><li><strong>Customer Success &amp; Relationship Management</strong></li><ul><li>Own and nurture customer relationships, ensuring that GoGuardian products and services consistently meet and exceed expectations.</li><li>Act as the main point of contact for assigned accounts, fostering a trusted advisor relationship that positions GoGuardian as an essential partner in achieving customer goals.</li><li>Provide regular communication, strategic guidance, and best practices to help customers maximize their use of our platform.</li></ul><li><strong>Account Strategy and Renewal Management</strong></li><ul><li>Collaborate with New Business Managers to develop and execute Strategic Growth Plans for assigned regions.</li><li>Proactively manage contract renewals, ensuring agreements are secured before expiration, and identify areas for account expansion to support customer needs.</li><li>Track and monitor customer usage, engagement, and health, addressing any risks of churn with timely, targeted interventions.</li></ul><li><strong>Expansion, Cross-Sell, and Quota Ownership</strong></li><ul><li>Identify and pursue opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional GoGuardian products, driving growth within your existing accounts.</li><li>Actively manage and maintain your sales pipeline within Salesforce, with impeccable hygiene and a high level of accuracy in opportunity forecasting and management.</li><li>Meet or exceed your ARR targets on a quarterly and annual basis through proactive account management, focusing on retention, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities.</li></ul><li><strong>Internal Collaboration and Customer Advocacy</strong></li><ul><li>Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience, from onboarding through the entire customer lifecycle.</li><li>Act as an advocate for your customers within GoGuardian, sharing product feedback and insights with the Product team to inform future developments.</li><li>Partner with internal stakeholders to quarterback customer risks and escalations, creating and executing action plans to resolve issues and enhance customer satisfaction.<br></li></ul></ul><strong>What We Offer <br><br></strong><ul><li>Competitive pay, complete health insurance, 401(k) matching, and an employee equity plan.</li><li>Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, wellness days, and a paid year-end holiday break.</li><li>A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal well being, including work from home funds, fertility &amp;adoption reimbursement, and more…<br><br></li></ul><em>Plus the intangible:<br><br></em><ul><li>A varied and challenging role in a global and highly innovative high-growth company.</li><li>Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.<br><br></li></ul>The typical annual base salary range for this position, combined with variable pay, results in a total targeted earnings range of $120,000. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base pay for this position and your pay will be determined by a variety of factors, including your primary work location, skills, qualifications and experience. Additional benefits information is listed on our careers page.<br><br>Please share this with your friends or co-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talented people.<br><br>GoGuardian is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. GoGuardian does not discriminate against employees, applicants, interns or volunteers on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, sex, age, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.<br><br>GoGuardian's Job Applicant Privacy Policy is located <strong>here</strong>.<br><br>#BI-Remote

metadata.description: <p><strong>You're a strategic, innovative, people-fluent technical leader who:</strong></p><ul><li>Thrives on the opportunity to use all your technical expertise and <strong>leadership skills</strong> to innovate and find new ways to bring <strong>ambitious visions</strong> into reality.</li><li>Feels eager to join a collaborative, supportive leadership team focused on <strong>modernizing</strong> and <strong>advancing</strong> a high-growth business with <strong>emerging technologies</strong>.</li><li>Wants to play a pivotal role in shaping the promising future for a specialized healthcare organization with <strong>new platforms, AI integrations, </strong>and<strong> data innovation</strong>.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>If this sounds like you, welcome to the team!</p><p><br></p><p>The VP of Technology, Innovation &amp; Data will be an enthusiastic evangelist for technical enhancements, modernization, automation, and digitization. In this role, you will leverage all your technical know-how, curiosity, and people leadership expertise to be a pivotal part of our ongoing organizational evolution and deliver on our mission to do the right thing for the people and clients we serve.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Drive technology and innovation strategy and execution to achieve company goals including leading the Technology, Systems, Product, Engineering, IT, and Data Science teams to deliver scalable, innovative solutions that enhance our occupational health and safety services.</li><li>Provide comprehensive IT organization oversight, including infrastructure, operations, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, and end-user support, with deep and broad technical expertise.</li><li>Shape and determine product and data strategy, leveraging analytics, AI/ML, and business intelligence to inform decision-making and improve results.</li><li>Oversee architecture, technologies and drive process improvements to maintain a competitive edge.</li><li>Serve as the company’s AI champion by proactively scouting emerging tools, platforms, and capabilities, including evaluating applicability, building business cases, and overseeing enterprise adoption in partnership with the Operations, Clinical, HR, Compliance, and Finance teams.</li><li>Lead organization-wide AI discovery sessions, pilots, and proofs-of-concept to validate automation opportunities, decision support, predictive analytics, workflow optimization, and client-facing enhancements.</li><li>Establish responsible AI governance to ensure safe, compliant, ethical, and privacy-preserving deployment and use across all teams.</li><li>Build, mentor, and inspire high-performing teams while fostering a collaborative culture, accountability, curiosity, and continuous learning including AI literacy and investigation.</li><li>Partner closely with executive leadership to align technology, product, and data strategies with organizational goals and growth initiatives.</li><li>Provide thought leadership on technology trends, analytics, AI/ML, value-based care, and digital health integration to inform strategic decisions.</li><li>Ensure robust systems security, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across all technology platforms.</li></ul><p><strong>Qualifications + Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>Proven experience in senior technology or data leadership roles (Director/VP level) with quantifiable success delivering impactful results for engineering, product, analytics, and innovation initiatives, ideally in healthcare services.</li><li>Deep technical expertise across software engineering, systems architecture, analytics, and data science.</li><li>Previous success building and leading data science and analytics teams, including AI/ML, predictive modeling, and business intelligence.</li><li>Demonstrated experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing AI technologies within complex organizations, including hands-on familiarity with AI tooling, frameworks, automation platforms, and enterprise AI solutions .</li><li>Experience leading cross-functional teams through innovation, digital transformation, or AI-driven modernization initiatives.</li><li>Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, design thinking, innovation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making.</li><li>Experience in occupational health, safety, or value-based care is highly desirable.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Company</strong></p><p>We believe caring for others always comes first and all our work builds on one goal: doing the right thing for the people and businesses we serve. metadata.description: FutureSight is hiring an experienced and visionary Founding CEO for a B2B WealthTech advisor AI copilot. The new venture is revolutionizing how financial advisors process information to deliver proactive, personalized guidance at scale. Targeting small to mid-sized wealth management firms, our solution enables advisors to deliver better client experiences, boost retention, and accelerate AUM.<br><br>Wealth management is approaching a critical inflection point with $70T intergenerational wealth transfer underway and a projected shortage of 100,000+ advisors by 2034. Today's advisors are overwhelmed by fragmented tools, nonstop headlines, and the pressure to deliver high-touch service across hundreds of clients. Weli acts as a second brain for advisors — surfacing insights, anticipating client needs, and streamlining engagement.<br><br>Work has already begun in the studio. The idea has been validated through customer interviews, and pilot conversations are in motion.<br><br>As Founding CEO, you will:<br><br><ul><li>Lead the roadmap — Own customer discovery, refine the wedge, and translate insights into a focused GTM plan</li><li>Build the product — Work with FutureSight's product/engineering pod to launch V1 </li><li>Win customers — Run pilots, shape pricing, and validate retention + expansion</li><li>Raise capital — Lead the seed raise with our support, backed by real traction</li><li>Build your team — Hire your founding team and set the cultural foundation <br><br></li></ul><strong>About FutureSight<br><br></strong>FutureSight is a leading venture studio that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.<br><br>You'll co-create with a proven studio team including:<br><br><ul><li>John Carbrey - 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR</li><li>Joshua Auslander - Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits</li><li>Kevin Nguyen - Product leader with 0 → 1 SaaS scale-up experience</li><li>Alan Smith - Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold</li><li>Prathna Ramesh - Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor <br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Bring <br><br></strong><ul><li>Validated problem &amp; early market pull — You will enter a venture with a proven market need, early adopter interest, and strong momentum toward building and scaling</li><li>Studio bench strength — Designers, engineers, growth marketers, and fundraising pros are embedded from Day 1</li><li>Capital commitment — Initial pre-seed funding for early hires and building the MVP with potential for follow-on funding, and access to our investor and advisor network<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Bring <br><br></strong><ul><li>Founder-level drive — You're motivated to co-found a new venture as the CEO. With or without us, this is your calling</li><li>Startup scrappiness — You know what you're signing up for. You're familiar with the scrappiness of owning something from start to finish</li><li>Previous founding experience — You have co-founded a product company or B2B SaaS venture or have been at a venture-backed company</li><li>Risk appetite and capacity — Read more on our post on the Entrepreneurial Risk Profile </li><li>GTM chops — Proven success in B2B SaaS sales, marketing, and customer engagement</li><li>Fundraising fluency — Able to craft investor narratives and close capital; well-networked in fintech and early-stage communities</li><li>People leadership — Magnet for top talent; coach and culture carrier</li><li>Bonus: Exposure to WealthTech, AI agents/LLMs, or highly regulated industries <br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Can Expect<br><br></strong>Daily active engagement with our team to launch initial product, achieve initial market traction, and prepare for seed fundraise.<br><br><strong>Ready to Build?<br><br></strong>If this is the perfect opportunity for you, we want to hear from you!<br><br>Submit your Resume and LinkedIn profile and tell us more about why you think we should chat!<br><br>FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

metadata.description: <strong>About Goodr<br><br></strong>We create and sell active eyewear for anyone. No Slip. No Bounce. All Polarized. All Fun. Interested in joining our team? Keep reading.<br><br><strong>OUR VALUES:</strong> We have two core values: Fun &amp; Authenticity.<br><br><ul><li>FUN = Being sh*tty isn’t fun. Agreed? Taking pride in your work, finding joy in being GREAT, and celebrating wins… and losses. Now, that’s fun!</li><li>AUTHENTICITY = Focusing on being authentic over being liked. (Next-level guru stuff. Count it.) <br><br></li></ul><strong>LEADERSHIP:</strong> We expect our leaders to be guiding lights for their teams. To support that, we provide leadership courses to sharpen their leadership abilities, including an in-house leadership coach.<br><br><strong>Fun Fact:</strong> We do not allow email to be sent internally. Carrier pigeons only. JK, we use Slack.<br><br><strong>AUTONOMY:</strong> We practice autonomy, empowerment, and accountability so that every team member can be in control of their own life.<br><br><ul><li>HYBRID WORKING: This role is required to be in our Inglewood office every Tuesday and Thursday with the occasional third day thrown in.</li><li>PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: We have an all-company learning program so that we’re constantly leveling up our skills.<br><br></li></ul><strong>SUSTAINABILITY:</strong> We think Earth’s pretty rad. That’s why we take action wherever possible to limit our impact on the planet.<br><br><ul><li>1% FOR THE PLANET MEMBER: 1% of goodr’s annual sales go directly to environmental organizations.</li><li>CARBON NEUTRAL: In 2019, goodr became a 100% carbon neutral company.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Fun Fact:</strong> goodr celebrates every Earth Day by releasing limited-edition sunglasses with frames made from 100% recycled materials—and the packaging is 100% sustainable, too!<br><br><strong>About The Role<br><br></strong>Do you look at a mess of legacy technical debt and see a beautiful puzzle instead of a reason to pull your hair out? We’re looking for a digital wizard to architect scalable, cloud-first platforms while ensuring our systems don’t pull a "blue screen of death" during a big launch. You’ll be the one holding the keys to the kingdom, negotiating vendor contracts like a shark and keeping our data more secure than a squirrel’s favorite nut stash.<br><br>If you can translate a "strategic roadmap" into plain English without making our eyes glaze over, you’re already halfway there. We need a leader who can kill off useless tech dependencies so we don’t accidentally end up using floppy disks in 2026. If you’re ready to lead our tech empire with high-level genius and a healthy dose of sarcasm, plug yourself in and apply!<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong>LEADERSHIP<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead by example by consistently living into goodr’s values of Fun and Authenticity </li><li>Be a culture carrier by leaning into our three fundamentals of communication, professionalism, and vision</li><li>Hold monthly one-on-ones with each team member to build upon their role duties and hold everyone accountable</li><li>Ask clear questions, increase everyone’s knowledge, and empower the team so that we can get the best out of every person in your department</li><li>Give consistent, continuous feedback and challenge your flock to perpetually grow so they become the best version of themselves</li><li>Own your team’s budget and ensure its accuracy</li><li>Use imagination and wisdom to set team goals and communicate them clearly</li><li>Challenge the status quo ALWAYS; the phrase “this is how we’ve always done it” is banned here at goodr, so don’t be afraid to push out of your comfort zone and encourage your team to do the same<br><br></li></ul><strong>ROLE SPECIFIC<br><br></strong><ul><li>Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and administration of the organization’s technology systems, platforms, and equipment</li><li>Define and execute the enterprise technology strategy and multi-year roadmap, ensuring alignment with company objectives and growth plans</li><li>Architect and evolve scalable, cloud-first platforms and infrastructure to support rapid growth and operational reliability</li><li>Oversee enterprise systems, platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure performance, availability, and resiliency</li><li>Own technology financials, including annual budgeting, vendor strategy, contract negotiation, and cost optimization</li><li>Establish and maintain standards for data security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management</li><li>Drive reduction of technical debt, improve system resilience, and decrease dependency on external vendors to strengthen platform stability and operational agility</li><li>Lead delivery of large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives with clear business outcomes and measurable impact</li><li>Partner with executive leadership and business stakeholders to prioritize technology investments and initiatives</li><li>Monitor emerging technologies and industry trends to inform strategic decisions and maintain competitive advantage</li><li>This role is in the Money Department and will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer</li><li>Perform other related duties as assigned<br><br></li></ul><strong>About The Ideal Candidate<br><br></strong><ul><li>May or may not have a degree…we don’t care (bonus points for Basset Hound Science or Dinosaur Law)</li><li>12+ years in technology leadership, with at least 5+ in senior leadership roles</li><li>Experience managing ERP, CRM, and enterprise platforms, including NetSuite, Salesforce, and Shopify</li><li>Skilled in systems integration and iPaaS platforms (e.g., Boomi) and cloud-based infrastructure</li><li>Strong track record in data governance, security, compliance, and fraud prevention</li><li>Proven ability to translate business strategy into scalable technology solutions</li><li>Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, and ROI-driven investments</li><li>Visionary excited to grow and scale the systems function</li><li>Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives</li><li>Excellent executive communication and stakeholder collaboration skills</li><li>Lives for systems!</li><li>Loves the work more than a paycheck</li><li>Is happy to give away credit to their team </li><li>Loves getting and giving feedback </li><li>Is into personal growth</li><li>Thinks Fun is doing great work (not just partying) </li><li>Is proactive and an independent problem solver! (Can you google a question?)<br><br></li></ul><strong>What You Get<br><br></strong><ul><li>A role at a company that is going to the moon</li><li>The opportunity to show up every day and have fun</li><li>The ability to learn and grow as a person</li><li>Paid vacation (we encourage you to take time off!)</li><li>Flexible work environment (want to go for a run at 11am on Wednesday, go for it!)</li><li>Paycheck... obviously. Salary range: $250k - $270k; final offer will be made within this range based on experience</li><li>Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits</li><li>401(K) with company matching</li><li>Financial Wellness Counseling</li><li>Sunglasses. Duh.</li><li>No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.<br><br></li></ul><strong>NEXT STEPS<br><br></strong>Here's what we expect the hiring process for this role to be, should all go well with your candidacy. This entire process is expected to take 10 weeks to complete and you'd be expected to start on a specific date.<br><br><ul><li> Application</li><li> Fill out a form with basic questions</li><li> 30 minute virtual interview with HR team member</li><li> 30 minute virtual interview with hiring manager</li><li> 25 minute virtual interviews with various leaders and peers</li><li> 45 minute in-person assignment and presentation with group panel</li><li> Final interview with hiring manager</li><li> Offer!<br><br></li></ul><strong>TO GET THE PROCESS STARTED, REVIEW &amp; SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING: <br><br></strong><ul><li>Review goodr's Applicant Privacy Policy. By submitting an application to goodr, you are confirming that you have read the Applicant Privacy Policy and agree to its terms. (Because nothing says “fun” like reading legal documents!)</li><li>Resume</li><li>Cover letter showing your personality. Seriously. No boring corporate speak allowed.</li><li>Links to projects or groups you’re involved with (if you have them)</li><li>A drawing of an octopus fighting a pirate (not joking)*</li><li>We may ask you to enter a code. But don't worry, it's just our attempt to keep the bots at bay.</li><li>We accept submissions using accessibility tools.<br><br></li></ul>

metadata.description: <strong>Job Description And Duties<br><br></strong>We are seeking a motivated person who values a positive and empowering work environment. As a Senior Legal Analyst in the Government Law Section, you will work under the direction of the Senior Assistant Attorney General in performing administrative, technical, and analytical work to support the Government Law Section's mission (which is to provide legal advice and representation to the State's constitutional officers and agencies on a wide range of issues). The Senior Legal Analyst ensures that a wide range of administrative processes and requirements for the Section are timely satisfied. Among other things, specific duties include: independently reviewing and analyzing legal documents; drafting legal memoranda recommending courses of action to attorney; organizing and managing case files, investigative and discovery documents; arranging for and receiving service of process; identifying and interviewing witnesses and drafting witnesses' declarations; and assisting attorneys in work on ballot initiatives and election matters. The position requires substantial organizational skills, effective time management, clear written and oral communication skills, and the ability to meet deadlines and timely respond to emails.<br><br>You will find additional information about the job in the <strong> Duty Statement </strong>.<br><br><strong>Position Details<br><br></strong><strong>Job Code #:<br><br></strong>JC-500730<br><br><strong>Position #(s):<br><br></strong>420-121-5333-901<br><br><strong>Working Title<br><br></strong><strong> PARALEGAL, GOVERNMENT LAW SECTION <br><br></strong><strong>Classification<br><br></strong>SENIOR LEGAL ANALYST<br><br>$6,330.00 - $7,929.00 A<br><br>New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.<br><br><strong>Shall Consider<br><br></strong>LEGAL ASSISTANT<br><br>$4,873.00 - $6,102.00 A<br><br>LEGAL ANALYST<br><br>$5,529.00 - $6,922.00 A<br><br><strong># of Positions:<br><br></strong>2<br><br><strong>Work Location:<br><br></strong>Los Angeles County<br><br><strong>Telework<br><br></strong>Hybrid<br><br><strong>Job Type<br><br></strong>Permanent, Full Time<br><br><strong>Work Shift<br><br></strong>8:00 AM to 5:00 PM<br><br><strong>Work Week<br><br></strong>Monday through Friday<br><br><strong>Department Information<br><br></strong><ul><li> This position is located in the Division of Civil Law, Government Law Section. </li><li> This position may be filled in either Sacramento (JC-500685), San Francisco (JC-500719), Los Angeles (JC-500730), and San Diego (JC-500745). Please clearly indicate your preferred city in the "Explanations" section of your State application. </li><li> Please disregard the SROA/Surplus language below, as the Department of Justice requires applicants to submit their SROA/Surplus letter, if that is the basis of their eligibility. </li><li> The Department of Justice may consider a Training &amp; Development (T&amp;D) assignment for this recruitment. For current state employees and/or those with reinstatement rights, your salary will be determined in accordance with the applicable laws, rules, and regulations. </li><li> For more information about the department, please visit the Attorney General's website at www.oag.ca.gov . <br><br></li></ul><strong>Personal Leave Program: Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary wage reductions in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) accruals. The specific rate and hours earned were negotiated and agreed upon by each bargaining unit. The actual monetary impact of these temporary reductions can vary based on your bargaining unit and/or federal and state tax withholding. For additional information, please visit </strong> <strong> Human Resources Manual - CalHR <br><br></strong><strong>Benefits of working for the State of California:<br></strong> <ul>   <li>Work-life balance</li>   <li>11 paid holidays</li>   <li>Flexible paid leave options</li>   <li>Consistent wage increases</li>   <li>Pension retirement</li>   <li>Job stability</li>   <li>Health/Dental/Vision Insurance</li>   <li>Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) and more!</li></ul>

metadata.description: <p>Clean Creatives is hiring <strong>three research assistants</strong> to conduct open source research between April 1 and June 15, 2026 for the 2026 edition of our annual report, The F-List.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>We are hiring one researcher in each of these 3 regions: (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe and (3) MENAT and brand studios. </strong>These are fully remote positions.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Details</strong></p><p>Clean Creatives is seeking researchers to contribute to the 2026 edition of our premier research report, the F-List. This report documents relationships between fossil fuel companies and advertising and PR firms worldwide, with the goals of providing transparency for communications professionals and brands and better understanding the communications strategies of major polluters.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>In its sixth year, the 2026 F-List will seek to present the most current picture of these relationships possible, with an added goal of filling in specific geographic gaps in our past research.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Past editions of this report have attracted wide coverage in communication industry press, extensive online conversation, and significantly impacted agencies’ practices. We are interested in uncovering data that helps make news and shapes the advertising and PR industry’s business goals.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><p>We are seeking either an individual researcher, or a team, to identify which agencies are responsible for promoting fossil fuel companies and lobbying groups in (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe, and (3) MENAT and brand studios.</p><p><br></p><p>The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized and intuitive, and have previous experience analyzing data or conducting research. We would like to work with researchers who are curious and self-motivated and who can consistently dedicate at least 15-20 hours of time every week during the 8-10 week research period. If you are the type of person who likes to search through databases and go through pages of Google search results, this is for you!</p><p><br></p><p>This researcher or team will analyze public sources to find proof of advertising and PR agencies working on fossil fuel campaigns. These sources include:</p><ul><li>Agency websites</li><li>Creative portfolio sites</li><li>Government disclosures</li><li>Lobbying databases</li><li>Award show directories</li><li>News coverage</li><li>LinkedIn and Meta ad libraries</li><li>Social media posts</li></ul><p><br></p><p>We will train researchers on how to find and record contracts and provide a list of countries and companies to guide their research. The researcher(s) should be comfortable working with multi-lingual sources, or in translation, to accurately and comprehensively identify key data in relevant languages.</p><p><br></p><p>We are especially interested in candidates who have experience researching the region and candidates who are familiar with company names and structures in the oil and gas industry and/or the advertising and PR industry. However, this experience is not required.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p><p>This is a paid contract position which will start on April 1, 2026 and end on June 15, 2026. Compensation will be $5000 for all deliverables.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply</strong></p><p>Applicants from any country are welcome to apply. <strong>To apply, send resumes and 2-3 research work samples to Clean Creatives Head of Research Nayantara Dutta (nayantara@fossilfree.media)</strong> with one of the following subject lines:</p><ul><li>“F-List Research Assistant - North America and LATAM”</li><li>"F-List Research Assistant - UK and Europe”</li><li>“F-List Research Assistant - MENAT and brand studios”</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Applicants are encouraged to apply by Feb 21.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><em>Further details in this Google Doc: </em>https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qr8bpE9Ofs7SEBVTDeK0IHOhJ88AX3r3yxstn9qh-Xo/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.8a9ub4h8xyvv</p>

He has a well-established family life and values stability, discretion, and long-term commitment.</p><p><br></p><p>This role will suit someone with a <strong>broad, lived frame of reference</strong> - well-read, well-travelled, culturally fluent - who is <strong>energised by working with an entrepreneurial principal and a lifestyle rooted in the ocean (sailing / surfing). </strong>A natural fit will be someone comfortable outside corporate structures, with curiosity, adaptability, and an independent cast of mind.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The principal is approachable, open to dialogue and ideas. He will not micro-manage. </strong></p><p><br></p><p>He is keen to establish a sustainable, well-balanced working relationship built on trust, planning, and mutual respect. This is a <strong>senior partnership position</strong> for someone who has already operated at the highest level and understands what it means to quietly hold responsibility.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Role</strong></p><p>The successful candidate will act as a <strong>primary extension of the principal</strong>, with the authority and trust to manage complex personal, operational, and family-office matters independently.</p><p>This role has been created to <strong>add capacity and continuity</strong>, enabling the principal to focus on the life he is intentionally building — not simply to manage day-to-day demands.</p><p>The position is <strong>remote</strong>, but the candidate <strong>must be New York City–based</strong> and available for <strong>occasional domestic and international travel</strong>. matters.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Acting as a trusted proxy for the principal in complex or sensitive situations, including negotiations and high-stakes logistics</li><li>Providing judgment, stability, and calm across unstructured and high-pressure situations</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>The Ideal Profile</strong></p><p>This role is suited to candidates who are <strong>currently operating at a senior level as a Chief of Staff or Personal Assistant to a UHNW principal.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation / Benefits PTO</li><li>Long-term opportunity for the right individual</li></ul><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Working Environment</strong></p><p>This is a close working relationship with an exceptionally metadata.description: <strong>About Us</strong><p>Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.</p> Recruiter (New York, NY)<strong>Build the teams behind the biggest content and businesses on YouTube</strong><p>Beast is scaling fast and the people we hire are as important as the ideas we put into the world. We’re looking for a Recruiter to help build the teams powering our content, brands, and operations across the Beast ecosystem.</p><p>This role is for someone who understands that great recruiting is equal parts judgment, creativity, and execution. enjoys ambiguity, moves with urgency, and is energized by building teams in environments that don’t look like traditional companies.</p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong><strong>Own Hiring From Idea to Offer</strong><ul><li>Lead full-cycle recruiting across content, production, operations, and corporate roles.</li><li>Partner with hiring managers to define what success actually looks like in a role and not just what’s written on paper.</li><li>Run fast, focused processes that balance urgency with a high bar for talent.</li><li>Close candidates by clearly articulating impact, ownership, and growth, not buzzwords.</li></ul><p><strong>Find Talent in Unconventional Places</strong></p><ul><li>Proactively source candidates from creative, operational, and non-traditional backgrounds.</li><li>Build pipelines for roles that blend creativity, execution, and leadership.</li><li>Stay deeply connected to creator, media, and internet culture to spot emerging talent confident, timely hiring decisions in a fast-changing environment.</li><li>Balance speed, quality, and culture fit as roles and priorities evolve.</li></ul><p><strong>Build Recruiting for Scale</strong></p><ul><li>Improve recruiting processes, interview structures, and tools as the company grows.</li><li>Introduce clarity and consistency without slowing teams down.</li><li>Use data, pattern recognition, and judgment to continuously raise the hiring bar.</li></ul><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong><ul><li>4-6 years of full cycle recruiting experience, ideally in the media, entertainment, tech or high-growth startups.</li><li>A strong track record of hiring high performers in fast-moving, creative environments.</li><li>Exceptional sourcing skills and a willingness to go off-script to find the right people.</li><li>Comfort working with ambiguity, evolving roles, and leaders who think big and move fast.</li><li>Strong instincts for talent, culture, and potential, not just resumes.</li><li>Clear communicator, strong closer, and someone who takes real pride in the teams they help build.</li><li>Deep interest in creators, content, internet culture, and building things people actually care about.</li></ul><p><strong>The total compensation range (base + annual bonus) for this role is between $130,000 and $160,000 </strong><strong>+ Equity</strong></p> metadata.description: <p><strong>WHO ARE WE?</strong></p><p>We are the VMS Co-Op, a group of fast growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. The VMS Co-Op includes OLLY, SmartyPants and future acquisitions to come! This position's home company is OLLY.</p><p><strong>THE ROLE: Financial Analyst, Financial Planning &amp; Analysis (FP&amp;A) – VMS (Overheads, P&amp;L &amp; Cash)</strong></p><p>This is a high impact finance role consolidates and governs an $800M+ retail sales P&amp;L across Olly & Smarty Pants. You will serve as the trusted right hand to the VMS Senior FP&A Manager, to own key parts of the monthly landing, forecast cadence, and close orchestration; harmonizing reporting across both OpCos; and leading the overheads performance agenda while supporting full P&amp;L and cash analytics. You “own the story” for the lines you cover and help the team move from data → insight → decision quickly.</p><p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p><p>This Financial Analyst supports end to end FP&amp;A across the P&amp;L (Revenue → GM → UOP → Cash) for both operating companies, with a dedicated focus on Overheads. You’ll partner with budget owners, translate analysis into clear narratives, and drive actions that land targets</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><p><strong>Monthly Landing &amp; Forecast Cadence</strong></p><ul><li>Run preclose risk/opportunity (R&amp;O) and bridge analyses across key lines (Revenue, GM, BMI, Overheads, UOP) and Cash.</li><li>Deliver accurate rolling forecasts with drivers, sensitivities, and clear actions to close gaps.</li><li>Craft concise executive narratives: what moved, why it moved, and what we’ll do next. </li></ul><p><strong>Month End Reporting &amp; Close Orchestration</strong></p><ul><li>Colead elements of month end close with Accounting (cutoff, accruals, late post governance—especially for Overheads).</li><li>Produce timely, accurate close packs for both OpCos and reconcile to the consolidated VMS view.</li><li>Maintain auditable workings; ensure compliance with policy, Table of Authority, and controls. </li></ul><p><strong>Harmonized Reporting &amp; Forums (Across Both OpCos)</strong></p><ul><li>Standardize the KPI dictionary, deck templates, and forum cadence so OLLY and SmartyPants share the same look/feel/process for weekly performance, MBRs/QBRs, AOP, and 3YP.</li><li>Maintain a single source of truth for models, queries, mapping, and master data logic; drive automation (Power BI/Tableau). </li></ul><p><strong>Overheads Ownership (Primary Focus)</strong></p><ul><li>Own overheads planning, forecasting, bridges (rate/volume/one-offs), and spend governance with budget owners and HR.</li><li>Build visibility (dashboards + executive summaries), track actions, and land inyear targets. </li></ul><p><strong>P&amp;L Performance Management (Beyond Overheads)</strong></p><ul><li>Build driver based models and variance analysis across Revenue, GM, BMI, Overheads, and UOP; translate insights into decisions.</li><li>Partner cross functionally (Sales, Marketing/Innovation, Supply Chain, HR) to quantify tradeoffs and prioritize interventions. </li></ul><p><strong>Cash &amp; Working Capital</strong></p><ul><li>Support cash forecasting and WC analytics (DSO/DIO/DPO, CCC/CTN); connect movements to operating drivers.</li><li>Maintain action logs that improve cash conversion; reconcile cash outcomes to P&amp;L and balance sheet drivers. </li></ul><p><strong>SUCCESS METRICS</strong></p><ul><li>Forecast accuracy within ±1–2% on priority P&amp;L lines; cash forecast variance trending down quarter over quarter.</li><li>Overheads on track with transparent bridges, mitigations, and a living actions log that lands in year targets.</li><li>Harmonized reporting live across both OpCos; crisp monthly exec pack delivered on time, every time.</li><li>Cycle time reduction from data → insight → decision via automation and clean master data.</li><li>Executive storytelling: that drives decisions (not just information sharing). </li></ul><p><strong>CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED</strong></p><ul><li>Experience: 1-3 years in FP&amp;AR/Commercial Finance (CPG/retail preferred); multi-entity exposure a plus.</li><li>Technical: Advanced Excel; Power BI/Tableau (Anaplan/D365 a plus). Strong modeling and driver based forecasting.</li><li>Communication: Excellent verbal/written skills; storytelling that simplifies complexity for senior stakeholders.</li><li>Ways of Working: Bias for action, detail oriented, resilient, collaborative; thrives in fast paced, ambiguous environments.</li><li>Control Mindset: Comfortable with accruals, cutoff, policy/TOA compliance, and audit ready documentation. </li></ul><p><strong>What To Expect During The Interview Process </strong></p><ul><li>Initial video screen with a member of our Talent team</li><li>Round 1: Conversation with the Hiring Manager + 1-2 conversations with other cross-functional team members</li><li>Round 2: 2-3 conversations with team or cross functional Ollies</li><li>Final Round: Homework*</li><li>Our final round is called Homework. Candidates who participate in this round are given 3 questions in advance to answer and present to the interview panel they previously spoke with in the process. We understand every candidate is different. If you need a reasonable accommodation to adjust this procedure, please let us know as soon as possible so that we can evaluate and provide other options that work for your needs</li></ul><p><strong>THE DETAILS</strong></p><ul><li>LOCATION: Los Angeles, CA</li><li>HOURS: Full-time, exempt (salaried)</li><li>TRAVEL: Up to ~10% for key forums and planning cycles</li><li>MANAGER: Senior Director, Head of Commercial &amp; Strategy, VMS</li><li>PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.</li><li>The base pay for this role is $71,000 - $83,000 based on experience.</li></ul><p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER:</strong> </p><ul><li>An opportunity to work with an intelligent, inspiring, and extraordinarily fun team</li><li>We pay 100% of the premiums for employee-only medical, dental + orthodontics, and vision insurance</li><li>4 weeks PTO + paid holidays + 12 Mental Health Days per year</li><li>100% Paid parental leave, Fertility + Adoption Benefits</li><li>Annual Bonus</li><li>401(k) plan with Employer Match</li><li>Hybrid Work + Wellness + Cell Phone Stipends</li><li>Free product</li><li>And much more!</li></ul>

metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>You may know us as FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, Justin Wine, Teleflora and Halos Citrus, but we’re all Wonderful – and we have a great opportunity for a Benefits Analyst. We’re looking to make the world a healthier place through an uncompromising commitment to the well-being of our employees and their families. We foster a collaborative workforce that encourages an entrepreneurial spirit and openness to change.<br><br>The Wonderful Total Rewards’ Benefits Team is looking for an experienced Benefits professional to join our team. This role oversees and manages employee benefits programs of some of the smaller companies within the Wonderful ecosystem as well as providing administrative support to the broader Global Benefits Team.<br><br>The role will facilitate enrollment and processing of various employee benefits, manage vendors, run regular audits and reporting for these plans, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and communicate benefits information to employees.<br><br>Attention to detail, knowledge of benefits regulations, and effective communication skills are essential for success in this role. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a structured environment, enjoys solving people-related puzzles, and believes in the power of thoughtful, responsive service. You'll work closely with both internal teams and external vendors, helping to ensure our benefits processes are efficient, compliant, and centered on the employee experience.<br><br>This position will be based at our West Los Angeles, CA office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday-Wednesday and the option to work remotely on Thursday and Friday.<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong><ul><li>Manage small group/company employee benefits programs including Medical, Dental, Vision, Wellness Programs, and supplemental health plans (enrollments, changes, terminations, COBRA). </li><li>Provide ongoing support for vendor management, including participating in regular status calls and strategic reviews, proactively driving root causes, proactively identifying areas for process improvement and assisting with implementation of new initiatives</li><li>Develop and maintain process documentation (including SOPs, policies, templates and communications) for benefit programs and provide recommendations for process improvement, where appropriate</li><li>Manage the day-to-day benefits operations and programs, including administration of current employee benefits, managing projects and implementations of new benefits and well-being vendors and programs for these small groups</li><li>Enter and update benefits data in HRIS and collaborate with payroll to ensure accuracy. </li><li>Present benefits information during new hire orientation and respond to employee questions related to eligibility, policies, and procedures. </li><li>Ensure compliance with state and federal regulations and communicate updates and policy changes effectively. </li><li>Assist with the open enrollment processes beyond the small group plans</li><li>Assist with ad hoc support, as needed (e.g. vendor implementation)</li><li>Reconcile benefit invoices and process payments across a variety of benefit vendors and plans. </li><li>Audit and validate day-to-day management of the Benefits Administration system against payroll and other systems across a broad set of programs based on set processes</li><li>Execute regular compliance reporting across all plans (e.g. ACA tracking and reporting, state filings, NQTL audits, etc.)<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>3-6 years of experience in benefits administration or benefits specialization within human resources</li><li>Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field </li><li>Working knowledge of federal and state laws related to employee benefits and leaves</li><li>Comfortable juggling time sensitive-tasks and multiple projects</li><li>Experience with HRIS and benefits administration platforms</li><li>Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li><li>High level of discretion and respect for confidentiality</li><li>Capability to exercise sound judgment and work well under pressure to effectively manage priorities and meet timelines and deliverables</li><li>Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li><li>Problem solver</li><li>Process-oriented</li><li>Bilingual in Spanish is a plus<br><br></li></ul>Pay Range: $80,000 - $95,000 and may include a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills &amp; experience.<br><br><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><ul><li>Thriving Wellness Community: Access to top-notch medical coverage comprehensive vision and dental plans, and a 401k with match eligibility to secure your financial future and including:</li><ul><li>24/7 online physician consultations </li><li>virtual mental health resources </li><li>life coaching </li><li>engaging employee community groups </li><li>cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements </li><li>library of on-demand fitness videos </li></ul><li>Career Advancement Opportunities: Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units. </li><li>Focused Learning and Development: Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses. </li><li>Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward. </li><li>Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace. </li><li>Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. To learn more about our corporate social responsibility efforts, visit csr.wonderful.com. </li><li>Giving Back to the Community: Make a difference with Wonderful Giving, allowing you to allocate company-provided funds to up to three charities of your choice, and join Wonderful Neighbor to contribute to group service projects within our local communities. <br><br></li></ul>Headquartered in Los Angeles, The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company dedicated to harvesting health around the world through its iconic consumer brands. The company’s 10,000 employees worldwide are committed to bringing consumers everywhere the freshest, most wholesome pistachios, citrus and pomegranates; bottling the finest water and wines; and creating colorful bouquets that are sure to touch the heart. This commitment is reflected in the company’s market share: Wonderful Pistachios® is America’s No. 1 tree nut and America’s fastest-growing snack; Wonderful® Halos® is the No. 1 mandarin orange in America; POM Wonderful® is the No. 1 100% pomegranate brand in America; FIJI® Water is America’s No. 1 premium imported bottled water brand; JUSTIN® Wine has the No. 1 Cabernet Sauvignon in California; and Teleflora® is the world’s leading floral delivery service.<br><br>The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back at its core. The company has a long-standing commitment to corporate social responsibility, including more than $1 billion invested in environmental sustainability; $65 million in charitable giving, education initiatives, and innovative health and wellness programs each year; and $143 million toward the construction of two charter school campuses in California’s Central Valley. To view the current Corporate Social Responsibility report, visit www.wonderful.com/csr.<br><br>To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products and its core values, visit www.wonderful.com, or follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.<br><br>The Wonderful Company is an Equality Opportunity Employer that provides opportunities for advancement. We are committed to creating a diverse workforce that embodies a deep culture of acceptance, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected categories.<br><br>EEO is the law - click here for more information<br><br>

metadata.description: <strong>About The Job<br><br></strong>Hopper is looking for an <strong>Advertising Account Manager</strong> to serve as the quarterback for advertiser partnerships. This role is focused on campaign execution, performance optimization, upselling, and delivering compelling insights that drive long-term advertiser success.<br><br>Working closely with Advertising Account Executives, Product, and Analytics, you’ll ensure campaigns are launched flawlessly, perform strongly, and continuously evolve to meet advertiser goals. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys managing details, telling data-driven stories, and growing accounts through trust and results.<br><br><strong>What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like<br><br></strong><ul><li>Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact and build strong, trusted relationships with advertisers</li><li>Manage end-to-end campaign execution, including onboarding, setup, optimization, and reporting</li><li>Monitor performance and proactively recommend optimizations to improve outcomes</li><li>Deliver clear, compelling insights and post-campaign reporting tied to advertiser KPIs</li><li>Identify upsell and renewal opportunities based on performance, seasonality, and advertiser goals</li><li>Partner with Account Executives to support renewals, expansions, and strategic planning</li><li>Coordinate cross-functionally with Analytics, Product, and Ad Operations to ensure campaign success</li><li>Build strong, trusted relationships with advertisers<br><br></li></ul><strong>An Ideal Candidate Has<br><br></strong><ul><li>3-5+ years of experience in digital advertising, account management, client success, or media operations</li><li>Strong understanding of digital performance metrics and campaign optimization</li><li>Experience managing multiple advertiser accounts and priorities simultaneously</li><li>Comfortable working with data and turning insights into clear client recommendations</li><li>Strong communication, organization, and project management skills</li><li>Collaborative mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment<br><br></li></ul><strong>Bonus Points<br><br></strong><ul><li>Familiarity with commerce-driven media platforms</li><li>Experience working with agencies or supporting enterprise advertisers</li><li>Familiarity with CRM systems and campaign management tools<br><br></li></ul><strong>Perks and benefits of working with us:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.</li><li>Unlimited PTO.</li><li>Carrot Cash travel stipend.</li><li>Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.</li><li>Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.</li><li>Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.</li><li>Open communication with management and company leadership.</li><li>Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.</li><li>100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees.</li><li>Access to Disability &amp; Life insurance.</li><li>Health Reimbursement Account (HRA).</li><li>DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan.<br><br></li></ul><strong>More about Hopper<br><br></strong>At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.<br><br>The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.<br><br>While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.<br><br>Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.<br><br><strong>Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:<br><br></strong>Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.<br><br>Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.<br><br>Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.<br><br>Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.<br><br>Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.<br><br>Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.<br><br>Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.<br><br>Come take off with us!<br><br>Compensation Range: $180K - $220K<br><br>
