metadata.description: <strong>About Ketone-IQ<br><br></strong>At Ketone-IQ, we're revolutionizing the way the world thinks about energy. Our cutting-edge approach to fueling the body transcends conventional expectations, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. We're the trusted choice of elite endurance athletes, special operators, and high performers across diverse fields – from cyclists conquering the Tour de France to EMTs working double shifts on the front lines.<br><br>In 2019, our innovative ketone nutritional superfuel caught the attention of the US Department of Defense SOCOM, securing a $6MM contract to power their elite forces. But our ambitions don't stop there. We're on a mission to disrupt the entire energy market, bringing our high-performance fuel to everyone, from professional athletes to busy professionals and active individuals.<br><br>Ketone-IQ is High Performance Energy. We’re changing the way people fuel and rapidly expanding as we lead the ketone movement and we're looking for a passionate, driven individual to join us on this exciting journey.<br><br><strong>The Role<br><br></strong>We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Operations &amp; Commercialization to own the connective tissue between Product, Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, and external partners. This role is equal parts project leader, systems builder, and operator — ensuring that products move from concept to market smoothly, sustainably, and at scale.<br><br>This is a hands-on role for someone who loves complexity, thrives in cross-functional environments, and takes pride in building processes that make teams faster and better.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Own<br><br></strong><strong>Cross-Functional Product and Project Execution:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Own integrated product execution across all physical Product at Ketone-IQ — including consumables, packaging, retail merchandising, and branded materials — guiding project initiatives from concept through commercialization</li><li>Define and manage launch plans, dependencies, and decision gates to balance speed, cost (COGS), quality, and operational feasibility</li><li>Drive alignment across Product, Marketing, Sales, Creative, Quality, and Supply Chain, ensuring clarity of ownership and momentum across complex initiatives</li><li>Ensure downstream needs of GTM Teams (Sales, E-commerce, and Marketing — e.g., product pages, creative assets, sales materials, and operational readiness) are considered early and sequenced appropriately</li><li>Partner with stakeholders post-launch to monitor Product performance metrics and identify optimization opportunities, upgrades, cost-savings, and operational improvements<br><br></li></ul><strong>Systems, Process &amp; Operating Rhythm:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Design and maintain scalable systems for project tracking, documentation, and cross-functional visibility (e.g., Notion; PJM tools like Asana, Smartsheets, Instagantt, Google Suite)</li><li>Build clear, repeatable workflows for product development, specification management, packaging changes, and commercialization that enable teams to move faster without sacrificing rigor</li><li>Continuously identify friction points and operational gaps. Evolve processes to improve execution quality and decision-making as the business scales<br><br></li></ul><strong>Packaging and Physical Goods Commercialization:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead RFPs and supplier sourcing/evaluation for packaging, merchandising, merch, and other physical components, assessing options across cost, quality, scalability, sustainability, and risk</li><li>Partner closely with Quality, Creative, and Supply Chain to ensure new components and vendors are properly qualified, prototyped, press-checked (if printed), and produced to quality first time and at scale</li><li>Own primary product packaging holistically — including development, component changes, custom development, sustainability improvements, and vendor qualifications</li><li>Support onboarding of new partners and transitions between vendors to ensure continuity and quality<br><br></li></ul><strong>Strategic and Special Initiatives:<br><br></strong><ul><li>Jump into high-priority initiatives as needed — especially where structure, coordination, and execution are required to unblock progress</li><li>Act as a thought partner to the VP of Product on how to scale product execution, operating cadence, and cross-functional collaboration as the business grows</li><li>Help embed sustainability and broader stewardship impact considerations into decision-making, Product pipeline development and manufacturing, reporting, and KPI tracking<br><br></li></ul><strong>High Performer Traits<br><br></strong><ul><li>Thrive in complex, cross-functional environments</li><li>Systems thinker who naturally builds structure where there is ambiguity</li><li>Clear communicator across creative, technical, and operational teams</li><li>High-ownership mindset with a bias toward action</li><li>Comfortable navigating evolving priorities in a fast-growing business</li><li>Energized by building scalable processes that improve execution quality<br><br></li></ul><strong>Experience &amp; Background<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience in product operations, project management, commercialization, or adjacent roles within CPG, food &amp; beverage, wellness, or regulated consumer products</li><li>Proven experience leading cross-functional product and packaging initiatives from concept through launch</li><li>Demonstrated ability to manage external partners (co-manufacturers, packaging vendors, creative production partners)</li><li>Strong comfort owning packaging projects (even if not a packaging engineer) — including sourcing, vendor qualification, sustainability trade-offs, and cost considerations</li><li>Experience working in fast-growing, ambiguous environments where priorities evolve<br><br></li></ul><strong>What Makes You a Winner<br><br></strong><ul><li>You instinctively connect teams and remove friction before it slows execution</li><li>You see around corners by anticipating risks, bottlenecks, and trade-offs early</li><li>You treat commercialization as a strategic advantage, not just a handoff</li><li>You build systems that scale with the business</li><li>You take pride in delivering products to market that are operationally sound from day one<br><br></li></ul>Powered by JazzHR<br><br>EMkpEr10xR

metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>The Team<br><br>The Music Business Affairs (BA) team is an international group with members in offices around the world and is responsible for all of Netflix’s global music business affairs, legal affairs, and strategy, from the production and licensing of Netflix Originals through to the distribution of the Netflix service globally.<br><br>The Role<br><br>Our Music BA team is looking for a Coordinator who shares our passion for music and the entertainment industry to help support our expanding slate of Netflix content. Someone who seeks out and thrives in an environment where freedom and responsibility are a tenet, and passion, innovation and curiosity are mandates (Netflix culture). A stunning and selfless colleague for whom no task is too small or insurmountable.<br><br>This unique and exciting role sits on the studio side of the Music BA team and will play a key role in supporting music business and legal deal and rights workflows for the commissioning and licensing of music for Netflix series, documentaries, and films.<br><br>This role is based in our Los Angeles office and will report to the Senior Director, Music Business &amp; Legal Affairs.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong>The successful candidate will be detail-oriented and resourceful, supporting business-critical administrative and analytical workflows in connection with our music agreements and music rights. This important role requires exceptional critical thinking and excellent time management and prioritization. Key responsibilities include music talent contract review and analysis to extract material deal terms and ingest pertinent data into internal tracking systems. Deep comprehension of soundtrack deal terms is also essential, with the ability to review and analyze royalty terms and partner effectively with cross-functional teams. The successful candidate will coordinate credit review and QC across various platforms, including screen and soundtrack credit obligations, and you will also track and communicate updates on other workflows and deals. Success requires strong contract analysis along with high-level communication skills to maintain alignment with the global Music BA team and cross-functional partners.<br><br>This is an opportunity to be part of a public company with a great consumer brand and to help Netflix shape the future of entertainment.<br><br><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong>The ideal candidate will have: 5+ years of experience in series or film production business/legal affairs and/or in the commercial music industry (including in a music rights-related function at a record label or publisher), including experience in supporting operational workflows in the music and soundtrack deal making and release process - from the initial engagement of talent through completion of services and execution of formal documentation; and practical knowledge of the music and technology industries. In-house music experience in a TV or film production company, studio or record company is preferred. The successful candidate will also possess the following:<br><br><ul><li>Exceptional project management skills.</li><li>Unparalleled organizational skills and an unwavering attention to detail.</li><li>Tech-savvy, with a strong sense of how cloud-based document and database systems are used in a modern business environment and the operational knowledge and ability to use tech and tools to optimize workflows.</li><li>Strong analytical capabilities and excellent judgment, even when the rules are unclear and the issues are of first impression.</li><li>Clear, concise and effective communication skills.</li><li>Highly-collaborative and resilient, with the ability to be fluid and respond positively to change and new ideas.</li><li>Ability to work proactively, independently and reliably under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Resourcefulness and ability to pivot quickly, think practically and be solution-oriented.</li><li>Curiosity and eagerness to tackle additional projects as needed, including matters outside of your area of expertise.</li><li>An eagerness to give and receive constructive feedback.</li><li>Demonstrated curiosity about how different backgrounds and cultures affect us at work, and a commitment to acknowledge and work past implicit biases.<br><br></li></ul>Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of hourly pay; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in hourly pay versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The hourly range for this role is $43.27 - $76.92.<br><br>Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.<br><br>Netflix is a unique culture and environment. metadata.description: <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p><p>CTW Cayman (“CTW”) is a Nasdaq-listed global gaming platform company focused on delivering anime IP-based HTML5 games through its flagship platform, <strong>G123</strong>. Headquartered in Japan, CTW serves a growing international audience and partners with leading Japanese IP holders to bring high-quality browser-based gaming experiences to users worldwide.</p><p><br></p><p>Following our recent U.S. listing, CTW is in a critical growth and institutionalization phase. Reporting directly to the CFO, this role is responsible for the day-to-day preparation and execution of IR communications, materials, and investor interactions.</p><p><br></p><p>This is <strong>not a strategy-only or coordinator role</strong>. The successful candidate will personally own drafting, analysis, and execution while working closely with senior management and external IR/PR advisors during a transition period toward greater in-house ownership.</p><p><br></p><p>CTW plans to hire <strong>two Investor Relations Managers at the same level</strong> to support growing IR needs and to foster a performance-driven environment. High performers will have opportunities for expanded responsibilities and career progression as the function matures.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><p><strong>Investor Relations Execution</strong></p><ul><li>Prepare and update core IR materials, including:</li><li>Earnings press releases and scripts</li><li>Investor presentations and fact sheets</li><li>Q&amp;A documents and FAQs</li><li>Shareholder and analyst communication materials</li><li>Support quarterly and interim earnings processes, including internal coordination, drafting, review cycles, and external dissemination.</li><li>Manage day-to-day investor and analyst inquiries via email, calls, and meetings, ensuring responses are accurate, consistent, and compliant.</li></ul><p><strong>Investor Engagement &amp; Market Monitoring</strong></p><ul><li>Coordinate logistics and materials for earnings calls, investor meetings, non-deal roadshows, conferences, and site visits.</li><li>Track and analyze:</li><li>Shareholder base and ownership changes</li><li>Analyst coverage and feedback</li><li>Peer disclosures and market trends</li><li>Stock performance and trading activity</li><li>Prepare regular IR feedback summaries and insights for senior management.</li></ul><p><strong>Disclosure, Compliance &amp; Strategic Support</strong></p><ul><li>Support capital markets activities as needed (e.g., follow-on offerings, ATM programs).</li><li>Assist with proxy-related inquiries, investor governance questions, and ESG-related communications.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications &amp; Requirements</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Communications, or a related field.</li><li><strong>3–8 years of relevant experience</strong> in investor relations, equity research (sell-side or buy-side), corporate finance, financial reporting, or IR advisory.</li><li>Demonstrated <strong>hands-on experience</strong> preparing earnings materials, investor presentations, and disclosure-related documents.</li><li>Strong understanding of U.S. securities regulations, public company disclosure practices, and Regulation FD.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills in <strong>English</strong> (Japanese language skills are a strong plus).</li><li>High proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; experience with IR tools (e.g., Bloomberg, Q4, FactSet) is a plus.</li><li>Detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced public company environment.</li><li>Self-starter with strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Preferred Experience</strong></p><ul><li>Experience at a <strong>newly listed, microcap, or small-cap public company</strong>.</li><li>Prior exposure to gaming, technology, internet, or media sectors.</li><li>Experience transitioning IR responsibilities from external advisors to in-house teams.</li><li>Comfortable operating in a performance-oriented environment with high visibility and accountability.</li></ul><p></p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>About Softbank</strong></p><p>The SoftBank Group invests in breakthrough technology to improve the quality of life for people around the world. The SoftBank Group is comprised of SoftBank Group Corp. (TOKYO: 9984), an investment holding company that includes stakes in AI, smart robotics, IoT, telecommunications, internet services, and clean energy technology providers, as well as a majority stake in Arm, which is building the future of computing; and the SoftBank Vision Funds, which are investing to help transform industries and shape new ones. To learn more, please visit www.visionfund.com and https://group.softbank/en.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the role</strong></p><p>As a member of the global communications and marketing team at SoftBank Investment Advisers [manager of the SoftBank Vision Funds], you will play a pivotal role in shaping how SoftBank communicates its mission, brand, and impact. You’ll help educate and engage entrepreneurs, reporters, opinion leaders, policymakers, and our employees around the world on how SoftBank accelerates the advancement of technology for the benefit of humanity.</p><p><br></p><p>You will also partner closely with the SoftBank Group ecosystem and SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio companies, helping them manage their reputations and share their stories with the world.</p><p><br></p><p>This role reports to the Global Head of Communications and Marketing for SoftBank Investment Advisers. The successful candidate will bring experience in corporate communications and brand marketing within the technology and/or financial services sectors, complemented by political, governmental, or campaign experience that demonstrates an ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments. They will have a strong understanding of policy and its intersection with communications and stakeholder messaging, a passion for technology, and a constant desire to learn in a fast-paced, global environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p><ul><li>Develop and execute integrated communications, brand marketing, and policy engagement initiatives across global markets to advance SoftBank’s reputation and mission.</li><li>Protect and enhance SoftBank’s reputation across audiences, anticipating and addressing issues that may impact the business or its portfolio.</li><li>Serve as a company spokesperson where appropriate and manage high-profile media interactions.</li><li>Build and maintain deep relationships with reporters, opinion leaders, and policymakers.</li><li>Prepare and advise executives for media engagements, speaking opportunities, and public appearances.</li><li>Manage communications for portfolio company funding announcements, M&amp;A activity, and Vision Fund components of quarterly earnings.</li><li>Oversee global social media strategy and content development in coordination with the SoftBank Group social media team.</li><li>Lead global internal communications to align employees with strategic objectives and foster a connected, high-performance culture.</li><li>Oversee agency relationships, vendor management, budgeting, and communications metrics.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Preferred qualifications </strong></p><ul><li>Experience (8+ years) in corporate communications, brand marketing, and public affairs, including political, government, and campaign experience that demonstrates fluency in stakeholder engagement and message strategy.</li><li>Proven track record developing and executing global communications strategies in fast-paced, high-growth, or complex organizations.</li><li>Experience working in both agency and in-house environments is advantageous.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to collaborate across geographies and cultures with a global mindset.</li><li>Exceptional strategic thinking, writing, and storytelling skills — with the ability to simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.</li><li>Comfortable working under pressure with competing demands, while maintaining precision and judgment.</li><li>A low-ego, high-impact leader who embodies SoftBank’s cultural values of teamwork, integrity, entrepreneurship, and impact.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant international experience a plus.</li><li>Willingness to travel internationally as needed.</li></ul><p></p>

metadata.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company committed to providing high-quality, healthy brands and helping improve the lives of the people who live and work in the places where we operate. Ranked No. 1 on the 2025 PEOPLE® Companies That Care list and one of Fortune® magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” in the U.S., The Wonderful Company is continually recognized for its dedication to the well-being of its workforce, their communities, and the planet.<br><br>We are looking for a <strong>Manager, Strategic Insights</strong> to join our Wonderful Insights team, which functions as an in-house, full-service research agency with deep understanding and connection to the businesses it supports, enabling high-value recommendations. The team leverages primary and secondary data to inform major strategic decisions across the businesses and at an enterprise level.<br><br>Together with the Director, Strategic Insights, this role supports two senior executives on projects that drive enterprise growth and ultimately report to the owners, leading initiatives from early, ambiguous stages through completion while partnering closely with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of strategy and insights. The successful candidate will leverage data and insights to help shape enterprise-level priorities, bringing strong business acumen and attention to detail without losing the broader strategic picture.<br><br>This is a great opportunity for a strategic leader who thrives in ambiguity and wants to shape enterprise-level decisions, build new capabilities from the ground up, and gain exposure to senior leadership while driving measurable business growth.<br><br><strong>This position will be based at our West Los Angeles, CA office.</strong> We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday-Wednesday and the option to work remotely on Thursday and Friday.<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong><ul><li>Support key high priority initiatives designed to drive growth for each individual business unit as well as overall enterprise-level growth for two senior executives designated to report to owners. </li><li>Support the development of quarterly business reviews for each of the brands to provide a holistic picture of performance, including financials, sales, and marketing. These serve as a comprehensive overview for the owners. </li><li>Lead key commercial growth, operational, technological, and organizational improvements, including guiding the process of building new teams and processes from the ground up (e.g., innovation, AI/innovative tech, RGM, among others). </li><li>Act as front-line contact for BU presidents and executives on behalf of those two executives. </li><li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams and act as a centralized point of contact to share information, analyze results, and build reports. </li><li>Develop concise and actionable reports highlighting only the critical information needed to guide strategic decisions. </li><li>Create secondary research reports by summarizing readily available data sources to deepen clients’ market knowledge (e.g., innovation category deep-dives, competitive brand and product analyses). </li><li>Lead effective presentations and brainstorms with senior level audiences across the organization. </li><li>Mentor junior team members across projects through ongoing training and development. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in strategy, consulting, operations, technology, finance, or related fields; MBA preferred. Food &amp; beverage or consumer packaged goods (CPG) experience preferred. </li><li>Strong quantitative and Excel data analysis skills: Comfortable with quantitative data analysis and manipulating large data sets from a range of sources (e.g., finance) in Excel; ability to think critically and identify themes from large data sets and communicate key findings clearly. </li><li>Strong business and financial acumen: Excellent business acumen combined with strategic thinking; ability to read and interpret a P&amp;L, understand various business metrics (EBITDA, profit margin) and glean meaningful business insights. </li><li>Proven ability to drive commercial growth through RGM: Ability to identify business growth opportunities and support RGM initiatives. </li><li>M&amp;A evaluation experience (preferred): Experience with M&amp;A evaluations as a plus. </li><li>Excellent problem-solving, project execution, and stakeholder management: Superior analytical problem-solving skills in ambiguous or undefined situations; takes initiative to identify solutions; able to manage multiple projects, prioritize work, and partner with internal and external stakeholders by establishing clear timelines and communications to deliver high-quality results on short timeframes. </li><li>Executive-level communication and presentation skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to put together and present thoughtful and interactive presentations; ability to build reports from scratch in PowerPoint; demonstrated executive presence. </li><li>Willingness and ability to travel as required. <br><br></li></ul><strong>Pay Range:</strong> $140,000 - $150,000 and may include a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills &amp; experience.<br><br><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong><ul><li>Thriving Wellness Community: Access to top-notch medical coverage comprehensive vision and dental plans, and a 401k with match eligibility to secure your financial future and including:</li><ul><li>24/7 online physician consultations </li><li>virtual mental health resources </li><li>life coaching </li><li>engaging employee community groups </li><li>cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements </li><li>library of on-demand fitness videos </li></ul><li>Career Advancement Opportunities: Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units. </li><li>Focused Learning and Development: Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses. </li><li>Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward. </li><li>Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace. </li><li>Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. To learn more about our corporate social responsibility efforts, visit csr.wonderful.com. </li><li>Giving Back to the Community: Make a difference with Wonderful Giving, allowing you to allocate company-provided funds to up to three charities of your choice, and join Wonderful Neighbor to contribute to group service projects within our local communities. <br><br></li></ul>Headquartered in Los Angeles, The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company dedicated to harvesting health around the world through its iconic consumer brands. The company’s 10,000 employees worldwide are committed to bringing consumers everywhere the freshest, most wholesome pistachios, citrus and pomegranates; bottling the finest water and wines; and creating colorful bouquets that are sure to touch the heart. This commitment is reflected in the company’s market share: Wonderful Pistachios® is America’s No. 1 tree nut and America’s fastest-growing snack; Wonderful® Halos® is the No. 1 mandarin orange in America; POM Wonderful® is the No. 1 100% pomegranate brand in America; FIJI® Water is America’s No. 1 premium imported bottled water brand; JUSTIN® Wine has the No. 1 Cabernet Sauvignon in California; and Teleflora® is the world’s leading floral delivery service.<br><br>The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back at its core. The company has a long-standing commitment to corporate social responsibility, including more than $1 billion invested in environmental sustainability; $65 million in charitable giving, education initiatives, and innovative health and wellness programs each year; and $143 million toward the construction of two charter school campuses in California’s Central Valley. To view the current Corporate Social Responsibility report, visit www.wonderful.com/csr.<br><br>To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products and its core values, visit www.wonderful.com, or follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.<br><br>The Wonderful Company is an Equality Opportunity Employer that provides opportunities for advancement. We are committed to creating a diverse workforce that embodies a deep culture of acceptance, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected categories.<br><br>EEO is the law - click here for more information<br><br>

This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. growth.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort Experience<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field</li><li>Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window BENEFITS: <br><br></strong>Business Analyst/Level I: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00/per year<br><br>Business Analyst/Level II: $90,000.00 - $115,000.00/per year<br><br>Your actual level and base salary will metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>The Team<br><br>The Music Business Affairs (BA) team is an international group with members in offices around the world and is responsible for all of Netflix’s global music business affairs, legal affairs, and strategy, from the production and licensing of Netflix Originals through to the distribution of the Netflix service globally.<br><br>The Role<br><br>Our Music BA team is looking for a Coordinator who shares our passion for music and the entertainment industry to help support our expanding slate of Netflix content. Someone who seeks out and thrives in an environment where freedom and responsibility are a tenet, and passion, innovation and curiosity are mandates (Netflix culture). A stunning and selfless colleague for whom no task is too small or insurmountable.<br><br>This unique and exciting role sits on the studio side of the Music BA team and will play a key role in supporting music business and legal deal and rights workflows for the commissioning and licensing of music for Netflix series, documentaries, and films.<br><br>This role is based in our Los Angeles office and will report to the Senior Director, Music Business &amp; Legal Affairs.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong>The successful candidate will be detail-oriented and resourceful, supporting business-critical administrative and analytical workflows in connection with our music agreements and music rights. This important role requires exceptional critical thinking and excellent time management and prioritization. Key responsibilities include music talent contract review and analysis to extract material deal terms and ingest pertinent data into internal tracking systems. Deep comprehension of soundtrack deal terms is also essential, with the ability to review and analyze royalty terms and partner effectively with cross-functional teams. The successful candidate will coordinate credit review and QC across various platforms, including screen and soundtrack credit obligations, and you will also track and communicate updates on other workflows and deals. Success requires strong contract analysis along with high-level communication skills to maintain alignment with the global Music BA team and cross-functional partners.<br><br>This is an opportunity to be part of a public company with a great consumer brand and to help Netflix shape the future of entertainment.<br><br><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong>The ideal candidate will have: 5+ years of experience in series or film production business/legal affairs and/or in the commercial music industry (including in a music rights-related function at a record label or publisher), including experience in supporting operational workflows in the music and soundtrack deal making and release process - from the initial engagement of talent through completion of services and execution of formal documentation; and practical knowledge of the music and technology industries. In-house music experience in a TV or film production company, studio or record company is preferred. metadata.description: <p>AI Engineer (GenAI Workflows for OTC Derivatives)</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Location:</strong> New York City (SoHo) — In-Person</p><p><br></p><p>About Our Client</p><p>Our client is building the next-generation platform for institutional finance. The OTC derivatives market moves <strong>trillions of dollars daily</strong> on infrastructure that hasn’t fundamentally changed in decades—and this team is rebuilding that foundation with a <strong>modern stack</strong>, a <strong>delightful product experience</strong>, and an <strong>AI-native architecture</strong>.</p><p><br></p><p>The founding team comes from trading, quantitative, and engineering roles at tier-one financial institutions and has built some of the most innovative products in the market. Their clients include sophisticated banks, hedge funds, and asset managers—meaning the problems are complex, the scale is massive, and the software will shape how this market operates for years to come.</p><p><br></p><p>Tech Stack</p><ul><li>Cloud-native, serverless-first architecture + Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)</li><li>Backend services in <strong>Python</strong> and <strong>Java</strong></li><li>Frontend in <strong>TypeScript / React</strong></li><li>Modern foundation models + AI tooling</li><li>Automated SDLC using tools like <strong>GitHub</strong>, <strong>Logfire</strong>, <strong>Vercel</strong>, and rapid intraday deployment practices</li></ul><p><br></p><p>The Role</p><p>Our client is hiring an <strong>AI Engineer</strong> to build and productionize generative AI workflows that increase efficiency across the OTC derivatives lifecycle. You’ll own key parts of the <strong>evaluation and context engineering</strong> infrastructure, ensuring model outputs are high-quality, reliable, and explainable.</p><p><br></p><p>You’ll work closely with financial engineers and domain experts to design <strong>retrieval, grounding, and validation</strong> pipelines for complex derivatives data. The work includes building tools for knowledge extraction from trade documents, improving data consistency across the trade lifecycle, and integrating AI reasoning into workflows like settlement, valuation, and risk management.</p><p><br></p><p>What You’ll Do</p><ul><li>Build GenAI workflows that automate and enhance OTC derivatives processes end-to-end</li><li>Own <strong>context engineering</strong> (retrieval, grounding, memory, and data shaping) to improve response quality and reliability</li><li>Build evaluation systems (offline + online) to measure accuracy, consistency, and explainability</li><li>Design structured output patterns (schemas, constrained generation, validation) for production-grade AI</li><li>Create pipelines to extract and normalize data from unstructured trade documents (confirmations, term sheets, etc.)</li><li>Integrate AI reasoning into downstream workflows (settlement, valuation, risk, cashflows, reconciliation)</li><li>Collaborate with domain experts to translate financial requirements into robust AI systems</li><li>Contribute to a high-velocity engineering culture with strong SDLC practices and rapid deployments</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Requirements</p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, or related field</li><li><strong>In-person</strong> role in NYC (SoHo)</li><li>Strong proficiency in <strong>Python</strong> (Java experience is a plus)</li><li>Proficiency in prompt engineering and <strong>structured output generation</strong> (JSON, Pydantic schemas, validation)</li><li>Experience with NoSQL databases (e.g., <strong>MongoDB</strong>, <strong>DynamoDB</strong>)</li><li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and deployment tools (CDK, Terraform) and cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)</li><li>Strong understanding of both traditional SDLC and AI SDLC (versioning, testing, rollout, monitoring)</li><li>Strong software design fundamentals</li><li>Excellent problem-solving and communication skills</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Bonus Qualifications</p><ul><li>Experience fine-tuning or deploying LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)</li><li>Familiarity with vector databases and <strong>RAG</strong> pipelines</li><li>Experience building AI agents or workflow orchestration for financial data tasks</li><li>Understanding of OTC derivatives data models and trade representations (e.g., ISDA concepts)</li><li>Experience integrating AI systems with pricing, settlements, risk, or cashflow infrastructure</li><li>Familiarity with LangChain, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks</li><li>Experience extracting data from unstructured financial documents (confirmations, term sheets, schedules)</li><li>Strong grasp of evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and data quality management in production AI systems</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Why This Role</p><p>This is a rare chance to build <strong>production-grade AI systems</strong> in a domain where correctness matters and the upside is massive. If you want to own foundational AI infrastructure, work alongside domain experts, and modernize a trillion-dollar market—this role is built for high-impact engineers.</p>

and onboarding</li></ol><p><br></p><p>If you are interested in contacting us, please apply, and our team will reach out to you within the hour.</p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone. </p><p><br></p><p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p><p><br></p><p>We’re looking for a Regional Recruiter to support our restaurant leadership. You should have a proven track record of interviewing and identifying leaders at all levels and teaching and coaching on recruiting best practices. As a Regional Recruiter, you’ll lead Restaurant Manager searches, and facilitate the internal interview process for regional leadership. In this position, you must be able to identify recruitment trends and challenges and implement solutions to solve business needs. Additionally, you must be able to interpret and apply an understanding of Chipotle policies and practices, employment law, and other regulations to serve as a recruiting expert in your region. A passion for fresh guac might also come in handy.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p><p>In addition to following Chipotle’s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:</p><ul><li>Creatively source, screen, and provide selection guidance for Restaurant Manager and field leadership positions</li><li>Facilitate the internal interview process for regional leadership positions</li><li>Develop regional recruitment strategies with senior field leadership by identify hiring trends through regular reporting while partnering with restaurant leadership to drive strategic priorities</li><li>Provide coaching to leaders and champion best practices in staffing, interviewing, and candidate experience</li><li>Be a brand and employee advocate who enables change and innovation to create best-in-class teams</li><li>Partner with HRBP, other support employees, and COEs to implement market-specific recruitment strategies to address current and future needs</li><li>Roll out and drive the execution of recruiting initiatives and processes in your region</li><li>Engage in critical activities to understand the business and enable talent succession planning effectively</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE</strong></p><ul><li>High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required, bachelor's degree from a 4-year college or university preferred</li><li>3+ years of experience in Recruiting or a related field, multi-unit restaurant or retail environment preferred</li><li>Proficient in MS Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook</li><li>Ability to build strong relationships and influence business leaders through effective communication</li><li>Results-driven approach; owns and executes short and long-term projects with sound judgment and decision-making skills</li><li>Expert problem-solving skills with an ability to work autonomously to identify gaps and apply creative solutions in ambiguous situations</li><li>Demonstrated ability to be a change agent, partnering with cross-functional and remote teams to support business leaders at all levels</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>PAY TRANSPARENCY</strong></p><p><br></p><p>A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $69,000.00–$93,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>WHO WE ARE </strong></p><p><br></p><p>Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) is cultivating a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. For more information or to place an order online, visit WWW.CHIPOTLE.COM</p><p><br></p><p><em>Chipotle Mexican Grill is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. </em></p><p><br></p><p><em>Qualified applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or certain state or local laws. Please contact <u>ADAaccommodations@chipotle.com </u>if you need an accommodation due to a disability to complete an application, job interview, and/or to otherwise participate in the hiring process. This email does not respond to non-accommodations related requests.</em></p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>The position advertised has been exempted from the federal civilian hiring freeze.</u></strong></p><p><br></p><p>Use your mathematics background to become an FBI special agent!</p><p><br></p><p>The transition from data to special agent is more than a career move—it’s an opportunity to upskill and become an expert in your field. At the FBI, you won’t just use your data analysis experience; you’ll also build on it by working on cases that challenge you to think critically, adapt quickly, and collaborate with elite professionals tackling national security threats. Your ability to uncover crucial information, problem-solve, and apply your technical knowledge will help protect our nation from cyberattacks, terrorism, fraud, and evolving threats.</p><p><br></p><p>With specialized training, real-world investigative experience, and access to cutting-edge technology, you’ll refine your predictive and statistical analysis skills, enhance your expertise, and develop the foundation to become a leader in your field. Apply today.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>HOW TO APPLY </strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 1</strong>: Click on the “Apply” button to be directed to the FBIJobs Careers website.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 2</strong>: Click the “Start” button to begin. You will be prompted to either sign in to continue or register with FBIJobs if you don’t already have an account.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>STEP 3</strong>: Follow the step-by-step process to submit your interest. You will be guided through each step. You must complete all sections of the form AND ALL REQUIRED DOCUMENTS MUST BE ATTACHED to successfully submit your interest.</p><p><br></p><ol><li>Your resume, specifically noting relevant work experience and associated start and end dates. Please note your resume MUST NOT exceed two (2) pages.</li><li>Other supporting documents:</li></ol><ul><li>College transcripts, if qualifying based on education or if there is a positive education requirement.</li><li>Veterans: DD 214; Disabled Veterans: DD 214, SF-15, and VA letter dated 1991 or later.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Please see instructions on the site for attaching documents.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>SALARY LEVEL</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Pay level for this position:</p><ul><li>$100,456.00–$129,609.00</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Salary is commensurate with base, locality, and availability pay.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>MAJOR DUTIES </strong></p><ul><li>Plan and conduct investigations of potential violations of federal laws, cybersecurity, and public safety.</li><li>Exercise judgment, resourcefulness, and versatility in meeting investigative demands.</li><li>Create and maintain effective liaison relationships with federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, and international law enforcement agencies.</li><li>Maintain a level of physical fitness to ensure the readiness required to perform law enforcement duties.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>KEY REQUIREMENTS </strong></p><ul><li>Must be a U.S. citizen.</li><li>Must be able to obtain a Top Secret Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) Clearance.</li><li>Must be willing to travel as required.</li><li>Must meet the FBI’s Employment Eligibility requirements.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>EDUCATION</strong></p><ul><li>Candidates must have a bachelor’s degree or higher (preferably in mathematics or a related field) from a U.S. accredited college or university.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>All degrees must be verified by submitting college transcripts.</strong></p><p><br></p><p>The FBI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for this vacancy. Unless explicitly authorized by law, selection will be made without regard to, and there will be no discrimination because of, color, race, religion, national origin, marital status, parental status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, age (40 or over), sex, pregnancy and related conditions, or on the basis of personal favoritism, or any other nonmerit factors.</p>

metadata.description: <p><span>PLCs.ai is an AI-powered platform transforming industrial automation by analyzing and generating PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) code across multiple vendors. We work with some of the world's top manufacturers as design partners across multiple sectors including CPG, automotive, and medical devices.</span></p><p><span>Our platform converts complex PLC code into natural language, removes bottlenecks where single PLC experts become gatekeepers, and enables engineers to query complicated projects through conversational interfaces.</span></p><p><strong>We've just closed our seed round</strong><span> and are building the foundational team that will scale this platform. This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor of a company solving a massive problem in a $50B+ industry.<br></span></p><strong>About the Role</strong><p><span>We're looking for a hands-on AI practitioner to lead the development and evolution of our AI capabilities. This is not a research role. We need someone who has shipped production AI systems and can build, deploy, and iterate rapidly. You'll start as an individual contributor with the mandate to build and lead the AI team as we scale.</span></p><p><span>You'll report directly to the CTO and work closely with the VP of R&amp;D and the Head of PLC Experts. In the rapidly evolving AI landscape where breakthroughs happen weekly, you'll be responsible for keeping us at the cutting edge, evaluating new models, frameworks, and techniques, and implementing what's relevant to our domain.</span></p><p><span>You'll own the entire AI stack: from data preparation and labeling to agent architecture, RAG pipelines, LLM selection for both cloud and local deployment, prompt engineering, and production systems.<br></span></p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><ul><li><span>Design, build, and maintain our multi-agent AI architecture, scaling capabilities across PLC vendors and industry verticals</span></li><li><span>Own the end-to-end RAG pipeline: embedding strategies, vector database optimization, context injection, and relevance scoring</span></li><li><span>Evaluate and select appropriate LLMs for different tasks, balancing performance, cost, latency, and deployment requirements (cloud and local)</span></li><li><span>Develop data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and structuring proprietary PLC code and manufacturing documentation</span></li><li><span>Design and implement data labeling, tagging, and annotation workflows for evaluation and quality assurance</span></li><li><span>Ensure production-grade reliability with fallback mechanisms, confidence scoring, and monitoring</span></li><li><span>Collaborate with PLC domain experts to translate industrial automation knowledge into AI capabilities</span></li><li><span>Build and lead the AI team as we scale, including hiring, mentoring, and establishing engineering excellence<br></span></li></ul><strong>Requirements</strong><ul><li><strong>Bachelor's degree</strong><span> in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field</span></li><li><strong>5+ years of hands-on experience</strong><span> building and deploying AI/ML systems in production</span></li><li><strong>Deep expertise with agents &amp; LLMs</strong><span>: LLMs evaluation, RAG architectures, and agent frameworks</span></li><li><strong>Strong software engineering skills</strong><span>: you write production-quality code. Proficiency in Python required</span></li><li><strong>Experience with vector databases</strong><span> and embedding models</span></li><li><strong>Track record of shipping</strong><span>: you've taken AI products from prototype to production</span></li><li><strong>Self-directed learner</strong><span> who stays current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape</span></li><li><strong>Startup mentality</strong><span>: comfortable with ambiguity, excited to build from the ground up</span></li><li><strong>Onsite work:</strong><span> Hoboken, NJ<br></span></li></ul><strong>Nice to Have</strong><ul><li><span>Experience with industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or domain-specific AI</span></li><li><span>Background in multi-agent systems, code generation, or structured data extraction</span></li><li><span>Prior experience at an early-stage startup</span></li><li><span>Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Machine Learning, NLP, or related field<br></span></li></ul><strong>What We Offer</strong><ul><li><strong>Competitive compensation</strong><span>: Base salary commensurate with experience plus meaningful equity</span></li><li><strong>Comprehensive benefits</strong><span>: Health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); flexible PTO</span></li><li><strong>Professional development</strong><span>: Budget for conferences, courses, and certifications</span></li><li><strong>Growth opportunity</strong><span>: Build and lead the AI function from the ground up with direct line to founding team</span></li></ul>

metadata.description: <p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong><u>The position advertised has been exempted from the federal civilian hiring freeze.</u></strong></p><p><br></p><p>Use your STEM background to become an FBI special agent!</p><p><br></p><p>The transition from engineering to special agent is more than a career move—it’s an opportunity to upskill and become an expert in your field. metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>Our Experiences team puts fans at the center of their favorite stories, in real life, through permanent entertainment venues, Netflix House, and touring attractions around the world. Netflix Houses are our permanent, always-on, constantly refreshable entertainment venues, where guests can step into their favorite stories. We want these experiences, along with merchandise offerings, to help promote love for our titles so they become part of the zeitgeist for longer periods of time and drive long-term value for Netflix.<br><br>The Experiences Design &amp; Delivery team is responsible for the site planning, creative development, construction, and delivery of our permanent experiences. As the Operations Development Manager, you will sit at the intersection of Creative, Production, Operations and Finance &amp; Strategy, responsible for taking our business and commercial goals and translating them into plans that speak to program briefs, operational criteria, and show quality maintenance, ensuring a consistent world-class experience for our fans. You will be the primary operational voice throughout the project’s lifecycle, effectively balancing the various operational needs and inputs with the broader strategic intent of the project.<br><br><strong>What You Will Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Oversee operational design of new experiences from initial concepting through turnover, including capacity requirements, financial P&amp;L inputs, theory of operations, etc. </li><li>Model capacity v. throughput, identify bottlenecks, advocate for guest accessibility &amp; safety, provide expert knowledge of efficient layouts and flow for attraction/entertainment experience, F&amp;B, retail, and back of house.</li><li>Optimize operations within new experiences, maximizing efficiency using best practices across the industry. Seek and try new approaches as needed in order to keep our experiences fresh and relevant. </li><li>Be a champion for both an optimal guest experience and efficient operations; facilitate dialogue and decision-making that effectively balances multiple priorities and inputs with the broader strategic intent of the projects.</li><li>Ensure creative and operational excellence by working with vendors and cross-functional contributors.</li><li>Partner with finance &amp; strategy partners to ensure financial viability of projects, modeling operational costs and risks in P&amp;L</li><li>Develop Standard Operating Procedures and Operational Guidelines for new experiences.</li><li>Liaise with third-party operating vendors and partners (Food &amp; Beverage, Retail, Ticketing, etc).</li><li>Establish regular meetings with key stakeholders to update on progress and solicit feedback.</li><li>Role based in Los Angeles, California, but travel to agency/vendors and on-site support at experiences as needed.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Need From You<br><br></strong><ul><li>Demonstrated 7+ years of operations leadership/managerial experience in the location based experience or touring entertainment industry.</li><li>Hands-on operational expertise across multiple lines of business including Attractions, Food &amp; Beverage, Retail, Entertainment, Ticketing, and Guest Services.</li><li>Proven ability to direct and lead projects and new project development. Demonstrates ways to translate project plans into reality by adjusting, multitasking, and re-prioritizing on a continuous basis. </li><li>Exceptional influencing skills with an ability to integrate diverse points of view to desired resolution.</li><li>Proven leader who enables the overarching strategy and drives results through creative sensibilities, strong business acumen and strategic thinking.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to build and foster relationships with cross functional partners and lead in a collaborative style - holds self and others accountable.</li><li>Strong financial acumen and experience with financial modeling and OPEX cost knowledge</li><li>Strong desire and ability to think outside the box and innovate.</li><li>Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Excellent communication skills, both verbal and digital.</li><li>Excellent organizational skills using digital tools and Google suite.</li><li>Ability to drive positive operational results (i.e. budget, revenue, labor, costs, etc.).<br><br></li></ul>Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $205,000.00 - $343,000.00.<br><br>Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.<br><br>Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.<br><br>Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.<br><br>We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>We are looking for a Workplace Operations Specialist who is organized, flexible, and enthusiastic for both the practical and creative elements of strategic Workplace Operations. This position reports to the Workplace Operations Manager and provides the opportunity to scale and shape Netflix’s workplace operations while working collaboratively with stakeholders from across the company.<br><br>A successful candidate will be passionate, self-motivated, proactive, quick-thinking, flexible, and able to pivot when necessary. The ability to juggle multiple, diverse responsibilities with a strong emphasis on organization and unwavering attention to detail is always required. This is a demanding and fast-moving position that requires someone who is proactive, a positive thinker, and able to exercise good judgment and communication.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li>Coordinating Preventative Maintenance programs, ensuring timely completion by internal teams or third-party vendors, and implements best practice processes to increase efficiency.</li><li>Leading small to mid-sized projects such as capital improvements, vendor transitions, new site enhancements, and reconfigurations. Develop project scopes, timelines, milestones, and communication plans to ensure successful delivery.</li><li>Overseeing daily work requests, manages maintenance ticketing systems, and ensures accurate documentation of corrective/preventative maintenance work records.</li><li>Providing prompt responses to facility occupant requests, facilitating resolution through vendor and internal team coordination.</li><li>Conducting regular facility inspections and audits to ensure compliance and optimal functioning.</li><li>Supporting the integration and operation of network systems such as HVAC automation, Fire Life Safety (FLS), and additional integrated systems.</li><li>Participating in new design construction walks, new system training, documentation, and collaborative efforts between Workplace Operations and Design and Construction teams.</li><li>Acting as a liaison between Workplace Operations, vendors, and cross-functional partners to ensure scope alignment, clear handoffs, and timely delivery of project milestones.</li><li>Developing good partner relationships and addresses service needs.</li><li>Assisting in implementing site-specific programs, procedures, and systems to ensure regulatory compliance and the protection of employees and the environment.</li><li>Collaborating with the Global Environmental Health and Safety team to ensure adherence to health and safety standards and industry codes.</li><li>Supporting cross-functional infrastructure initiatives, providing coordination across MEP, Fire Life Safety, and IT projects while ensuring minimal disruption to live environments.</li><li>Working closely with functional partners, assisting with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing tasks/projects, including Security, Events, Audio Visual Team, IT Team, Food &amp; Beverage Team, Moves &amp; Adds Team, Logistics, Transportation, Design &amp; Construction, and Workplace Experience Teams.</li><li>Taking the lead on self-initiated projects and generates comprehensive reports.</li><li>Producing Building/Energy Management System reports, highlighting real-time and historical trends such as temperature, humidity, and system status to identify anomalies.</li><li>Identifying problem trends and ensures troubleshooting efforts to determine root causes.</li><li>Performing other duties as assigned or requested by the Operations Manager.</li><li>Providing and processes Tenant Alteration Requests as per Landlord requirements.</li><li>Working with coordinators to assign Zendesk tickets to technicians</li><li>Ability to manage schedule and shift changes for technicians.</li><li>This role is based in the Los Angeles, Hollywood, and Burbank areas. It will require you to travel to different locations as part of your responsibilities. We're looking for someone who is able and willing to commute to various sites as needed for this role.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications / Requirements<br><br></strong><ul><li>5+ years of experience in facility operations, workplace support, or a related infrastructure support role</li><li>Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and Building Automation Systems (BAS)</li><li>Exceptional organizational skills with a strong ability to follow through on tasks</li><li>Proficiency in critical infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire life safety systems</li><li>Basic understanding of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), preferably Maximo</li><li>Ability to guide and influence vendor teams effectively</li><li>Excellent time management skills with a proven track record of on-time project delivery</li><li>Proficiency in G-Suite applications</li><li>Willingness to support team members in meeting deadlines and goals</li><li>Experience supporting or coordinating small to mid-sized capital improvement and tenant improvement (TI) projects</li><li>Working knowledge of construction sequencing, punch walks, and post-occupancy enhancements</li><li>Proficiency in project scoping, vendor RFPs, schedule coordination, and tracking milestones</li><li>Experience collaborating with General Contractors, subcontractors, and cross-functional stakeholders in live environments</li><li>Familiarity with reading and interpreting as-built drawings, site plans, and construction documents</li><li>Flexible working hours are required due to the 24/7 operation </li><li>Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment</li><li>Availability for on-call and emergency situations as needed<br><br></li></ul>Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of hourly pay; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in hourly pay versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The hourly range for this role is $38.46 - $57.69.<br><br>Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.<br><br>Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.<br><br>Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.<br><br>We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. metadata.description: Who we are<p>The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it.</p>Who you are<p>Metropolis is seeking a dynamic, results-oriented Vice President of Operations to lead parking operations across a designated region. This executive-level role is responsible for driving operational excellence, maximizing financial performance, and delivering exceptional customer experiences across multiple locations. The Vice President will serve as a strategic leader, overseeing a team of regional and operations managers while partnering with cross-functional leaders to scale and optimize the business.</p>What you'll do<ul><li>Develop and execute regional strategies to drive growth, operational efficiency, and profitability</li><li>Identify new business opportunities and lead expansion initiatives within and enhance customer experience</li><li>Manage regional budgets by overseeing revenue forecasting, cost control, and margin optimization, while conducting financial analyses to identify opportunities satisfaction metrics across all sites</li><li>Ensure full compliance with ADA, safety, and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations</li><li>Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, community leaders, and local officials, representing Metropolis at industry events and community initiatives</li><li>Support sales and marketing efforts by providing local market insights and multi-site operations, parking management, or facilities management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role</li><li>Proven ability to drive revenue growth, manage P&amp;L, and lead large management skills</li><li>Ability to travel frequently within the assigned region</li></ul>While not required, these are a plus:<ul><li>MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred</li><li>Familiarity with parking technology platforms and data-driven decision making</li></ul><p><em>When you join Metropolis, you’ll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of metadata.description: <p>Creative Project Operations Manager</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p><p>Leading Beauty Group is seeking a Creative Project Operations Manager who lives at the intersection of creativity and operations. In this role, you’ll be the engine behind a high-volume creative team, ensuring campaigns and content move smoothly from concept to launch across digital, social, e-commerce, and experiential channels.</p><p>You’ll partner closely with Creative, Marketing, E-commerce, and Merchandising, keeping projects organized, stakeholders aligned, and deadlines on track in a fast-paced beauty-driven environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Own creative projects end-to-end, from brief through delivery, including seasonal campaigns, direct mail, e-commerce/email, social content, events, and special initiatives.</li><li>Translate ideas into clear project plans: define scope, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and milestones with key partners.</li><li>Build and manage detailed schedules; drive the day-to-day workflow across internal creative, production, post-production, and external vendors.</li><li>Traffic work through project management systems, track progress, and keep teams informed so nothing falls through the cracks.</li><li>Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, anticipate shifts in priorities, and quickly adjust plans while maintaining clarity for all stakeholders.</li><li>Lead the approval process: route work to stakeholders, schedule review meetings, set agendas, and ensure assets are presentation-ready.</li><li>Monitor quality, productivity, and costs, proactively identifying bottlenecks and recommending smarter, more efficient ways of working.</li><li>Develop and roll out process tools such as creative brief templates, documentation, and repeatable workflows to streamline execution.</li><li>Run post-mortems to capture learnings and continuously improve how the creative team operates.</li><li>Support the organization and governance of creative assets (imagery, photo, video, audio, fonts) in alignment with DAM/CMS best practices.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p><ul><li>A detail-obsessed, highly organized, and proactive mindset; you love turning chaos into clarity.</li><li>Comfort working under tight deadlines while maintaining high standards for quality and service.</li><li>Proven experience building processes, documentation, and templates that help teams move faster and smarter.</li><li>Strong understanding of print, digital, photo, and motion production processes.</li><li>Experience managing creative digital assets and working within DAM/CMS environments, including metadata, taxonomy, and SEO-informed organization.</li><li>Ability to design logical data structures (architecture maps, naming conventions) that make assets easy to find and use.</li><li>A track record of elevating creative operations and increasing output without sacrificing creativity.</li><li>Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both internal stakeholders and external partners.</li><li>High ownership and accountability for planning, delivery, and follow-through on every project.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Background &amp; Experience</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field.</li><li>5+ years of project management experience in beauty, fashion, or an advertising/creative agency setting.</li><li>Expertise managing projects across the full lifecycle—from concept to final delivery—especially for photo and motion content.</li><li>Hands-on experience overseeing 360° brand campaigns and coordinating deliverables across multiple channels.</li><li>Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and written/verbal communication skills.</li><li>Advanced proficiency with project management tools; Asana and Figma experience is required.</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Contract</p><p>Hybrid Work Schedule</p>

metadata.description: <strong>WHY WORK FOR VALENTINO <br><br></strong>Founded in Rome 1960, Valentino is an Italian Maison de Couture that aims to provide uniqueness to our customers through mastery, creativity, intimacy and care. They offer exceptional customer experience, by understanding client needs and exceeding their expectations in order to increase sales and store profitability. The Client Engagement Manager maintains strong knowledge of the luxury fashion industry and has in depth understanding of the brand heritage and collections.<br><br>This role is based out of our Los Angeles office and reports to the Director of Client Engagement.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong> Client Development and Relations – 50% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Partner with Director of Client Engagement and Store teams to build expert knowledge of VICs in each location/store, and constantly develop and follow-up on action plans to grow existing VICs and develop Retail Operations and Events on the execution of local retail activities and experiences to drive strong ROI </li><li> Support the Director of Client Engagement in planning and execution on major/institutional events (i.e., Fashion Shows, Forever Valentino Doha Exhibition, etc.) </li><li> Attend events and act as a Valentino Ambassador for VICs involved, ensuring excellence in event <br><br></li></ul><strong> Clienteling Strategy and Performance – 30% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Manage the client gifting and experiences’ budget for retail network to develop and maximize client development plan in cohesion with global and regional strategy </li><li> Lead regular performance reviews and impact of client initiatives, analyze prior, during and post strategy to ensure each touchpoint opportunity is maximized for client engagement KPIs </li><li> Constantly analyze client outreach to identify opportunities to close gaps and deriving bottom up action plans to meet sales and client segment goals </li><li> Produce benchmarking analysis along with research of new market landscapes and competitors’ events </li><li> Assist with the coordination, when needed, of event logistics including but not limited to car service, hair and makeup, florals, catering and gifting </li><li> Prepare post event recaps and ad-hoc analysis to monitor sales, client’s feedback and identify follow-up actions <br><br></li></ul><strong> Training and Team Development – 20% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Consistent training of store teams (in-person when necessary) around clienteling improve client development impact </li><li> Support the Store Managers in the management of all sensitive issues related to top clients and escalate when appropriate <br><br></li></ul><strong> Requirements : <br><br></strong><ul><li> 5+ Years of direct or related experience (personal shopping, sales, PR, etc); </li><li> In store, retail experience is a requirement </li><li> Established
