metadata.description: <p>Creative Project Operations Manager</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p><p>Leading Beauty Group is seeking a Creative Project Operations Manager who lives at the intersection of creativity and operations. In this role, you’ll be the engine behind a high-volume creative team, ensuring campaigns and content move smoothly from concept to launch across digital, social, e-commerce, and experiential channels.</p><p>You’ll partner closely with Creative, Marketing, E-commerce, and Merchandising, keeping projects organized, stakeholders aligned, and deadlines on track in a fast-paced beauty-driven environment.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Own creative projects end-to-end, from brief through delivery, including seasonal campaigns, direct mail, e-commerce/email, social content, events, and special initiatives.</li><li>Translate ideas into clear project plans: define scope, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and milestones with key partners.</li><li>Build and manage detailed schedules; drive the day-to-day workflow across internal creative, production, post-production, and external vendors.</li><li>Traffic work through project management systems, track progress, and keep teams informed so nothing falls through the cracks.</li><li>Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, anticipate shifts in priorities, and quickly adjust plans while maintaining clarity for all stakeholders.</li><li>Lead the approval process: route work to stakeholders, schedule review meetings, set agendas, and ensure assets are presentation-ready.</li><li>Monitor quality, productivity, and costs, proactively identifying bottlenecks and recommending smarter, more efficient ways of working.</li><li>Develop and roll out process tools such as creative brief templates, documentation, and repeatable workflows to streamline execution.</li><li>Run post-mortems to capture learnings and continuously improve how the creative team operates.</li><li>Support the organization and governance of creative assets (imagery, photo, video, audio, fonts) in alignment with DAM/CMS best practices.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p><ul><li>A detail-obsessed, highly organized, and proactive mindset; metadata.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.<br><br>Our Experiences team puts fans at the center of their favorite stories, in real life, through permanent entertainment venues, Netflix House, and touring attractions around the world. Netflix Houses are our permanent, always-on, constantly refreshable entertainment venues, where guests can step into their favorite stories. We want these experiences, along with merchandise offerings, to help promote love for our titles so they become part of the zeitgeist for longer periods of time and drive long-term value for Netflix.<br><br>The Experiences Design &amp; Delivery team is responsible for the site planning, creative development, construction, and delivery of our permanent experiences. As the Operations Development Manager, you will sit at the intersection of Creative, Production, Operations and Finance &amp; Strategy, responsible for taking our business and commercial goals and translating them into plans that speak to program briefs, operational criteria, and show quality maintenance, ensuring a consistent world-class experience for our fans. You will be the primary operational voice throughout the project’s lifecycle, effectively balancing the various operational needs and inputs with the broader strategic intent of the project.<br><br><strong>What You Will Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Oversee operational design of new experiences from initial concepting through turnover, including capacity requirements, financial P&amp;L inputs, theory of operations, etc. </li><li>Model capacity v. throughput, identify bottlenecks, advocate for guest accessibility &amp; safety, provide expert knowledge of efficient layouts and flow for attraction/entertainment experience, F&amp;B, retail, and back of house.</li><li>Optimize operations within new experiences, maximizing efficiency using best practices across the industry. Seek and try new approaches as needed in order to keep our experiences fresh and relevant. </li><li>Be a champion for both an optimal guest experience and efficient operations; facilitate dialogue and decision-making that effectively balances multiple priorities and inputs with the broader strategic intent of the projects.</li><li>Ensure creative and operational excellence by working with vendors and cross-functional contributors.</li><li>Partner with finance &amp; strategy partners to ensure financial viability of projects, modeling operational costs and risks in P&amp;L</li><li>Develop Standard Operating Procedures and Operational Guidelines for new experiences.</li><li>Liaise with third-party operating vendors and partners (Food &amp; Beverage, Retail, Ticketing, etc).</li><li>Establish regular meetings with key stakeholders to update on progress and solicit feedback.</li><li>Role based in Los Angeles, California, but travel to agency/vendors and on-site support at experiences as needed.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What We Need From You<br><br></strong><ul><li>Demonstrated 7+ years of operations leadership/managerial experience in the location based experience or touring entertainment industry.</li><li>Hands-on operational expertise across multiple lines of business including Attractions, Food &amp; Beverage, Retail, Entertainment, Ticketing, and Guest Services.</li><li>Proven ability to direct and lead projects and new project development. Demonstrates ways to translate project plans into reality by adjusting, multitasking, and re-prioritizing on a continuous basis. </li><li>Exceptional influencing skills with an ability to integrate diverse points of view to desired resolution.</li><li>Proven leader who enables the overarching strategy and drives results through creative sensibilities, strong business acumen and strategic thinking.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to build and foster relationships with cross functional partners and lead in a collaborative style - holds self and others accountable.</li><li>Strong financial acumen and experience with financial modeling and OPEX cost knowledge</li><li>Strong desire and ability to think outside the box and innovate.</li><li>Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Excellent communication skills, both verbal and digital.</li><li>Excellent organizational skills using digital tools and Google suite.</li><li>Ability to drive positive operational results (i.e. budget, revenue, labor, costs, etc.).<br><br></li></ul>Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $205,000.00 - $343,000.00.<br><br>Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.<br><br>Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.<br><br>Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.<br><br>We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

metadata.description: <strong>WHY WORK FOR VALENTINO <br><br></strong>Founded in Rome 1960, Valentino is an Italian Maison de Couture that aims to provide uniqueness to our customers through mastery, creativity, intimacy and care. Our network fully embodies the essence of the Maison, by practicing the Italian hospitality culture with our distinguishing quality, uniqueness and care for details.<br><br><strong>What We Believe In<br><br></strong>Here at Valentino, we act as a Unique Community &amp; Company. This role is a full-time permanent position based in our Beverly Hills Office. <br><br></strong><strong>Overview<br><br></strong><strong> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR <br><br></strong>The Client Engagement Manager will lead planning and implementation of retail client development strategies across the West Coast directly operated store (DOS) that drive retention, elevation, and acquisition through exceptional relationship management and local market events to support key client moments and achieve overall targets. This role is responsible for translating Valentino America’s client engagement strategy, in alignment with retail business objectives, to create store-embedded client plans that directly impact sales. The Client Engagement Manager will coordinate the partnerships with Store Managers, retail leadership and corporate client engagement teams ensuring synergy and collaboration.<br><br>The Client Engagement Manager establishes and builds relationships with Very Important Clients. They offer exceptional customer experience, by understanding client needs and exceeding their expectations in order to increase sales and store profitability. The Client Engagement Manager maintains strong knowledge of the luxury fashion industry and has in depth understanding of the brand heritage and collections.<br><br>This role is based out of our Los Angeles office and reports to the Director of Client Engagement.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><strong> Client Development and Relations – 50% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Partner with Director of Client Engagement and Store teams to build expert knowledge of VICs in each location/store, and constantly develop and follow-up on action plans to grow existing VICs and develop future VICs by identifying innovative new concepts and personalized VIC experiences, proposing client targeting segmentation, and ensuring proper execution and follow-up </li><li> Partner with CRM, Retail Operations and Events on the execution of local retail activities and experiences to drive strong ROI </li><li> Support the Director of Client Engagement in planning and execution on major/institutional events (i.e., Fashion Shows, Forever Valentino Doha Exhibition, etc.) </li><li> Attend events and act as a Valentino Ambassador for VICs involved, ensuring excellence in event execution and sales maximization </li><li> Assist in managing the personal shoppers and stylists’ program for each store </li><li> Oversee the Runway VIC Pre-Orders end-to-end process <br><br></li></ul><strong> Clienteling Strategy and Performance – 30% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Manage the client gifting and experiences’ budget for retail network to develop and maximize client relationships, including invoicing, budget planning and tracking </li><li> Develop and oversee partnerships with third parties (e.g., AMEX Offer, hotels, concierges, membership clubs, etc.) to drive acquisition and cultivation of VICs </li><li> Work closely with cross-functional corporate teams (regional and HQ) and store teams to align VICs goals and annual calendar to achieve annual client development plan in cohesion with global and regional strategy </li><li> Lead regular performance reviews and impact of client initiatives, analyze prior, during and post strategy to ensure each touchpoint opportunity is maximized for client engagement KPIs </li><li> Constantly analyze client outreach to identify opportunities to close gaps and deriving bottom up action plans to meet sales and client segment goals </li><li> Produce benchmarking analysis along with research of new market landscapes and competitors’ events </li><li> Assist with the coordination, when needed, of event logistics including but not limited to car service, hair and makeup, florals, catering and gifting </li><li> Prepare post event recaps and ad-hoc analysis to monitor sales, client’s feedback and identify follow-up actions <br><br></li></ul><strong> Training and Team Development – 20% <br><br></strong><ul><li> Consistent training of store teams (in-person when necessary) around clienteling culture and activities, as well as onboarding new store members to ensure consistency across store teams </li><li> Identify store-specific opportunities to develop stronger training programs aimed to improve client development impact </li><li> Support the Store Managers in the management of all sensitive issues related to top clients and escalate when appropriate <br><br></li></ul><strong> Requirements : <br><br></strong><ul><li> 5+ Years of direct or related experience (personal shopping, sales, PR, etc); </li><li> In store, retail experience is a requirement </li><li> Established relationships with VIC clients </li><li> Elevated verbal and written communication skills </li><li> Ability to travel up to 25% <br><br></li></ul><strong> Budgeted salary - $125-150K + bonus (based on experience) <br><br></strong><strong>How We Are<br><br></strong>The Valentino Ecosystem is complex and interconnected. It is populated by many talents from different areas and with different attributes. We work hard to grow everyday both as a Maison and as individuals. Learning by doing and from mistakes, communicating transparently, inspiring sense of belonging, passion and engaging colleagues are the bases of our inclusive and multifaceted world.

metadata.description: <span><span><strong><u>FP&amp;A Specialist<br></u></strong><br>   We are currently seeking candidates for a FP&amp;A Specialist opportunity with a growing SaaS organization offering 100% REMOTE flexibility (must be located on EST). metadata.description: <p>Clean Creatives is hiring <strong>three research assistants</strong> to conduct open source research between April 1 and June 15, 2026 for the 2026 edition of our annual report, The F-List.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>We are hiring one researcher in each of these 3 regions: (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe and (3) MENAT and brand studios. </strong>These are fully remote positions.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Details</strong></p><p>Clean Creatives is seeking researchers to contribute to the 2026 edition of our premier research report, the F-List. This report documents relationships between fossil fuel companies and advertising and PR firms worldwide, with the goals of providing transparency for communications professionals and brands and better understanding the communications strategies of major polluters.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>In its sixth year, the 2026 F-List will seek to present the most current picture of these relationships possible, with an added goal of filling in specific geographic gaps in our past research.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Past editions of this report have attracted wide coverage in communication industry press, extensive online conversation, and significantly impacted agencies’ practices. We are interested in uncovering data that helps make news and shapes the advertising and PR industry’s business goals.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><p>We are seeking either an individual researcher, or a team, to identify which agencies are responsible for promoting fossil fuel companies and lobbying groups in (1) North America and LATAM, (2) UK and Europe, and (3) MENAT and brand studios.</p><p><br></p><p>The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized and intuitive, and have previous experience analyzing data or conducting research. We would like to work with researchers who are curious and self-motivated and who can consistently dedicate at least 15-20 hours of time every week during the 8-10 week research period. If you are the type of person who likes to search through databases and go through pages of Google search results, this is for you!</p><p><br></p><p>This researcher or team will analyze public sources to find proof of advertising and PR agencies working on fossil fuel campaigns. These sources include:</p><ul><li>Agency websites</li><li>Creative portfolio sites</li><li>Government disclosures</li><li>Lobbying databases</li><li>Award show directories</li><li>News coverage</li><li>LinkedIn and Meta ad libraries</li><li>Social media posts</li></ul><p><br></p><p>We will train researchers on how to find and record contracts and provide a list of countries and companies to guide their research. The researcher(s) should be comfortable working with multi-lingual sources, or in translation, to accurately and comprehensively identify key data in relevant languages.</p><p><br></p><p>We are especially interested in candidates who have experience researching the region and candidates who are familiar with company names and structures in the oil and gas industry and/or the advertising and PR industry. However, this experience is not required.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p><p>This is a paid contract position which will start on April 1, 2026 and end on June 15, 2026. Compensation will be $5000 for all deliverables.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p><strong>How to Apply</strong></p><p>Applicants from any country are welcome to apply. <strong>To apply, send resumes and 2-3 research work samples to Clean Creatives Head of Research Nayantara Dutta (nayantara@fossilfree.media)</strong> with one of the following subject lines:</p><ul><li>“F-List Research Assistant - North America and LATAM”</li><li>"F-List Research Assistant - UK and Europe”</li><li>“F-List Research Assistant - MENAT and brand studios”</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Applicants are encouraged to apply by Feb 21.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><em>Further details in this Google Doc: </em>https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qr8bpE9Ofs7SEBVTDeK0IHOhJ88AX3r3yxstn9qh-Xo/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.8a9ub4h8xyvv</p>

metadata.description: <p><strong>DO NOT REACH OUT DIRECTLY TO QUIRE OF ANY OF ITS TEAM. QUIRE WILL REACH OUT TO CANDIDATES DIRECTLY WITH NEXT STEPS IF YOU ARE A FIT FOR THE ROLE.</strong></p><p><strong>ABOUT QUIRE</strong></p><p><br></p><p>At Quire, we are builders and innovators.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire operates at the intersection of craftsmanship and strategic finance, specializing in media, technology, and consumer convergence - value creation where content, technology, and commerce meet. We serve enterprise leaders: public and private founders/CEOs, boards, corporate owners, and select PE/VC sponsors and family offices. Our standard is atelier-level quality, speed, and discretion.</p><p><br></p><p>Our work focuses on two strategic areas.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Innovation &amp; Growth</strong>: Our innovation and growth teams build strategic plans to support revenue and market share growth, including relevant financial and valuation analysis. Innovation &amp; Growth clients seek ways to grow much faster, achieve deeper competitive differentiation, and demand a clearer sense of potential exit valuations.</li></ul><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Restructuring</strong>: Our restructuring teams eliminate costs, build new strategies, and support repositioning or relaunch. Restructuring clients typically have failed to achieve strategic plans and goals, and, often, have limited capital and time to build and execute a new strategic and financial plan.&nbsp;</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Our projects are all highly structured and use teams made up of remote consultants who are domain experts. Consultants are compensated based on expertise and experience. Quire pays a premium of 25% - 40% above market on average to ensure the best talent.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire’s clients are highly sophisticated and demand excellence.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>To ensure we are always raising our standards, Quire maintains values that define our work and culture.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Exceptional Quality</strong>. We strive in all instances to contribute ideas, recommendations, and work product that are of exceptional quality. Quire’s standard is often higher than both that of our clients and the market.&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Focus on Client Value</strong>. Our strategic solutions must deliver clear, quantifiable value to clients. We achieve this through how we connect innovative strategic ideas with world-class financial and valuation analysis.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Creative Scarcity</strong>. Quire deeply values creativity and appreciates its scarcity. We maintain space to nurture creativity and are constantly pursuing ways to apply new creative solutions and technologies to solve problems and build new products and forms of content.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>All new consultants who hope to work with Quire must provide information on how your prior work, key skills, and values align with Quire's requirements.&nbsp;</strong></p><p><br></p><p><span>We are seeking a highly skilled</span><strong> Project Manager</strong><span> to lead both internal and client&nbsp; projects across our Strategic Advisory and Capital Partners business verticals.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>This role is responsible for driving the team's </span><strong>productivity</strong><span>, ensuring the</span><strong> timely delivery of high-quality work</strong><span> that aligns with project and company standards. They </span><strong>collaborate across disciplines</strong><span> to define and achieve the project's goals, fostering</span><strong> efficient workflows and maintaining excellence</strong><span> throughout development. metadata.description: <p><strong>FIRM OVERVIEW</strong></p><p>J. Goldman &amp; Co., L.P. (“JGC”) is an independent investment manager founded in 1986 by Jay G. Goldman and has been in continuous operation for almost four decades. JGC’s investment philosophy is based upon fundamental analysis, a comprehensive understanding of the capital markets, and disciplined execution on investment ideas. JGC seeks to achieve attractive risk-adjusted returns in all market conditions with low correlation and low volatility. The firm employs a rigorous process to identify, evaluate, and allocate capital to the best ideas of its investment professionals. JGC is a meritocracy where teamwork is demanded, talent is rewarded, and absolute integrity is required.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>POSITION OVERVIEW</strong></p><p>We are seeking an Analyst to join our team, focusing on Internet &amp; Emerging Technology Equities. The successful candidate will engage in detailed research and analysis of companies, contributing significantly to idea generation. The ideal candidate should have 4+ years of relevant experience within financial services, preferably at an Equity long / short hedge fund within the technology sector.</p><p><br></p><p>As an Analyst, you will report directly to a Portfolio Manager, a partner with over 20 years of experience at our Firm. From day one, you will assume a substantial role in the research and investment processes, handling a range of responsibilities while gaining meaningful exposure to durable and proven alpha generative investment processes. This role represents an excellent chance to develop and advance as an investor within our supportive and dynamic environment. JGC is committed to internal promotion, offering Analysts substantial growth opportunities in both responsibility and compensation.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES </strong></p><ul><li>Conduct company and industry fundamental research to develop a deep understanding of key business and industry drivers within the coverage universe and other related/adjacent industries.</li><li>Interact and maintain positive relationships with company management and other industry participants while growing a meaningful network of business contacts globally.</li><li>Clearly and effectively communicate and articulate actionable Equity ideas to colleagues, including Portfolio Managers, Analysts, and Traders.</li><li>Create, maintain, and update company financial models.</li><li>Explore and stay informed of emerging trends/initiatives/companies which are or that may become important innovators.</li><li>Attend roadshows, meetings, conferences, and other company or industry events as required.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p><p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p><p>The ideal candidate will have:</p><ul><li>Bachelors’ degree required complemented by a strong academic record (3.75+ GPA preferred) from a competitive institution/program including successful coursework in Accounting &amp; Finance. Preference for candidates with CPA or CFA but not required.</li><li>Minimum 4+ years of experience conducting investment research or financial analysis – preference for hedge fund experience.</li><li>Demonstrated passion for the Equity markets, investing, and analyzing companies.</li><li>Professional experience building financial models combined with strong forensic accounting knowledge.</li><li>Professional or educational experience working with data; programming experience is a plus.</li></ul><p><strong>Competencies: </strong></p><p>To perform the job successfully, an individual should excel in the following areas:</p><ul><li><strong>Research / Problem Solving-</strong> the individual displays strong technical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities. The individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner, gathers and analyzes information skillfully, asks intelligent questions, and maintains confidentiality.</li><li><strong>Quality control-</strong> the individual consistently demonstrates accuracy, thoroughness, monitors work to ensure quality, and possesses a strong attention to detail.</li><li><strong>Drive-</strong> the individual possesses a competitive and self-motivated mindset as well as a natural drive for results, reflecting an ownership mentality.</li><li><strong>Dependability-</strong> the individual is consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, responds to management direction, and solicits feedback to improve performance.</li><li><strong>Interpersonal skills-</strong> the individual maintains confidentiality, remains open to new ideas, effectively communicates, and partners with others at the firm. The individual possesses the highest standards of integrity, honesty, and mutual consideration.</li><li><strong>Planning/organizing-</strong> the individual possesses impressive organizational skills, prioritizes, and uses time efficiently.</li><li><strong>Written communication-</strong> the individual demonstrates superior writing/drafting skills, presents information clearly and concisely, and can read and interpret written information with ease.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>The Firm offers a total compensation package that includes a base salary and discretionary performance-related bonus, as well as a comprehensive benefits package. Consistent with New York City’s Pay Transparency Law, the currently anticipated base salary range for this role is $175,000 – $225,000 which is specific to New York City and New York State. When crafting an offer of employment and total compensation package for candidates, the Firm may incorporate a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, an individual’s experience level and qualifications.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong><em>The Firm is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, color, religion, disability, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.</em></strong></p><p></p>

metadata.description: <p>Most startup EA roles come with chaos and a promise. This one comes with chaos and involvement from day one.</p><p><br></p><p>Here's what I know about startup life:</p><p><br></p><p>Unstructured to the point of confusion.</p><p>Zero systems.</p><p>Living in Slack like it's oxygen.</p><p>A founder who's figuring it out in real time because that's what first-time founders do.</p><p><br></p><p>That's not a warning. That's the opportunity.</p><p><br></p><p>Because this founder doesn't need someone to inherit his systems. He needs someone to build them.</p><p><br></p><p>I've placed EAs into startups for twenty years. The ones who thrive aren't the ones who need structure handed to them. They're the ones who walk into chaos and create order from nothing. They see the gap before the founder does. They build the process before anyone asks for it.</p><p><br></p><p>That's what this role requires.</p><p><br></p><p>Your experience won't just be valued here. It will be the most important asset in the room. You'll see problems he doesn't know exist yet. You'll create a structure he hasn't thought to ask for. You'll shape how he operates from day one.</p><p><br></p><p>Most EA roles are about supporting a machine that already runs. You inherit the systems. You learn the rhythms. You slot into something that existed before you arrived.</p><p><br></p><p>This one is about building the machine.</p><p><br></p><p>The founder has just closed Series A. The money is in. The ambition is real. Now he needs someone who can help him scale without losing his mind in the process.</p><p><br></p><p>That person won't just manage his calendar. They'll become his operational backbone. The one who turns his half-formed ideas into action. The one who protects his time so he can focus on what only he can do.</p><p><br></p><p>$150,000 base. Equity. Fully remote with occasional time in NYC for the meetings that matter. You'll need to be within commutable distance.</p><p><br></p><p>If you've supported founders before and wondered what it would feel like to get in earlier, this is earlier.</p><p>The kind of role where you look back in three years and realise you helped build something.</p><p><br></p><p>Please note that we can only consider EAs with prior Start-Up experience (ideally at the Founder level).&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>You must live commutable distance to Manhattan.</p>

metadata.description: <strong>Who is Flock?<br><br></strong>Flock Safety is the leading safety technology platform, helping communities thrive by taking a proactive approach to crime prevention and security. Our hardware and software suite connects cities, law enforcement, businesses, schools, and neighborhoods in a nationwide public-private safety network. Trusted by over 5,000 communities, 4,500 law enforcement agencies, and 1,000 businesses, Flock delivers real-time intelligence while prioritizing privacy and responsible innovation.<br><br>We’re a high-performance, low-ego team driven by urgency, collaboration, and bold thinking. Working at Flock means tackling big challenges, moving fast, and continuously improving. It’s intense but deeply rewarding for those who want to make an impact.<br><br>With nearly $700M in venture funding and a $7.5B valuation, we’re scaling intentionally and seeking top talent to help build the impossible. If you value teamwork, ownership, and solving tough problems, Flock could be the place for you.<br><br><strong>The Opportunity<br><br></strong>As Vice President of Finance, you will lead the Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&amp;A) and Deal Desk functions during a critical phase of Flock Safety’s growth. This role is both strategic and hands-on — responsible for building a world-class team while serving as a trusted thought partner to the executive team. You’ll bring public-market rigor to a high-growth, private-company environment, elevating forecasting precision, GTM financial strategy, and decision-making across the business. This is an opportunity for a proven finance leader to shape how Flock plans, measures, and scales — helping the company operate like a public company well before it becomes one.<br><br><strong>The Skillset<br><br></strong><ul><li>World-class FP&amp;A leadership: Deep experience leading FP&amp;A at a company meaningfully larger and more complex than Flock, with a demonstrated ability to scale financial planning, forecasting, and reporting.</li><li>Public-market mindset: Strong understanding of public company standards, including forecast accuracy, operating cadence, financial controls, and executive-level reporting expectations.</li><li>GTM &amp; enterprise sales finance expertise: Proven experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps — owning or deeply supporting GTM FP&amp;A, enterprise sales motions, capacity modeling, pipeline economics, and ROI analysis.</li><li>High-velocity operator &amp; builder: Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; brings a builder mentality to designing teams, processes, and financial infrastructure that scale with the business.</li><li>Exceptional business partnership: Trusted advisor to executives and functional leaders; collaborative, thoughtful, and influential, with the ability to translate financial insights into clear, actionable recommendations.</li><li>Strong people leader: Experience building and developing high-performing teams with clear ownership, accountability, and growth paths.<br><br></li></ul><em>Feeling uneasy that you haven’t ticked every box? That’s okay; we’ve felt that way too. Studies have shown women and minorities are less likely to apply unless they meet all qualifications. We encourage you to break the status quo and apply to roles that would make you excited to come to work every day.<br><br></em><strong>90 Day Plan<br><br></strong>We prescribe to 90 day plans and believe that good days lead to good weeks, which lead to good months. This serves as a preview of the 90 day plan you will receive if you were to be hired in this role at Flock Safety.<br><br><strong>First 30 Days<br><br></strong><ul><li>Build deep context on Flock’s business model, GTM motion, product strategy, and growth drivers.</li><li>Establish strong relationships with the executive team, GTM leaders, and key cross-functional partners.</li><li>Assess current FP&amp;A and Deal Desk processes, forecasting accuracy, planning cadence, and financial infrastructure.</li><li>Identify immediate gaps and quick wins related to reporting clarity, forecasting rigor, and executive insights.<br><br></li></ul><strong>60 Days<br><br></strong><ul><li>Lead improvements to forecast quality and operating cadence, incorporating public-market-level rigor where appropriate.</li><li>Partner with GTM leadership to refine sales capacity models, pipeline forecasting, and enterprise deal economics.</li><li>Define the future-state FP&amp;A operating model, including org design, tooling, and core planning processes.</li><li>Begin elevating how financial insights are used in executive decision-making and strategic planning.<br><br></li></ul><strong>90 Days<br><br></strong><ul><li>Deliver a clear, scalable FP&amp;A roadmap aligned to Flock’s growth trajectory and long-term ambitions.</li><li>Implement enhanced planning and reporting frameworks that improve predictability and accountability across the business.</li><li>Solidify FP&amp;A and Deal Desk’s roles as true strategic partners to the exec team and functional leaders.</li><li>Build momentum toward a best-in-class finance function capable of supporting a future public company.<br><br></li></ul>Salary &amp; Equity<br><br>In this role, you’ll receive a starting salary between $270,000 - $300,000 as well as Flock Safety Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in-depth with you during our first chat.<br><br><strong>Location<br><br></strong>This role is based in New York City where you’ll join our dynamic team to collaborate in person and drive innovation. Candidates must reside in or relocate to New York City for this position.<br><br><strong>The Perks <br><br></strong>🌴<strong>Flexible PTO</strong>: We offer non-accrual PTO, plus 11 company holidays.<br><br>⚕️<strong>Fully-paid </strong><strong>health benefits</strong><strong> plan for employees</strong>: including Medical, Dental, and Vision and an HSA match.<br><br>👪<strong>Family Leave</strong>: All employees receive 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave. Birthing parents are eligible for an additional 6-8 weeks of physical recovery time.<br><br>🍼<strong>Fertility &amp; Family Benefits: </strong>We have partnered with Maven, a complete digital health benefit for starting and raising a family. Flock will provide a $50,000-lifetime maximum benefit related to eligible adoption, surrogacy, or fertility expenses.<br><br>🧠<strong>Spring Health: </strong>Spring Health offers a variety of mental health benefits, including therapy, coaching, medication management, and digital tools, all tailored to each individual's needs.<br><br>💖<strong>Caregiver Support:</strong> We have partnered with Cariloop to provide our employees with caregiver support.<br><br>💸<strong>Carta Tax Advisor:</strong> Employees receive 1:1 sessions with Equity Tax Advisors who can address individual grants, model tax scenarios, and answer general questions.<br><br>💚<strong>ERGs:</strong> We want all employees to thrive and feel like they belong at Flock. We offer four ERGs today - Women of Flock, Flock Proud, LEOs and Melanin Motion. If you are interested in talking to a representative from one of these, please let your recruiter know.<br><br><strong>💻WFH Stipend:</strong> $150 per month to cover the costs of working from home.<br><br><strong>📚Productivity Stipend:</strong> $300 per year to use on Audible, Calm, Masterclass, Duolingo and so much more.<br><br><strong>🏠Home Office Stipend:</strong> A one-time $750 to help you create your dream office.<br><br><em>Flock is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse backgrounds and thoughts and welcome everyone to apply for employment with us. We are committed to fostering an environment that is inclusive, transparent, and collaborative. Mutual respect is central to how Flock operates, and we believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills. We embrace our differences and know that we are stronger working together.<br><br></em><em>If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at recruiting@flocksafety.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only to determine an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.<br><br></em><em>At Flock Safety, we compensate our employees fairly for their work. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. The range above is representative of base salary only and does not include equity, sales bonus plans (when applicable) and benefits. This range may be modified in the future. This job posting may span more than one career level. <br><br></em><em>Flock Safety is aware of fraudulent individuals and agencies falsely claiming to represent our company. All legitimate communication from Flock Safety will come from an email address ending in <strong>@</strong></em><em><strong>flocksafety.com</strong></em><em>. We do not make job offers through messaging apps, social platforms, or unauthorized third parties, and we will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you encounter suspicious outreach related to a Flock Safety role, please report it to </em><em>recruiting@flocksafety.com</em>

metadata.description: <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p><p>The company is a mission-driven, venture-backed platform operating at meaningful scale, with a nationally recognized brand. Following a period of rapid growth and recent organizational change, the business is entering a critical phase focused on financial discipline, operating leverage, and long-term scalability.</p><p>This interim Director of Finance role will serve as a <strong>true strategic partner to senior finance leadership</strong>, stepping into a high-impact environment where decisions made over the next several months will directly shape the company’s trajectory. The role is central to rebuilding a best-in-class FP&amp;A function—establishing clear planning, forecasting, and performance management infrastructure that enables leadership to operate with confidence, clarity, and speed.</p><p>The ideal profile is someone who thrives in <strong>VC-backed, growth-stage environments</strong>—comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity, elevating analytical rigor, and acting as the connective tissue between accounting, operations, and executive leadership. This is not a maintenance role; it is a <strong>build, stabilize, and elevate</strong> mandate with real visibility and influence.</p><p>This individual will own budgeting, forecasting, analytics, and reporting infrastructure, enabling leadership to shift from reactive execution to forward-looking, strategic decision-making during a pivotal transition period.</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Lead company-wide budgeting and monthly forecast consolidation</li><li>Build and maintain headcount and cash flow forecasting models in Excel and Google Sheets</li><li>Develop and standardize ARR, KPI, and performance reporting</li><li>Deliver high-impact ad hoc financial and operational analysis</li><li>Translate complex data into executive-ready dashboards and presentations</li><li>Support performance management design and execution</li><li>Act as a central analytics partner across FP&amp;A and Accounting</li><li>Partner with systems and data teams to leverage NetSuite-connected reporting tools like Cube</li><li>Help re-establish financial discipline and analytical rigor during turnaround execution</li></ul><p><strong>Ideal Candidate Profile</strong></p><ul><li>Strong FP&amp;A and strategic finance background</li><li>Exceptional financial modeling and analytical capabilities (advanced Excel / Sheets required)</li><li>Ability to bridge accounting and finance, translating data into business insights</li><li>Strong project management and execution skills</li><li>Comfortable operating in fast-paced, turnaround environments</li><li>Highly independent; Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.</p><p> </p><strong>Benefits</strong><p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p><p> </p><strong>Accommodations</strong><p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.</p><p> </p><strong>The Roku Culture</strong><p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. metadata.description: <p>Most startup EA roles come with chaos and a promise. This one comes with chaos and involvement from day one.</p><p><br></p><p>Here's what I know about startup life:</p><p><br></p><p>Unstructured to the point of confusion.</p><p>Zero systems.</p><p>Living in Slack like it's oxygen.</p><p>A founder who's figuring it out in real time because that's what first-time founders do.</p><p><br></p><p>That's not a warning. That's the opportunity.</p><p><br></p><p>Because this founder doesn't need someone to inherit his systems. He needs someone to build them.</p><p><br></p><p>I've placed EAs into startups for twenty years. The ones who thrive aren't the ones who need structure handed to them. They're the ones who walk into chaos and create order from nothing. They see the gap before the founder does. They build the process before anyone asks for it.</p><p><br></p><p>That's what this role requires.</p><p><br></p><p>Your experience won't just be valued here. It will be the most important asset in the room. You'll see problems he doesn't know exist yet. You'll create a structure he hasn't thought to ask for. You'll shape how he operates from day one.</p><p><br></p><p>Most EA roles are about supporting a machine that already runs. You inherit the systems. You learn the rhythms. You slot into something that existed before you arrived.</p><p><br></p><p>This one is about building the machine.</p><p><br></p><p>The founder has just closed Series A. The money is in. The ambition is real. Now he needs someone who can help him scale without losing his mind in the process.</p><p><br></p><p>That person won't just manage his calendar. They'll become his operational backbone. The one who turns his half-formed ideas into action. The one who protects his time so he can focus on what only he can do.</p><p><br></p><p>$150,000 base. Equity. Fully remote with occasional time in NYC for the meetings that matter. You'll need to be within commutable distance.</p><p><br></p><p>If you've supported founders before and wondered what it would feel like to get in earlier, this is earlier.</p><p>The kind of role where you look back in three years and realise you helped build something.</p><p><br></p><p>Please note that we can only consider EAs with prior Start-Up experience (ideally at the Founder level).&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>You must live commutable distance to Manhattan.</p>

Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.<br><br><strong>Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:<br><br></strong>Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.<br><br>Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.<br><br>Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.<br><br>Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.<br><br>Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. sourcing to close.</li><li>Structure and analyze project- and corporate-level investments, including PPAs, service agreements, and other commercial contracts.</li><li>Own investment analysis across a investments.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Candidate Profile:</strong></p><ul><li>7–10+ years of experience in investment banking, project finance, private equity, or corporate development focused on energy or infrastructure.</li><li>Demonstrated success executing transactions in utility-scale renewables (solar, storage) or conventional generation.</li><li>Strong background in financial modeling, term sheet negotiation, and commercial due diligence.</li><li>Strategic thinker who can independently manage deals but also support leadership in broader portfolio oversight.</li><li>Comfortable working in a lean team environment where adaptability and ownership are essential.</li><li>Experience across both project-level and platform-level transactions preferred.</li><li>Prior exposure to both institutional and boutique investment environments is a plus.</li><li>U.S. work authorization required.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></p><ul><li>Competitive metadata.description: <p><strong>Title: Sr. Process Manager (Treasury Management)</strong></p><p><strong>Location: McLean/Richmond, VA (Hybrid – 3 Days a week)</strong></p><p><strong>Duration: 12 Months of Contract</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Job Description</strong></p><p>The SBB Onboarding Specialist will possess an in-depth technical knowledge of Treasury Management products. The SBB Onboarding Specialist will work closely with the client, Treasury Management Sales Officers, Client Service Teams, and business partners to drive revenue generation by improving client experience and increasing client retention rate through effective management of client implementations. The SBB Onboarding Specialist is responsible for implementing and directing all aspects of Treasury Management products and related service set-up for new and existing clients of Treasury Management Offerings. Acting as a central point of contact for the client throughout the implementation process, the Onboarding Specialist develops a customized plan for each client and directs junior resources and required internal partners (i.e., product, operations, technology, and risk) to ensure delivery of products and services is completed within agreed upon timeframes, with full ownership of end-to-end process from client commitment to revenue generation.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>General Responsibilities:</strong></p><ul><li>Operate independently and exercise professional judgment in making decisions that impact the client experience</li><li>Establish and maintain a high-level of credibility with clients and business partners</li><li>Provide a best-in-class client experience, while managing internal and external client expectations</li><li>Serve as product expert by accompanying and/or support sales officers on client calls to explain more complex product set-up to customers, provide feedback and advice on modifications, and help ensure our capabilities meet client needs</li><li>Acting as a subject matter expert, provide feedback and advice on modifications of Treasury Management Products</li><li>Will work jointly with Treasury Management Sales on deals prior to sale commitment</li><li>Facilitate pre-implementation kickoff &amp; post sale call with client (in-person, via teleconference, or via email as required) to review project requirements, develop plan of approach, roles and responsibilities, discuss documents / information required from the client, and determine agreed upon timeframes for completion; regular communication with client and Treasury Management Sales Officer to update status and address issues</li><li>Effectively manage each implementation as a custom client specific project from end to end while meeting defined SLAs with a focus on expediting revenue generation</li><li>Maintain a current portfolio of client implementations and related promised dates, monitoring requests in queue to ensure aged items are expedited in a timely basis</li><li>Individually responsible for the quality and timeliness of all project deliverables, including executing client Operational Instructions, as well as the implementation of relevant project management practices (status reporting, issue tracking etc.)</li><li>Conduct new client training</li><li>Attend meetings and training as required to continue development and to enhance knowledge of cash management products, processes, and industry knowledge</li><li>Ability to prioritize daily workload to maximize productivity</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Basic Qualifications:</strong></p><ul><li>Bachelor’s Degree or Military Experience or Equivalent Work Experience</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p><ul><li>At least 4 years of detailed knowledge of Treasury Management products and an understanding of the sales process</li><li>At least 4 years of customer service experience</li><li>Must be able to work under minimal supervision and work well under pressure</li><li>Must be able to influence others</li><li>Technical skills</li><li>Leadership Skills</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>“Mindlance is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of – Minority/Gender/Disability/Religion/LGBTQI/Age/Veterans.”</strong></p>

metadata.description: <p>Analytica is seeking a <strong>Senior Economist </strong>to support one or more dynamic, long-term federal government regulatory programs. The Senior Economist will lead the economic evaluation of proposed federal safety regulations, developing complex benefit/cost models and conducting comprehensive market analyses. This role is pivotal in providing expert insights to high-level decision-makers, evaluating the financial health of industry firms, and providing expert testimony in legal proceedings related to regulatory actions.  </p><p>Analytica has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing 250 businesses in the US for 3 years. We work with U.S. government clients in health, civilian, and national security missions to build better technology products that impact our day-to-day lives. The company offers competitive compensation with opportunities for bonuses, employer-paid health care, training and development funds, and 401k match.   </p><p> <br><strong>Responsibilities include (but not limited to): </strong></p><ul><li><p>Regulatory Modeling: Develop robust statistical and regression models to evaluate the impact of proposed federal rules and standards. </p></li><li><p>Cost-Benefit Analysis: Conduct high-level data analyses to build repeatable benefit/cost models for regulatory evaluations. </p></li><li><p>Market Intelligence: Synthesize large volumes of industry data for public and private firms to assess market health and competitive impacts. </p></li><li><p>Advanced Analytics: Leverage Python, SQL, and Machine Learning to extract maximum value from existing large-scale datasets. </p></li><li><p>Safety Evaluation: Review medical expenditure and survey data to determine the effectiveness of health and safety interventions. </p></li><li><p>Expert Consultation: Conduct technical interviews with industry executives and subject matter experts to inform economic research. </p></li><li><p>Litigation Support: Provide expert testimony and detailed uncertainty assessments for research used in regulatory legal proceedings. </p></li><li><p>Project Leadership: Lead complex analytical projects characterized by high levels of public impact and data uncertainty. </p></li></ul><p><strong> Required Qualifications: </strong></p><ul><li><p>Regulatory Expertise: 10+ years conducting complex cost-benefit analyses and regulatory evaluations for federal or state agencies, including the development of robust, repeatable economic models. </p></li><li><p>Specialized Safety Analysis: 3+ years evaluating the effectiveness of health/safety interventions and estimating the tangible and non-tangible impacts of non-fatal injuries using medical expenditure and survey data. </p></li><li><p>Field Research &amp; Standards: 3+ years conducting technical interviews with industry executives and subject matter experts, with specific experience reviewing mandatory or voluntary product standards. </p></li><li><p>Project Leadership: Extensive experience managing large-scale analytical projects characterized by high levels of data uncertainty and significant public policy impact. </p></li><li><p>US citizen with Ability to secure a US Federal Clearance </p></li></ul><p><strong>Highly Desired Skills: </strong></p><ul><li><p>Cloud-Native Economics: 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying economic models using Python within an Azure cloud environment. </p></li><li><p>Advanced Data Manipulation: Mastery of SQL for querying disparate datasets and expert-level MS Excel proficiency (arrays, financial, and statistical modeling). </p></li><li><p>Modern Tooling: Familiarity with leveraging Machine Learning and automated data-gathering tools to assess market health and industry-wide competitive impacts. <br></p></li></ul>About ANALYTICA: Analytica is a leading consulting and information technology solutions provider to public sector organizations supporting health, civilian, and national security missions. metadata.description: <strong>Department Summary<br><br></strong>The Epidemiology department in the Fielding School of Public Health is a national leader in preparing a new generation of epidemiologists. Through specialized methodologies, epidemiologists identify, track, and analyze how diseases and other conditions are caused, transmitted, and prevented, as well as how they are distributed throughout the population. Such information plays a critical role in guiding policies and other evidence-based strategies to promote health and work toward health equity. The vital importance of epidemiologic research was highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic, in which epidemiologists have helped to track outbreaks and provide guidance on how the virus spreads in community settings.<br><br><strong>Position Summary<br><br></strong>This position is based in Los Angeles, CA and requires international travel to locations where the UCLA-DRC Research group is conducting several studies on emerging infectious diseases and vaccine preventable diseases, including but not limited to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Peru, Indonesia, and Turkey. Research Data Analyst 3 (RDA3) will coordinate and manage research activities including project planning implementation, and evaluation as well as manuscript preparation. The RDA3 is the senior research staff member based in the U.S. and is responsible for overseeing U.S. based subcontracts and their research assistant staff as well as supervising graduate student workers. He/She will be responsible for coordinating complex research projects that require coordination with multiple collaborating staff, sites and investigators. Specifically, he/she will lead the development of study protocols, questionnaires, guides and data collection forms and will help manage logistics for study implementation and data dissemination. The RDA3 will also coordinate regulatory aspects of research studies, including but not limited to the development, review and submission of Institutional Review Board and Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee applications for new studies as well as the revision and re-submission of documents for existing studies. He/She will collaborate with community groups, DRC-based-staff and research collaborators to implement study activities. These may include visits to potential study sites, leading training activities, and delivering presentations or participating in study meetings. He/She will represent the UCLA-DRC Research Program in the DRC and elsewhere and serve as a liaison with collaborating agencies, funders, and co-investigators. The RDA3's duties may include travel to remote and rural areas to participate in data collection. The RDA3 will lead analytic efforts on qualitative and quantitative data, prepare and deliver presentations, conduct literature reviews, write proposal content, and contribute to the development, editing and submission of manuscripts related to UCLA-DRC Research Program research. He/She will oversee project supply inventory for all research projects to ensure research materials are appropriately handled and distributed.<br><br><strong>Salary &amp; Compensation<br><br></strong><ul><li>UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. metadata.description: <p><strong>DO NOT REACH OUT DIRECTLY TO QUIRE OR ANY OF ITS TEAM. QUIRE WILL REACH OUT TO CANDIDATES DIRECTLY WITH NEXT STEPS IF YOU ARE A FIT FOR THE ROLE.</strong></p><p><strong>ABOUT QUIRE</strong></p><p><br></p><p>At Quire, we are builders and innovators.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire operates at the intersection of craftsmanship and strategic finance, specializing in media, technology, and consumer convergence—value creation where content, technology, and commerce meet. We serve enterprise leaders: public and private founders/CEOs, boards, corporate owners, and select PE/VC sponsors and family offices. Our standard is atelier-level quality, speed, and discretion.</p><p><br></p><p>Our work focuses on two strategic areas.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ol><li><strong>Innovation &amp; Growth</strong>: Our innovation and growth teams build strategic plans to support revenue and market share growth, including investment banking services. Innovation &amp; Growth clients seek ways to grow much faster, achieve deeper competitive differentiation, and demand a clearer sense of potential exit valuations.</li><li><strong>Restructuring</strong>: Our restructuring teams eliminate costs, build new strategies, and support repositioning or relaunch. Restructuring clients typically have failed to achieve strategic plans and goals, and, often, have limited capital and time to build and execute a new strategic and financial plan.&nbsp;</li></ol><p><br></p><p>Our projects are all highly structured and use teams made up of remote consultants who are domain experts. Consultants are compensated based on expertise and experience. Quire pays a premium of 25% - 40% above market on average to ensure the best talent.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire’s clients are highly sophisticated and demand excellence.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>To ensure we are always raising our standards, Quire maintains values that define our work and culture.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Exceptional Quality</strong>. We strive in all instances to contribute ideas, recommendations, and work product that is of exceptional quality. Quire’s standard is often higher than both that of our clients and the market.&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Client Value</strong>. Our strategic solutions must deliver clear, quantifiable value to clients. We achieve this through how we connect innovative strategic ideas with world-class financial and valuation analysis.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Creative Scarcity</strong>. Quire deeply values creativity and appreciates its scarcity. We maintain space to nurture creativity and are constantly pursuing ways to apply new creative solutions and technologies to solve problems and build new products and forms of content.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>All new consultants who hope to work with Quire must provide information on how your prior work, key skills, and values align with Quire's requirements.&nbsp;</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>Financial Analyst – Terrestrial Radio</strong></p><p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><p><strong>Quire is seeking a highly experienced Financial Analyst from the radio sector</strong>.<strong> </strong>This role will serve as a core financial engine for a client, managing day-to-day <strong>FP&amp;A activities</strong> while providing critical support during a transformative <strong>bridge capital raise</strong> and eventual <strong>M&amp;A exit</strong>. </p><p><br></p><p>Reporting directly to the <strong>fractional CFO</strong>, you will own the maintenance and continuous refinement of the company's multi-year financial model, delivering dashboard reporting on cash burn, revenue projections, and core industry KPIs. </p><p><br></p><p>Beyond standard reporting, you will be a key liaison for <strong>investment bankers</strong>, preparing high-stakes presentation materials, managing the granular data requirements for <strong>due diligence</strong> (FDD), and building the scenario models necessary to justify valuation during a sell-side process. This position requires a "doer" who can translate raw data into the narrative needed to secure interim funding and demonstrate maximum value to potential acquirers.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field; advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CFA, MBA) are a plus.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5+ years of hands-on financial modeling experience, with a focus local media.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Prior experience within local media (radio or tv) required.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>Bridge Funding Support: </strong>Developing short-term cash flow forecasts and rolling projections to satisfy the immediate reporting needs of bridge lenders.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>M&amp;A Readiness:</strong> Coordinating the sell-side data room, identifying audit adjustments in management accounts, and ensuring all financial records are audit-ready for buyer scrutiny.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>Banking Liaison: </strong>Assisting investment bankers by conducting comparable company analysis and precedent transaction research to support valuation negotiations.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>Strategic Reporting: </strong>Designing and executing monthly reporting packages that provide clear visibility into business performance for board members and potential stakeholders.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<strong>Scenario Modeling: </strong>Maintain integrated 3-statement models to test different deal structures, financing options, and the impact of the capital raise on long-term liquidity.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into actionable insights.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with strong working knowledge of PowerPoint and Word; experience with financial AI tools is a plus.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain financial concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Strong logical reasoning, structured thinking, and the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p><p><span>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Bachelor’s degree </span></p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;5+ years of relevant experience in local media</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Experience contributing to investor or capital formation processes preferred. </p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously under tight timelines.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Strong written communication</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Ability to work efficiently with senior leaders and project teams</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Compensation (CONTRACT)</strong></p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span>Compensation for this role is based on experience and ranges from</span><strong> $45 to $65 per hour</strong><span>, with a potential for a higher scale based on more complex creative work. We will pay a premium for candidates with extensive experience in terrestrial radio.</span></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>To be considered for this role, you MUST provide the following to hiring@thequire.com</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A brief summary (3–4 sentences) of your experience relevant to this area.</p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;An example of past financial analyses you have conducted and FP&amp;A responsibilities. </p><p>●&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Detail on your timing to start and ability to work remotely.</p><p><br></p><p><span>You will be working as a contractor, not an employee.&nbsp;The work is highly complex, fast-paced, and requires the utmost skill and professionalism.</span> <span>This position is remote, with no travel required.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>Quire is an Equal Opportunity Contractor committed to a diversified and inclusive workforce. We value you, your skills, and your ability to contribute to our clients over any other factors.&nbsp;</span></p>

metadata.description: <strong>Department Summary<br><br></strong>The Epidemiology department in the Fielding School of Public Health is a national leader in preparing a new generation of epidemiologists. Through specialized methodologies, epidemiologists identify, track, and analyze how diseases and other conditions are caused, transmitted, and prevented, as well as how they are distributed throughout the population. Such information plays a critical role in guiding policies and other evidence-based strategies to promote health and work toward health equity. The vital importance of epidemiologic research was highlighted by the COVID-19 pandemic, in which epidemiologists have helped to track outbreaks and provide guidance on how the virus spreads in community settings.<br><br><strong>Position Summary<br><br></strong>This position is based in Los Angeles, CA and requires international travel to locations where the UCLA-DRC Research group is conducting several studies on emerging infectious diseases and vaccine preventable diseases, including but not limited to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Peru, Indonesia, and Turkey. Research Data Analyst 3 (RDA3) will coordinate and manage research activities including project planning implementation, and evaluation as well as manuscript preparation. The RDA3 is the senior research staff member based in the U.S. and is responsible for overseeing U.S. based subcontracts and their research assistant staff as well as supervising graduate student workers. He/She will be responsible for coordinating complex research projects that require coordination with multiple collaborating staff, sites and investigators. Specifically, he/she will lead the development of study protocols, questionnaires, guides and data collection forms and will help manage logistics for study implementation and data dissemination. The RDA3 will also coordinate regulatory aspects of research studies, including but not limited to the development, review and submission of Institutional Review Board and Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee applications for new studies as well as the revision and re-submission of documents for existing studies. He/She will collaborate with community groups, DRC-based-staff and research collaborators to implement study activities. These may include visits to potential study sites, leading training activities, and delivering presentations or participating in study meetings. He/She will represent the UCLA-DRC Research Program in the DRC and elsewhere and serve as a liaison with collaborating agencies, funders, and co-investigators. The RDA3's duties may include travel to remote and rural areas to participate in data collection. The RDA3 will lead analytic efforts on qualitative and quantitative data, prepare and deliver presentations, conduct literature reviews, write proposal content, and contribute to the development, editing and submission of manuscripts related to UCLA-DRC Research Program research. He/She will oversee project supply inventory for all research projects to ensure research materials are appropriately handled and distributed.<br><br><strong>Salary &amp; Compensation<br><br></strong><ul><li>UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. Salary offers at the top of the range are not common. Visit UC Benefit package to discover benefits that start on day one, and UC Total Compensation Estimator to calculate the total compensation value with benefits.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li> Experience in emerging infectious diseases, including monkeypox Ebola, and vaccine preventable diseases including polio and measles (Required) </li><li>2 years Experience living and working on health related projects in Central Africa and Familiarity with rural tropical regions in the developing world. (Required) </li><li> Experience with implementing contracts in a developing country. (Required) </li><li> Experience in analyzing information, situations, problems, policies and procedures to: 1) define problems accurately, 2) separate problems from symptoms, 3) identify potential solutions. (Required) </li><li> Experience in computer software for data management and analysis, budget preparation, word processing, and communications. (Required) </li><li>Ability to initiate projects, delegate tasks and supervise through completion (Required)</li><li>Ability to work off-site in DRC. (Required)</li><li>Willingness to travel extensively within DRC, including locations considered difficult to reach and extremely rural. (Required)</li><li>Knowledge of rationale for data variables and ability to interpret them to others for use in analysis. (Required)</li><li>Ability to supervise sample collection including phlebotomy, urine collection, and collection of rectal and oral swabs. (Preferred)</li><li>Demonstrated competence in French. (Preferred)</li><li>Skill in conducting literature searches. (Required)</li><li>Ability to work independently, under tight deadlines. (Required)</li><li>Ability to interact diplomatically, yet effectively with individuals from various social, cultural and ethnic backgrounds. (Required)</li><li>Extensive knowledge of emerging infectious diseases, including monkeypox Ebola, and vaccine preventable diseases including polio and measles. (Preferred)</li><li>Ability to forecast and control expenses and well as skill in financial analysis.
