metadata.description: <strong>Overview<br><br></strong><strong>THE ROLE: <br><br></strong>Enable smarter investment and faster learning by redefining ambiguous business challenges into evidence-based decisions, not just documented requirements.<br><br>This role exists to reduce strategic and execution risk by uncovering the real problems, validating assumptions, and guiding teams toward solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will operate at the intersection of strategy, data, and discovery, crafting what should be built and why—before it is fully specified.<br><br>This is not a traditional “requirements gathering” role.<br><br>You will:<br><br><ul><li>Work in problem spaces before solutions are known</li><li>Challenge assumptions embedded in requests and roadmaps</li><li>Use analysis, data, and experimentation to guide decisions</li><li>Help leadership decide where to invest, pivot, or stop<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>HOW YOU WOULD CONTRIBUTE: <br><br></strong>Problem Framing &amp; Strategic Discovery<br><br><ul><li>Partner with business, product, UX, and engineering leaders to reframe requests into solvable business problems</li><li>Identify underlying drivers behind symptoms, feature requests, and collaborator demands </li><li>Surface assumptions, risks, and unknowns early—before large investments are made</li><li>Translate strategic objectives into clear decision questions, not just requirements<br><br><br></li></ul>Experimentation &amp; Assumption Validation<br><br><ul><li>Design and support business experiments, pilots, and discovery efforts</li><li>Define hypotheses, success criteria, and measurable outcomes</li><li>Use qualitative and quantitative analysis to validate or invalidate assumptions</li><li>Enable early go / no-go/pivot decisions based on evidence<br><br><br></li></ul>Data-Driven Insight &amp; Decision Support<br><br><ul><li>Perform data analysis to uncover patterns, opportunities, and risks</li><li>Develop arguments focused on learning value and optionality, not just the return on investment </li><li>Build decision frameworks that balance value, feasibility, risk, and timing </li><li>Translate complex analysis into executive-ready insights and recommendations<br><br><br></li></ul>Future-State Thinking &amp; Value Design<br><br><ul><li>Define future-state business capabilities and workflows advised by insight</li><li>Find opportunities for process simplification, automation, and digital enablement </li><li>Help build solution approaches collaboratively with UX and engineering </li><li>Ensure business intent is preserved from discovery through delivery<br><br><br></li></ul>Innovation → Scale Enablement<br><br><ul><li>Resolve when business understanding is sufficient to lock requirements</li><li>Support the transition from exploration to delivery with clarity and focus within the field </li><li>Ensure requirements, success metrics, and value hypotheses are well-defined for scale teams</li><li>Maintain traceability between the original problem, insight, and delivered outcome<br><br><br></li></ul>Stakeholder Facilitation &amp; Influence<br><br><ul><li>Facilitate workshops focused on decision-making, not documentation</li><li>Align diverse collaborators around evidence rather than opinion </li><li>Act as a trusted advisor to leadership during periods of uncertainty</li><li>Mentor other analysts in analysis approaches focused on learning and adaptation <br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><strong>SKILLS AND BACKGROUND REQUIRED TO BE SUCCESSFUL: <br><br></strong><ul><li> 7+ years of progressive business analysis experience; demonstrated success leading analysis for large-scale, complex initiatives across multiple business domains</li><li> Demonstrated impact across both early-stage discovery and scaled initiatives</li><li> Advanced business analysis, requirements elicitation, and problem structuring</li><li> Analysis and insight generation based on careful evaluation</li><li> Process mapping and optimization (BPMN, process flow diagrams)</li><li> Data analysis, interpretation, and business intelligence</li><li> Collaborator facilitation under ambiguity</li><li> Argument decision framework development, development, and return on investment analysis</li><li> Comfort working without predefined solutions</li><li> Ability to challenge senior collaborators respectfully with evidence</li><li> Bias toward learning and early validation</li><li> Strong systems-thinking and value-chain awareness</li><li> Ability to translate insight into clear strategic direction</li><li> Proven track record of optimally delivering complex business analysis projects with measurable outcomes</li><li> Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to address complex business challenges</li><li> Expertise in requirements documentation techniques and tools</li><li> Excellent facilitation skills managing diverse collaborator groups with competing priorities</li><li> Ability to think strategically while maintaining attention to detail</li><li> Experience supporting innovation labs, pilots, or transformation initiatives</li><li> Familiarity with agile discovery, dual-track delivery, or experimentation models</li><li> Understanding of UX research and engineering feasibility considerations</li><li> Knowledge of specific business domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, retail, manufacturing)</li><li> Experience with business process management and workflow automation</li><li> capabilities</li><li> Experience guiding organizational transformation and adaptation<br><br><br></li></ul>Education<br><br><ul><li> Minimum: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information metadata.description: <p><strong>bout Turing:</strong></p><p>Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.</p><p>Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&amp;L</p><p><br></p><p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p><p>We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p><ul><li>Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.</li><li>Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.</li><li>Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.</li><li>Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.</li><li>Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.</li><li>Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.</li><li>Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p><ul><li>Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.</li><li>Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.</li><li>Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).</li><li>Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.</li><li>High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.</li><li>Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.</li><li>Good written communication skills in English.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p><ul><li>Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.</li><li>Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.</li><li>Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Perks of Freelancing With Turing:</strong></p><ul><li>Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.</li><li>Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.</li><li>Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.</li><li>Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Offer Details:</strong></p><ul><li>Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.</li><li>Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).</li><li>Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Application Process:</strong></p><ul><li>Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.</li><li>Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.</strong></p><p><br></p><p>Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.</p>

QUIRE WILL REACH OUT TO CANDIDATES DIRECTLY WITH NEXT STEPS IF YOU ARE A FIT FOR THE ROLE.</strong></p><p><strong>ABOUT QUIRE</strong></p><p><br></p><p>At Quire, we are builders and innovators.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire operates at the intersection of craftsmanship and strategic finance, specializing in media, technology, and consumer convergence - value creation where content, technology, and commerce meet. We serve enterprise leaders: public and private founders/CEOs, boards, corporate owners, and select PE/VC sponsors and family offices. Our standard is atelier-level quality, speed, and discretion.</p><p><br></p><p>Our work focuses on two strategic areas.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Innovation &amp; Growth</strong>: Our innovation and growth teams build strategic plans to support revenue and market share growth, including relevant financial and valuation analysis. Innovation &amp; Growth clients seek ways to grow much faster, achieve deeper competitive differentiation, and demand a clearer sense of potential exit valuations.</li></ul><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Restructuring</strong>: Our restructuring teams eliminate costs, build new strategies, and support repositioning or relaunch. Restructuring clients typically have failed to achieve strategic plans and goals, and, often, have limited capital and time to build and execute a new strategic and financial plan.&nbsp;</li></ul><p><br></p><p>Our projects are all highly structured and use teams made up of remote consultants who are domain experts. Consultants are compensated based on expertise and experience. Quire pays a premium of 25% - 40% above market on average to ensure the best talent.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Quire’s clients are highly sophisticated and demand excellence.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>To ensure we are always raising our standards, Quire maintains values that define our work and culture.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><ul><li><strong>Exceptional Quality</strong>. We strive in all instances to contribute ideas, recommendations, and work product that are of exceptional quality. Quire’s standard is often higher than both that of our clients and the market.&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Focus on Client Value</strong>. Our strategic solutions must deliver clear, quantifiable value to clients. We achieve this through how we connect innovative strategic ideas with world-class financial and valuation analysis.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li><li><strong>Creative Scarcity</strong>. Quire deeply values creativity and appreciates its scarcity. We maintain space to nurture creativity and are constantly pursuing ways to apply new creative solutions and technologies to solve problems and build new products and forms of content.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>All new consultants who hope to work with Quire must provide information on how your prior work, key skills, and values align with Quire's requirements.&nbsp;</strong></p><p><br></p><p><span>We are seeking a highly skilled</span><strong> Project Manager</strong><span> to lead both internal and client&nbsp; projects across our Strategic Advisory and Capital Partners business verticals.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>This role is responsible for driving the team's </span><strong>productivity</strong><span>, ensuring the</span><strong> timely delivery of high-quality work</strong><span> that aligns with project and company standards. They </span><strong>collaborate across disciplines</strong><span> to define and achieve the project's goals, fostering</span><strong> efficient workflows and maintaining excellence</strong><span> throughout development. The Project Manager role requires a </span><strong>strategic thinker, operator, and executor</strong><span> who thrives in fast-paced, high-performance environments.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>Our preference is for candidates from Strategic Advisory, Consultancy, Wall Street or Private Equity, particularly those with direct experience in client-facing projects. Candidates with relevant backgrounds in other industries will also be considered if they possess strong project management knowledge and business experience.</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>You will work with a group of highly experienced consultants, strategists, financial analysts, operators and subject matter experts as part of a client engagement which means every deliverable must be the highest quality. </span><span>Because of the nature of our projects, the working environment is very fast-paced, requires the highest professionalism, and is stressful for those who are not truly world-class contributors.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p><span>Candidates must consistently exhibit exceptional self-discipline and professionalism. You will play a pivotal role in translating our value proposition to potential clients and providing them with the highest-quality deliverables.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p><strong>DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU DO NOT HAVE THE REQUISITE EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS.</strong></p><p><br></p><p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p><ul><li><span>This position is paid hourly as a 1099 contractor.</span></li><li><span>Compensation for this role is based on experience and ranges from </span><strong>$40 to $50</strong><span> per hour.</span></li><li><span>This opportunity is a contract consultative position.&nbsp; Flexible work schedule and ability to work some nights and weekends may be needed.&nbsp;</span></li><li><span>Candidates must be available during normal business hours, with flexibility for distributed timezones.</span></li></ul><p><em>Quire offers above-market compensation to individuals who maintain the highest standards, possess consummate professional expertise, with all compensation marked-to-market using third-party salary and contractor platforms; those who exceed average experience or efficiency can expect a material premium to market rates.&nbsp;</em></p><p><br></p><p><em>Candidates must be top performers with a strong work ethic and be able to perform in a fast-paced environment. metadata.description: We improve lives<br><br>The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment.<br><br><strong>About This Position<br><br></strong>We are looking for a driven, committed, rigorous data scientist. As a data scientist, you will apply your analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills to strengthen the data foundations that power the IDB’s open knowledge ecosystem.<br><br>You will work in the Felipe Herrera Library team, part of the Knowledge and Learning Division, which is responsible for promoting and disseminating open knowledge produced by the Bank and ensuring the quality of metadata in the public-facing publications and data catalogs. You will work closely with library specialists responsible for interoperability, taxonomy, metadata, and knowledge product catalogs, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality data flows, actionable insights, and reliable analytical support for KLD’s strategic priorities.<br><br>What you’ll do<br><br><ul><li>Apply knowledge of NLP, Generative AI, and LLMs to assist with classification tasks, controlled vocabulary alignment, entity/keyword extraction, and metadata enrichment in collaboration with taxonomy specialists.</li><li>Systematically and comprehensively review the quality, completeness, and relevance of existing metadata applied across publications, datasets, and other knowledge assets, leveraging algorithmic or agentic approaches to ensure consistency, accuracy, reliability and alignment with IDB standards and best practices to enhance discoverability. </li><li>Align metadata across different standards and schemas, including internal taxonomies, external vocabularies, and industry frameworks such as Schema.org, DataCite, Dublin Core, and DCAT-3 to promote interoperability and a consistent user experience across IDB platforms.</li><li>Support structured metadata-cleanup, enrichment, and retagging cycles, applying data-driven methods to update, adjust, or remove metadata to improve discoverability, classification accuracy, and semantic clarity.</li><li>Analyze metadata usage patterns across systems and databases (publications catalog, open data catalog, knowledge graphs, search tools, etc.) to identify inconsistencies, redundancies, gaps, and opportunities for improved coherence and interoperability.</li><li>Partner with team members managing interoperability and metadata standards to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve data issues, recommending systematic improvements and AI-driven solutions that enhance end-to-end data quality, including the design of automated or semi-automated business rules and validation routines (e.g., scripts, checks, dashboards) to continuously monitor metadata quality, flag anomalies, recommend corrective actions and strengthen metadata governance.</li><li>Support the process of updating the IDB’s knowledge taxonomy, including metadata mapping between legacy and current terms and across projects and analyzing terminology usage and user search logs to inform design decisions. </li><li>Apply Search Engine Optimization (SEO) principles to metadata to improve the visibility and ranking of IDB knowledge products in search platforms.</li><li>Produce concise technical documentation—including data dictionaries, mappings, workflow descriptions, and process notes as necessary—to ensure transparency and continuity across projects.<br><br></li></ul>What you'll need<br><br>Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in data science, computer science, library science, taxonomy, or other fields relevant to the responsibilities of the role.<br><br>Experience: At least 2 years of experience in the following:<br><br><ul><li>Strong grounding in metadata standards, controlled vocabularies, and classification systems.</li><li>Skills in SQL, Python, and working with APIs to retrieve, process, and clean metadata.</li><li>Ability to build dashboards or reports using modern BI tools.</li><li>Experience applying AI/LLMs or automation techniques to metadata or data‑quality workflows.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to evaluate and improve data quality across systems.</li><li>Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.<br><br></li></ul>Languages: Proficiency in Spanish and English, spoken and written, is required. Additional knowledge of French and Portuguese is preferable.<br><br><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong><strong>Citizenship:</strong> You are a citizen of one of our 48-member countries. Must be eligible to work in job location(s) without the need for sponsorship.<br><br><strong>Consanguinity:</strong> You have no family members (up to fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab.<br><br>Type of contract and duration<br><br><ul><li>Local Remote Consultant Full-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility) rendered 100% remotely from place of residence of the selected candidate. Services are expected to be provided from a country where the IDB Group has offices.<br><br></li></ul>What we offer<br><br>The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include:<br><br><ul><li>A competitive compensation package.</li><li>Leave and vacations: 2 days per month of contract + gender-neutral parental leave.</li><li>Health Insurance: The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance for the purchase of health insurance.</li><li>Savings plan: The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance.</li><li>Fully remote modality.</li><li>Development support: We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more.</li><li>Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees.<br><br></li></ul>Our culture<br><br>At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions.<br><br>In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives.<br><br>We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org.
